; ============================================================================================
; 16216588 OS (GM 6.5L diesel ECM, OBD2) + calibration 09389101 - fully noted listing, ECTS bug FIXED
; Traced only from the image bytes (reset/interrupt vectors, far-call wrappers, J1850 service
; descriptors, verified code tables, cal PID records) - no outside entry-point list. Every byte matches
; the original except F77C (D1 -> C1) and the ROM checksum ($D7C1 -> $D7B1).
; Layout: RAM/I-O equates, bank 0 ($2000-$FFFF, calibration inline), bank 1 ($8000-$FFFF).
; Line format:  instruction ; addr  bytes  plain-language note | analysis / OBD1 notes
; Routine banners give a summary and the callers. To assemble, use the split files in the project
; (equates.inc, cal_<pn>.inc, bank0.asm, bank1.asm) with MGTEK asm11.
; ============================================================================================

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; load_EEPROM_shadows_5914
;   analysis [high]: Cold-start copy of the internal EEPROM ($0E00 block) into RAM shadows: 0E04-0E1F ->
;        1824-183F, 0E20-0E37 -> 1840-1857, 0E60-0E65 (stored inverted) -> TDC_REF_OFFSET 1858-185D, 0EE0-0EE2
;        (inverted) -> 0036-0038. Returns A = 8-bit sum of the RAM values for the checksum test in the next
;        routine.
;   called from: RESET_entry
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	ldy #$1824                          ; 5917  18 CE 18 24   Y = $1824(6180)
	clra                                ; 591B  4F            A = 0
loc_591C:
	cpx #$0E20                          ; 591C  8C 0E 20      compare X with $0E20(3616)
	bcc loc_592C                        ; 591F  24 0B         if X >= $0E20(3616) goto loc_592C
	ldab $00,x                          ; 5921  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	stab $00,y                          ; 5923  18 E7 00      [Y+0] = B
	aba                                 ; 5926  1B            A += B
	inx                                 ; 5927  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 5928  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_591C                        ; 592A  20 F0         goto loc_591C
loc_592C:

	ldy #$1840                          ; 592F  18 CE 18 40   Y = $1840(6208)

	bcc loc_5943                        ; 5936  24 0B         if X >= $0E38(3640) goto loc_5943
	ldab $00,x                          ; 5938  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	stab $00,y                          ; 593A  18 E7 00      [Y+0] = B
	aba                                 ; 593D  1B            A += B
	inx                                 ; 593E  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 593F  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_5933                        ; 5941  20 F0         goto loc_5933
loc_5943:
	ldx #$0E60                          ; 5943  CE 0E 60      X = $0E60(3680) | TDC offset + marker bytes are stored inverted in EEPROM 0E60-0E65
	ldy #TDC_REF_OFFSET                 ; 5946  18 CE 18 58   Y = &TDC_REF_OFFSET
loc_594A:
	cpx #$0E66                          ; 594A  8C 0E 66      compare X with $0E66(3686)
	bcc loc_595B                        ; 594D  24 0C         if X >= $0E66(3686) goto loc_595B
	ldab $00,x                          ; 594F  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	comb                                ; 5951  53            B = ~B
	stab $00,y                          ; 5952  18 E7 00      [Y+0] = B
	aba                                 ; 5955  1B            A += B
	inx                                 ; 5956  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 5957  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_594A                        ; 5959  20 EF         goto loc_594A
loc_595B:
	ldx #$0EE0                          ; 595B  CE 0E E0      X = $0EE0(3808)
	ldy #EEPROM_shadow                  ; 595E  18 CE 00 36   Y = &EEPROM_shadow
loc_5962:
	cpx #tdc_v0EE3                      ; 5962  8C 0E E3      compare X with &tdc_v0EE3
	bcc loc_5973                        ; 5965  24 0C         if X >= &tdc_v0EE3 goto loc_5973
	ldab $00,x                          ; 5967  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	comb                                ; 5969  53            B = ~B
	stab $00,y                          ; 596A  18 E7 00      [Y+0] = B
	aba                                 ; 596D  1B            A += B
	inx                                 ; 596E  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 596F  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_5962                        ; 5971  20 EF         goto loc_5962
loc_5973:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; check_EEPROM_sum_TDC_offset_5974
;   analysis [medium]: Compares the shadow sum (A) with EEPROM checksum byte $0EE3. Bad sum: clears $0036, sets
;        $0037-38=$FFFF, sets P1214 and defaults the TDC offset (TDC_REF_OFFSET=0, marker $185A=$BD). Good sum:
;        marker $AC = learned offset valid -> clears P1214; any other marker -> TDC offset defaulted to 0/$BD
;        without a code.
;   called from: RESET_entry
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_EEPROM_sum_TDC_offset_5974:
	cmpa >tdc_v0EE3                     ; 5974  B1 0E E3      compare A with tdc_v0EE3 | A = sum of shadow bytes from load_EEPROM_shadows; $0EE3 = stored EEPROM checksum
	bne loc_5982                        ; 5977  26 09         if A != tdc_v0EE3 goto loc_5982
	ldaa >TDC_offset_valid_marker       ; 5979  B6 18 5A      A = TDC_offset_valid_marker | $AC in $185A marks a learned/valid TDC offset; $BD = defaulted
	cmpa #$AC                           ; 597C  81 AC         compare A with $AC(172)
	beq loc_59A8                        ; 597E  27 28         if TDC_offset_valid_marker == $AC(172) goto loc_59A8
	bra loc_599B                        ; 5980  20 19         goto loc_599B
loc_5982:
	clr >EEPROM_shadow                  ; 5982  7F 00 36      EEPROM_shadow = 0
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 5985  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
	std <$37                            ; 5988  DD 37         [$37] = D
	brclr <$0B,$80,loc_5992             ; 598A  13 0B 80 04   if [$0B] .7 clear goto loc_5992 | skip re-reporting if code already current and latched (pattern used before every DTC set)
	brset <$2B,$80,loc_599B             ; 598E  12 2B 80 09   if [$2B] .7 set goto loc_599B
loc_5992:
	ldaa #$01                           ; 5992  86 01         A = 1
	ldy #DTC_P1214                      ; 5994  18 CE 52 47   Y = &DTC_P1214
	jsr >DTC_set_clear_farcall          ; 5998  BD 7D A9      report DTC_P1214: A!=0 set / A=0 clear
loc_599B:
	ldd #$0000                          ; 599B  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	std >TDC_REF_OFFSET                 ; 599E  FD 18 58      TDC_REF_OFFSET = D
	ldaa #$BD                           ; 59A1  86 BD         A = $BD(189)
	staa >TDC_offset_valid_marker       ; 59A3  B7 18 5A      TDC_offset_valid_marker = A
	bra loc_59B8                        ; 59A6  20 10         goto loc_59B8
loc_59A8:
	brset <$0B,$80,loc_59B0             ; 59A8  12 0B 80 04   if [$0B] .7 set goto loc_59B0
	brset <$1B,$80,loc_59B8             ; 59AC  12 1B 80 08   if [$1B] .7 set goto loc_59B8
loc_59B0:
	clra                                ; 59B0  4F            A = 0
	ldy #DTC_P1214                      ; 59B1  18 CE 52 47   Y = &DTC_P1214
	jsr >DTC_set_clear_farcall          ; 59B5  BD 7D A9      report DTC_P1214: A!=0 set / A=0 clear
loc_59B8:
	rts                                 ; 59B8  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; INIT_CRANK_FUEL_CTR
;   analysis [high]: Clears the crank flags in $5A, STARTUP_CTR and the ITS settle counter $19C7, then sets $5A.0.
;        Looks up the crank ITS timing position from tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B vs coolant_temp into
;        ITS_Cold_Base. If ITS_TIMING_POSITION >= CAL_ITS_RESET_INIT_LIMIT it is reset to that crank position.
;   OBD1 INIT_CRANK_FUEL_CTR (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: RESET_entry, ignition_off_powerdown_F615
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
INIT_CRANK_FUEL_CTR:
	clr >crank_ITS_flags                ; 59B9  7F 00 5A      crank_ITS_flags = 0
	clr >STARTUP_CTR                    ; 59BC  7F 19 E3      STARTUP_CTR = 0
	clr >ITS_settle_ctr                 ; 59BF  7F 19 C7      ITS_settle_ctr = 0
	bset <crank_ITS_flags,$01           ; 59C2  14 5A 01      crank_ITS_flags .0 = 1
	ldaa >coolant_temp                  ; 59C5  B6 19 29      A = coolant_temp
	ldx #tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B; 59C8  CE 27 5B      X = &tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B | OBD1: c3...8c
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; 59CB  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B[A]
	staa >ITS_Cold_Base                 ; 59CE  B7 19 C6      ITS_Cold_Base = A
	ldab >ITS_TIMING_POSITION           ; 59D1  F6 01 19      B = ITS_TIMING_POSITION
	cmpb >CAL_ITS_RESET_INIT_LIMIT      ; 59D4  F1 22 AD      compare B with CAL_ITS_RESET_INIT_LIMIT | ITS above limit after reset -> snap position to crank timing target
	bcs loc_59DC                        ; 59D7  25 03         if ITS_TIMING_POSITION < CAL_ITS_RESET_INIT_LIMIT goto loc_59DC
	staa >ITS_TIMING_POSITION           ; 59D9  B7 01 19      ITS_TIMING_POSITION = A
loc_59DC:
	rts                                 ; 59DC  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; init_memory_region
;   analysis [high]: Generic register initialiser. Y points at (offset,value) byte pairs and each value is written
;        to [X+offset]. Stops when the next offset is 0 (only the first entry may use offset 0).
;   OBD1 _init_memory_region (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: init_IOR_registers_59DD, Main_task_scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
init_memory_region:
	ldab $00,y                          ; 5A00  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0]
loc_5A03:
	pshx                                ; 5A03  3C            push X
	abx                                 ; 5A04  3A            X += B
	ldaa $01,y                          ; 5A05  18 A6 01      A = [Y+1]
	staa $00,x                          ; 5A08  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	iny                                 ; 5A0A  18 08         Y++
	iny                                 ; 5A0C  18 08         Y++
	pulx                                ; 5A0E  38            pop X
	ldab $00,y                          ; 5A0F  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0]
	bne loc_5A03                        ; 5A12  26 EF         if B != 0 goto loc_5A03
	rts                                 ; 5A14  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	ldaa >k_368B                        ; 5AC4  B6 36 8B      A = k_368B
	staa >rpm_v1A20                     ; 5AC7  B7 1A 20      rpm_v1A20 = A

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;        watchdog after each block.

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Main_task_scheduler
;   analysis [medium]: Background loop: WAI, then (unless an EEPROM write is pending) verifies the EEPROM shadows.
;        On each tick flag $57.3 it refreshes the DDRA/DDRD/DDRG and IOR config registers, then walks all RAM
;        (0000-03FF, 1820-1FFF) with no-op BSET mask 0. Interleaved with that walk, it sums 2 ROM bytes per 8 RAM
;        bytes, covering bank0 $2006-$FFFF then bank1 $8000-$FFFF. A finished sum not equal to ROM_checksum (an
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Main_task_scheduler:
	ldx #PORTG_PG3_bank_select          ; 5B5C  CE 10 02      X = &PORTG_PG3_bank_select
	bclr $00,x,$08                      ; 5B5F  1D 00 08      PORTG_PG3_bank_select .3 bank select (1=bank1) = 0
	ldx #checksum_skip_AA               ; 5B62  CE 20 06      X = &checksum_skip_AA
	stx >ROM_sum_ptr                    ; 5B65  FF 03 56      ROM_sum_ptr = X
	ldx #ram_v0000                      ; 5B68  CE 00 00      X = &ram_v0000

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; verify_EEPROM_shadows_5C80
;   analysis [high]: Background check that each RAM shadow (see load_EEPROM_shadows) still equals its EEPROM byte,
;        and that their sum equals $0EE3. The first mismatch queues an EEPROM rewrite for the TOC/PPROG interrupt
;        (out_EEPROM_PPROG_6614): $57.1=pending, $58 = EEPROM offset low byte, $59 = value to write.
;   called from: Main_task_scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
verify_EEPROM_shadows_5C80:
	ldx #$0E04                          ; 5C80  CE 0E 04      X = $0E04(3588)
	ldy #$1824                          ; 5C83  18 CE 18 24   Y = $1824(6180)
	clra                                ; 5C87  4F            A = 0
loc_5C88:
	cpx #$0E20                          ; 5C88  8C 0E 20      compare X with $0E20(3616)
	bcc loc_5C9A                        ; 5C8B  24 0D         if X >= $0E20(3616) goto loc_5C9A
	ldab $00,y                          ; 5C8D  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0]
	aba                                 ; 5C90  1B            A += B
	cmpb $00,x                          ; 5C91  E1 00         compare B with [X+0]
	bne loc_5CEC                        ; 5C93  26 57         if [Y+0] != [X+0] goto loc_5CEC
	inx                                 ; 5C95  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 5C96  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_5C88                        ; 5C98  20 EE         goto loc_5C88
loc_5C9A:
	ldx #$0E20                          ; 5C9A  CE 0E 20      X = $0E20(3616)
	ldy #$1840                          ; 5C9D  18 CE 18 40   Y = $1840(6208)
loc_5CA1:
	cpx #$0E38                          ; 5CA1  8C 0E 38      compare X with $0E38(3640)
	bcc loc_5CB3                        ; 5CA4  24 0D         if X >= $0E38(3640) goto loc_5CB3
	ldab $00,y                          ; 5CA6  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0]
	aba                                 ; 5CA9  1B            A += B
	cmpb $00,x                          ; 5CAA  E1 00         compare B with [X+0]
	bne loc_5CEC                        ; 5CAC  26 3E         if [Y+0] != [X+0] goto loc_5CEC
	inx                                 ; 5CAE  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 5CAF  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_5CA1                        ; 5CB1  20 EE         goto loc_5CA1
loc_5CB3:

	inx                                 ; 5CC8  08            X++
	iny                                 ; 5CC9  18 08         Y++
	bra loc_5CBA                        ; 5CCB  20 ED         goto loc_5CBA

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_ODM_status_hi_5CF7
;   analysis [low]: Reads the ODM fault status over SPI (out_ODM_6D97 A=1, saved in $1BDA/$1BDB). For shift
;        solenoid A and B it builds a 4-bit status (b0 commanded on, b1 off, b2/b3 ODM bit 4/5 fault flags) and
;        runs it through sub_5E1E to update $1BB6 (sol A, used by diag_P0753) and $1BB7 (sol B). Then it runs a
;        second state machine on $1BB9, gated by bits 0/1 of $1BBB and the ODM bit-6 flags.
;   inferred [C, pass A]: writes ODM_status_hi, ODM_shiftA_diag_status, ODM_shiftB_diag_status,
;        ODM_TCC_PWM_diag_status
;   called from: calc_SHIFTPAT_SELECT_90AC
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_ODM_status_hi_5CF7:

	psha                                ; 5CFA  36            push A
	ldaa >PCS_clean_pulse_state         ; 5CFB  B6 1B BB      A = PCS_clean_pulse_state
	psha                                ; 5CFE  36            push A
	ldaa #$01                           ; 5CFF  86 01         A = 1 | read ODM fault status word over SPI
	jsr >ODM_SPI_read_status_6D97       ; 5D01  BD 6D 97      call ODM_SPI_read_status_6D97
	staa >ODM_status_hi                 ; 5D04  B7 1B DA      ODM_status_hi = A
	stab >ram_v1BDB                     ; 5D07  F7 1B DB      ram_v1BDB = B
	pshb                                ; 5D0A  37            push B
	psha                                ; 5D0B  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; 5D0C  30            X = SP + 1
	clrb                                ; 5D0D  5F            B = 0
	ldaa >IOR_1800                      ; 5D0E  B6 18 00      A = IOR_1800 | shift sol A: build status nibble b0 cmd on, b1 cmd off, b2/b3 ODM fault bits
	bita #$10                           ; 5D11  85 10         test IOR_1800 .4 shift solenoid A
	beq loc_5D19                        ; 5D13  27 04         if IOR_1800 .4 shift solenoid A all clear goto loc_5D19

	bra loc_5D1B                        ; 5D17  20 02         goto loc_5D1B

	clrb                                ; 5D30  5F            B = 0

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_ODM_status_hi_part_5DDA
;   analysis [low]: Helper for the $1BB9 state machine. Steps the bit pairs 6->5 and 4->3 of the state byte (X+3),
;        enabled by request bits 0/1 in X+2 and blocked by the ODM bit-6 fault flags.

;   called from: calc_ODM_status_hi_5CF7

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; sub_5E1E
;   analysis [low]: Fault-latch state machine for one shift solenoid. A = previous state, B = status (b0 cmd on,
;        b1 cmd off, b2/b3 driver fault flags). Fault seen in both commanded states sets b3/b4 and then b1 (fault)
;        and clears b0; no fault sets b2 (pass). Returns the new state in A.
;   called from: calc_ODM_status_hi_5CF7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sub_5E1E:

	beq loc_5E4E                        ; 5E20  27 2C         if mask 1 all clear goto loc_5E4E

loc_5E38:

	bita #$10                           ; 5E3C  85 10         test A mask $10(16)

	bra loc_5E9C                        ; 5E62  20 38         goto loc_5E9C

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; run_12ms_job
;   analysis [medium]: 12.5 ms task. Before start/cranking (RPM hi < $50, battery >= $31, no TDC test) it drives
;        the ITS toward the crank position from tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B (ITS_ERROR = (target-pos)/2). Once
;        the error stays at 0 for k_22AC ticks it sets $5A.1. Then it runs the injector-response/P0606 diag and
;        the 360-deg delivery limiter, and calls the bank-1 12.5 ms jobs ($EE4C every other pass via $8F.0). I
;   OBD1 _run_12ms_job (match 0.73 p2-dataref): MODULE START: INJECTION TIMING and WATCHDOG RESET
;   Run every 12.5 ms
;   called from: TOC3_scheduler_ISR_8000
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_12ms_job:
	bset <TASKFLAGS1,$08                ; 5E9D  14 55 08      TASKFLAGS1 .3 12.5 ms job running = 1
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; 5EA0  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM | pre-start only: engine not turning fast, not running, no TDC test, battery OK
	cmpa #$50                           ; 5EA3  81 50         compare A with $50(80)
	bcc loc_5F0E                        ; 5EA5  24 67         if engine_RPM >= $50(80) goto loc_5F0E
	brset <crank_ITS_flags,$80,loc_5F0E ; 5EA7  12 5A 80 63   if crank_ITS_flags .7 set goto loc_5F0E
	brset <TDC_TEST_RUNNING,$01,loc_5F0E; 5EAB  12 45 01 5F   if TDC_TEST_RUNNING .0 set goto loc_5F0E
	ldaa >battery_voltage               ; 5EAF  B6 19 21      A = battery_voltage
	cmpa #$31                           ; 5EB2  81 31         compare A with $31(49)
	bcs loc_5F0E                        ; 5EB4  25 58         if battery_voltage < $31(49) goto loc_5F0E
	brset <crank_ITS_flags,$08,loc_5ED7 ; 5EB6  12 5A 08 1D   if crank_ITS_flags .3 set goto loc_5ED7
	ldaa >coolant_temp                  ; 5EBA  B6 19 29      A = coolant_temp | first pass: target ITS = crank timing table vs ECT, error = signed half of difference
	ldx #tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B; 5EBD  CE 27 5B      X = &tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; 5EC0  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_CRANK_INJ_TIMING_TBL_275B[A]
	staa >ITS_Cold_Base                 ; 5EC3  B7 19 C6      ITS_Cold_Base = A
	suba >ITS_TIMING_POSITION           ; 5EC6  B0 01 19      A -= ITS_TIMING_POSITION
	rora                                ; 5EC9  46            A rotate right thru C
	staa >ITS_ERROR                     ; 5ECA  B7 19 C3      ITS_ERROR = A
	brclr <sys_state_flags,$01,loc_5ED4 ; 5ECD  13 57 01 03   if sys_state_flags .0 clear goto loc_5ED4
	staa >ram_v0493                     ; 5ED1  B7 04 93      ram_v0493 = A
loc_5ED4:
	bset <crank_ITS_flags,$08           ; 5ED4  14 5A 08      crank_ITS_flags .3 = 1
loc_5ED7:
	ldaa >ITS_ERROR                     ; 5ED7  B6 19 C3      A = ITS_ERROR
	bne loc_5EDF                        ; 5EDA  26 03         if A != 0 goto loc_5EDF
	bset <crank_ITS_flags,$10           ; 5EDC  14 5A 10      crank_ITS_flags .4 = 1
loc_5EDF:
	brclr <crank_ITS_flags,$04,loc_5F0E ; 5EDF  13 5A 04 2B   if crank_ITS_flags .2 clear goto loc_5F0E
	brclr <crank_ITS_flags,$10,loc_5F0E ; 5EE3  13 5A 10 27   if crank_ITS_flags .4 clear goto loc_5F0E
	ldaa >ITS_ERROR                     ; 5EE7  B6 19 C3      A = ITS_ERROR
	bne loc_5F0E                        ; 5EEA  26 22         if A != 0 goto loc_5F0E
	ldaa >ITS_settle_ctr                ; 5EEC  B6 19 C7      A = ITS_settle_ctr | ITS on target: count k_22AC ticks (12.5 ms) before declaring ITS ready
	inca                                ; 5EEF  4C            A++
	beq loc_5EFA                        ; 5EF0  27 08         if A == 0 goto loc_5EFA
	staa >ITS_settle_ctr                ; 5EF2  B7 19 C7      ITS_settle_ctr = A
	cmpa >k_ITS_crank_settle_ticks_22AC ; 5EF5  B1 22 AC      compare A with k_ITS_crank_settle_ticks_22AC
	bcs loc_5F0E                        ; 5EF8  25 14         if ITS_settle_ctr < k_ITS_crank_settle_ticks_22AC goto loc_5F0E
loc_5EFA:
	sei                                 ; 5EFA  0F            disable interrupts
	bclr <crank_ITS_flags,$02           ; 5EFB  15 5A 02      crank_ITS_flags .1 = 0
	brclr <ENGMODEFLAG,$80,loc_5F0A     ; 5EFE  13 4C 80 08   if ENGMODEFLAG .7 cranking (STARTUP_CTR <= CAL_MIN_CRANK_C clear goto loc_5F0A
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; 5F02  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	beq loc_5F0A                        ; 5F05  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_5F0A
	bset <crank_ITS_flags,$02           ; 5F07  14 5A 02      crank_ITS_flags .1 = 1
loc_5F0A:
	cli                                 ; 5F0A  0E            enable interrupts
	clr >ITS_settle_ctr                 ; 5F0B  7F 19 C7      ITS_settle_ctr = 0
loc_5F0E:
	jsr >diag_fuel_sol_response_P0606_5F53; 5F0E  BD 5F 53      call diag_fuel_sol_response_P0606_5F53
	jsr >calc_COMMAND_FUEL_DELIV_360FS_60B1; 5F11  BD 60 B1      call calc_COMMAND_FUEL_DELIV_360FS_60B1
	ldaa >PORTG_PG3_bank_select         ; 5F14  B6 10 02      A = PORTG_PG3_bank_select
	psha                                ; 5F17  36            push A
	ldx #PORTG_PG3_bank_select          ; 5F18  CE 10 02      X = &PORTG_PG3_bank_select
	bset $00,x,$08                      ; 5F1B  1C 00 08      PORTG_PG3_bank_select .3 bank select (1=bank1) = 1
	jsr >$C892                          ; 5F1E  BD C8 92      call $C892
	jsr >$F624                          ; 5F21  BD F6 24      call $F624
	jsr >$CBFD                          ; 5F24  BD CB FD      call $CBFD
	brset <task_toggle_25ms,$01,loc_5F2E; 5F27  12 8F 01 03   if task_toggle_25ms .0 skip J1850 session timer (b1:EE4C) in 12 set goto loc_5F2E | $8F.0 toggles every pass -> $EE4C runs every other 12.5 ms (25 ms)
	jsr >$EE4C                          ; 5F2B  BD EE 4C      call $EE4C
loc_5F2E:
	jsr >$F5CE                          ; 5F2E  BD F5 CE      call $F5CE
	sei                                 ; 5F31  0F            disable interrupts
	ldaa <task_toggle_25ms              ; 5F32  96 8F         A = task_toggle_25ms
	eora #$01                           ; 5F34  88 01         A ^= 1
	cli                                 ; 5F36  0E            enable interrupts
	staa <task_toggle_25ms              ; 5F37  97 8F         task_toggle_25ms = A
	jsr >$E8B5                          ; 5F39  BD E8 B5      call $E8B5
	ldx #PORTG_PG3_bank_select          ; 5F3C  CE 10 02      X = &PORTG_PG3_bank_select
	pula                                ; 5F3F  32            pop A
	anda #$08                           ; 5F40  84 08         A &= 8 (keep bits)
	beq loc_5F49                        ; 5F42  27 05         if A == 0 goto loc_5F49
	bset $00,x,$08                      ; 5F44  1C 00 08      PORTG_PG3_bank_select .3 bank select (1=bank1) = 1
	bra loc_5F4C                        ; 5F47  20 03         goto loc_5F4C
loc_5F49:
	bclr $00,x,$08                      ; 5F49  1D 00 08      [X+0] .3 = 0
loc_5F4C:
	jsr >Watchdog_reset                 ; 5F4C  BD 61 06      call Watchdog_reset
	bclr <TASKFLAGS1,$08                ; 5F4F  15 55 08      TASKFLAGS1 .3 12.5 ms job running = 0
	rts                                 ; 5F52  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; diag_fuel_sol_response_P0606_5F53
;   analysis [medium]: Runs with battery inside CAL_diag_MIN/MAXBATT, ECT > MINECTS, RPM > MINRPM and fuel
;        commanded. MEAS_INJ_RSP below CAL_diag_MINRSP counts $1A92 and above CAL_diag_MAXRSP counts $1A93;
;        reaching k_368D sets P1216 (response too short) or P1217 (too long). Also P0606 (counter $1A90): measured
;        pump timing > kw_36FA or TIO $146A > kw_36FC for k_36FE passes. Finally it selects the timing source into
;        $193D

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TOVFL_SERVICE
;   analysis [high]: Timer-overflow ISR: counts TOVFL_CNT (saturating) and TCNT_EXTENSION, and adds 16 to the high
;        bytes of the trans input shaft and 4K VSS 20-bit timestamp extensions (TCNT is used >>4).
;   OBD1 TOVFL_SERVICE (match 1.00 p1-exact): TOVFL flag interrupt
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	staa >TOVFL_CNT                     ; 6530  B7 19 8B      TOVFL_CNT = A

	inca                                ; 6536  4C            A++

	ldaa >TRANS_SHAFT_CTR_EXTENSION     ; 653A  B6 1C 99      A = TRANS_SHAFT_CTR_EXTENSION | OBD1: add 16 to this counter

	adda #$10                           ; 6545  8B 10         A += $10(16)

	rti                                 ; 654F  3B            return from interrupt

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ISR_RTI_EEPROM_write_6614
;   analysis [high]: RTI interrupt (vector FFF0). Background EEPROM byte-write state machine, one step per RTI
;        tick: writes byte [$59] to $0E00+[$58] when request $57.1 is set. Does a byte erase first only when new
;        data needs a 0->1 bit; verifies with EEPROM_program_byte, then clears the request.
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ISR_RTI_EEPROM_write_6614:
	brclr <sys_state_flags,$02,loc_6669 ; 6614  13 57 02 51   if sys_state_flags .1 EEPROM byte rewrite pending ($58/$59) clear goto loc_6669 | $57.1 = EEPROM write request; $58 = offset into EEPROM $0E00, $59 = data (set at 5CEC)
	ldx #eeprom_security_seed           ; 6618  CE 0E 00      X = &eeprom_security_seed
	ldab <EEPROM_write_offset           ; 661B  D6 58         B = EEPROM_write_offset
	abx                                 ; 661D  3A            X += B
	ldaa >PPROG                         ; 661E  B6 10 3B      A = PPROG | PPROG=3 (EELAT|EEPGM): program cycle running -> finish, verify and clear request
	cmpa #$03                           ; 6621  81 03         compare A with 3
	beq loc_6658                        ; 6623  27 33         if PPROG == 3 goto loc_6658
	bita #$04                           ; 6625  85 04         test PPROG .2 | PPROG.2 ERASE set: erase cycle finished -> verify $FF, then start programming
	bne loc_6643                        ; 6627  26 1A         if any of PPROG .2 set goto loc_6643
	ldab $00,x                          ; 6629  E6 00         B = [X+0] | erase needed only if new data needs a bit 0->1 (~old & new != 0)
	comb                                ; 662B  53            B = ~B
	andb <EEPROM_write_value            ; 662C  D4 59         B &= EEPROM_write_value
	beq loc_6648                        ; 662E  27 18         if B == 0 goto loc_6648
	ldaa #$02                           ; 6630  86 02         A = 2 | start byte erase: $16 = BYTE|ERASE|EELAT, then $17 turns on EEPGM
	staa >PPROG                         ; 6632  B7 10 3B      PPROG = A
	ldaa #$16                           ; 6635  86 16         A = $16(22)
	staa >PPROG                         ; 6637  B7 10 3B      PPROG = A
	stab $00,x                          ; 663A  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	ldaa #$17                           ; 663C  86 17         A = $17(23)
	staa >PPROG                         ; 663E  B7 10 3B      PPROG = A
	bra loc_6669                        ; 6641  20 26         goto loc_6669
loc_6643:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; 6643  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	jsr >EEPROM_program_byte            ; 6645  BD 64 2C      call EEPROM_program_byte
loc_6648:
	ldab <EEPROM_write_value            ; 6648  D6 59         B = EEPROM_write_value | program cycle: EELAT, latch data, then EELAT|EEPGM; completes on next RTI
	ldaa #$02                           ; 664A  86 02         A = 2
	staa >PPROG                         ; 664C  B7 10 3B      PPROG = A
	stab $00,x                          ; 664F  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	ldaa #$03                           ; 6651  86 03         A = 3
	staa >PPROG                         ; 6653  B7 10 3B      PPROG = A
	bra loc_6669                        ; 6656  20 11         goto loc_6669
loc_6658:
	ldaa <EEPROM_write_value            ; 6658  96 59         A = EEPROM_write_value
	jsr >EEPROM_program_byte            ; 665A  BD 64 2C      call EEPROM_program_byte
	clr >PPROG                          ; 665D  7F 10 3B      PPROG = 0
	bclr <sys_state_flags,$02           ; 6660  15 57 02      sys_state_flags .1 EEPROM byte rewrite pending ($58/$59) = 0
	clr >EEPROM_write_offset            ; 6663  7F 00 58      EEPROM_write_offset = 0

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; mul_scale_16x8
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 MULFACT2: D = (D * stacked byte) >> 8.
;   OBD1 MULFACT2 (match 1.00 p1-exact): 8x16 Multiply routine
;   Inputs
;   SPi[0] (before call) = Multiplier
;   D - Multiplicand
;   Result in D = (Spi[0] * D) >> 8
;   Saves and restores X but doesn't use it
;   called from: lookup_2D_17pt_word_6883, sub_6FE3, run_25ms_job, pedal_select_filter, engine_load_from_fuel_demand, read_sensors_linearize_EEDD +5 more
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	pshb                                ; 68A5  37            push B | OBD1: 2:1 - Xi, 0 Bi

	mul                                 ; 68AA  3D            D = A * B | OBD1: D = SPi[0] * Ai
	std $00,x                           ; 68AB  ED 00         [X+0] = D | OBD1: 4:3 - Xi, 2 Bi, 1:0 (SPi[0] * Ai)
	ldaa $02,x                          ; 68AD  A6 02         A = [X+2] | OBD1: A = Bi

	clra                                ; 68B5  4F            A = 0
	addd $00,x                          ; 68B6  E3 00         D += [X+0] | OBD1: D = (SPi[0] * Ai) + (Bi * Spi[0]) >> 8

	pulx                                ; 68BA  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; 68BB  39            return

	aslb                                ; 68DB  58            B <<= 1

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; lookup_2D_table
;   analysis [high]: Standard 2D byte-table lookup (header = number of intervals). Falls through into
;        interp_2D_table.
;   OBD1 INTRP1_1 (match 1.00 p1-call)
;   called from: INIT_CRANK_FUEL_CTR, run_12ms_job, RESET_entry, calc_EGR_desired_vac_MAF_70DF, calc_injection_timing, idle_fuel_learn +26 more
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
lookup_2D_table:
	ldab $00,x                          ; 6D06  E6 00         B = [X+0]

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; interp_2D_table
;   analysis [high]: Entry with A=input and B=interval count: scales the input to index and fraction, skips the
;        header, and interpolates (falls into 6D0A).
;   OBD1 LEE58 (match 1.00 p1-call): Another entry to 2D Interpolated Lookup with args:
;   A = Col Count
;   B = Coefficent
;   X = Row Pointer
;   called from: lookup_3D_table
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
interp_2D_table:
	mul                                 ; 6D08  3D            D = A * B | OBD1: D = A * B
	inx                                 ; 6D09  08            X++ | OBD1: ++X

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; interp_row_idx_frac_6D0A
;   analysis [high]: Core interpolation: returns X[A]*(1-B/256) + X[A+1]*B/256. Fall-through target of
;        lookup_2D_table, also called directly by lookup_3D_table.
;   OBD1 LEE5A (match 1.00 p1-exact): 2D Interpolated Lookup
;   X = Row Pointer
;   A = Row Index
;   B = Coefficient
;   Returns A = *(X+A) * (1.0 - B) + *(X+A+1) * B
;   called from: lookup_3D_table
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
interp_row_idx_frac_6D0A:
	pshb                                ; 6D0A  37            push B | OBD1: Save Low Byte
	tab                                 ; 6D0B  16            B = A | OBD1: B = High Byte
	abx                                 ; 6D0C  3A            X += B | OBD1: X += B
	ldd $00,x                           ; 6D0D  EC 00         D = [X+0] | OBD1: Fetch bytes from table
	sba                                 ; 6D0F  10            A -= B | OBD1: Get difference
	pulb                                ; 6D10  33            pop B
	bcc loc_6D19                        ; 6D11  24 06         if A >= 0 goto loc_6D19
	nega                                ; 6D13  40            A = -A
	mul                                 ; 6D14  3D            D = A * B
	adca $00,x                          ; 6D15  A9 00         A += C + [X+0]
	bra loc_6D1F                        ; 6D17  20 06         goto loc_6D1F
loc_6D19:
	mul                                 ; 6D19  3D            D = A * B
	adca #$00                           ; 6D1A  89 00         A += C + 0
	suba $00,x                          ; 6D1C  A0 00         A -= [X+0]
	nega                                ; 6D1E  40            A = -A
loc_6D1F:
	rts                                 ; 6D1F  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; lookup_3D_table
;   analysis [high]: Header-driven 3D table: cols=(hdr&F)+2, rows=(hdr>>4)+2. Interpolates two adjacent rows by
;        column, then between them by row. Result in A.
;   OBD1 LKUP_3D (match 1.00 p1-exact): 3D table lookup, result in A
;   A - Column Coefficient
;   B - Row Coefficient
;   X - Table Address (Points to 1 byte table header)
;   Low nibble of table header is col count - 2
;   High nibble of table hea
;   called from: calc_EGR_desired_vac_MAF_70DF, calc_injection_timing, calc_fuel_timing_modifiers, glow_state0_init_F9B3, glow_state1_preglow_FA6F, boost_control +6 more
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
lookup_3D_table:
	pshx                                ; 6D20  3C            push X | OBD1: 7,8 - Table Header Address
	psha                                ; 6D21  36            push A | OBD1: 6 - Col Coefficient
	pshb                                ; 6D22  37            push B | OBD1: 5 - Row Coefficient
	pshx                                ; 6D23  3C            push X | OBD1: 3,4 - Table Header Address
	pshx                                ; 6D24  3C            push X | OBD1: 1,2 - Table Header Address
	des                                 ; 6D25  34            SP--
	ldaa $00,x                          ; 6D26  A6 00         A = [X+0] | OBD1: Table Header (often 7f)
	tab                                 ; 6D28  16            B = A | OBD1: copy to b
	tsx                                 ; 6D29  30            X = SP + 1 | OBD1: X = SP
	andb #$0F                           ; 6D2A  C4 0F         B &= $0F(15) (keep bits) | OBD1: Low nibble of table header
	incb                                ; 6D2C  5C            B++
	incb                                ; 6D2D  5C            B++
	stab $02,x                          ; 6D2E  E7 02         [X+2] = B | OBD1: *(X+2) = Col Count
	lsra                                ; 6D30  44            A >>= 1
	lsra                                ; 6D31  44            A >>= 1
	lsra                                ; 6D32  44            A >>= 1
	lsra                                ; 6D33  44            A >>= 1 | OBD1: high nibble of table header shifted to low nibble
	inca                                ; 6D34  4C            A++ | OBD1: A = Row Count - 1
	ldab $05,x                          ; 6D35  E6 05         B = [X+5] | OBD1: Original B input
	mul                                 ; 6D37  3D            D = A * B | OBD1: Times header high nibble
	stab $05,x                          ; 6D38  E7 05         [X+5] = B
	ldab $02,x                          ; 6D3A  E6 02         B = [X+2]
	mul                                 ; 6D3C  3D            D = A * B
	addd $03,x                          ; 6D3D  E3 03         D += [X+3]
	std $03,x                           ; 6D3F  ED 03         [X+3] = D | OBD1: Pointer to first row
	ldab $02,x                          ; 6D41  E6 02         B = [X+2] | OBD1: Col Count
	decb                                ; 6D43  5A            B--
	ldaa $06,x                          ; 6D44  A6 06         A = [X+6] | OBD1: Col Coeff
	ldx $03,x                           ; 6D46  EE 03         X = [X+3] | OBD1: Pointer to first row
	bsr interp_2D_table                 ; 6D48  8D BE         call interp_2D_table | OBD1: First Row Lookup
	tsx                                 ; 6D4A  30            X = SP + 1
	staa $00,x                          ; 6D4B  A7 00         [X+0] = A | OBD1: *(X) = First Row Lookup Result
	ldaa $06,x                          ; 6D4D  A6 06         A = [X+6] | OBD1: Col Coeff
	ldab $02,x                          ; 6D4F  E6 02         B = [X+2] | OBD1: Col Cnt
	ldx $03,x                           ; 6D51  EE 03         X = [X+3] | OBD1: First Row
	abx                                 ; 6D53  3A            X += B | OBD1: Skip to second row by adding col count
	decb                                ; 6D54  5A            B--
	bsr interp_2D_table                 ; 6D55  8D B1         call interp_2D_table | OBD1: Second Row Lookup
	tsx                                 ; 6D57  30            X = SP + 1
	staa $01,x                          ; 6D58  A7 01         [X+1] = A | OBD1: Second Result
	ldab $05,x                          ; 6D5A  E6 05         B = [X+5] | OBD1: Row Coefficient
	clra                                ; 6D5C  4F            A = 0 | OBD1: No Col offset, X and X+1
	bsr interp_row_idx_frac_6D0A        ; 6D5D  8D AB         call interp_row_idx_frac_6D0A | OBD1: Interpolate intermediate results
	pulx                                ; 6D5F  38            pop X
	pulx                                ; 6D60  38            pop X
	pulx                                ; 6D61  38            pop X
	ins                                 ; 6D62  31            SP++
	pulx                                ; 6D63  38            pop X | OBD1: Restore stack, result in A
	rts                                 ; 6D64  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ODM_SPI_read_status_6D97
;   analysis [medium]: Reads two status/fault bytes over SPI from output driver chip A (1 or 2) via chip-select
;        bits in 16FA. Returns D=status, X=0. Returns D=X=FFFF on SPI timeout, and D=X=0 if battery <= k_36AB (8.5
;        V).
;   OBD1 LEED8 (match 0.91 p1-global)
;   called from: calc_ODM_status_hi_5CF7, EGR_baro_flow_test_AE76
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ODM_SPI_read_status_6D97:
	ldab >ADC_AN4_battery_volts         ; 6D97  F6 19 07      B = ADC_AN4_battery_volts | skip ODM read when battery <= 8.5 V (k_36AB, VOLTS=N/10)
	cmpb >k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB      ; 6D9A  F1 36 AB      compare B with k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB
	bls loc_6E1E                        ; 6D9D  23 7F         if ADC_AN4_battery_volts <= k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB goto loc_6E1E
	tab                                 ; 6D9F  16            B = A | OBD1: SPI subroutine	- maybe read output driver module status?
	clra                                ; 6DA0  4F            A = 0
	xgdx                                ; 6DA1  8F            swap D <-> X

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ADC_read_AN4_7_and_AMUX
;   analysis [high]: Converts AN4-7: battery to 1907, boost to 1908, AN6 to the current MUX slot 1941+n, AN7 to
;        190A. Advances the AMUX channel (0-15) in AMUX_channel_select and the external latch $0C04/$BE. Four
;        consecutive conversion timeouts set FLAGS0.7.
;   OBD1 READ_ATOD_HIGH (match 0.82 p1-global): This function reads the A-D channels 4 through 7, and stores the
;   multiplexed channel 6 value into the appropriate location.
;   called from: RESET_entry, diag_fuel_sol_ODM_P0215_6481, run_6ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	staa >ADCTL                         ; 6E27  B7 10 30      ADCTL = A
	ldx #PORTA                          ; 6E2A  CE 10 00      X = &PORTA
	ldy #$0018                          ; 6E2D  18 CE 00 18   Y = $0018(24)

	brset $30,x,$80,loc_6E4A            ; 6E31  1E 30 80 15   if [X+48] .7 set goto loc_6E4A | wait up to 24 loops for CCF
	dey                                 ; 6E35  18 09         Y--
	bne loc_6E31                        ; 6E37  26 F8         if Y != 0 goto loc_6E31
	ldaa >ADC_timeout_count             ; 6E39  B6 19 0B      A = ADC_timeout_count | after 4 consecutive timeouts flag A/D failure FLAGS0.7
	cmpa #$04                           ; 6E3C  81 04         compare A with 4
	bcc loc_6E45                        ; 6E3E  24 05         if ADC_timeout_count >= 4 goto loc_6E45
	inc >ADC_timeout_count              ; 6E40  7C 19 0B      ADC_timeout_count++
	bra loc_6E80                        ; 6E43  20 3B         goto loc_6E80
loc_6E45:
	bset <FLAGS0,$80                    ; 6E45  14 48 80      FLAGS0 .7 A/D conversion timeout fault (4 consecut = 1
	bra loc_6E80                        ; 6E48  20 36         goto loc_6E80
loc_6E4A:
	clr >ADC_timeout_count              ; 6E4A  7F 19 0B      ADC_timeout_count = 0
	ldd >ADR1                           ; 6E4D  FC 10 31      D = ADR1
	std >ADC_AN4_battery_volts          ; 6E50  FD 19 07      ADC_AN4_battery_volts = D | OBD1: read a-d channels: 0232 = volt, 0233 = press???
	ldd >ADR3                           ; 6E53  FC 10 33      D = ADR3 | ADR3 = AN6 (AMUX) -> A, ADR4 = AN7 -> B (stored at 190A)
	std >ADC_AN6_AMUX_raw               ; 6E56  FD 19 09      ADC_AN6_AMUX_raw = D | OBD1: multiplexed input, 0235 = press???
	ldab >AMUX_channel_select           ; 6E59  F6 19 3C      B = AMUX_channel_select | store AMUX reading in slot of currently selected channel, then advance channel (mod 16) | OBD1: read multiplexed channel

	lsrb                                ; 6E5F  54            B >>= 1

	abx                                 ; 6E63  3A            X += B
	staa $00,x                          ; 6E64  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	aslb                                ; 6E66  58            B <<= 1

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; SCALE_1BAR_MAP
;   analysis [high]: Converts filtered EGR vacuum sensor A/D (EGR_VAC_VOLTS_FILT) to MEASURED_EGR_VAC (0.5
;        kPa/bit): out = (A*94+2709)*2/256 ~= A*0.734+21, clamped 30..210 (15..105 kPa). Called from the bank-1
;        EGR sensor filter.
;   OBD1 SCALE_1BAR_MAP (match 1.00 p1-call): Utility routine called from multiple sites
;   called from: run_egr_press_filter
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCALE_1BAR_MAP:
	ldab #$5E                           ; 6E81  C6 5E         B = $5E(94)
	mul                                 ; 6E83  3D            D = A * B
	addd #$0A95                         ; 6E84  C3 0A 95      D += $0A95(2709) | out = (volts*94 + 2709)*2/256, i.e. ~0.734*counts + 21 in 0.5 kPa units
	asld                                ; 6E87  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_6E8E                        ; 6E88  25 04         if D overflowed goto loc_6E8E
	cmpa #$D2                           ; 6E8A  81 D2         compare A with $D2(210) | clamp measured EGR vacuum to 30..210 (15..105 kPa)
	bls loc_6E92                        ; 6E8C  23 04         if A <= $D2(210) goto loc_6E92
loc_6E8E:
	ldaa #$D2                           ; 6E8E  86 D2         A = $D2(210) | OBD1: 210 = 105 kPaA
	bra loc_6E98                        ; 6E90  20 06         goto loc_6E98
loc_6E92:
	cmpa #$1E                           ; 6E92  81 1E         compare A with $1E(30) | OBD1: 1e = 15 kPaA
	bcc loc_6E98                        ; 6E94  24 02         if A >= $1E(30) goto loc_6E98
	ldaa #$1E                           ; 6E96  86 1E         A = $1E(30)
loc_6E98:
	rts                                 ; 6E98  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; msg_index_to_bit_byte_6E99
;   analysis [high]: Splits slot number A into A = bit mask (1<<(A&7), via table at 6EA7) and B = byte index

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;   analysis [high]: Converts 3-digit BCD (A low nibble = hundreds 0..2, B = packed tens/ones) to binary in X;

	lsra                                ; 70A4  44            A >>= 1
	lsra                                ; 70A5  44            A >>= 1
	lsra                                ; 70A6  44            A >>= 1

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TOC3_scheduler_ISR_8000
;   analysis [high]: TOC3 interrupt (reached via the common trampoline 7E99 in the vector table). Exact 160 Hz
;        with E=3.1457 MHz: adds 19661, or 19660 every 5th tick. Overrun watchdog, RAM-code hooks, then a rate-
;        divided dispatch: 160 Hz task, 12.5/25/50/100 ms jobs, then the 1 s job. Each job has a re-entrancy bit
;        (TASKFLAGS1) and an overrun bit ($56).
;   called from: far_run_1s_job_7E3F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TOC3_scheduler_ISR_8000:
	ldaa #$20                           ; 8000  86 20         A = $20(32)
	staa >TFLG1                         ; 8002  B7 10 23      TFLG1 = A
	brclr <task_overrun_flags,$7E,loc_8010; 8005  13 56 7E 07   if task_overrun_flags .1,.2,.3,.4,.5,.6 clear goto loc_8010 | a job overrun flag is set: count down; at 0 hang so the COP watchdog resets the ECM
	dec >sched_overrun_count            ; 8009  7A 19 A3      sched_overrun_count--
	bne loc_8015                        ; 800C  26 07         if sched_overrun_count != 0 goto loc_8015
loc_800E:
	bra loc_800E                        ; 800E  20 FE         goto loc_800E
loc_8010:
	ldaa #$11                           ; 8010  86 11         A = $11(17)
	staa >sched_overrun_count           ; 8012  B7 19 A3      sched_overrun_count = A
loc_8015:
	ldd #$4CCD                          ; 8015  CC 4C CD      D = $4CCD(19661) | 160 Hz period: 19661 ticks, 19660 every 5th tick (avg 19660.8 = 3.1457MHz/160)
	tst >COUNTER_32HZ                   ; 8018  7D 19 74      test COUNTER_32HZ
	bne loc_8020                        ; 801B  26 03         if COUNTER_32HZ != 0 goto loc_8020
	ldd #$4CCC                          ; 801D  CC 4C CC      D = $4CCC(19660)
loc_8020:
	addd >TOC3_sched_160Hz_inj_disable  ; 8020  F3 10 1A      D += TOC3_sched_160Hz_inj_disable
	std >TOC3_sched_160Hz_inj_disable   ; 8023  FD 10 1A      TOC3_sched_160Hz_inj_disable = D
	bset <FLAGS1,$04                    ; 8026  14 49 04      FLAGS1 .2 = 1
	bset <shift_v0069,$20               ; 8029  14 69 20      shift_v0069 .5 trans diagnostics inhibited (ignition no = 1
	brset <FLAGS0,$04,loc_803D          ; 802C  12 48 04 0D   if FLAGS0 .2 ignition off / powerdown in progress (IG set goto loc_803D
	ldaa >serial_v1DF1                  ; 8030  B6 1D F1      A = serial_v1DF1
	bita #$10                           ; 8033  85 10         test serial_v1DF1 .4
	bne loc_803D                        ; 8035  26 06         if any of serial_v1DF1 .4 set goto loc_803D
	bclr <FLAGS1,$04                    ; 8037  15 49 04      FLAGS1 .2 = 0
	bclr <shift_v0069,$20               ; 803A  15 69 20      shift_v0069 .5 trans diagnostics inhibited (ignition no = 0
loc_803D:
	brclr <sys_state_flags,$80,loc_805C ; 803D  13 57 80 1B   if sys_state_flags .7 clear goto loc_805C | $57.7: RAM-resident code hook - $0600=$0AED signature -> run $0602, else $57.0 -> run $0628
	ldx >dev_hook_0600                  ; 8041  FE 06 00      X = dev_hook_0600
	cpx #$0AED                          ; 8044  8C 0A ED      compare X with $0AED(2797)
	bne loc_804E                        ; 8047  26 05         if X != $0AED(2797) goto loc_804E
	jsr >$0602                          ; 8049  BD 06 02      call $0602 | factory dev hook: calls code at $06xx/$07xx only if the hook is enabled - never in production
	bra loc_8055                        ; 804C  20 07         goto loc_8055
loc_804E:
	brclr <sys_state_flags,$01,loc_8055 ; 804E  13 57 01 03   if sys_state_flags .0 clear goto loc_8055
	jsr >$0628                          ; 8052  BD 06 28      call $0628 | factory dev hook: calls code at $06xx/$07xx only if the hook is enabled - never in production
loc_8055:
	brclr <TASKFLAGS1,$40,loc_805F      ; 8055  13 55 40 06   if TASKFLAGS1 .6 160 Hz task in progress clear goto loc_805F | TASKFLAGS1.6 still set = previous 160 Hz task unfinished: flag overrun and exit
	bset <task_overrun_flags,$40        ; 8059  14 56 40      task_overrun_flags .6 = 1
loc_805C:

loc_805F:

	ldaa >ITS_STEPPER_TIMER             ; 8066  B6 1A AD      A = ITS_STEPPER_TIMER | rate divider: (tick-1)&F, each LSR picks next slower job (12.5/25/50/100 ms)

loc_8078:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; run_25ms_job
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 _run_25ms_job (runs to 8241; the banners at 812D/8141 are false splits). Covers gear/TCC
;        stability counters, APP A/D + filter + zero learn, pedal, discretes and stall timer. With no internal
;        trans control it drives the ECT-based outputs (1809/1800.4), otherwise Central_Scheduler; then VSS,
;        timing, ext-module tests, backup timing.
;   OBD1 _run_25ms_job (match 0.71 p2-dataref): run every 25 milliseconds
;   called from: TOC3_scheduler_ISR_8000
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_25ms_job:

	ldx >engine_RPM                     ; 80D2  FE 19 86      X = engine_RPM
	pshx                                ; 80D5  3C            push X
	ldaa #$96                           ; 80D6  86 96         A = $96(150)
	psha                                ; 80D8  36            push A
	xgdx                                ; 80D9  8F            swap D <-> X
	jsr >mul_scale_16x8                 ; 80DA  BD 68 A4      call mul_scale_16x8
	std >engine_speed_raw_trans         ; 80DD  FD 18 97      engine_speed_raw_trans = D
	ins                                 ; 80E0  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; 80E1  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; 80E2  31            SP++
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; 80E3  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT | $B4 = count of 25 ms ticks gear unchanged (sat 255), $BA = last gear
	cmpa <last_gear                     ; 80E6  91 BA         compare A with last_gear
	bne loc_80F5                        ; 80E8  26 0B         if trans_gear_AT != last_gear goto loc_80F5
	ldaa <gear_stable_count             ; 80EA  96 B4         A = gear_stable_count
	cmpa #$FF                           ; 80EC  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)

loc_80F5:
	clr >gear_stable_count              ; 80F5  7F 00 B4      gear_stable_count = 0
loc_80F8:
	ldx #Configuration_set              ; 80F8  CE 20 0B      X = &Configuration_set | 200B.2 (no internal trans): use calculated manual gear; gear change can reset $B1 and RPM_SCALE_CNT+3 bit0

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; garage_shift_fuel_limit_check_83C3
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 L79B6: if the pedal is >= CAL_SAFE_APP_LIM, RPM > CAL_SAFE_RPM_LIM and there is no APP
;        fault, a range change N/R->D or into R loads the safe-limit timers 1873/1874 from CAL_SAFE_LIM_TM1/2
;        (fuel limit for 'power shift' protection).
;   OBD1 L79B6 (match 0.96 p1-global): 40hz - 25ms
;   This code checks for shifts between neutral/reverse/drive
;   with rpm and throttle above thresholds and sets a timer
;   First check for TPS, RPM below thresholds and exit, also exit if TPS
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
garage_shift_fuel_limit_check_83C3:
	ldaa >pedal_position_filtered       ; 83C3  B6 19 16      A = pedal_position_filtered
	cmpa >CAL_SAFE_APP_LIM              ; 83C6  B1 20 3D      compare A with CAL_SAFE_APP_LIM

	cmpa #$01                           ; 85E6  81 01         compare A with 1

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_backup_pump_to_TDC_time_85FD
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 L7A2B: when backup timing mode is active ($04.7 or $07.1), computes the pump-to-TDC
;        time (kw_204F/RPM with kw_204D factor via sub_6A3F, saturating) into PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP. It is limited
;        by BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY + kw_2051, and that latency resets when [1954]*8 is smaller.
;   OBD1 L7A2B (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_backup_pump_to_TDC_time_85FD:
	brset <$04,$80,loc_8605             ; 85FD  12 04 80 04   if [$04] .7 set goto loc_8605
	brclr <$07,$02,loc_8671             ; 8601  13 07 02 6C   if [$07] .1 clear goto loc_8671
loc_8605:

	beq loc_8671                        ; 8608  27 67         if X == 0 goto loc_8671
	pshx                                ; 860A  3C            push X
	puly                                ; 860B  18 38         pop Y
	ldd >kw_204F                        ; 860D  FC 20 4F      D = kw_204F
	idiv                                ; 8610  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	pshx                                ; 8611  3C            push X
	pshy                                ; 8612  18 3C         push Y
	pulx                                ; 8614  38            pop X
	fdiv                                ; 8615  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	ldd >kw_204D                        ; 8616  FC 20 4D      D = kw_204D
	jsr >MUL32                          ; 8619  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	xgdx                                ; 861C  8F            swap D <-> X
	pula                                ; 861D  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; 861E  33            pop B
	pshx                                ; 861F  3C            push X
	ldx >kw_204D                        ; 8620  FE 20 4D      X = kw_204D
	jsr >MUL32                          ; 8623  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	cpd #$0000                          ; 8626  1A 83 00 00   compare D with $0000(0)
	bne loc_8632                        ; 862A  26 06         if kw_204D != $0000(0) goto loc_8632
	xgdx                                ; 862C  8F            swap D <-> X
	tsx                                 ; 862D  30            X = SP + 1
	addd $00,x                          ; 862E  E3 00         D += [X+0]
	bcc loc_8635                        ; 8630  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_8635
loc_8632:
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 8632  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_8635:
	xgdx                                ; 8635  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldd >BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY         ; 8636  FC 19 63      D = BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY
	addd >kw_2051                       ; 8639  F3 20 51      D += kw_2051
	bcc loc_8641                        ; 863C  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_8641
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 863E  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_8641:
	pshb                                ; 8641  37            push B
	psha                                ; 8642  36            push A
	tsy                                 ; 8643  18 30         Y = SP + 1
	cpx $00,y                           ; 8645  CD AC 00      compare X with [Y+0]
	ins                                 ; 8648  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; 8649  31            SP++
	bcc loc_864D                        ; 864A  24 01         if X >= [Y+0] goto loc_864D
	xgdx                                ; 864C  8F            swap D <-> X
loc_864D:
	ldd >ref_period_filtered            ; 864D  FC 19 54      D = ref_period_filtered
	asld                                ; 8650  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_866C                        ; 8651  25 19         if D < 0 goto loc_866C
	asld                                ; 8653  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_866C                        ; 8654  25 16         if D < 0 goto loc_866C
	asld                                ; 8656  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_866C                        ; 8657  25 13         if D < 0 goto loc_866C
	pshb                                ; 8659  37            push B
	psha                                ; 865A  36            push A
	tsy                                 ; 865B  18 30         Y = SP + 1
	cpx $00,y                           ; 865D  CD AC 00      compare X with [Y+0]
	bls loc_866A                        ; 8660  23 08         if X <= [Y+0] goto loc_866A
	pulx                                ; 8662  38            pop X
	clra                                ; 8663  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; 8664  5F            B = 0
	std >BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY         ; 8665  FD 19 63      BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY = D
	bra loc_866C                        ; 8668  20 02         goto loc_866C

loc_866C:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; STALL_TIMER_RESET
;   analysis [high]: Counts 25 ms ticks in 199A (saturates; reset elsewhere on reference pulses). At >= 13 ticks
;        (~325 ms) without a reference it declares a stall: FLAGS0.4 is set and all RPM variables are zeroed. Sets
;        1474 to RPM_RAW (or 1 when RPM is 0 and still cranking).
;   OBD1 STALL_TIMER_RESET (match 1.00 p1-exact): end of cruise control
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
STALL_TIMER_RESET:
	inc >stall_timer                    ; 8672  7C 19 9A      stall_timer++
	bne loc_867A                        ; 8675  26 03         if stall_timer != 0 goto loc_867A
	dec >stall_timer                    ; 8677  7A 19 9A      stall_timer--
loc_867A:
	ldaa >stall_timer                   ; 867A  B6 19 9A      A = stall_timer | 13 x 25 ms without reference = stalled: zero all RPM variables
	cmpa #$0D                           ; 867D  81 0D         compare A with $0D(13)
	bcs loc_8699                        ; 867F  25 18         if stall_timer < $0D(13) goto loc_8699
	bset <FLAGS0,$10                    ; 8681  14 48 10      FLAGS0 .4 engine stalled (no reference for 325 ms) = 1
	ldd #$0000                          ; 8684  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	std >RPM_RAW                        ; 8687  FD 19 82      RPM_RAW = D
	std >RPM_1                          ; 868A  FD 19 84      RPM_1 = D
	std >engine_RPM                     ; 868D  FD 19 86      engine_RPM = D
	staa >RPM_2_DBL                     ; 8690  B7 19 8A      RPM_2_DBL = A
	std >engine_speed_raw_trans         ; 8693  FD 18 97      engine_speed_raw_trans = D
	std >engine_speed_filtered          ; 8696  FD 18 C7      engine_speed_filtered = D
loc_8699:
	ldx >RPM_RAW                        ; 8699  FE 19 82      X = RPM_RAW
	bne loc_86A7                        ; 869C  26 09         if X != 0 goto loc_86A7
	ldab >STARTUP_CTR                   ; 869E  F6 19 E3      B = STARTUP_CTR
	cmpb >CAL_MIN_CRANK_CYLS            ; 86A1  F1 22 A8      compare B with CAL_MIN_CRANK_CYLS | OBD1: is set to 3
	bhi loc_86A7                        ; 86A4  22 01         if STARTUP_CTR > CAL_MIN_CRANK_CYLS goto loc_86A7
	inx                                 ; 86A6  08            X++
loc_86A7:
	stx >$1474                          ; 86A7  FF 14 74      closure_time_response+2 = X
	rts                                 ; 86AA  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_APP_fault_fuel_limit_86AB
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 L81E7: in pedal-fault limp mode (DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2.3) it ramps
;        APP_FAULT_PWR_LIMIT. It steps fuel_quantity by k_22B8 up while vehicle accel is below the speed-band
;        threshold (kw_22B2/4/6 by VSS < k_22B0/k_22B1), and down otherwise. In the low band the floor is k_22B9.
;   OBD1 L81E7 (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_APP_fault_fuel_limit_86AB:
	brclr <DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2,$08,loc_86F5; 86AB  13 53 08 46   if DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .3 only one valid pedal sensor (P1125) clear goto loc_86F5
	ldaa >vehicle_speed                 ; 86AF  B6 19 F1      A = vehicle_speed | pick accel threshold by speed band: VSS<k_22B0 -> kw_22B2, <k_22B1 -> kw_22B4, else kw_22B6
	ldx >kw_22B2                        ; 86B2  FE 22 B2      X = kw_22B2
	cmpa >k_APPflt_VSS_band1_22B0       ; 86B5  B1 22 B0      compare A with k_APPflt_VSS_band1_22B0

	ldx >kw_22B4                        ; 86BA  FE 22 B4      X = kw_22B4
	cmpa >k_APPflt_VSS_band2_22B1       ; 86BD  B1 22 B1      compare A with k_APPflt_VSS_band2_22B1
	bcs loc_86C5                        ; 86C0  25 03         if vehicle_speed < k_APPflt_VSS_band2_22B1 goto loc_86C5
	ldx >kw_22B6                        ; 86C2  FE 22 B6      X = kw_22B6
loc_86C5:
	pshx                                ; 86C5  3C            push X
	tsx                                 ; 86C6  30            X = SP + 1
	ldd >VEH_SPEED_DERIVATIVE           ; 86C7  FC 1C A2      D = VEH_SPEED_DERIVATIVE
	cpd $00,x                           ; 86CA  1A A3 00      compare D with [X+0]
	pulx                                ; 86CD  38            pop X
	bge loc_86DC                        ; 86CE  2C 0C         if VEH_SPEED_DERIVATIVE >= (signed) [X+0] goto loc_86DC
	ldaa >fuel_quantity                 ; 86D0  B6 19 A4      A = fuel_quantity
	adda >k_APPflt_fuel_step_22B8       ; 86D3  BB 22 B8      A += k_APPflt_fuel_step_22B8
	bcc loc_86E5                        ; 86D6  24 0D         if A no overflow goto loc_86E5
	ldaa #$FF                           ; 86D8  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	bra loc_86F2                        ; 86DA  20 16         goto loc_86F2
loc_86DC:
	ldaa >fuel_quantity                 ; 86DC  B6 19 A4      A = fuel_quantity
	suba >k_APPflt_fuel_step_22B8       ; 86DF  B0 22 B8      A -= k_APPflt_fuel_step_22B8
	bcc loc_86E5                        ; 86E2  24 01         if A >= 0 goto loc_86E5
	clra                                ; 86E4  4F            A = 0
loc_86E5:
	cpx >kw_22B2                        ; 86E5  BC 22 B2      compare X with kw_22B2
	bne loc_86F2                        ; 86E8  26 08         if X != kw_22B2 goto loc_86F2
	cmpa >k_APPflt_fuel_min_low_speed_22B9; 86EA  B1 22 B9      compare A with k_APPflt_fuel_min_low_speed_22B9
	bcc loc_86F2                        ; 86ED  24 03         if A >= k_APPflt_fuel_min_low_speed_22B9 goto loc_86F2
	ldaa >k_APPflt_fuel_min_low_speed_22B9; 86EF  B6 22 B9      A = k_APPflt_fuel_min_low_speed_22B9
loc_86F2:
	staa >APP_FAULT_PWR_LIMIT           ; 86F2  B7 19 B1      APP_FAULT_PWR_LIMIT = A
loc_86F5:
	rts                                 ; 86F5  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; debounce_discrete_inputs
;   analysis [high]: Three-sample debounce of IOR 1804 (brake/TCC brake/PTO/range switches) into
;        RAM_status_resistor and IOR 1802 (cruise/4WD/shift switches) into IN_1802_debounced. A bit takes its new
;        value only when the last three samples agree, otherwise it keeps the old value. With 200D.4 set, the
;        1804.0 PTO bit is masked from the samples, and old bit 0 stays set while [$0F].0 is clear.
;   OBD1 DEBOUNCE_SWITCHES (match 0.76 p2-dataref)
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
debounce_discrete_inputs:
	ldd >IN_1804_sample0                ; 86F6  FC 1C 87      D = IN_1804_sample0 | shift sample history: s2<-s1<-s0, then read new 1804 sample
	std >IN_1804_sample1                ; 86F9  FD 1C 88      IN_1804_sample1 = D
	ldaa >IOR_1804                      ; 86FC  B6 18 04      A = IOR_1804
	ldx #Configuration_set_3_200D       ; 86FF  CE 20 0D      X = &Configuration_set_3_200D
	brclr $00,x,$10,loc_8708            ; 8702  1F 00 10 02   if Configuration_set_3_200D .4 external module data tests clear goto loc_8708 | 200D.4: drop pin A6 (1804.0 PTO) from debounce
	anda #$FE                           ; 8706  84 FE         A &= $FE(254) (keep bits)
loc_8708:
	staa >IN_1804_sample0               ; 8708  B7 1C 87      IN_1804_sample0 = A
	tab                                 ; 870B  16            B = A | changed = (s0^s1)|(s0^s2); stable bits take s0, changing bits keep the old debounced value
	eora >IN_1804_sample1               ; 870C  B8 1C 88      A ^= IN_1804_sample1
	psha                                ; 870F  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; 8710  30            X = SP + 1
	eorb >IN_1804_sample2               ; 8711  F8 1C 89      B ^= IN_1804_sample2
	orab $00,x                          ; 8714  EA 00         B |= [X+0]
	tba                                 ; 8716  17            A = B
	comb                                ; 8717  53            B = ~B
	anda <RAM_status_resistor           ; 8718  94 4E         A &= RAM_status_resistor
	andb >IN_1804_sample0               ; 871A  F4 1C 87      B &= IN_1804_sample0
	stab $00,x                          ; 871D  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	oraa $00,x                          ; 871F  AA 00         A |= [X+0]
	ins                                 ; 8721  31            SP++
	ldx #Configuration_set_3_200D       ; 8722  CE 20 0D      X = &Configuration_set_3_200D | PTO bit 0 handling when 200D.4: keep it latched unless [$0F].0 says otherwise
	brclr $00,x,$10,loc_8735            ; 8725  1F 00 10 0C   if Configuration_set_3_200D .4 external module data tests clear goto loc_8735
	sei                                 ; 8729  0F            disable interrupts
	brset <$0F,$01,loc_8734             ; 872A  12 0F 01 06   if [$0F] .0 set goto loc_8734
	brclr <RAM_status_resistor,$01,loc_8734; 872E  13 4E 01 02   if RAM_status_resistor .0 PTO request (OBD1: engine crank) clear goto loc_8734
	oraa #$01                           ; 8732  8A 01         A |= 1
loc_8734:
	cli                                 ; 8734  0E            enable interrupts
loc_8735:
	staa <RAM_status_resistor           ; 8735  97 4E         RAM_status_resistor = A
	ldd >IN_1802_sample0                ; 8737  FC 1C 84      D = IN_1802_sample0 | same 3-sample debounce for IOR 1802 switches -> IN_1802_debounced
	std >IN_1802_sample1                ; 873A  FD 1C 85      IN_1802_sample1 = D
	ldaa >IOR_1802_AMUX                 ; 873D  B6 18 02      A = IOR_1802_AMUX
	staa >IN_1802_sample0               ; 8740  B7 1C 84      IN_1802_sample0 = A
	tab                                 ; 8743  16            B = A
	eora >IN_1802_sample1               ; 8744  B8 1C 85      A ^= IN_1802_sample1
	psha                                ; 8747  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; 8748  30            X = SP + 1
	eorb >IN_1802_sample2               ; 8749  F8 1C 86      B ^= IN_1802_sample2
	orab $00,x                          ; 874C  EA 00         B |= [X+0]
	tba                                 ; 874E  17            A = B
	comb                                ; 874F  53            B = ~B
	anda <IN_1802_debounced             ; 8750  94 4F         A &= IN_1802_debounced
	andb >IN_1802_sample0               ; 8752  F4 1C 84      B &= IN_1802_sample0
	stab $00,x                          ; 8755  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	oraa $00,x                          ; 8757  AA 00         A |= [X+0]
	ins                                 ; 8759  31            SP++
	staa <IN_1802_debounced             ; 875A  97 4F         IN_1802_debounced = A
	rts                                 ; 875C  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calculate_st_trans_shaft_speeds
;   analysis [medium]: Filters raw engine speed $1897 into engine_speed_filtered and runs the OSS calculation.
;        When the trans sensors are wired to the ECM (200D.3), output speed raw = trans input speed * 1.9375.
;        Filters TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED (CAL_OSS_FILTER), then computes RAW_VEHICLE_SPEED = OSS_raw /
;        CAL_VEH_GEAR_RATIO plus a signed trim [$1896], rounded and filtered into VEHICLE_SPEED_0.
;   OBD1 calculate_st_trans_shaft_speeds (match 0.84 p1-global): Transmission now...
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_st_trans_shaft_speeds:
	ldd >engine_speed_raw_trans         ; 875D  FC 18 97      D = engine_speed_raw_trans | engine speed filter, coef tbl_3892 ($FC)
	ldx >engine_speed_filtered          ; 8760  FE 18 C7      X = engine_speed_filtered
	ldy #tbl_3892                       ; 8763  18 CE 38 92   Y = &tbl_3892
	jsr >Sensor_smoothing_SPEED         ; 8767  BD 66 85      call Sensor_smoothing_SPEED
	std >engine_speed_filtered          ; 876A  FD 18 C7      engine_speed_filtered = D
	jsr >CALC_OSS_SPEED                 ; 876D  BD 96 C4      call CALC_OSS_SPEED
	ldx #Configuration_set_3_200D       ; 8770  CE 20 0D      X = &Configuration_set_3_200D
	brclr $00,x,$08,loc_8790            ; 8773  1F 00 08 19   if Configuration_set_3_200D .3 trans sensors wired to ECM clear goto loc_8790 | 200D.3: set = trans speed via 1877/18B7, clr = TIC2 input shaft 1C92/1C93
	jsr >calc_input_shaft_speed_raw_9612; 8777  BD 96 12      call calc_input_shaft_speed_raw_9612
	jsr >filter_trans_input_speed_B6BE  ; 877A  BD B6 BE      call filter_trans_input_speed_B6BE
	ldx #trans_input_speed_filtered     ; 877D  CE 18 A4      X = &trans_input_speed_filtered | OSS raw = input speed + input*240/256 (x1.9375 fixed ratio) when trans sensors go to ECM
	ldaa #$F0                           ; 8780  86 F0         A = $F0(240)
	jsr >MUL8_16                        ; 8782  BD 67 74      call MUL8_16
	addd >trans_input_speed_filtered    ; 8785  F3 18 A4      D += trans_input_speed_filtered
	bcc loc_878D                        ; 8788  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_878D
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 878A  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_878D:
	std >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW         ; 878D  FD 18 B0      TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW = D
loc_8790:
	ldd >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW         ; 8790  FC 18 B0      D = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW
	ldx >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; 8793  FE 18 B9      X = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED
	ldy #CAL_OSS_FILTER                 ; 8796  18 CE 38 53   Y = &CAL_OSS_FILTER
	jsr >Sensor_smoothing_SPEED         ; 879A  BD 66 85      call Sensor_smoothing_SPEED
	std >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; 879D  FD 18 B9      TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED = D
	ldd >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW         ; 87A0  FC 18 B0      D = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW | VSS = OSS_raw / CAL_VEH_GEAR_RATIO ($BA00), plus signed trim [$1896] on the high byte, saturating
	ldx >CAL_VEH_GEAR_RATIO             ; 87A3  FE 38 56      X = CAL_VEH_GEAR_RATIO
	fdiv                                ; 87A6  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; 87A7  8F            swap D <-> X
	suba #$80                           ; 87A8  80 80         A -= $80(128)
	adda >trans_v1896                   ; 87AA  BB 18 96      A += trans_v1896
	bvc loc_87B6                        ; 87AD  28 07         if no overflow goto loc_87B6
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; 87AF  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
	adcb #$00                           ; 87B2  C9 00         B += C + 0
	adca #$00                           ; 87B4  89 00         A += C + 0
loc_87B6:
	adda #$80                           ; 87B6  8B 80         A += $80(128)
	addd #$0080                         ; 87B8  C3 00 80      D += $0080(128)
	bcc loc_87C0                        ; 87BB  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_87C0
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 87BD  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_87C0:
	std >RAW_VEHICLE_SPEED              ; 87C0  FD 18 C1      RAW_VEHICLE_SPEED = D
	ldx >VEHICLE_SPEED_0                ; 87C3  FE 18 BD      X = VEHICLE_SPEED_0
	ldy #CAL_TRANS_VSPD_FILT            ; 87C6  18 CE 38 58   Y = &CAL_TRANS_VSPD_FILT
	jsr >Sensor_smoothing_SPEED         ; 87CA  BD 66 85      call Sensor_smoothing_SPEED
	std >VEHICLE_SPEED_0                ; 87CD  FD 18 BD      VEHICLE_SPEED_0 = D
	rts                                 ; 87D0  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calculate_std_transmission_gear
;   analysis [medium]: Manual-trans gear estimate: ratio = engine_speed_filtered / TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED as 8.8 fixed
;        point (FFFF if OSS=0 or ratio>=256). Ratio bands (kw_33DD..33E7) with hysteresis bands give gear 3..0
;        (low ratio = high gear). The result goes to gear_calc_MT and trans_gear_AT only when a brake-switch bit
;        (RAM_status_resistor b1|b2) is set; TRANSMISSION_RATIO is updated when the gear is accepted or held.
;   OBD1 calculate_std_transmission_gear (match 0.99 p1-global)
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_std_transmission_gear:
	ldx >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; 87D1  FE 18 B9      X = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED | ratio = engine_speed/OSS in 8.8 fixed point via idiv+fdiv; FFFF if OSS=0 or ratio >= 256
	beq loc_87EC                        ; 87D4  27 16         if X == 0 goto loc_87EC
	pshx                                ; 87D6  3C            push X
	puly                                ; 87D7  18 38         pop Y
	ldd >engine_speed_filtered          ; 87D9  FC 18 C7      D = engine_speed_filtered
	idiv                                ; 87DC  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	pshx                                ; 87DD  3C            push X
	pshy                                ; 87DE  18 3C         push Y
	pulx                                ; 87E0  38            pop X
	fdiv                                ; 87E1  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; 87E2  8F            swap D <-> X
	tab                                 ; 87E3  16            B = A
	pula                                ; 87E4  32            pop A
	tsta                                ; 87E5  4D            test A
	bne loc_87EB                        ; 87E6  26 03         if A != 0 goto loc_87EB
