; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; read_vehicle_speed
;   analysis [high]: Samples the VSS pulse accumulator count and timestamp atomically into VEH_SPD_INPUT_STRUCT
;        and gets the pulse period from read_vehicle_speed_part_886E (timeout reload k_3405=7). Speed =
;        $0565(1381)*65536/period, filtered with CAL_VEH_SPEED3_FILT into vehicle_speed; it is 0 when the period
;        times out (FFFF).
;   OBD1 read_vehicle_speed (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
read_vehicle_speed:
	sei                                 ; 8837  0F            disable interrupts
	ldab >VEH_SPD_4K_PAICT              ; 8838  F6 1C AD      B = VEH_SPD_4K_PAICT | OBD1: PAI counts
	ldx >VEH_SPD_4K_CT                  ; 883B  FE 1C AE      X = VEH_SPD_4K_CT
	cli                                 ; 883E  0E            enable interrupts
	ldy #VEH_SPD_INPUT_STRUCT           ; 883F  18 CE 1C A4   Y = &VEH_SPD_INPUT_STRUCT
	stab $08,y                          ; 8843  18 E7 08      VEH_SPD_INPUT_STRUCT+8 = B
	stx $06,y                           ; 8846  CD EF 06      VEH_SPD_INPUT_STRUCT+6 = X
	ldab >k_VSS_timeout_passes_3405     ; 8849  F6 34 05      B = k_VSS_timeout_passes_3405 | OBD1: is set to 7
	jsr >vss_period_from_pulse_count_886E; 884C  BD 88 6E      call vss_period_from_pulse_count_886E
	cpd #$FFFF                          ; 884F  1A 83 FF FF   compare D with $FFFF(65535) | FFFF period = no pulses within timeout -> speed 0
	bne loc_885A                        ; 8853  26 05         if D != $FFFF(65535) goto loc_885A
	ldd #$0000                          ; 8855  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	bra loc_886A                        ; 8858  20 10         goto loc_886A
loc_885A:
	ldx #$0565                          ; 885A  CE 05 65      X = $0565(1381) | speed = 1381*65536/period (1381 = pulses-per-mile scaling) | OBD1: pulses per mile
	xgdx                                ; 885D  8F            swap D <-> X
	fdiv                                ; 885E  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; 885F  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldx >vehicle_speed                  ; 8860  FE 19 F1      X = vehicle_speed
	ldy #CAL_VEH_SPEED3_FILT            ; 8863  18 CE 20 92   Y = &CAL_VEH_SPEED3_FILT
	jsr >Sensor_smoothing_SPEED         ; 8867  BD 66 85      call Sensor_smoothing_SPEED
loc_886A:
	std >vehicle_speed                  ; 886A  FD 19 F1      vehicle_speed = D
	rts                                 ; 886D  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; vss_period_from_pulse_count_886E
;   analysis [high]: Pulse-period calculator on the VSS struct (+0 last count, +1/2 last time, +3 timeout, +4/5
;        period, +6/7 new time, +8 new count). With new pulses, period = dTime/dPulses and the timeout is reloaded
;        from B. With no pulses, it counts the timeout down and returns FFFF (stopped) when it reaches 0. The
;        pulse delta is kept in $1CB1 for the odometer.
;   OBD1 L836A (match 0.98 p1-global): Looks like a math utility routine
;   called from: read_vehicle_speed
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
vss_period_from_pulse_count_886E:
	ldaa $08,y                          ; 886E  18 A6 08      A = [Y+8]
	suba $00,y                          ; 8871  18 A0 00      A -= [Y+0]
	staa >VSS_pulse_delta               ; 8874  B7 1C B1      VSS_pulse_delta = A
	bne loc_888C                        ; 8877  26 13         if A != 0 goto loc_888C | no new pulses: count down the timeout; at 0 report period FFFF
	ldab $03,y                          ; 8879  18 E6 03      B = [Y+3]
	beq loc_8884                        ; 887C  27 06         if B == 0 goto loc_8884
	decb                                ; 887E  5A            B--
	stab $03,y                          ; 887F  18 E7 03      [Y+3] = B
	bne loc_88AF                        ; 8882  26 2B         if B != 0 goto loc_88AF
loc_8884:
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 8884  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
	std $04,y                           ; 8887  18 ED 04      [Y+4] = D
	bra loc_88B2                        ; 888A  20 26         goto loc_88B2
loc_888C:
	pshb                                ; 888C  37            push B | new pulses: period = (t_new - t_last)/pulses, skipped on first edge after timeout
	ldab $03,y                          ; 888D  18 E6 03      B = [Y+3]
	beq loc_889F                        ; 8890  27 0D         if B == 0 goto loc_889F
	tab                                 ; 8892  16            B = A
	clra                                ; 8893  4F            A = 0
	xgdx                                ; 8894  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldd $06,y                           ; 8895  18 EC 06      D = [Y+6]
	subd $01,y                          ; 8898  18 A3 01      D -= [Y+1]
	idiv                                ; 889B  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	stx $04,y                           ; 889C  CD EF 04      [Y+4] = X
loc_889F:
	ldx $06,y                           ; 889F  CD EE 06      X = [Y+6]
	stx $01,y                           ; 88A2  CD EF 01      [Y+1] = X
	ldaa $08,y                          ; 88A5  18 A6 08      A = [Y+8]
	staa $00,y                          ; 88A8  18 A7 00      [Y+0] = A
	pula                                ; 88AB  32            pop A
	staa $03,y                          ; 88AC  18 A7 03      [Y+3] = A
loc_88AF:
	ldd $04,y                           ; 88AF  18 EC 04      D = [Y+4]
loc_88B2:
	rts                                 ; 88B2  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; PCS_PWM_output
;   analysis [medium]: Writes the PCS (force motor) duty to PWM 1809 and a copy at $1BAF. A tester device-control
;        override ($1C5B.2 accepted) forces duty 0/FF from $1C5C.2, and 1807.4 forces 0. In gear 0 it runs a
;        force-motor cleaning pulse sequence: low phase kw_4AB8 ticks, then FF phase kw_4ABA ticks, repeated up to
;        k_4AB7 cycles. Otherwise the duty is PCS_duty_cmd.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
PCS_PWM_output:
	ldx #devctl_status                  ; 8AB3  CE 1C 59      X = &devctl_status
	ldy #tbl_3865                       ; 8AB6  18 CE 38 65   Y = &tbl_3865
	brclr $02,x,$04,loc_8AC9            ; 8ABA  1F 02 04 0B   if devctl_accepted_mask .2 tester PCS on/off override accepted clear goto loc_8AC9 | tester device control of PCS: accepted ($1C5B.2) -> duty FF or 0 per requested state $1C5C.2
	brclr $03,x,$04,loc_8AC6            ; 8ABE  1F 03 04 04   if tester_override_values .2 clear goto loc_8AC6
	ldab #$FF                           ; 8AC2  C6 FF         B = $FF(255)
	bra loc_8B0A                        ; 8AC4  20 44         goto loc_8B0A
loc_8AC6:
	clrb                                ; 8AC6  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_8B0A                        ; 8AC7  20 41         goto loc_8B0A
loc_8AC9:
	ldx #IOR_1807_MIL_RES_TRANSPU_IATPU ; 8AC9  CE 18 07      X = &IOR_1807_MIL_RES_TRANSPU_IATPU
	brclr $00,x,$10,loc_8AD3            ; 8ACC  1F 00 10 03   if IOR_1807_MIL_RES_TRANSPU_IATPU .4 clear goto loc_8AD3
	clrb                                ; 8AD0  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_8B0A                        ; 8AD1  20 37         goto loc_8B0A
loc_8AD3:
	ldx #PCS_clean_pulse_state          ; 8AD3  CE 1B BB      X = &PCS_clean_pulse_state | gear 0: force-motor cleaning pulse sequence, up to k_4AB7 ($FE) cycles in $1BBC
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; 8AD6  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT
	bne loc_8B30                        ; 8AD9  26 55         if A != 0 goto loc_8B30
	ldaa >PCS_clean_pulse_count         ; 8ADB  B6 1B BC      A = PCS_clean_pulse_count
	cmpa >k_PCS_clean_cycles_4AB7       ; 8ADE  B1 4A B7      compare A with k_PCS_clean_cycles_4AB7
	bhi loc_8B30                        ; 8AE1  22 4D         if PCS_clean_pulse_count > k_PCS_clean_cycles_4AB7 goto loc_8B30
	brclr $00,x,$03,loc_8AE9            ; 8AE3  1F 00 03 02   if PCS_clean_pulse_state .0,.1 clear goto loc_8AE9
	bra loc_8AEC                        ; 8AE7  20 03         goto loc_8AEC
loc_8AE9:
	bset $00,x,$01                      ; 8AE9  1C 00 01      [X+0] .0 = 1
loc_8AEC:
	brclr $00,x,$01,loc_8B0C            ; 8AEC  1F 00 01 1C   if [X+0] .0 clear goto loc_8B0C | phase A: duty 0 for kw_4AB8 ticks
	ldd >PCS_clean_pulse_timer          ; 8AF0  FC 1B BD      D = PCS_clean_pulse_timer
	cpd >kw_PCS_clean_low_ticks_4AB8    ; 8AF3  1A B3 4A B8   compare D with kw_PCS_clean_low_ticks_4AB8
	bcs loc_8B03                        ; 8AF7  25 0A         if PCS_clean_pulse_timer < kw_PCS_clean_low_ticks_4AB8 goto loc_8B03
	clra                                ; 8AF9  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; 8AFA  5F            B = 0
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; 8AFB  1D 00 01      [X+0] .0 = 0
	bset $00,x,$02                      ; 8AFE  1C 00 02      [X+0] .1 = 1
	bra loc_8B06                        ; 8B01  20 03         goto loc_8B06
loc_8B03:
	addd #$0001                         ; 8B03  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
loc_8B06:
	std >PCS_clean_pulse_timer          ; 8B06  FD 1B BD      PCS_clean_pulse_timer = D
	clrb                                ; 8B09  5F            B = 0
loc_8B0A:
	bra loc_8B3C                        ; 8B0A  20 30         goto loc_8B3C
loc_8B0C:
	brclr $00,x,$02,loc_8B3C            ; 8B0C  1F 00 02 2C   if [X+0] .1 clear goto loc_8B3C | phase B: duty FF for kw_4ABA ticks, then count one cycle
	ldd >PCS_clean_pulse_timer          ; 8B10  FC 1B BD      D = PCS_clean_pulse_timer
	cpd >kw_PCS_clean_high_ticks_4ABA   ; 8B13  1A B3 4A BA   compare D with kw_PCS_clean_high_ticks_4ABA
	bcs loc_8B26                        ; 8B17  25 0D         if PCS_clean_pulse_timer < kw_PCS_clean_high_ticks_4ABA goto loc_8B26
	clra                                ; 8B19  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; 8B1A  5F            B = 0
	bclr $00,x,$02                      ; 8B1B  1D 00 02      [X+0] .1 = 0
	bset $00,x,$01                      ; 8B1E  1C 00 01      [X+0] .0 = 1
	inc >PCS_clean_pulse_count          ; 8B21  7C 1B BC      PCS_clean_pulse_count++
	bra loc_8B29                        ; 8B24  20 03         goto loc_8B29
loc_8B26:
	addd #$0001                         ; 8B26  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
loc_8B29:
	std >PCS_clean_pulse_timer          ; 8B29  FD 1B BD      PCS_clean_pulse_timer = D
	ldab #$FF                           ; 8B2C  C6 FF         B = $FF(255)
	bra loc_8B3C                        ; 8B2E  20 0C         goto loc_8B3C
loc_8B30:
	bclr $00,x,$03                      ; 8B30  1D 00 03      [X+0] .0,.1 = 0 | normal: duty = PCS_duty_cmd, reset pulse sequencer
	ldab >PCS_duty_cmd                  ; 8B33  F6 1A F7      B = PCS_duty_cmd
	clr >PCS_clean_pulse_timer          ; 8B36  7F 1B BD      PCS_clean_pulse_timer = 0
	clr >pcs_v1BBE                      ; 8B39  7F 1B BE      pcs_v1BBE = 0
loc_8B3C:
	stab >PCS_duty_out                  ; 8B3C  F7 1B AF      PCS_duty_out = B
	stab >$1809                         ; 8B3F  F7 18 09      PWM_PCS_control+1 = B | 1809 = TCC PWM solenoid duty (4L80E), see PWM_PCS_control note
	rts                                 ; 8B42  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_OLD_RPM2_4_8B43
;   analysis [low]: 50 ms: while fuel_quantity=0, [$B2] >= k_2755 and RPM above IDLE_SPEED_HIGH_BAND and $50,
;        counts RPM-rising samples (DELTA_RPM_COUNT), large RPM jumps >= kw_2757 ([$BD]) and trans slip ([$B9],
;        auto trans). Sets $54.2 when the counts pass the k_2752/k_2754/k_2756 limits, i.e. engine speed rising
;        with no fuel commanded (driveline-driven or runaway). Holds OLD_RPM2_4 as the previous RPM.
;   OBD1 L9E24 (match 1.00 p1-exact): seems related to engine shutdown of some kind... don't know what this does
;        yet.
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes OLD_RPM2_4, DELTA_RPM_COUNT
;   called from: run_50ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_OLD_RPM2_4_8B43:
	ldaa <closure_stale_ctr             ; 8B43  96 B2         A = closure_stale_ctr | only during zero fuel above idle band and $50 RPM byte (1500 rpm)
	cmpa >k_2755                        ; 8B45  B1 27 55      compare A with k_2755
	bcs loc_8B8E                        ; 8B48  25 44         if closure_stale_ctr < k_2755 goto loc_8B8E
	ldaa >fuel_quantity                 ; 8B4A  B6 19 A4      A = fuel_quantity
	bne loc_8B8E                        ; 8B4D  26 3F         if A != 0 goto loc_8B8E
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; 8B4F  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	cmpa >IDLE_SPEED_HIGH_BAND          ; 8B52  B1 1C 64      compare A with IDLE_SPEED_HIGH_BAND
	bcs loc_8B8E                        ; 8B55  25 37         if engine_RPM < IDLE_SPEED_HIGH_BAND goto loc_8B8E
	cmpa >k_zero_fuel_rise_min_RPM_2753 ; 8B57  B1 27 53      compare A with k_zero_fuel_rise_min_RPM_2753 | kw_2753 is really a byte ($50) - used with cmpa | OBD1: set to $50
	bcs loc_8B8E                        ; 8B5A  25 32         if engine_RPM < k_zero_fuel_rise_min_RPM_2753 goto loc_8B8E
	ldd >engine_RPM                     ; 8B5C  FC 19 86      D = engine_RPM
	cpd <OLD_RPM2_4                     ; 8B5F  1A 93 B6      compare D with OLD_RPM2_4
	bcs loc_8B6F                        ; 8B62  25 0B         if engine_RPM < OLD_RPM2_4 goto loc_8B6F
	ldaa <DELTA_RPM_COUNT               ; 8B64  96 B8         A = DELTA_RPM_COUNT
	cmpa #$FF                           ; 8B66  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)
	beq loc_8B76                        ; 8B68  27 0C         if DELTA_RPM_COUNT == $FF(255) goto loc_8B76
	inc >DELTA_RPM_COUNT                ; 8B6A  7C 00 B8      DELTA_RPM_COUNT++
	bra loc_8B76                        ; 8B6D  20 07         goto loc_8B76
loc_8B6F:
	ldaa <DELTA_RPM_COUNT               ; 8B6F  96 B8         A = DELTA_RPM_COUNT
	beq loc_8B76                        ; 8B71  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_8B76
	dec >DELTA_RPM_COUNT                ; 8B73  7A 00 B8      DELTA_RPM_COUNT--
loc_8B76:
	ldd >engine_RPM                     ; 8B76  FC 19 86      D = engine_RPM | count big RPM jumps (>= kw_2757) in [$BD]
	subd <OLD_RPM2_4                    ; 8B79  93 B6         D -= OLD_RPM2_4
	bcs loc_8B90                        ; 8B7B  25 13         if D < 0 goto loc_8B90
	cpd >kw_2757                        ; 8B7D  1A B3 27 57   compare D with kw_2757 | OBD1: is set to $50
	bcs loc_8B90                        ; 8B81  25 0D         if D < kw_2757 goto loc_8B90
	ldaa <rpm_v00BD                     ; 8B83  96 BD         A = rpm_v00BD
	cmpa #$FF                           ; 8B85  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)
	beq loc_8B93                        ; 8B87  27 0A         if rpm_v00BD == $FF(255) goto loc_8B93
	inc >rpm_v00BD                      ; 8B89  7C 00 BD      rpm_v00BD++
	bra loc_8B93                        ; 8B8C  20 05         goto loc_8B93
loc_8B8E:
	bra loc_8BD3                        ; 8B8E  20 43         goto loc_8BD3
loc_8B90:
	clr >rpm_v00BD                      ; 8B90  7F 00 BD      rpm_v00BD = 0
loc_8B93:
	ldx #Configuration_set              ; 8B93  CE 20 0B      X = &Configuration_set | OBD1: auto transmission flag
	brclr $00,x,$04,loc_8BA4            ; 8B96  1F 00 04 0A   if Configuration_set .2 TCM / no internal trans control clear goto loc_8BA4 | Configuration_set.2 (0x04) TCM/no-internal-trans flag | OBD1: BR IF NOT 4009.b2, BR IF auto
	ldaa <rpm_v00BD                     ; 8B9A  96 BD         A = rpm_v00BD
	cmpa >k_2756                        ; 8B9C  B1 27 56      compare A with k_2756

	ldaa <Cal_bit_6_store               ; 8BA8  96 5F         A = Cal_bit_6_store | OBD1: check for neutral

loc_8BC8:
	ldaa <rpm_v00B9                     ; 8BC8  96 B9         A = rpm_v00B9
	cmpa #$FF                           ; 8BCA  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)
	beq loc_8BD9                        ; 8BCC  27 0B         if rpm_v00B9 == $FF(255) goto loc_8BD9

loc_8BD3:
	clr >DELTA_RPM_COUNT                ; 8BD3  7F 00 B8      DELTA_RPM_COUNT = 0
loc_8BD6:

;        +/-CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_MAXRPMERR, PTO off and pedal 0, it learns idle fuel (drag torque) into one of 4 cells:

;        into DRAGTQ_ADJUST clamped to CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_MIN/MAX_ADJ, and computes the roughness/RPM-sag idle fuel a

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; idle_learn_cell_update
;   analysis [high]: Lag-filters fuel_quantity (CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_FILTER) into the cell's word at Y. Every
;        CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_RATE calls it snapshots the filter to Y+2 and stores learned cell = snapshot -
;        ENGINE_DRAGTQ (base drag fuel vs RPM, tbl 22F9).
;   OBD1 LEARN_DRAG_TORQUE (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: idle_fuel_learn
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
idle_learn_cell_update:
	pshx                                ; 8D34  3C            push X
	ldx $00,y                           ; 8D35  CD EE 00      X = [Y+0]
	ldab >CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_FILTER         ; 8D38  F6 23 13      B = CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_FILTER
	ldaa >fuel_quantity                 ; 8D3B  B6 19 A4      A = fuel_quantity | OBD1: filter power to engine
	jsr >lag_filter_8bit_coef           ; 8D3E  BD 69 49      call lag_filter_8bit_coef
	std $00,y                           ; 8D41  18 ED 00      [Y+0] = D
	inc >DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR               ; 8D44  7C 01 31      DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR++ | every CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_RATE passes: cell = filtered idle fuel - base drag fuel(RPM)
	ldaa >DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR              ; 8D47  B6 01 31      A = DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR
	cmpa >CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_RATE           ; 8D4A  B1 23 14      compare A with CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_RATE | OBD1: is 73
	bls loc_8D74                        ; 8D4D  23 25         if DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR <= CAL_DRAG_ADAPT_RATE goto loc_8D74
	clr >DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR               ; 8D4F  7F 01 31      DRAGTQ_LEARN_TMR = 0
	ldaa $00,y                          ; 8D52  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	staa $02,y                          ; 8D55  18 A7 02      [Y+2] = A
	ldx #tbl2D_idle_learn_rate_22F9     ; 8D58  CE 22 F9      X = &tbl2D_idle_learn_rate_22F9 | OBD1: is all 30, is base engine drag
	ldaa >RPM_2_DBL                     ; 8D5B  B6 19 8A      A = RPM_2_DBL
	asla                                ; 8D5E  48            A <<= 1
	bcc loc_8D63                        ; 8D5F  24 02         if A >= 0 goto loc_8D63
	ldaa #$FF                           ; 8D61  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_8D63:
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; 8D63  BD 6D 06      call lookup_2D_table
	staa >ENGINE_DRAGTQ                 ; 8D66  B7 01 32      ENGINE_DRAGTQ = A
	ldaa $02,y                          ; 8D69  18 A6 02      A = [Y+2] | OBD1: filtered power
	suba >ENGINE_DRAGTQ                 ; 8D6C  B0 01 32      A -= ENGINE_DRAGTQ
	pulx                                ; 8D6F  38            pop X
	staa $00,x                          ; 8D70  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	bra loc_8D75                        ; 8D72  20 01         goto loc_8D75
loc_8D74:
	pulx                                ; 8D74  38            pop X
loc_8D75:
	rts                                 ; 8D75  39            return

;   analysis [high]: 50 ms task: anti-theft state machine, a bank-1 job, idle drag learn, zero-fuel RPM-rise

;        module message tests. TASKFLAGS1.2 is set while it runs.
;   OBD1 _run_50ms_job (match 0.84 p2-dataref)

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; kam_block_check_blank_or_sum_91CA
;   analysis [high]: X=last byte, B=length, A=default fill. An all-zero block counts as blank: it is filled with A
;        and the checksum stored, returning Z=1 (A=0). Otherwise it defers to sub_91E9 (sum check).
;   called from: trans_init_at_reset_9114
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
kam_block_check_blank_or_sum_91CA:
	pshx                                ; 91CA  3C            push X
	pshb                                ; 91CB  37            push B
	psha                                ; 91CC  36            push A
	bra loc_91D0                        ; 91CD  20 01         goto loc_91D0
loc_91CF:
	dex                                 ; 91CF  09            X--
loc_91D0:
	ldaa $00,x                          ; 91D0  A6 00         A = [X+0] | scan backwards; all-zero block = blank KAM -> fill with default
	bne loc_91E2                        ; 91D2  26 0E         if A != 0 goto loc_91E2
	decb                                ; 91D4  5A            B--
	bne loc_91CF                        ; 91D5  26 F8         if B != 0 goto loc_91CF
	pula                                ; 91D7  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; 91D8  33            pop B
	jsr >kam_block_fill_and_checksum_91FC; 91D9  BD 91 FC      call kam_block_fill_and_checksum_91FC
	pulx                                ; 91DC  38            pop X
	stab $00,x                          ; 91DD  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	clra                                ; 91DF  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_91E8                        ; 91E0  20 06         goto loc_91E8
loc_91E2:
	pula                                ; 91E2  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; 91E3  33            pop B
	pulx                                ; 91E4  38            pop X
	jsr >kam_block_verify_checksum_91E9 ; 91E5  BD 91 E9      call kam_block_verify_checksum_91E9
loc_91E8:
	rts                                 ; 91E8  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; kam_block_verify_checksum_91E9
;   analysis [high]: Sums B bytes ending at X. Sum 0 = valid: returns Z=1 with nothing changed. Otherwise it falls
;        into the fill routine (91FC) to reinit the block with A and returns A=1 (Z=0), B=checksum byte for the
;        caller to store at the block end.
;   called from: trans_init_at_reset_9114, kam_block_check_blank_or_sum_91CA
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
kam_block_verify_checksum_91E9:
	pshb                                ; 91E9  37            push B
	psha                                ; 91EA  36            push A
	clra                                ; 91EB  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_91EF                        ; 91EC  20 01         goto loc_91EF
loc_91EE:
	dex                                 ; 91EE  09            X--
loc_91EF:
	adda $00,x                          ; 91EF  AB 00         A += [X+0] | zero-sum checksum over block
	decb                                ; 91F1  5A            B--
	bne loc_91EE                        ; 91F2  26 FA         if B != 0 goto loc_91EE
	tsta                                ; 91F4  4D            test A
	bne loc_91FA                        ; 91F5  26 03         if A != 0 goto loc_91FA
	pulx                                ; 91F7  38            pop X
	bra loc_9209                        ; 91F8  20 0F         goto loc_9209
loc_91FA:
	pula                                ; 91FA  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; 91FB  33            pop B

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; kam_block_fill_and_checksum_91FC
;   analysis [high]: Fills B-1 bytes from X upward with A and returns B = -(A*(B-1)) (checksum byte so the block
;        sums to 0), A=1.
;   called from: kam_block_check_blank_or_sum_91CA
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
kam_block_fill_and_checksum_91FC:
	decb                                ; 91FC  5A            B--
	pshb                                ; 91FD  37            push B
loc_91FE:
	staa $00,x                          ; 91FE  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	inx                                 ; 9200  08            X++
	decb                                ; 9201  5A            B--
	bne loc_91FE                        ; 9202  26 FA         if B != 0 goto loc_91FE
	pulb                                ; 9204  33            pop B
	mul                                 ; 9205  3D            D = A * B | checksum byte = -(fill*(len-1)) so the block sums to 0
	negb                                ; 9206  50            B = -B
	ldaa #$01                           ; 9207  86 01         A = 1
loc_9209:
	rts                                 ; 9209  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_pcs_sol_gains
;   analysis [high]: Picks the force-motor PI gains from trans temp. FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX = trans_temp/32 (0..7)
;        with about 2 counts of hysteresis. Then I-gain = tbl_4840[idx] and P-gain = tbl_4848[idx]. 25 ms.
;   OBD1 calc_pcs_sol_gains (match 0.95 p1-global): 25ms - 40hz
;   called from: calc_SHIFTPAT_SELECT_90AC
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_pcs_sol_gains:
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; 9488  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered | gain index = trans temp / 32 with ~2-count hysteresis on each boundary | OBD1: trans temp ???
	ldab #$08                           ; 948B  C6 08         B = 8
	mul                                 ; 948D  3D            D = A * B
	subd #$0001                         ; 948E  83 00 01      D -= $0001(1)
	blt loc_9498                        ; 9491  2D 05         if D < (signed) 0 goto loc_9498
	cmpa >FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX            ; 9493  B1 1B B3      compare A with FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX
	bge loc_94A0                        ; 9496  2C 08         if trans_temp_filtered >= (signed) FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX goto loc_94A0
loc_9498:
	addd #$0011                         ; 9498  C3 00 11      D += $0011(17)
	cmpa >FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX            ; 949B  B1 1B B3      compare A with FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX
	bge loc_94A3                        ; 949E  2C 03         if A >= (signed) FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX goto loc_94A3
loc_94A0:
	staa >FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX            ; 94A0  B7 1B B3      FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX = A
loc_94A3:
	ldab >FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX            ; 94A3  F6 1B B3      B = FORCE_MTR_GAIN_IDX
	ldx #tbl_FORCE_MTR_IGAIN_by_temp_4840; 94A6  CE 48 40      X = &tbl_FORCE_MTR_IGAIN_by_temp_4840 | OBD1: GET THIS
	abx                                 ; 94A9  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; 94AA  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa >FORCE_MTR_IGAIN               ; 94AC  B7 1B B4      FORCE_MTR_IGAIN = A
	ldx #tbl_FORCE_MTR_PGAIN_by_temp_4848; 94AF  CE 48 48      X = &tbl_FORCE_MTR_PGAIN_by_temp_4848

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; decode_range_switch_PRNDL
;   analysis [high]: Reads the perf/manual switches and builds SHIFTPAT_SELECT from table 960E. It also packs A/C,
;        range switches A/B/C, 4WD-low and PTO into a temp byte, which becomes DS_DISCOLD (previous-state copy),
;        and updates DS_DIFLAGS A/C and cruise bits. Range switches A/B/C are decoded via PRNDL_decode_table_ACB
;        into Cal_bit_6_store (PRNDL), and $1886 counts time in the current position. If the lever is in D2
;   OBD1 L8556 (match 0.81 p1-global): 25ms - 40hz
;   Mostly shift position/cruise/4x4 checks and flag updates
;   called from: run_25ms_job, Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
decode_range_switch_PRNDL:

	ldaa >CRUISE_STATE                  ; 952C  B6 19 F0      A = CRUISE_STATE
	cmpa #$02                           ; 952F  81 02         compare A with 2
	bhi loc_9536                        ; 9531  22 03         if CRUISE_STATE > 2 goto loc_9536
	bset <trans_switch_flags,$80        ; 9533  14 71 80      trans_switch_flags .7 = 1
loc_9536:
	brset <IN_1802_debounced,$04,loc_953D; 9536  12 4F 04 03   if IN_1802_debounced .2 perf shift sw set goto loc_953D | OBD1: not used in this application... pin e4 - manual shift switch
	bset <trans_switch_flags,$01        ; 953A  14 71 01      trans_switch_flags .0 = 1
loc_953D:
	brset <IN_1802_debounced,$02,loc_9544; 953D  12 4F 02 03   if IN_1802_debounced .1 manual shift sw set goto loc_9544 | OBD1: pin e3 - performance shift switch
	bset <trans_switch_flags,$02        ; 9541  14 71 02      trans_switch_flags .1 = 1
loc_9544:
	ldab <trans_switch_flags            ; 9544  D6 71         B = trans_switch_flags | perf/manual switch bits -> SHIFTPAT_SELECT via table at 960E {normal, manual, perf, illegal} | OBD1: pin e4/e3 switch status

	stab <LAST_SHIFTPAT_SEL             ; 9550  D7 64         LAST_SHIFTPAT_SEL = B

	ldaa <DS_DIFLAGS                    ; 9554  96 66         A = DS_DIFLAGS
	staa <DS_DIFLAGS_prev               ; 9556  97 67         DS_DIFLAGS_prev = A
	bclr <DS_DIFLAGS,$04                ; 9558  15 66 04      DS_DIFLAGS .2 POWER ENRICHMENT ACTIVE = 0

	psha                                ; 955C  36            push A

loc_9568:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; PRNDL_decode_table_ACB  (data 9606-9611)
;   range switch pattern -> PRNDL code, then shift pattern codes
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRNDL_decode_table_ACB:
	; data, not code: 9606-960D PRNDL decode {88,08,88,04,20,40,01,02}; 960E-9611 shift pattern {01,04,02,09}
	fcb	$88,$08,$88,$04,$20,$40,$01,$02                             ; 9606  PRNDL decode

d_960E:
	fcb	$01,$04,$02,$09                                             ; 960E  shift pattern

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_input_shaft_speed_raw_9612
;   analysis [medium]: Produces the raw input-shaft speed $18A2. If an input speed sensor exists
;        (Configuration_set_3.3 or tbl_3864.7) it is measured from TIC2 pulse count/capture through the period
;        routine sub_96F9 (struct at $1899, cal k_384A/kw_384B), and the last value is held while $1BFC != 0.
;        Otherwise it is estimated as output speed ($18B7) times ratio $1877, saturated at FFFF.
;   called from: calculate_st_trans_shaft_speeds, Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_input_shaft_speed_raw_9612:
	ldx #Configuration_set_3_200D       ; 9612  CE 20 0D      X = &Configuration_set_3_200D | no input speed sensor configured -> estimate input speed = output speed * ratio $1877
	brset $00,x,$08,loc_9644            ; 9615  1E 00 08 2B   if Configuration_set_3_200D .3 trans sensors wired to ECM set goto loc_9644
	ldaa >k_trans_type_flags_3864       ; 9619  B6 38 64      A = k_trans_type_flags_3864
	bita #$80                           ; 961C  85 80         test k_trans_type_flags_3864 .7
	bne loc_9644                        ; 961E  26 24         if any of k_trans_type_flags_3864 .7 set goto loc_9644
	ldd >output_speed_unfiltered        ; 9620  FC 18 B7      D = output_speed_unfiltered
	ldx >trans_ratio_measured           ; 9623  FE 18 77      X = trans_ratio_measured
	jsr >sub_6788                       ; 9626  BD 67 88      call sub_6788
	asld                                ; 9629  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_9632                        ; 962A  25 06         if carry goto loc_9632
	asld                                ; 962C  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_9632                        ; 962D  25 03         if carry goto loc_9632
	asld                                ; 962F  05            D <<= 1
	bcc loc_9637                        ; 9630  24 05         if no carry goto loc_9637
loc_9632:
	ldx #$FFFF                          ; 9632  CE FF FF      X = $FFFF(65535)
	bra loc_9672                        ; 9635  20 3B         goto loc_9672
loc_9637:
	xgdx                                ; 9637  8F            swap D <-> X | round 32-bit product and add top bits to keep 16-bit speed
	adda #$10                           ; 9638  8B 10         A += $10(16)
	anda #$E0                           ; 963A  84 E0         A &= $E0(224) (keep bits)
	rola                                ; 963C  49            A rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; 963D  49            A rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; 963E  49            A rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; 963F  49            A rotate left thru C
	tab                                 ; 9640  16            B = A
	abx                                 ; 9641  3A            X += B
	bra loc_9672                        ; 9642  20 2E         goto loc_9672
loc_9644:
	sei                                 ; 9644  0F            disable interrupts | measured input speed: snapshot TIC2 pulse count and capture time atomically
	ldab >input_shaft_pulse_count       ; 9645  F6 1C 92      B = input_shaft_pulse_count
	ldx >input_shaft_last_capture       ; 9648  FE 1C 93      X = input_shaft_last_capture

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; trans_task_9676
;   analysis [low]: Computes $18A8 from the input shaft speed $18A2. Normally it is a rounded copy (scaled by

;        is multiplied by ratio $1877 instead. Exact meaning of $18A8 is uncertain.

	inca                                ; 9688  4C            A++

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; CALC_OSS_SPEED
;   analysis [high]: Output shaft speed from VSS (TIC1) pulse count/capture through sub_96F9 (struct at $18AC,
;        CAL_TRANS_OSS_DT_SCALAR/kw_3851), giving the period in $18B5. When $6F.0 is set it converts to
;        TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW with CAL_OSS_SCALAR (saturated). 25 ms.
;   OBD1 CALC_OSS_SPEED (match 0.98 p1-global): 25ms - 40hz
;   called from: calculate_st_trans_shaft_speeds, Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CALC_OSS_SPEED:
	sei                                 ; 96C4  0F            disable interrupts
	ldab >VSS_pulse_count               ; 96C5  F6 1C 95      B = VSS_pulse_count
	ldx >VSS_last_capture               ; 96C8  FE 1C 96      X = VSS_last_capture
	cli                                 ; 96CB  0E            enable interrupts
	ldy #$18AC                          ; 96CC  18 CE 18 AC   Y = $18AC(6316) | OBD1: 7b + 8:6
	stab $08,y                          ; 96D0  18 E7 08      TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW+4 = B
	stx $06,y                           ; 96D3  CD EF 06      TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW+2 = X
	ldab >CAL_TRANS_OSS_DT_SCALAR       ; 96D6  F6 38 50      B = CAL_TRANS_OSS_DT_SCALAR
	ldx >kw_3851                        ; 96D9  FE 38 51      X = kw_3851
	jsr >calc_pulse_period_multi_96F9   ; 96DC  BD 96 F9      call calc_pulse_period_multi_96F9
	std >OSS_period                     ; 96DF  FD 18 B5      OSS_period = D
	brclr <pto_v006F,$01,loc_96F8       ; 96E2  13 6F 01 12   if pto_v006F .0 clear goto loc_96F8
	ldx >CAL_OSS_SCALAR                 ; 96E6  FE 38 54      X = CAL_OSS_SCALAR
	jsr >sub_6788                       ; 96E9  BD 67 88      call sub_6788
	asld                                ; 96EC  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_96F2                        ; 96ED  25 03         if carry goto loc_96F2
	asld                                ; 96EF  05            D <<= 1
	bcc loc_96F5                        ; 96F0  24 03         if no carry goto loc_96F5
loc_96F2:
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; 96F2  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_96F5:
	std >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW         ; 96F5  FD 18 B0      TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED_RAW = D
loc_96F8:
	rts                                 ; 96F8  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_pulse_period_multi_96F9
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 L8857: generic pulse-period calculator for a speed-input struct at Y (+0 last pulse
;        count, +1 last capture time, +3 hold counter, +4 period result, +6 new capture, +8 new count). With new
;        pulses it divides the capture-time delta by the pulse delta, scaled by B/X cal constants. With no new
;        pulses it keeps the old period for B cycles, then returns the default. Returns D = period.
;   OBD1 L8857 (match 1.00 p1-exact): Subroutine needed to process multiples of pulses...
;   called from: calc_input_shaft_speed_raw_9612, CALC_OSS_SPEED
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_pulse_period_multi_96F9:
	ldaa $08,y                          ; 96F9  18 A6 08      A = [Y+8] | new pulses? if none, hold last period [Y+3] cycles before falling to default | OBD1: number of pulses
	suba $00,y                          ; 96FC  18 A0 00      A -= [Y+0]
	bne loc_9711                        ; 96FF  26 10         if A != 0 goto loc_9711
	ldab $03,y                          ; 9701  18 E6 03      B = [Y+3]
	beq loc_970C                        ; 9704  27 06         if B == 0 goto loc_970C
	decb                                ; 9706  5A            B--
	stab $03,y                          ; 9707  18 E7 03      [Y+3] = B
	bne loc_9745                        ; 970A  26 39         if B != 0 goto loc_9745
loc_970C:
	std $04,y                           ; 970C  18 ED 04      [Y+4] = D
	bra loc_9745                        ; 970F  20 34         goto loc_9745
loc_9711:
	pshb                                ; 9711  37            push B | period = capture-time delta / (pulse delta * scale), two-step FDIV
	ldab $03,y                          ; 9712  18 E6 03      B = [Y+3]
	beq loc_9732                        ; 9715  27 1B         if B == 0 goto loc_9732
	tab                                 ; 9717  16            B = A
	pshx                                ; 9718  3C            push X
	clra                                ; 9719  4F            A = 0
	asld                                ; 971A  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; 971B  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; 971C  05            D <<= 1
	pshb                                ; 971D  37            push B
	psha                                ; 971E  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; 971F  30            X = SP + 1
	asld                                ; 9720  05            D <<= 1
	addd $00,x                          ; 9721  E3 00         D += [X+0]
	ins                                 ; 9723  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; 9724  31            SP++
	pulx                                ; 9725  38            pop X
	fdiv                                ; 9726  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	ldd $06,y                           ; 9727  18 EC 06      D = [Y+6]
	subd $01,y                          ; 972A  18 A3 01      D -= [Y+1]
	xgdx                                ; 972D  8F            swap D <-> X
	fdiv                                ; 972E  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	stx $04,y                           ; 972F  CD EF 04      [Y+4] = X
loc_9732:
	ldx $06,y                           ; 9732  CD EE 06      X = [Y+6]
	stx $01,y                           ; 9735  CD EF 01      [Y+1] = X
	ldaa $08,y                          ; 9738  18 A6 08      A = [Y+8]
	staa $00,y                          ; 973B  18 A7 00      [Y+0] = A
	pula                                ; 973E  32            pop A
	staa $03,y                          ; 973F  18 A7 03      [Y+3] = A
	ldd $04,y                           ; 9742  18 EC 04      D = [Y+4]
loc_9745:
	rts                                 ; 9745  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_tp_for_transmission
;   analysis [high]: Builds the simulated throttle position engine_load_est_filtered (OBD1 SIM_TPS) for trans
;        control. With cruise not engaged it is the filtered pedal. Otherwise it interpolates the cruise fuel
;        request through Fuel_demand_map_0..3 vs CRUISE_RPM_CAP, clamps it at k_2090 and lag-filters it with
;        k_2095. The OBD1 notes in the source describe the equations.
;   OBD1 calc_tp_for_transmission (match 1.00 p1-exact): This is used for other control stuff but not the actual
;        sync
;   fuel quantity calculation.
;   Equation inputs are:
;   CFR = CRUISE_FUEL_REQ_NO_DERATE
;   IFR = IDLE_FUEL_REQ
;   AFR = APP_FUEL_REQ
;   ACF  = A
;   called from: run_25ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_tp_for_transmission:
	ldaa >CRUISE_STATE                  ; 9746  B6 19 F0      A = CRUISE_STATE
	cmpa #$02                           ; 9749  81 02         compare A with 2
	bhi loc_9753                        ; 974B  22 06         if CRUISE_STATE > 2 goto loc_9753 | OBD1: BR IF CRUISE_STATE > 2
	ldaa >pedal_position_filtered       ; 974D  B6 19 16      A = pedal_position_filtered
	jmp >loc_9827                       ; 9750  7E 98 27      goto loc_9827 | OBD1: STORE SIM_TPS & rts
loc_9753:
	clra                                ; 9753  4F            A = 0
	brclr <ENGMODEFLAG,$40,loc_9765     ; 9754  13 4C 40 0D   if ENGMODEFLAG .6 idle mode clear goto loc_9765 | OBD1: in idle speed mode here
	ldab >IDLE_FUEL_REQ                 ; 9758  F6 1C 7F      B = IDLE_FUEL_REQ
	cmpb >APP_FUEL_REQ                  ; 975B  F1 19 AB      compare B with APP_FUEL_REQ
	bls loc_9765                        ; 975E  23 05         if IDLE_FUEL_REQ <= APP_FUEL_REQ goto loc_9765 | OBD1: BR IF IDLE_FUEL_REQ <= APP_FUEL_REQ
	cmpb >CRUISE_FUEL_REQ               ; 9760  F1 1A 15      compare B with CRUISE_FUEL_REQ | OBD1: already capped for derate
	bhi loc_979E                        ; 9763  22 39         if IDLE_FUEL_REQ > CRUISE_FUEL_REQ goto loc_979E | OBD1: BR IF IDLE_FUEL_REQ > CRUISE_FUEL_REQ
loc_9765:
	ldaa >pedal_position_filtered       ; 9765  B6 19 16      A = pedal_position_filtered
	cmpa #$DF                           ; 9768  81 DF         compare A with $DF(223)
	bcc loc_979E                        ; 976A  24 32         if pedal_position_filtered >= $DF(223) goto loc_979E | OBD1: BR IF APP_COND > 0xDF (87%)
	ldab >APP_FUEL_REQ                  ; 976C  F6 19 AB      B = APP_FUEL_REQ
	cmpb >CRUISE_FUEL_REQ               ; 976F  F1 1A 15      compare B with CRUISE_FUEL_REQ

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_trans_speed_ratios_A328
;   analysis [medium]: Calculates trans ratios in 3.13 fixed point ($2000 = 1.0) with sub_68BC (divide): $18C3 =
;        engine/output speed, $1879 = input/output speed (measured gear ratio), $1C12 = expected ratio, $18C5 =
;        measured/nominal ratio x2. Also keeps gear dwell timer $1BD5, last gear $1BD4, TCC-mode timer $1BD3, and
;        snapshots slip/ratio in 2nd gear ($1BD6/$1BD8).
;   called from: run_trans_diags_and_tasks_990B
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_trans_speed_ratios_A328:
	ldx >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; A328  FE 18 B9      X = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED | $18C3 = engine/output speed ratio (3.13 fixed, $2000 = 1.0)
	ldd >engine_speed_filtered          ; A32B  FC 18 C7      D = engine_speed_filtered
	jsr >div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC         ; A32E  BD 68 BC      call div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC
	std >engine_output_ratio            ; A331  FD 18 C3      engine_output_ratio = D
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; A334  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT
	cmpa #$01                           ; A337  81 01         compare A with 1
	bne loc_A347                        ; A339  26 0C         if trans_gear_AT != 1 goto loc_A347
	ldx >TCC_slip_speed                 ; A33B  FE 1B 01      X = TCC_slip_speed
	stx >trans_v1BD6                    ; A33E  FF 1B D6      trans_v1BD6 = X
	ldx >engine_output_ratio            ; A341  FE 18 C3      X = engine_output_ratio
	stx >trans_v1BD8                    ; A344  FF 1B D8      trans_v1BD8 = X
loc_A347:
	cmpa >last_gear_1BD4                ; A347  B1 1B D4      compare A with last_gear_1BD4 | gear dwell timer $1BD5, restarts on gear change
	beq loc_A34F                        ; A34A  27 03         if A == last_gear_1BD4 goto loc_A34F
	clrb                                ; A34C  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_A355                        ; A34D  20 06         goto loc_A355
loc_A34F:
	ldab >gear_dwell_timer              ; A34F  F6 1B D5      B = gear_dwell_timer
	incb                                ; A352  5C            B++
	beq loc_A358                        ; A353  27 03         if B == 0 goto loc_A358
loc_A355:
	stab >gear_dwell_timer              ; A355  F7 1B D5      gear_dwell_timer = B
loc_A358:
	staa >last_gear_1BD4                ; A358  B7 1B D4      last_gear_1BD4 = A
	clra                                ; A35B  4F            A = 0 | $1BD3 counts while TCC mode bits .2/.4 are set, else 0
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$14,loc_A366      ; A35C  13 7A 14 06   if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_A366
	ldaa >TCC_mode_timer                ; A360  B6 1B D3      A = TCC_mode_timer
	inca                                ; A363  4C            A++
	beq loc_A369                        ; A364  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_A369
loc_A366:
	staa >TCC_mode_timer                ; A366  B7 1B D3      TCC_mode_timer = A
loc_A369:
	ldx >OSS_period                     ; A369  FE 18 B5      X = OSS_period
	ldaa >k_trans_type_flags_3864       ; A36C  B6 38 64      A = k_trans_type_flags_3864
	bmi loc_A376                        ; A36F  2B 05         if A < 0 (signed) goto loc_A376
	ldd >engine_speed_filtered          ; A371  FC 18 C7      D = engine_speed_filtered
	bra loc_A398                        ; A374  20 22         goto loc_A398
loc_A376:
	ldd >input_shaft_speed_raw          ; A376  FC 18 A2      D = input_shaft_speed_raw | input-speed-sensor config: measured ratio / nominal gear ratio (1.0 in 3rd with TCC)
	jsr >div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC         ; A379  BD 68 BC      call div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC
	pshb                                ; A37C  37            push B
	psha                                ; A37D  36            push A
	ldaa #$03                           ; A37E  86 03         A = 3
	cmpa >k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B     ; A380  B1 38 7B      compare A with k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B
	bne loc_A393                        ; A383  26 0E         if 3 != k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B goto loc_A393
	cmpa >trans_gear_AT                 ; A385  B1 1A C0      compare A with trans_gear_AT
	bne loc_A393                        ; A388  26 09         if 3 != trans_gear_AT goto loc_A393
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$14,loc_A393      ; A38A  13 7A 14 05   if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_A393
	ldx >tbl_386F                       ; A38E  FE 38 6F      X = tbl_386F
	bra loc_A396                        ; A391  20 03         goto loc_A396
loc_A393:
	jsr >get_gear_ratio_98EE            ; A393  BD 98 EE      call get_gear_ratio_98EE
loc_A396:
	pula                                ; A396  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; A397  33            pop B
loc_A398:
	jsr >div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC         ; A398  BD 68 BC      call div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC
	asld                                ; A39B  05            D <<= 1
	bcc loc_A3A1                        ; A39C  24 03         if no carry goto loc_A3A1
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; A39E  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_A3A1:
	std >trans_v18C5                    ; A3A1  FD 18 C5      trans_v18C5 = D
	ldaa >k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B     ; A3A4  B6 38 7B      A = k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B

	bne loc_A3C2                        ; A3AA  26 16         if k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B != k_num_shift_adapt_tables_3890 goto loc_A3C2
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; A3AC  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT

	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$14,loc_A3C2      ; A3B3  13 7A 14 0B   if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_A3C2
	ldx >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; A3B7  FE 18 B9      X = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED
	ldd >engine_speed_filtered          ; A3BA  FC 18 C7      D = engine_speed_filtered
	jsr >div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC         ; A3BD  BD 68 BC      call div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC
	bra loc_A3C5                        ; A3C0  20 03         goto loc_A3C5
loc_A3C2:
	ldd >trans_ratio_measured           ; A3C2  FC 18 77      D = trans_ratio_measured
loc_A3C5:
	std >trans_ratio_for_diag           ; A3C5  FD 1C 12      trans_ratio_for_diag = D
	ldx >TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED             ; A3C8  FE 18 B9      X = TRANS_OUTPUT_SPEED | $1879 = input/output speed = measured gear ratio
	ldd >trans_input_speed_filtered     ; A3CB  FC 18 A4      D = trans_input_speed_filtered
	jsr >div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC         ; A3CE  BD 68 BC      call div_ratio_q13_sat_68BC
	std >trans_ratio_measured_1879      ; A3D1  FD 18 79      trans_ratio_measured_1879 = D
	rts                                 ; A3D4  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; sat_udiff_to_s16_AE46
;   analysis [high]: Helper called right after SUBD. It converts the unsigned 16-bit difference in D (carry =
;        borrow) into a saturated signed value: a borrow clamps to <= $8000 (most negative), no borrow clamps to
;        <= $7FFF.
;   called from: diag_P0723_output_speed_intermit_AD68
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sat_udiff_to_s16_AE46:
	bcc loc_AE53                        ; AE46  24 0B         if no carry goto loc_AE53
	cpd #$8000                          ; AE48  1A 83 80 00   compare D with $8000(32768)
	bcc loc_AE5C                        ; AE4C  24 0E         if D >= $8000(32768) goto loc_AE5C
	ldd #$8000                          ; AE4E  CC 80 00      D = $8000(32768)
	bra loc_AE5C                        ; AE51  20 09         goto loc_AE5C
loc_AE53:
	cpd #$7FFF                          ; AE53  1A 83 7F FF   compare D with $7FFF(32767)
	bls loc_AE5C                        ; AE57  23 03         if D <= $7FFF(32767) goto loc_AE5C
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; AE59  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
loc_AE5C:
	rts                                 ; AE5C  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; trans_load_filter
;   analysis [high]: Produces trans_load_filtered (high byte of 16-bit filter state $18E2) from
;        engine_load_est_filtered with FILTER1 coefficient k_3837. While DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2.7 (limp) is set,
;        latched in $1C58.0, load is forced to k_3832. First pass sets $8C.0.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	bset <trans_v008C,$01               ; B391  14 8C 01      trans_v008C .0 trans load filter initialised = 1
	brset <DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2,$80,loc_B3A0; B394  12 53 80 08   if DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .7 no valid pedal sensor (limp, P1125) set goto loc_B3A0
	anda #$FE                           ; B398  84 FE         A &= $FE(254) (keep bits)
	bra loc_B3A2                        ; B39A  20 06         goto loc_B3A2
loc_B39C:
	brclr <DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2,$80,loc_B3A5; B39C  13 53 80 05   if DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .7 no valid pedal sensor (limp, P1125) clear goto loc_B3A5
loc_B3A0:
	oraa #$01                           ; B3A0  8A 01         A |= 1
loc_B3A2:
	staa >trans_load_limp_latch         ; B3A2  B7 1C 58      trans_load_limp_latch = A
loc_B3A5:
	bita #$01                           ; B3A5  85 01         test A mask 1
	beq loc_B3AF                        ; B3A7  27 06         if mask 1 all clear goto loc_B3AF
	ldaa >k_trans_load_limp_3832        ; B3A9  B6 38 32      A = k_trans_load_limp_3832

	bra loc_B3BB                        ; B3AD  20 0C         goto loc_B3BB

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;   analysis [medium]: Sets DS_DIFLAGS.4 (kickdown) when load state $18E2 rises above k_385B (2WD) / k_3859 (4WD),
;        not in manual. It clears it below k_385C / k_385A. It computes load rate $18D5 (signed per-call delta)
;        for tip-out ($6B.0, hold timer $18D6=k_389B) and tip-in ($6A.3) flags. It also sets $6A.6 VSS-high

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_engine_speed_tracking_B6CF
;   analysis [medium]: Runs the alpha-beta-gamma tracking filter sub_B709 with measurement $1897 (engine_RPM*150
;        scaled) and gains tbl_38E6. Updates engine_speed_filtered (position), $18C9 (rate) and $18CB (2nd
;        derivative). It saves the old rate in $18CD and sets $85.0 when the rate is decreasing (engine
;        decelerating).
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_engine_speed_tracking_B6CF:
	ldx >engine_speed_rate              ; B6CF  FE 18 C9      X = engine_speed_rate | stack args for tracking filter: meas $1897, gains tbl_38E6, pos, rate, accel
	stx >engine_speed_rate_prev         ; B6D2  FF 18 CD      engine_speed_rate_prev = X
	ldx >engine_speed_raw_trans         ; B6D5  FE 18 97      X = engine_speed_raw_trans
	pshx                                ; B6D8  3C            push X
	ldx #tbl_engspd_tracking_gains_38E6 ; B6D9  CE 38 E6      X = &tbl_engspd_tracking_gains_38E6
	pshx                                ; B6DC  3C            push X
	ldx >engine_speed_filtered          ; B6DD  FE 18 C7      X = engine_speed_filtered
	pshx                                ; B6E0  3C            push X
	ldx >engine_speed_rate              ; B6E1  FE 18 C9      X = engine_speed_rate
	pshx                                ; B6E4  3C            push X
	ldx >engine_speed_accel             ; B6E5  FE 18 CB      X = engine_speed_accel
	pshx                                ; B6E8  3C            push X
	jsr >abg_tracking_filter_B709       ; B6E9  BD B7 09      call abg_tracking_filter_B709
	pulx                                ; B6EC  38            pop X
	stx >engine_speed_accel             ; B6ED  FF 18 CB      engine_speed_accel = X
	pulx                                ; B6F0  38            pop X
	stx >engine_speed_rate              ; B6F1  FF 18 C9      engine_speed_rate = X
	pulx                                ; B6F4  38            pop X
	stx >engine_speed_filtered          ; B6F5  FF 18 C7      engine_speed_filtered = X
	pulx                                ; B6F8  38            pop X
	pulx                                ; B6F9  38            pop X
	bclr <shift_v0085,$01               ; B6FA  15 85 01      shift_v0085 .0 engine speed rate decreasing = 0 | $85.0 = engine speed rate decreasing

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; abg_tracking_filter_B709
;   analysis [medium]: Generic 3-state tracking filter with stack arguments (meas, gain table ptr, pos, rate,
;        accel). It computes the error meas-pos with a +-1 deadband (rates zeroed), then corrects pos, rate and
;        accel using gains [tbl+0], [tbl+2], [tbl+4] via MULS32 (>>2) plus sub_B7E6 prediction terms with [tbl+6].
;        All results are signed-saturated.
;   called from: calc_engine_speed_tracking_B6CF
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
abg_tracking_filter_B709:
	pshx                                ; B709  3C            push X
	pshx                                ; B70A  3C            push X
	tsx                                 ; B70B  30            X = SP + 1
	ldd $0E,x                           ; B70C  EC 0E         D = [X+14] | error = measurement - estimate; |error| <= 1 -> zero rate/accel (deadband)
	subd $0A,x                          ; B70E  A3 0A         D -= [X+10]
	bcs loc_B71C                        ; B710  25 0A         if D < 0 goto loc_B71C
	bmi loc_B72A                        ; B712  2B 16         if D < 0 (signed) goto loc_B72A
	cpd #$0001                          ; B714  1A 83 00 01   compare D with $0001(1)
	bls loc_B724                        ; B718  23 0A         if D <= $0001(1) goto loc_B724
	bra loc_B72D                        ; B71A  20 11         goto loc_B72D
loc_B71C:
	bpl loc_B72A                        ; B71C  2A 0C         if result >= 0 (signed) goto loc_B72A
	cpd #$FFFF                          ; B71E  1A 83 FF FF   compare D with $FFFF(65535)
	blt loc_B72D                        ; B722  2D 09         if D < (signed) $FFFF(65535) goto loc_B72D
loc_B724:
	clra                                ; B724  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; B725  5F            B = 0
	std $08,x                           ; B726  ED 08         [X+8] = D
	std $06,x                           ; B728  ED 06         [X+6] = D
loc_B72A:
	jmp >loc_B7E3                       ; B72A  7E B7 E3      goto loc_B7E3
loc_B72D:
	std $02,x                           ; B72D  ED 02         [X+2] = D | position correction = gain0*error (MULS32 >>2) + 2*predicted rate term
	ldx $0C,x                           ; B72F  EE 0C         X = [X+12]
	ldx $00,x                           ; B731  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	jsr >MULS32                         ; B733  BD 6A 6C      call MULS32
	asra                                ; B736  47            A >>= 1 (signed)
	rorb                                ; B737  56            B rotate right thru C
	xgdx                                ; B738  8F            swap D <-> X
	rora                                ; B739  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; B73A  56            B rotate right thru C
	xgdx                                ; B73B  8F            swap D <-> X
	asra                                ; B73C  47            A >>= 1 (signed)
	rorb                                ; B73D  56            B rotate right thru C
	xgdx                                ; B73E  8F            swap D <-> X
	rora                                ; B73F  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; B740  56            B rotate right thru C
	psha                                ; B741  36            push A
	xgdx                                ; B742  8F            swap D <-> X
	tba                                 ; B743  17            A = B
	pulb                                ; B744  33            pop B
	tsx                                 ; B745  30            X = SP + 1
	std $00,x                           ; B746  ED 00         [X+0] = D
	ldd $08,x                           ; B748  EC 08         D = [X+8]
	ldx $0C,x                           ; B74A  EE 0C         X = [X+12]
	ldx $06,x                           ; B74C  EE 06         X = [X+6]
	jsr >signed_idiv_16_B7E6            ; B74E  BD B7 E6      call signed_idiv_16_B7E6
	tsx                                 ; B751  30            X = SP + 1
	asld                                ; B752  05            D <<= 1
	addd $00,x                          ; B753  E3 00         D += [X+0]
	bvc loc_B75E                        ; B755  28 07         if no overflow goto loc_B75E
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; B757  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
	adcb #$00                           ; B75A  C9 00         B += C + 0
	adca #$00                           ; B75C  89 00         A += C + 0
loc_B75E:
	tsta                                ; B75E  4D            test A
	bmi loc_B76A                        ; B75F  2B 09         if A < 0 (signed) goto loc_B76A
	addd $0A,x                          ; B761  E3 0A         D += [X+10]
	bcc loc_B77C                        ; B763  24 17         if D no overflow goto loc_B77C
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; B765  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
	bra loc_B77C                        ; B768  20 12         goto loc_B77C
loc_B76A:
	nega                                ; B76A  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; B76B  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; B76C  82 00         A -= C + 0
	pshb                                ; B76E  37            push B
	psha                                ; B76F  36            push A
	ldd $0A,x                           ; B770  EC 0A         D = [X+10]
	tsx                                 ; B772  30            X = SP + 1
	subd $00,x                          ; B773  A3 00         D -= [X+0]
	bcc loc_B779                        ; B775  24 02         if D >= 0 goto loc_B779
	clra                                ; B777  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; B778  5F            B = 0
loc_B779:
	ins                                 ; B779  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; B77A  31            SP++
	tsx                                 ; B77B  30            X = SP + 1
loc_B77C:
	std $0A,x                           ; B77C  ED 0A         [X+10] = D
	ldd $02,x                           ; B77E  EC 02         D = [X+2] | rate correction = gain1*error + half accel term

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; signed_idiv_16_B7E6
;   analysis [high]: Signed 16/16 divide: D (signed) / X (unsigned) using IDIV, takes the absolute value and puts
;        the sign back on the quotient. Returns the quotient in D. Called from sub_B709.
;   called from: abg_tracking_filter_B709
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
signed_idiv_16_B7E6:
	tsta                                ; B7E6  4D            test A
	bmi loc_B7ED                        ; B7E7  2B 04         if A < 0 (signed) goto loc_B7ED
	idiv                                ; B7E9  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	xgdx                                ; B7EA  8F            swap D <-> X
	bra loc_B7F7                        ; B7EB  20 0A         goto loc_B7F7
loc_B7ED:
	nega                                ; B7ED  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; B7EE  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; B7EF  82 00         A -= C + 0
	idiv                                ; B7F1  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	xgdx                                ; B7F2  8F            swap D <-> X
	nega                                ; B7F3  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; B7F4  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; B7F5  82 00         A -= C + 0
loc_B7F7:
	rts                                 ; B7F7  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_slip_speed_B7F8
;   analysis [low]: Signed speed difference [$1897] - [$18A8] (most likely engine speed minus turbine speed, i.e.
;        torque converter slip), saturated to 16 bits and filtered with FILTER2 (coefficient tbl_3891) into $1B01;
;        |slip| goes to $1AFD. Flag $6A.5 is set when slip < kw_43A8 (-640) and cleared when slip > kw_43AA (+1),
;        so it means negative slip (coast or overrun).
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes TCC_slip_speed, TCC_slip_abs
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_slip_speed_B7F8:
	ldd >engine_speed_raw_trans         ; B7F8  FC 18 97      D = engine_speed_raw_trans
	subd >trans_v18A8                   ; B7FB  B3 18 A8      D -= trans_v18A8
	rora                                ; B7FE  46            A rotate right thru C
	rola                                ; B7FF  49            A rotate left thru C
	bvc loc_B809                        ; B800  28 07         if no overflow goto loc_B809
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; B802  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
	adcb #$00                           ; B805  C9 00         B += C + 0
	adca #$00                           ; B807  89 00         A += C + 0
loc_B809:
	ldx >TCC_slip_speed                 ; B809  FE 1B 01      X = TCC_slip_speed | filter TC slip (engine - turbine?) with coef tbl_3891 -> $1B01, abs -> $1AFD
	ldy #k_TC_slip_filter_3891          ; B80C  18 CE 38 91   Y = &k_TC_slip_filter_3891
	jsr >FILTER2                        ; B810  BD 66 6F      call FILTER2
	std >TCC_slip_speed                 ; B813  FD 1B 01      TCC_slip_speed = D
	bpl loc_B81C                        ; B816  2A 04         if D >= 0 (signed) goto loc_B81C
	nega                                ; B818  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; B819  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; B81A  82 00         A -= C + 0
loc_B81C:
	std >TCC_slip_abs                   ; B81C  FD 1A FD      TCC_slip_abs = D
	ldx >TCC_slip_speed                 ; B81F  FE 1B 01      X = TCC_slip_speed | hysteresis: $6A.5 = negative slip (coast), set < kw_43A8, clear > kw_43AA
	cpx >kw_43A8                        ; B822  BC 43 A8      compare X with kw_43A8
	bge loc_B82C                        ; B825  2C 05         if X >= (signed) kw_43A8 goto loc_B82C
	bset <tcc_v006A,$20                 ; B827  14 6A 20      tcc_v006A .5 TC slip negative (coast), hysteresis = 1
	bra loc_B834                        ; B82A  20 08         goto loc_B834
loc_B82C:
	cpx >kw_43AA                        ; B82C  BC 43 AA      compare X with kw_43AA
	ble loc_B834                        ; B82F  2F 03         if X <= (signed) kw_43AA goto loc_B834
	bclr <tcc_v006A,$20                 ; B831  15 6A 20      tcc_v006A .5 TC slip negative (coast), hysteresis = 0
loc_B834:
	rts                                 ; B834  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;        into DS_DIFLAGS.7, polarity from tbl_383F.5. Then sets the trans mode code $6F to 1 (override,
;        $8B.0/$1BCA/tbl_4AC4, or both flags set), 12 (4WD), 2 (PTO) or 4 (normal). $1BE2 is a saturating timer
;        cleared on

; calc_shift_ratio_profile_BA38
;   analysis [medium]: State machine for the commanded gear ratio $1889 during a shift. The state bits are in
;        $6C/$6D/$6E and are reset by sub_BD07. Each state is driven by shift-phase bits $1B46.1/.2, $77 and
;        $85.4. $188C is a tick timer. The state picks a start ratio $1894 and a target ratio $1892
;        (tbl_386B/386D/386F/3869 via sub_BD0F) plus a delay ($188F) and ramp length ($188B, from
;        tbl_3876/tbl_3873/$1B64). It then
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; clear_shift_ratio_states_BD07
;   analysis [high]: Clears the three shift-ratio state bytes $6C, $6D and $6E (B=0 on return).
;   called from: calc_shift_ratio_profile_BA38
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
clear_shift_ratio_states_BD07:
	clrb                                ; BD07  5F            B = 0
	stab <shift_ratio_state1            ; BD08  D7 6C         shift_ratio_state1 = B
	stab <shift_v006D                   ; BD0A  D7 6D         shift_v006D = B
	stab <shift_v006E                   ; BD0C  D7 6E         shift_v006E = B
	rts                                 ; BD0E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; get_ratio_for_gear_BD0F
;   analysis [high]: Returns the word at X[trans_gear_AT*2] from the ratio table in X. In Reverse
;        (Cal_bit_6_store.5) it returns the reverse ratio tbl_3869 ($423E = 2.07) instead.
;   OBD1 L8812 (match 0.71 p2-dataref)
;   called from: calc_shift_ratio_profile_BA38
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_ratio_for_gear_BD0F:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; BD0F  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$20,loc_BD1B ; BD12  13 5F 20 05   if Cal_bit_6_store .5 Reverse clear goto loc_BD1B
	ldx #kw_reverse_gear_ratio_3869     ; BD16  CE 38 69      X = &kw_reverse_gear_ratio_3869
	bra loc_BD1D                        ; BD19  20 02         goto loc_BD1D
loc_BD1B:
	aslb                                ; BD1B  58            B <<= 1
	abx                                 ; BD1C  3A            X += B
loc_BD1D:
	ldx $00,x                           ; BD1D  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	rts                                 ; BD1F  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_ratio_ramp_remaining_BD20
;   analysis [medium]: $1890 = ramp length $188B + delay $188F - elapsed $188C, saturated to 0..255. These are the
;        ticks left in the current ratio ramp.
;   called from: calc_shift_ratio_profile_BA38
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_ratio_ramp_remaining_BD20:
	ldab >shift_ratio_ramp_len          ; BD20  F6 18 8B      B = shift_ratio_ramp_len
	addb >shift_ratio_ramp_delay        ; BD23  FB 18 8F      B += shift_ratio_ramp_delay
	bcs loc_BD30                        ; BD26  25 08         if B overflowed goto loc_BD30
	subb >shift_ratio_timer             ; BD28  F0 18 8C      B -= shift_ratio_timer
	bcc loc_BD37                        ; BD2B  24 0A         if B >= 0 goto loc_BD37
	clrb                                ; BD2D  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_BD37                        ; BD2E  20 07         goto loc_BD37
loc_BD30:
	subb >shift_ratio_timer             ; BD30  F0 18 8C      B -= shift_ratio_timer
	bcs loc_BD37                        ; BD33  25 02         if B < 0 goto loc_BD37
	ldab #$FF                           ; BD35  C6 FF         B = $FF(255)
loc_BD37:
	stab >shift_ratio_ramp_left         ; BD37  F7 18 90      shift_ratio_ramp_left = B
	rts                                 ; BD3A  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; get_ratio_ramp_time_BD3B
;   analysis [medium]: B = tbl_3876[trans_gear_AT] (30 ticks for every gear in this cal), the length of the ratio
;        ramp.

get_ratio_ramp_time_BD3B:

	abx                                 ; BD41  3A            X += B
	ldab $00,x                          ; BD42  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	rts                                 ; BD44  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; get_ratio_ramp_delay_BD45
;   analysis [medium]: B = tbl_3873[trans_gear_AT] (10 ticks per gear), the delay before the ratio ramp starts.
;   called from: calc_shift_ratio_profile_BA38
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_ratio_ramp_delay_BD45:
	ldx #tbl_ratio_ramp_delay_3873      ; BD45  CE 38 73      X = &tbl_ratio_ramp_delay_3873
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; BD48  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	abx                                 ; BD4B  3A            X += B
	ldab $00,x                          ; BD4C  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	rts                                 ; BD4E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; detect_garage_shift_BD4F
;   analysis [medium]: Compares the PRNDL position Cal_bit_6_store with the previous one in $60 and writes a
;        garage-shift code to $62. N/P to Drive gives 1 or 2, depending on whether TC slip $1B01 is below a trans-
;        temperature-based limit (tbl_3BCE, or kw_3BEA when hot). N/P to Reverse gives 4 or 8 by the same test.
;        Drive to N/P gives $10, Reverse to N/P gives $20. No change gives 0.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
detect_garage_shift_BD4F:
	ldaa <Cal_bit_6_store               ; BD4F  96 5F         A = Cal_bit_6_store
	cmpa <PRNDL_prev                    ; BD51  91 60         compare A with PRNDL_prev
	bne loc_BD57                        ; BD53  26 02         if Cal_bit_6_store != PRNDL_prev goto loc_BD57
	bra loc_BDC0                        ; BD55  20 69         goto loc_BDC0
loc_BD57:
	brclr <PRNDL_prev,$70,loc_BD81      ; BD57  13 60 70 26   if PRNDL_prev .4,.5,.6 clear goto loc_BD81 | N/P -> forward gear: compare TC slip with temp-based limit -> $62 = 1 or 2
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$0F,loc_BD81 ; BD5B  13 5F 0F 22   if Cal_bit_6_store .0 Low,.1 Drive 2,.2 Drive 3,.3 Drive 4 clear goto loc_BD81
	ldx #tbl_3BCE                       ; BD5F  CE 3B CE      X = &tbl_3BCE
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; BD62  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered
	cmpa #$E0                           ; BD65  81 E0         compare A with $E0(224)
	bcs loc_BD6D                        ; BD67  25 04         if trans_temp_filtered < $E0(224) goto loc_BD6D
	ldd $1C,x                           ; BD69  EC 1C         D = kw_3BEA
	bra loc_BD70                        ; BD6B  20 03         goto loc_BD70
loc_BD6D:
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_word_6883       ; BD6D  BD 68 83      call lookup_2D_17pt_word_6883
loc_BD70:
	eora #$80                           ; BD70  88 80         A ^= $80(128)
	subd >TCC_slip_speed                ; BD72  B3 1B 01      D -= TCC_slip_speed
	bgt loc_BD7C                        ; BD75  2E 05         if D > (signed) 0 goto loc_BD7C
	clrb                                ; BD77  5F            B = 0
	orab #$02                           ; BD78  CA 02         B |= 2
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BD7A  20 45         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BD7C:
	clrb                                ; BD7C  5F            B = 0
	orab #$01                           ; BD7D  CA 01         B |= 1
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BD7F  20 40         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BD81:
	brset <PRNDL_prev,$20,loc_BDAB      ; BD81  12 60 20 26   if PRNDL_prev .5 set goto loc_BDAB | N/P -> Reverse: same test -> $62 = 4 or 8
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$20,loc_BDAB ; BD85  13 5F 20 22   if Cal_bit_6_store .5 Reverse clear goto loc_BDAB
	ldx #tbl_3BCE                       ; BD89  CE 3B CE      X = &tbl_3BCE
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; BD8C  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered
	cmpa #$E0                           ; BD8F  81 E0         compare A with $E0(224)
	bcs loc_BD97                        ; BD91  25 04         if trans_temp_filtered < $E0(224) goto loc_BD97
	ldd $1C,x                           ; BD93  EC 1C         D = kw_3BEA
	bra loc_BD9A                        ; BD95  20 03         goto loc_BD9A
loc_BD97:
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_word_6883       ; BD97  BD 68 83      call lookup_2D_17pt_word_6883
loc_BD9A:
	eora #$80                           ; BD9A  88 80         A ^= $80(128)
	subd >TCC_slip_speed                ; BD9C  B3 1B 01      D -= TCC_slip_speed
	bgt loc_BDA6                        ; BD9F  2E 05         if D > (signed) 0 goto loc_BDA6
	clrb                                ; BDA1  5F            B = 0
	orab #$08                           ; BDA2  CA 08         B |= 8
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BDA4  20 1B         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BDA6:
	clrb                                ; BDA6  5F            B = 0
	orab #$04                           ; BDA7  CA 04         B |= 4
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BDA9  20 16         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BDAB:
	clrb                                ; BDAB  5F            B = 0 | into N/P from forward ($10) or reverse ($20)
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$50,loc_BDC0 ; BDAC  13 5F 50 10   if Cal_bit_6_store .4 Neutral,.6 Park/Neutral clear goto loc_BDC0
	brclr <PRNDL_prev,$0F,loc_BDB8      ; BDB0  13 60 0F 04   if PRNDL_prev .0,.1,.2,.3 clear goto loc_BDB8
	orab #$10                           ; BDB4  CA 10         B |= $10(16)
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BDB6  20 09         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BDB8:
	brclr <PRNDL_prev,$20,loc_BDC0      ; BDB8  13 60 20 04   if PRNDL_prev .5 clear goto loc_BDC0
	orab #$20                           ; BDBC  CA 20         B |= $20(32)
	bra loc_BDC1                        ; BDBE  20 01         goto loc_BDC1
loc_BDC0:
	clrb                                ; BDC0  5F            B = 0
loc_BDC1:
	stab <garage_shift_code             ; BDC1  D7 62         garage_shift_code = B
	rts                                 ; BDC3  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Central_Scheduler_part_BDC4
;   analysis [low]: Picks a byte from a pointer table selected by mode $6F: bit0 uses tbl_4813, bit1 tbl_481D,
;        bit2 tbl_4827. The table is indexed by gear (4 in Reverse) and the byte is stored to $1BA9. All three
;        tables are zero in this cal.
;   inferred [C, pass B]: only called from Central_Scheduler
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Central_Scheduler_part_BDC4:
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$20,loc_BDCC ; BDC4  13 5F 20 04   if Cal_bit_6_store .5 Reverse clear goto loc_BDCC
	ldab #$04                           ; BDC8  C6 04         B = 4
	bra loc_BDCF                        ; BDCA  20 03         goto loc_BDCF
loc_BDCC:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; BDCC  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
loc_BDCF:
	ldx #tbl_4813                       ; BDCF  CE 48 13      X = &tbl_4813
	ldaa <pto_v006F                     ; BDD2  96 6F         A = pto_v006F
	bita #$01                           ; BDD4  85 01         test pto_v006F .0
	beq loc_BDDA                        ; BDD6  27 02         if pto_v006F .0 all clear goto loc_BDDA
	bra loc_BDEA                        ; BDD8  20 10         goto loc_BDEA
loc_BDDA:
	bita #$02                           ; BDDA  85 02         test A mask 2
	beq loc_BDE3                        ; BDDC  27 05         if mask 2 all clear goto loc_BDE3
	ldx #tbl_481D                       ; BDDE  CE 48 1D      X = &tbl_481D
	bra loc_BDEA                        ; BDE1  20 07         goto loc_BDEA
loc_BDE3:
	bita #$04                           ; BDE3  85 04         test A mask 4
	beq loc_BDF3                        ; BDE5  27 0C         if mask 4 all clear goto loc_BDF3
	ldx #tbl_4827                       ; BDE7  CE 48 27      X = &tbl_4827
loc_BDEA:
	aslb                                ; BDEA  58            B <<= 1
	abx                                 ; BDEB  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; BDEC  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldaa $00,x                          ; BDEE  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa >pcs_v1BA9                     ; BDF0  B7 1B A9      pcs_v1BA9 = A
loc_BDF3:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; pcs_task_C046
;   analysis [low]: For trans_gear_AT >= k_387B (3): runs the 3-segment pressure profile into $1BA5. Segment times
