; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; lookup_shift_adapt_cell_C9EC
;   analysis [medium]: While a shift is active (1B46 b1 = use current gear, b2 = gear+1), it sets 1B6A =
;        min(1B7B,512)/32 (the adapt cell index 0..16). It reads the learned value at the interpolated axis point
;        1B7F from the KAM shift-adapt table and stores it signed in 1B69.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	bita #$02                           ; C9F2  85 02         test shift_monitor_flags .1
	bne loc_C9FB                        ; C9F4  26 05         if any of shift_monitor_flags .1 set goto loc_C9FB
	bita #$04                           ; C9F6  85 04         test shift_monitor_flags .2
	beq loc_CA23                        ; C9F8  27 29         if shift_monitor_flags .2 all clear goto loc_CA23
	incb                                ; C9FA  5C            B++
loc_C9FB:
	aslb                                ; C9FB  58            B <<= 1
	ldx #ptrs_SHIFTADAPT_tables_by_gear ; C9FC  CE C3 78      X = &ptrs_SHIFTADAPT_tables_by_gear
	abx                                 ; C9FF  3A            X += B

	cpd #$0200                          ; CA06  1A 83 02 00   compare D with $0200(512)
	bls loc_CA0F                        ; CA0A  23 03         if shift_v1B7B <= $0200(512) goto loc_CA0F

; calc_shift_press_axis_crv_CBA1
;   analysis [low]: During a shift ($77 b1/b4), looks up the base shift pressure 1B74 from per-gear/per-pattern

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; shift_task_CC9F
;   analysis [low]: For lower gears, computes 1B77 (signed 16-bit) from shift progress $1877 against per-gear
;        thresholds (tbl_41B2, tbl_41BE, curve d_C330). The progress fraction is scaled by per-gear curves
;        (d_C324, $C32A) on axis 1B72, plus an offset curve. Writes 0 when progress is below threshold.
;   inferred [C, pass B]: subsystem by references: SHIFT=3.5, TRANS=2 (round 2)
;   called from: shift_task_CC6C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
shift_task_CC9F:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CC9F  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	aslb                                ; CCA2  58            B <<= 1
	ldx #tbl_41B2                       ; CCA3  CE 41 B2      X = &tbl_41B2
	abx                                 ; CCA6  3A            X += B

	cpy >trans_ratio_measured           ; CCAA  18 BC 18 77   compare Y with trans_ratio_measured | shift progress $1877 below the per-gear start threshold -> no ramp
	bcs loc_CD2D                        ; CCAE  25 7D         if Y < trans_ratio_measured goto loc_CD2D
	ldx #d_C330                         ; CCB0  CE C3 30      X = &d_C330
	abx                                 ; CCB3  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CCB4  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldd >shift_press_axis_crv           ; CCB6  FC 1B 72      D = shift_press_axis_crv
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; CCB9  BD 67 D3      call lookup_curve_67D3
	cmpa >trans_ratio_measured          ; CCBC  B1 18 77      compare A with trans_ratio_measured
	bhi loc_CCEE                        ; CCBF  22 2D         if A > trans_ratio_measured goto loc_CCEE
	tab                                 ; CCC1  16            B = A
	pshy                                ; CCC2  18 3C         push Y
	pula                                ; CCC4  32            pop A
	sba                                 ; CCC5  10            A -= B
	pulb                                ; CCC6  33            pop B
	xgdx                                ; CCC7  8F            swap D <-> X
	xgdy                                ; CCC8  18 8F         swap D <-> Y
	subd >trans_ratio_measured          ; CCCA  B3 18 77      D -= trans_ratio_measured
	fdiv                                ; CCCD  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	pshx                                ; CCCE  3C            push X
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CCCF  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	aslb                                ; CCD2  58            B <<= 1

	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CCEE  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT

	std >shift_v1B77                    ; CD48  FD 1B 77      shift_v1B77 = D
	rts                                 ; CD4B  39            return

; calc_shift_press_temp_corr_CD4C
;   analysis [medium]: During upshift ($77 b1, current gear) or 1B46 b2 (gear+1), 1B71 = signed per-gear 3-D
;        offset-table lookup (d_C336). Inputs are the torque axis min(1B7B,600) scaled by FDIV/$780 and trans
;        temp. 1B71 = 0 when the gear's table pointer is null.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_shift_press_temp_corr_CD4C:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CD4C  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	brset <shift_event_flags,$02,loc_CD5B; CD4F  12 77 02 08   if shift_event_flags .1 upshift in progress (likely) set goto loc_CD5B
	ldaa >shift_monitor_flags           ; CD53  B6 1B 46      A = shift_monitor_flags
	bita #$04                           ; CD56  85 04         test shift_monitor_flags .2
	beq loc_CD89                        ; CD58  27 2F         if shift_monitor_flags .2 all clear goto loc_CD89
	incb                                ; CD5A  5C            B++
loc_CD5B:
	aslb                                ; CD5B  58            B <<= 1
	ldy #d_C336                         ; CD5C  18 CE C3 36   Y = &d_C336
	aby                                 ; CD60  18 3A         Y += B
	ldd >shift_v1B7B                    ; CD62  FC 1B 7B      D = shift_v1B7B
	cpd #$0258                          ; CD65  1A 83 02 58   compare D with $0258(600)
	bcs loc_CD6E                        ; CD69  25 03         if shift_v1B7B < $0258(600) goto loc_CD6E
	ldd #$0258                          ; CD6B  CC 02 58      D = $0258(600)
loc_CD6E:
	ldx #$0780                          ; CD6E  CE 07 80      X = $0780(1920) | column input = min(1B7B,600)/1920 as a fraction
	fdiv                                ; CD71  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; CD72  8F            swap D <-> X
	rolb                                ; CD73  59            B rotate left thru C
	adca #$00                           ; CD74  89 00         A += C + 0
	ldx $00,y                           ; CD76  CD EE 00      X = [Y+0]
	bne loc_CD7E                        ; CD79  26 03         if X != 0 goto loc_CD7E
	clra                                ; CD7B  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_CD86                        ; CD7C  20 08         goto loc_CD86
loc_CD7E:
	ldab >trans_temp_filtered           ; CD7E  F6 18 E7      B = trans_temp_filtered
	jsr >lookup_3D_offset_table         ; CD81  BD 67 02      call lookup_3D_offset_table
	eora #$80                           ; CD84  88 80         A ^= $80(128)
loc_CD86:
	staa >shift_v1B71                   ; CD86  B7 1B 71      shift_v1B71 = A
loc_CD89:
	rts                                 ; CD89  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; shift_task_CD8A
;   analysis [low]: For gear >= k_387B: each call adds (curve(1B72)-128)*8 to the signed ramp 1B77, with
;        saturation. The curve is d_C342 or d_C33C, chosen by comparing 1B49 with 1B4B + curve d_C348 or curve
;        d_C34E. When 1B49 is below the d_C34E level, no step is taken.
;   inferred [C, pass B]: subsystem by references: SHIFT=5, TRANS=1.5, PCS=0.5
;   called from: shift_task_CC6C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
shift_task_CD8A:
	brclr <shift_v0085,$10,loc_CDAD     ; CD8A  13 85 10 1F   if shift_v0085 .4 ratio change (inertia phase) started clear goto loc_CDAD
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CD8E  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	aslb                                ; CD91  58            B <<= 1
	ldx #d_C348                         ; CD92  CE C3 48      X = &d_C348
	abx                                 ; CD95  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CD96  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldd >shift_press_axis_crv           ; CD98  FC 1B 72      D = shift_press_axis_crv
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; CD9B  BD 67 D3      call lookup_curve_67D3
	adda >shift_delay_time              ; CD9E  BB 1B 4B      A += shift_delay_time
	bcs loc_CDAD                        ; CDA1  25 0A         if A overflowed goto loc_CDAD
	cmpa >shift_timer                   ; CDA3  B1 1B 49      compare A with shift_timer
	bcc loc_CDAD                        ; CDA6  24 05         if A >= shift_timer goto loc_CDAD
	ldx #d_C342                         ; CDA8  CE C3 42      X = &d_C342
	bra loc_CDC5                        ; CDAB  20 18         goto loc_CDC5
loc_CDAD:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CDAD  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	aslb                                ; CDB0  58            B <<= 1
	ldx #d_C34E                         ; CDB1  CE C3 4E      X = &d_C34E
	abx                                 ; CDB4  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CDB5  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldd >shift_press_axis_crv           ; CDB7  FC 1B 72      D = shift_press_axis_crv
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; CDBA  BD 67 D3      call lookup_curve_67D3
	cmpa >shift_timer                   ; CDBD  B1 1B 49      compare A with shift_timer
	bhi loc_CDEE                        ; CDC0  22 2C         if A > shift_timer goto loc_CDEE
	ldx #d_C33C                         ; CDC2  CE C3 3C      X = &d_C33C
loc_CDC5:
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CDC5  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	aslb                                ; CDC8  58            B <<= 1
	abx                                 ; CDC9  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CDCA  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	bne loc_CDD1                        ; CDCC  26 03         if X != 0 goto loc_CDD1
	xgdx                                ; CDCE  8F            swap D <-> X
	bra loc_CDEB                        ; CDCF  20 1A         goto loc_CDEB
loc_CDD1:
	ldd >shift_press_axis_crv           ; CDD1  FC 1B 72      D = shift_press_axis_crv | ramp step = (curve-$80)*8 added to signed 16-bit 1B77, saturating at $7FFF
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; CDD4  BD 67 D3      call lookup_curve_67D3
	tab                                 ; CDD7  16            B = A
	clra                                ; CDD8  4F            A = 0
	subd #$0080                         ; CDD9  83 00 80      D -= $0080(128)
	asld                                ; CDDC  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; CDDD  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; CDDE  05            D <<= 1
	addd >shift_v1B77                   ; CDDF  F3 1B 77      D += shift_v1B77
	bvc loc_CDEB                        ; CDE2  28 07         if no overflow goto loc_CDEB
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; CDE4  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
	adcb #$00                           ; CDE7  C9 00         B += C + 0
	adca #$00                           ; CDE9  89 00         A += C + 0
loc_CDEB:
	std >shift_v1B77                    ; CDEB  FD 1B 77      shift_v1B77 = D
loc_CDEE:
	rts                                 ; CDEE  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_shift_start_load_CDEF
;   analysis [low]: Computes 1B83 = $187B (torque/throttle-type load, 0..512) ± 1B76, where 1B76 is a per-gear
;        curve on TRANS_TURBINE_SPEED/25. It latches this into 1B7B/1B7D at shift start and lets it follow load
;        changes per the hysteresis k_3EE0..k_3EE3, with 1B7A = load at shift start and 1B85 b1 = latched. It
;        converts both to curve-axis pairs 1B81/1B82 and 1B7F(frac)/1B80(index) via sub_CF03. All are 0 when no sh
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes shift_start_load, shift_torque_axis_crv
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_shift_start_load_CDEF:

	ldab <shift_event_flags             ; CDF0  D6 77         B = shift_event_flags
	bitb #$12                           ; CDF2  C5 12         test shift_event_flags .1 upshift in progress (likely),.4 downshift / other shift in progress (lik

	clrb                                ; CDF6  5F            B = 0
	std >shift_v1B7B                    ; CDF7  FD 1B 7B      shift_v1B7B = D
	ldx #shift_v1B85                    ; CDFA  CE 1B 85      X = &shift_v1B85
	bclr $00,x,$02                      ; CDFD  1D 00 02      shift_v1B85 .1 = 0
	jmp >loc_CEFC                       ; CE00  7E CE FC      goto loc_CEFC
loc_CE03:
	ldaa >shift_monitor_flags           ; CE03  B6 1B 46      A = shift_monitor_flags
	bitb #$02                           ; CE06  C5 02         test B mask 2
	beq loc_CE1A                        ; CE08  27 10         if mask 2 all clear goto loc_CE1A
	bita #$02                           ; CE0A  85 02         test shift_monitor_flags .1
	bne loc_CE12                        ; CE0C  26 04         if any of shift_monitor_flags .1 set goto loc_CE12
	brset <shift_v0085,$10,loc_CE1A     ; CE0E  12 85 10 08   if shift_v0085 .4 ratio change (inertia phase) started set goto loc_CE1A
loc_CE12:
	ldab >trans_load_filtered           ; CE12  F6 18 E4      B = trans_load_filtered
	stab >shift_start_load_1B7A         ; CE15  F7 1B 7A      shift_start_load_1B7A = B
	bra loc_CE26                        ; CE18  20 0C         goto loc_CE26
loc_CE1A:
	bitb #$10                           ; CE1A  C5 10         test B mask $10(16)
	beq loc_CE69                        ; CE1C  27 4B         if mask $10(16) all clear goto loc_CE69

	ldx #$0019                          ; CE29  CE 00 19      X = $0019(25)
	idiv                                ; CE2C  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	xgdx                                ; CE2D  8F            swap D <-> X
	cmpa #$08                           ; CE2E  81 08         compare A with 8
	; ---- calc_shift_start_load_CE30: continues the routine above (nothing calls this point)
	;      analysis [low]: Mid-function fragment of calc_shift_torque_axis (the turbine-speed curve lookup for 1B76).
	;      It has no callers of its own.
	;      inferred [B, pass A]: writes shift_start_load, shift_torque_axis_crv
calc_shift_start_load_CE30:
	bcs loc_CE35                        ; CE30  25 03         if carry goto loc_CE35
	ldd #$0800                          ; CE32  CC 08 00      D = $0800(2048)
loc_CE35:
	asld                                ; CE35  05            D <<= 1
	pshb                                ; CE36  37            push B
	ldx #d_C354                         ; CE37  CE C3 54      X = &d_C354
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; CE3A  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	brclr <shift_event_flags,$10,loc_CE5D; CE3D  13 77 10 1C   if shift_event_flags .4 downshift / other shift in progress (lik clear goto loc_CE5D
	incb                                ; CE41  5C            B++
	aslb                                ; CE42  58            B <<= 1
	abx                                 ; CE43  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CE44  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	tab                                 ; CE46  16            B = A
	pula                                ; CE47  32            pop A
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; CE48  BD 67 D3      call lookup_curve_67D3
	staa >shift_v1B76                   ; CE4B  B7 1B 76      shift_v1B76 = A
loc_CE4E:
	ldd >pcs_v187B                      ; CE4E  FC 18 7B      D = pcs_v187B
	subb >shift_v1B76                   ; CE51  F0 1B 76      B -= shift_v1B76
	sbca #$00                           ; CE54  82 00         A -= C + 0
	bcc loc_CE75                        ; CE56  24 1D         if A >= 0 goto loc_CE75
	ldd #$0000                          ; CE58  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	bra loc_CE75                        ; CE5B  20 18         goto loc_CE75
loc_CE5D:

	abx                                 ; CE5E  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; CE5F  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	tab                                 ; CE61  16            B = A

loc_CE69:
	ldab >shift_v1B76                   ; CE69  F6 1B 76      B = shift_v1B76
	clra                                ; CE6C  4F            A = 0
	addd >pcs_v187B                     ; CE6D  F3 18 7B      D += pcs_v187B
	bcc loc_CE75                        ; CE70  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_CE75
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; CE72  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_CE75:
	ldx >shift_v1B7B                    ; CE75  FE 1B 7B      X = shift_v1B7B | stack: [X+0] new value -> 1B83 (always), [X+2] old 1B7B (replaced only when latching)
	pshx                                ; CE78  3C            push X
	ldx >shift_v1B83                    ; CE79  FE 1B 83      X = shift_v1B83
	pshx                                ; CE7C  3C            push X
	tsx                                 ; CE7D  30            X = SP + 1
	std $00,x                           ; CE7E  ED 00         [X+0] = D
	brclr <shift_event_flags,$02,loc_CE97; CE80  13 77 02 13   if shift_event_flags .1 upshift in progress (likely) clear goto loc_CE97
	ldaa >shift_monitor_flags           ; CE84  B6 1B 46      A = shift_monitor_flags
	bita #$02                           ; CE87  85 02         test shift_monitor_flags .1
	bne loc_CE8F                        ; CE89  26 04         if any of shift_monitor_flags .1 set goto loc_CE8F
	brset <shift_v0085,$10,loc_CE9D     ; CE8B  12 85 10 0E   if shift_v0085 .4 ratio change (inertia phase) started set goto loc_CE9D
loc_CE8F:
	ldd $00,x                           ; CE8F  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	std $02,x                           ; CE91  ED 02         [X+2] = D
	brset <shift_v0085,$10,loc_CE9D     ; CE93  12 85 10 06   if shift_v0085 .4 ratio change (inertia phase) started set goto loc_CE9D
loc_CE97:
	brset <shift_event_flags,$10,loc_CEE3; CE97  12 77 10 48   if shift_event_flags .4 downshift / other shift in progress (lik set goto loc_CEE3
	bra loc_CEE7                        ; CE9B  20 4A         goto loc_CEE7
loc_CE9D:
	ldab >shift_v1B85                   ; CE9D  F6 1B 85      B = shift_v1B85 | re-latch the torque axis if load rose by > k_3EE2 or fell below the k_3EE0/k_3EE1 hysteresis
	bitb #$02                           ; CEA0  C5 02         test shift_v1B85 .1
	bne loc_CEE3                        ; CEA2  26 3F         if any of shift_v1B85 .1 set goto loc_CEE3
	ldaa >shift_start_load_1B7A         ; CEA4  B6 1B 7A      A = shift_start_load_1B7A
	adda >k_3EE2                        ; CEA7  BB 3E E2      A += k_3EE2
	bcs loc_CEB8                        ; CEAA  25 0C         if A overflowed goto loc_CEB8
	cmpa >trans_load_filtered           ; CEAC  B1 18 E4      compare A with trans_load_filtered
	bhi loc_CEB8                        ; CEAF  22 07         if A > trans_load_filtered goto loc_CEB8
	orab #$02                           ; CEB1  CA 02         B |= 2
	stab >shift_v1B85                   ; CEB3  F7 1B 85      shift_v1B85 = B
	bra loc_CEE3                        ; CEB6  20 2B         goto loc_CEE3
loc_CEB8:
	ldab >trans_load_filtered           ; CEB8  F6 18 E4      B = trans_load_filtered
	cmpb >k_3EE0                        ; CEBB  F1 3E E0      compare B with k_3EE0
	bcc loc_CED0                        ; CEBE  24 10         if trans_load_filtered >= k_3EE0 goto loc_CED0
	ldaa >shift_start_load_1B7A         ; CEC0  B6 1B 7A      A = shift_start_load_1B7A
	sba                                 ; CEC3  10            A -= B
	bcs loc_CED0                        ; CEC4  25 0A         if A < 0 goto loc_CED0

	suba >k_3EE1                        ; CED3  B0 3E E1      A -= k_3EE1
	bcs loc_CEE7                        ; CED6  25 0F         if A < 0 goto loc_CEE7

	bls loc_CEE7                        ; CEDB  23 0A         if A <= trans_load_filtered goto loc_CEE7

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; scale_to_curve_axis_32_CF03
;   analysis [high]: Takes X = value (clamped to 512) and returns D = value*8: A = value/32 (cell index 0..16), B
;        = fractional part. The caller stores B,A swapped so a later 'ldd' gives A = fraction and B = index, as
;        lookup_curve_67D3 expects.
;   called from: calc_shift_start_load_CDEF
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scale_to_curve_axis_32_CF03:
	cpx #$0200                          ; CF03  8C 02 00      compare X with $0200(512)
	bls loc_CF0B                        ; CF06  23 03         if X <= $0200(512) goto loc_CF0B
	ldx #$0200                          ; CF08  CE 02 00      X = $0200(512)
loc_CF0B:
	ldd #$2000                          ; CF0B  CC 20 00      D = $2000(8192) | FDIV by $2000 = value*8: A = value/32 cell, B = fraction
	xgdx                                ; CF0E  8F            swap D <-> X
	fdiv                                ; CF0F  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; CF10  8F            swap D <-> X
	rts                                 ; CF11  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; line_press_adapt_cell_update_CF12
;   analysis [medium]: Steps the adaptive line-pressure cell in NV RAM 0317+[$1876]/2 (cell = gear/TCC state) when
;        the slip-error integrator $1B3E saturates: +tbl_3ED0[idx] at >=k_3ECE ($7F), -tbl_3ED8[idx] at <=k_3ECF
;        ($81). Keeps checksum $031F in step, then holds off further steps for k_3EAA ticks via $1B3D. Inhibited
;        by $1B41 flags or ignition off. Runs every Central_Scheduler pass.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
line_press_adapt_cell_update_CF12:
	ldaa >line_adapt_hold_timer         ; CF12  B6 1B 3D      A = line_adapt_hold_timer
	bne loc_CF28                        ; CF15  26 11         if A != 0 goto loc_CF28
	ldaa >line_adapt_inhibit            ; CF17  B6 1B 41      A = line_adapt_inhibit
	bne loc_CF20                        ; CF1A  26 04         if A != 0 goto loc_CF20
	brset <shift_v0069,$08,loc_CF2B     ; CF1C  12 69 08 0B   if shift_v0069 .3 set goto loc_CF2B
loc_CF20:
	ldab >line_adapt_status             ; CF20  F6 1B 45      B = line_adapt_status
	andb #$FC                           ; CF23  C4 FC         B &= $FC(252) (keep bits)
	stab >line_adapt_status             ; CF25  F7 1B 45      line_adapt_status = B
loc_CF28:
	jmp >loc_CFC8                       ; CF28  7E CF C8      goto loc_CFC8
loc_CF2B:
	clrb                                ; CF2B  5F            B = 0
	pshb                                ; CF2C  37            push B
	tsx                                 ; CF2D  30            X = SP + 1
	ldy #line_press_adapt_cells         ; CF2E  18 CE 03 17   Y = &line_press_adapt_cells | Y -> learned line-pressure cell in NV RAM, index = $1876/2 (gear*2 + TCC state)
	ldab >trans_state_index             ; CF32  F6 18 76      B = trans_state_index
	lsrb                                ; CF35  54            B >>= 1
	aby                                 ; CF36  18 3A         Y += B
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; CF38  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT | gear >= 3 with TCC slipping: also copy new value to neighbouring cell (local flag b1)
	cmpa >k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B     ; CF3B  B1 38 7B      compare A with k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B
	bcs loc_CF65                        ; CF3E  25 25         if trans_gear_AT < k_TCC_top_gear_index_387B goto loc_CF65
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$10,loc_CF63      ; CF40  13 7A 10 1F   if DS_TCCMODE .4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_CF63
	ldaa >line_adapt_slip_integ         ; CF44  B6 1B 3E      A = line_adapt_slip_integ
	cmpa >k_3ECE                        ; CF47  B1 3E CE      compare A with k_3ECE
	blt loc_CF55                        ; CF4A  2D 09         if line_adapt_slip_integ < (signed) k_3ECE goto loc_CF55
	brset <Cal_bit_6_store,$20,loc_CF6D ; CF4C  12 5F 20 1D   if Cal_bit_6_store .5 Reverse set goto loc_CF6D
	bset $00,x,$02                      ; CF50  1C 00 02      [X+0] .1 = 1
	bra loc_CF6D                        ; CF53  20 18         goto loc_CF6D
loc_CF55:
	cmpa >k_3ECF                        ; CF55  B1 3E CF      compare A with k_3ECF
	bgt loc_CFC7                        ; CF58  2E 6D         if A > (signed) k_3ECF goto loc_CFC7
	brset <Cal_bit_6_store,$20,loc_CF88 ; CF5A  12 5F 20 2A   if Cal_bit_6_store .5 Reverse set goto loc_CF88
	bset $00,x,$02                      ; CF5E  1C 00 02      [X+0] .1 = 1
	bra loc_CF88                        ; CF61  20 25         goto loc_CF88
loc_CF63:
	bra loc_CFC7                        ; CF63  20 62         goto loc_CFC7

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_adaptive_min_line_pressure_D028
;   analysis [medium]: Per-cell pressure = base[cell] (ptr table d_C2EE) * $187B + trans-temp correction
;        (tbl17_TRANS_temp_3B7D), + signed offset[cell] (d_C2FE) + learned adapt cell (0317+cell/2), clamped
;        0..255 -> $1B26. Converts to $1B25 = ($1B26 - k_3BC2)/k_3BC0*64 (k_3BC3/k_3BC1 in Reverse). $1B25 is the
;        floor used by the line_pressure_desired logic (C719).
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_adaptive_min_line_pressure_D028:
	ldx #d_C2EE                         ; D028  CE C2 EE      X = &d_C2EE | base[cell] * $187B (16-bit scale) -> 16-bit on stack
	ldab >trans_state_index             ; D02B  F6 18 76      B = trans_state_index
	abx                                 ; D02E  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; D02F  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldaa $00,x                          ; D031  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	ldx #pcs_v187B                      ; D033  CE 18 7B      X = &pcs_v187B
	jsr >MUL8_16                        ; D036  BD 67 74      call MUL8_16
	pshb                                ; D039  37            push B
	psha                                ; D03A  36            push A
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; D03B  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered | add trans-temp correction from 17pt table
	ldx #tbl17_TRANS_temp_3B7D          ; D03E  CE 3B 7D      X = &tbl17_TRANS_temp_3B7D
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; D041  BD 66 E5      A = 17pt lookup tbl17_TRANS_temp_3B7D[A]

	std $00,x                           ; D048  ED 00         [X+0] = D
	cmpa #$02                           ; D04A  81 02         compare A with 2
	bcc loc_D078                        ; D04C  24 2A         if trans_temp_filtered >= 2 goto loc_D078
	ldx #d_C2FE                         ; D04E  CE C2 FE      X = &d_C2FE | add signed per-cell offset (d_C2FE) and learned cell 0317[cell/2]; clamp 0..255
	ldab >trans_state_index             ; D051  F6 18 76      B = trans_state_index
	abx                                 ; D054  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; D055  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	clra                                ; D057  4F            A = 0
	ldab $00,x                          ; D058  E6 00         B = [X+0]

	deca                                ; D05C  4A            A--

	lsrb                                ; D068  54            B >>= 1
	abx                                 ; D069  3A            X += B
	clra                                ; D06A  4F            A = 0
	ldab $00,x                          ; D06B  E6 00         B = [X+0]

	addd $00,x                          ; D06E  E3 00         D += [X+0]

loc_D078:

	std >tcc_v1B03                      ; D61F  FD 1B 03      tcc_v1B03 = D
loc_D622:
	std >tcc_v1AE3                      ; D622  FD 1A E3      tcc_v1AE3 = D
	rts                                 ; D625  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; PCS_duty_from_pressure
;   Builds the IOR 1809 duty (TCC PWM solenoid on this board) from the pressure-style command via curves
;        4585/45A7; 0 when the TCC is forced off. "PCS" in the name is probably wrong.
;   analysis [medium]: Converts line_pressure_desired (clamped to $60, /3 into curve index) into PCS_duty_cmd.
;        Uses curve tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_4585, corrected by the term (k_4584 - duty)*[$1AF5] and a fdiv
;        against curve 45A7, +0.5 rounding, clamped to $FF. Forces duty 0 when DS_TCCMODE b0/b1 are set and $1AF5
;        is 0.
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
PCS_duty_from_pressure:
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$03,loc_D632      ; D626  13 7A 03 08   if DS_TCCMODE .0 TCC IS BEING FORCED OFF,.1 TCC ENABLE SOLENOID VALID clear goto loc_D632
	ldd >TCC_PWM_duty_cmd               ; D62A  FC 1A F5      D = TCC_PWM_duty_cmd
	bne loc_D632                        ; D62D  26 03         if D != 0 goto loc_D632
	clra                                ; D62F  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_D67B                        ; D630  20 49         goto loc_D67B
loc_D632:
	ldaa >line_pressure_desired         ; D632  B6 1B 88      A = line_pressure_desired | pressure index = min(desired,$60)/3 with fraction in low byte for curve interpolation
	cmpa #$60                           ; D635  81 60         compare A with $60(96)
	bls loc_D63B                        ; D637  23 02         if line_pressure_desired <= $60(96) goto loc_D63B
	ldaa #$60                           ; D639  86 60         A = $60(96)
loc_D63B:
	clrb                                ; D63B  5F            B = 0
	lsrd                                ; D63C  04            D >>= 1
	ldx #$0003                          ; D63D  CE 00 03      X = $0003(3)
	idiv                                ; D640  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	decb                                ; D641  5A            B--
	ble loc_D645                        ; D642  2F 01         if B <= (signed) 0 goto loc_D645
	inx                                 ; D644  08            X++
loc_D645:
	xgdx                                ; D645  8F            swap D <-> X
	stab >pcs_v1AFA                     ; D646  F7 1A FA      pcs_v1AFA = B
	staa >pcs_v1AFB                     ; D649  B7 1A FB      pcs_v1AFB = A
	ldd >pcs_v1AFA                      ; D64C  FC 1A FA      D = pcs_v1AFA
	ldx #tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_4585  ; D64F  CE 45 85      X = &tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_4585
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; D652  BD 67 D3      A = curve lookup tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_4585[A]
	psha                                ; D655  36            push A | correction term (k_4584 - duty) * [$1AF5]/256
	suba >k_4584                        ; D656  B0 45 84      A -= k_4584
	nega                                ; D659  40            A = -A
	ldx #TCC_PWM_duty_cmd               ; D65A  CE 1A F5      X = &TCC_PWM_duty_cmd
	jsr >MUL8_16                        ; D65D  BD 67 74      call MUL8_16
	pshb                                ; D660  37            push B
	psha                                ; D661  36            push A
	ldd >pcs_v1AFA                      ; D662  FC 1A FA      D = pcs_v1AFA
	ldx #tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_45A7  ; D665  CE 45 A7      X = &tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_45A7
	jsr >lookup_curve_67D3              ; D668  BD 67 D3      A = curve lookup tbl_TRANS_PCS_duty_curve_45A7[A]
	clrb                                ; D66B  5F            B = 0
	pulx                                ; D66C  38            pop X
	xgdx                                ; D66D  8F            swap D <-> X
	fdiv                                ; D66E  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; D66F  8F            swap D <-> X
	addd #$0080                         ; D670  C3 00 80      D += $0080(128)
	pulb                                ; D673  33            pop B
	bcs loc_D679                        ; D674  25 03         if D overflowed goto loc_D679
	aba                                 ; D676  1B            A += B
	bcc loc_D67B                        ; D677  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_D67B
loc_D679:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; D679  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_D67B:
	staa >PCS_duty_cmd                  ; D67B  B7 1A F7      PCS_duty_cmd = A
	rts                                 ; D67E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_D67F
;   analysis [low]: Sets $1AF5 = minimum $1AF8. When timer $1AF0 reaches $1AEE+k_455D, advances the phase flags in
;        $80 (set b3, clear b1/b2).
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes TCC_PWM_duty_cmd, TCC_status_flags
;   called from: tcc_task_DAB0
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_D67F:
	ldaa >press_cmd_min                 ; D67F  B6 1A F8      A = press_cmd_min
	clrb                                ; D682  5F            B = 0
	std >TCC_PWM_duty_cmd               ; D683  FD 1A F5      TCC_PWM_duty_cmd = D
	ldaa >tcc_v1AEE                     ; D686  B6 1A EE      A = tcc_v1AEE
	adda >k_455D                        ; D689  BB 45 5D      A += k_455D
	bcc loc_D690                        ; D68C  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_D690
	ldaa #$FF                           ; D68E  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_D690:
	cmpa >tcc_v1AF0                     ; D690  B1 1A F0      compare A with tcc_v1AF0
	bhi loc_D69B                        ; D693  22 06         if A > tcc_v1AF0 goto loc_D69B
	bset <TCC_status_flags,$08          ; D695  14 80 08      TCC_status_flags .3 = 1
	bclr <TCC_status_flags,$06          ; D698  15 80 06      TCC_status_flags .1,.2 = 0
loc_D69B:
	rts                                 ; D69B  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_press_cmd_min_D69C
;   analysis [medium]: Sets min $1AF8 = k_4583 and line_pressure_max = tbl17 lookup by engine_speed_filtered (flat
;        $78 in this cal). Then dispatches on the DS_TCCMODE mode bits to compute the 16-bit command $1AF5: b2 ->
;        D597 + trans_line_pressure_calc, b3 -> DAB0, b4 -> D5CF + calc, b7 -> DFEA base, b5 -> DB8E. Otherwise
;        (or b0/b1) it resets the flags and runs pcs_task_DA80.
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes press_cmd_min, line_pressure_max; tables TRANS_line_pressure_max_vs_RPM
;   called from: Central_Scheduler
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_press_cmd_min_D69C:
	bclr <tcc_v0083,$80                 ; D69C  15 83 80      tcc_v0083 .7 = 0
	brset <DS_TCCMODE,$04,loc_D6AB      ; D69F  12 7A 04 08   if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED set goto loc_D6AB
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$10,loc_D6AE      ; D6A3  13 7A 10 07   if DS_TCCMODE .4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_D6AE
	brset <tcc_v0083,$08,loc_D6AE       ; D6A7  12 83 08 03   if tcc_v0083 .3 set goto loc_D6AE
loc_D6AB:
	bset <tcc_v0083,$80                 ; D6AB  14 83 80      tcc_v0083 .7 = 1
loc_D6AE:
	ldaa >k_press_cmd_min_4583          ; D6AE  B6 45 83      A = k_press_cmd_min_4583 | minimum command $1AF8 = k_4583; maximum = line_pressure_max vs RPM
	staa >press_cmd_min                 ; D6B1  B7 1A F8      press_cmd_min = A
	ldaa >engine_speed_filtered         ; D6B4  B6 18 C7      A = engine_speed_filtered
	ldx #tbl17_TRANS_line_pressure_max_vs_RPM_4596; D6B7  CE 45 96      X = &tbl17_TRANS_line_pressure_max_vs_RPM_4596
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; D6BA  BD 66 E5      A = 17pt lookup tbl17_TRANS_line_pressure_max_vs_RPM_4596[A]
	staa >line_pressure_max             ; D6BD  B7 1A F9      line_pressure_max = A
	ldaa <DS_TCCMODE                    ; D6C0  96 7A         A = DS_TCCMODE | dispatch on the DS_TCCMODE state bits (one handler per state)
	bita #$03                           ; D6C2  85 03         test DS_TCCMODE .0 TCC IS BEING FORCED OFF,.1 TCC ENABLE SOLENOID VALID
	bne loc_D702                        ; D6C4  26 3C         if any of DS_TCCMODE .0 TCC IS BEING FORCED OFF,.1 TCC ENABLE SOLENOID VALID set goto loc_D702
	bita #$04                           ; D6C6  85 04         test DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED
	beq loc_D6D5                        ; D6C8  27 0B         if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED all clear goto loc_D6D5
	bclr <tcc_v007D,$10                 ; D6CA  15 7D 10      tcc_v007D .4 = 0
	jsr >tcc_task_D597                  ; D6CD  BD D5 97      call tcc_task_D597
	jsr >trans_line_pressure_calc       ; D6D0  BD D7 2A      call trans_line_pressure_calc
	bra loc_D70B                        ; D6D3  20 36         goto loc_D70B
loc_D6D5:
	bita #$08                           ; D6D5  85 08         test A mask 8
	beq loc_D6E1                        ; D6D7  27 08         if mask 8 all clear goto loc_D6E1
	bclr <tcc_v007D,$08                 ; D6D9  15 7D 08      tcc_v007D .3 = 0
	jsr >tcc_task_DAB0                  ; D6DC  BD DA B0      call tcc_task_DAB0
	bra loc_D70B                        ; D6DF  20 2A         goto loc_D70B
loc_D6E1:
	bita #$10                           ; D6E1  85 10         test A mask $10(16)
	beq loc_D6ED                        ; D6E3  27 08         if mask $10(16) all clear goto loc_D6ED
	jsr >calc_TCC_cond_flags_D5CF       ; D6E5  BD D5 CF      call calc_TCC_cond_flags_D5CF
	jsr >trans_line_pressure_calc       ; D6E8  BD D7 2A      call trans_line_pressure_calc
	bra loc_D70B                        ; D6EB  20 1E         goto loc_D70B
loc_D6ED:
	bita #$80                           ; D6ED  85 80         test A mask $80(128)
	beq loc_D6F9                        ; D6EF  27 08         if mask $80(128) all clear goto loc_D6F9
	bclr <tcc_v0083,$80                 ; D6F1  15 83 80      tcc_v0083 .7 = 0
	jsr >calc_TCC_PWM_slip_control_DFEA ; D6F4  BD DF EA      call calc_TCC_PWM_slip_control_DFEA
	bra loc_D70B                        ; D6F7  20 12         goto loc_D70B
loc_D6F9:
	bita #$20                           ; D6F9  85 20         test A mask $20(32)
	beq loc_D708                        ; D6FB  27 0B         if mask $20(32) all clear goto loc_D708
	jsr >calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_DB8E     ; D6FD  BD DB 8E      call calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_DB8E
	bra loc_D70B                        ; D700  20 09         goto loc_D70B
loc_D702:
	bclr <tcc_v007D,$18                 ; D702  15 7D 18      tcc_v007D .3,.4 = 0
	bclr <tcc_v0083,$CC                 ; D705  15 83 CC      tcc_v0083 .2,.3,.6,.7 = 0
loc_D708:
	jsr >calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_DA80     ; D708  BD DA 80      call calc_TCC_PWM_duty_cmd_DA80
loc_D70B:
	rts                                 ; D70B  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_cond_flags_D70C
;   analysis [low]: Clears $7C.1. When timer $1AF0 >= $1AEE+k_455D+k_455F, sets $7D.4 and clears the $80 phase
;        bits 1-3 (phase sequence complete).
;   inferred [C, pass A]: writes TCC_cond_flags, TCC_status_flags
;   called from: tcc_task_DAB0
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_cond_flags_D70C:
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$02            ; D70C  15 7C 02      TCC_cond_flags .1 = 0
	ldaa >tcc_v1AEE                     ; D70F  B6 1A EE      A = tcc_v1AEE
	adda >k_455D                        ; D712  BB 45 5D      A += k_455D
	bcs loc_D71C                        ; D715  25 05         if A overflowed goto loc_D71C
	adda >k_455F                        ; D717  BB 45 5F      A += k_455F
	bcc loc_D71E                        ; D71A  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_D71E
loc_D71C:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; D71C  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_D71E:
	cmpa >tcc_v1AF0                     ; D71E  B1 1A F0      compare A with tcc_v1AF0
	bhi loc_D729                        ; D721  22 06         if A > tcc_v1AF0 goto loc_D729
	bset <tcc_v007D,$10                 ; D723  14 7D 10      tcc_v007D .4 = 1
	bclr <TCC_status_flags,$0E          ; D726  15 80 0E      TCC_status_flags .1,.2,.3 = 0
loc_D729:
	rts                                 ; D729  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; trans_line_pressure_calc
;   analysis [low]: Ramps $1AF5 = base $1AE3 + ramp $1AE5, clamped to [$1AF8, line_pressure_max]. Ramp rate comes
;        from tbl17_TRANS_pressure_ramp_456D vs VSS or k_46FE. Path $83.3 clear: base from
;        tblOfs3D_TRANS_line_pressure_base_45BA(turbine speed, trans load) -> $1B11, then closed-loop correction
;        $1B1F from slip counter $1B01, sub_E351 gain and tbl17_TRANS_pressure_adapt_4723.
;   called from: calc_press_cmd_min_D69C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
trans_line_pressure_calc:
	bclr <tcc_v007D,$10                 ; D72A  15 7D 10      tcc_v007D .4 = 0
	brset <tcc_v0083,$40,loc_D736       ; D72D  12 83 40 05   if tcc_v0083 .6 set goto loc_D736
	ldd >tcc_v1AE3                      ; D731  FC 1A E3      D = tcc_v1AE3
	bra loc_D775                        ; D734  20 3F         goto loc_D775
loc_D736:
	ldaa >TCC_option_bits_43A4          ; D736  B6 43 A4      A = TCC_option_bits_43A4
	bita #$80                           ; D739  85 80         test TCC_option_bits_43A4 .7
	beq loc_D77B                        ; D73B  27 3E         if TCC_option_bits_43A4 .7 all clear goto loc_D77B
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$40,loc_D74E      ; D73D  13 7A 40 0D   if DS_TCCMODE .6 TCC IS BEING APPLIED clear goto loc_D74E
	ldd >TCC_PWM_duty_cmd               ; D741  FC 1A F5      D = TCC_PWM_duty_cmd
	subd >tcc_v1AE3                     ; D744  B3 1A E3      D -= tcc_v1AE3
	bcc loc_D74B                        ; D747  24 02         if D >= 0 goto loc_D74B
	clra                                ; D749  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; D74A  5F            B = 0
loc_D74B:
	std >tcc_v1AE5                      ; D74B  FD 1A E5      tcc_v1AE5 = D
loc_D74E:
	ldx #tbl17_TRANS_pressure_ramp_456D ; D74E  CE 45 6D      X = &tbl17_TRANS_pressure_ramp_456D | ramp: $1AE5 += 4*table(VSS); command = base + ramp, clamp at line_pressure_max
	ldaa >VEHICLE_SPEED_0               ; D751  B6 18 BD      A = VEHICLE_SPEED_0
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; D754  BD 66 E5      A = 17pt lookup tbl17_TRANS_pressure_ramp_456D[A]
	tab                                 ; D757  16            B = A
	clra                                ; D758  4F            A = 0
	asld                                ; D759  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_D772                        ; D75A  25 16         if A < 0 goto loc_D772
	asld                                ; D75C  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_D772                        ; D75D  25 13         if A < 0 goto loc_D772
	addd >tcc_v1AE5                     ; D75F  F3 1A E5      D += tcc_v1AE5
	bcs loc_D772                        ; D762  25 0E         if D overflowed goto loc_D772
	std >tcc_v1AE5                      ; D764  FD 1A E5      tcc_v1AE5 = D
	addd >tcc_v1AE3                     ; D767  F3 1A E3      D += tcc_v1AE3
	bcs loc_D772                        ; D76A  25 06         if D overflowed goto loc_D772
	cpd >line_pressure_max              ; D76C  1A B3 1A F9   compare D with line_pressure_max
	bcs loc_D775                        ; D770  25 03         if D < line_pressure_max goto loc_D775
loc_D772:
	ldd >line_pressure_max              ; D772  FC 1A F9      D = line_pressure_max
loc_D775:
	std >TCC_PWM_duty_cmd               ; D775  FD 1A F5      TCC_PWM_duty_cmd = D
	jmp >loc_D91C                       ; D778  7E D9 1C      goto loc_D91C
loc_D77B:
	brclr <tcc_v0083,$08,loc_D7C6       ; D77B  13 83 08 47   if tcc_v0083 .3 clear goto loc_D7C6
	brset <tcc_v0084,$10,loc_D78E       ; D77F  12 84 10 0B   if tcc_v0084 .4 set goto loc_D78E
	bclr <tcc_v0084,$04                 ; D783  15 84 04      tcc_v0084 .2 = 0
	ldd >tcc_v1AE5                      ; D786  FC 1A E5      D = tcc_v1AE5
	std >pcs_v1B19                      ; D789  FD 1B 19      pcs_v1B19 = D
	bra loc_D790                        ; D78C  20 02         goto loc_D790
loc_D78E:
	bra loc_D7BA                        ; D78E  20 2A         goto loc_D7BA
loc_D790:

	asld                                ; D794  05            D <<= 1

	bcc loc_D7B1                        ; D7AC  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_D7B1

	ldx #tblOfs3D_TRANS_line_pressure_base_45BA; D7CE  CE 45 BA      X = &tblOfs3D_TRANS_line_pressure_base_45BA | base from 3D table (turbine speed*4, trans load); A/C on forces minimum k_4704

	brclr <DS_DIFLAGS,$02,loc_D7EF      ; D7E3  13 66 02 08   if DS_DIFLAGS .1 A/C COMPRESSOR ENGAGED clear goto loc_D7EF

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_apply_speed_DBC6
;   analysis [medium]: Gets the TCC apply vehicle speed for the current gear from shift-pattern pointer tables
;        (selected by flags $73/$75/$76 via trans_task_EBF2). Normal pattern: 17-pt tables vs trans_load_filtered;
;        kickdown pattern: fixed bytes. The two values are blended by the altitude factor (diag_P0602_EC22).
;        Raised to tbl_43D2[gear] with A/C on ($80.6) and to k_43A6 when trans is hot ($80.7). Sets $7C.6 (apply

	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$80            ; DC5C  15 7C 80      TCC_cond_flags .7 TCC release requested = 0
loc_DC5F:
	rts                                 ; DC5F  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TCC_control_50ms_part_DC60
;   analysis [low]: Sets $7D.5 when trans failure mode ENA2.3 or the cold-trans inhibit $7F.2 is active.
;        Otherwise, when $7E has no brake or $6B reason bits set, sets $7D.6 for gear/FMEM conditions enabled by
;        tbl_4AC5 bits 2/3 (4th gear with FMEM_ENA.2, or gear>=3rd with $8A.1).
;   inferred [C, pass B]: only called from TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TCC_control_50ms_part_DC60:
	bclr <tcc_v007D,$60                 ; DC60  15 7D 60      tcc_v007D .5,.6 = 0
	brset <TRANS_FMEM_ENA2_FLAGS,$08,loc_DC6D; DC63  12 89 08 06   if TRANS_FMEM_ENA2_FLAGS .3 set goto loc_DC6D
	brset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$04,loc_DC6D; DC67  12 7F 04 02   if TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .2 set goto loc_DC6D
	bra loc_DC72                        ; DC6B  20 05         goto loc_DC72
loc_DC6D:
	bset <tcc_v007D,$20                 ; DC6D  14 7D 20      tcc_v007D .5 = 1
	bra loc_DC99                        ; DC70  20 27         goto loc_DC99
loc_DC72:
	brclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$28,loc_DC78; DC72  13 7E 28 02   if TCC_inhibit_reasons .3,.5 clear goto loc_DC78
	bra loc_DC99                        ; DC76  20 21         goto loc_DC99
loc_DC78:
	ldaa >tbl_4AC5                      ; DC78  B6 4A C5      A = tbl_4AC5
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; DC7B  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	cmpb #$03                           ; DC7E  C1 03         compare B with 3
	bne loc_DC8A                        ; DC80  26 08         if trans_gear_AT != 3 goto loc_DC8A
	brclr <TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS,$04,loc_DC8A; DC82  13 88 04 04   if TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS .2 P1810 fault: force range = Drive 4 clear goto loc_DC8A
	bita #$08                           ; DC86  85 08         test tbl_4AC5 .3
	bne loc_DC96                        ; DC88  26 0C         if any of tbl_4AC5 .3 set goto loc_DC96
loc_DC8A:
	cmpb #$02                           ; DC8A  C1 02         compare B with 2
	bcs loc_DC99                        ; DC8C  25 0B         if B < 2 goto loc_DC99
	brclr <shift_v008A,$02,loc_DC99     ; DC8E  13 8A 02 07   if shift_v008A .1 clear goto loc_DC99
	bita #$04                           ; DC92  85 04         test A mask 4
	beq loc_DC99                        ; DC94  27 03         if mask 4 all clear goto loc_DC99
loc_DC96:
	bset <tcc_v007D,$40                 ; DC96  14 7D 40      tcc_v007D .6 = 1
loc_DC99:
	rts                                 ; DC99  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_apply_release_bits_DC9A
;   analysis [medium]: Runs the TCC apply-delay timer $1B08: when $80.5 is set it is preset to k_4580 (+k_4582 if
;        $1B07 is still running) and $1B07 is preset to k_4581; otherwise both count down to 0. It then turns the
;        apply-speed-met ($7C.6) and release-request ($7C.7) bits into $7C.4 (apply allowed, timer expired) and
;        $7C.5 (release).
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_apply_release_bits_DC9A:
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$30            ; DC9A  15 7C 30      TCC_cond_flags .4,.5 = 0
	brclr <TCC_status_flags,$20,loc_DCB8; DC9D  13 80 20 17   if TCC_status_flags .5 clear goto loc_DCB8 | $80.5 set: preload apply-delay timer $1B08 (longer if re-request within $1B07 window)
	ldaa >k_4580                        ; DCA1  B6 45 80      A = k_4580
	ldab >tcc_v1B07                     ; DCA4  F6 1B 07      B = tcc_v1B07
	beq loc_DCB0                        ; DCA7  27 07         if B == 0 goto loc_DCB0
	adda >k_4582                        ; DCA9  BB 45 82      A += k_4582
	bcc loc_DCB0                        ; DCAC  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_DCB0
	ldaa #$FF                           ; DCAE  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_DCB0:
	staa >TCC_apply_delay_tmr           ; DCB0  B7 1B 08      TCC_apply_delay_tmr = A
	ldaa >k_4581                        ; DCB3  B6 45 81      A = k_4581
	bra loc_DCC7                        ; DCB6  20 0F         goto loc_DCC7
loc_DCB8:
	ldaa >TCC_apply_delay_tmr           ; DCB8  B6 1B 08      A = TCC_apply_delay_tmr | otherwise count both delay timers down to 0
	beq loc_DCBE                        ; DCBB  27 01         if A == 0 goto loc_DCBE
	deca                                ; DCBD  4A            A--
loc_DCBE:
	staa >TCC_apply_delay_tmr           ; DCBE  B7 1B 08      TCC_apply_delay_tmr = A
	ldaa >tcc_v1B07                     ; DCC1  B6 1B 07      A = tcc_v1B07
	beq loc_DCC7                        ; DCC4  27 01         if A == 0 goto loc_DCC7
	deca                                ; DCC6  4A            A--
loc_DCC7:
	staa >tcc_v1B07                     ; DCC7  B7 1B 07      tcc_v1B07 = A
	brclr <TCC_cond_flags,$40,loc_DCE1  ; DCCA  13 7C 40 13   if TCC_cond_flags .6 TCC apply speed met clear goto loc_DCE1 | apply allowed ($7C.4) only when speed met, no release, and delay timer expired
	brset <TCC_cond_flags,$80,loc_DCE1  ; DCCE  12 7C 80 0F   if TCC_cond_flags .7 TCC release requested set goto loc_DCE1
	ldaa >TCC_apply_delay_tmr           ; DCD2  B6 1B 08      A = TCC_apply_delay_tmr
	bne loc_DCDC                        ; DCD5  26 05         if A != 0 goto loc_DCDC
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$10            ; DCD7  14 7C 10      TCC_cond_flags .4 = 1
	bra loc_DCF5                        ; DCDA  20 19         goto loc_DCF5
loc_DCDC:
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$10            ; DCDC  15 7C 10      TCC_cond_flags .4 = 0
	bra loc_DCF5                        ; DCDF  20 14         goto loc_DCF5
loc_DCE1:
	brclr <TCC_cond_flags,$40,loc_DCEB  ; DCE1  13 7C 40 06   if TCC_cond_flags .6 TCC apply speed met clear goto loc_DCEB
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$10            ; DCE5  14 7C 10      TCC_cond_flags .4 = 1
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$20            ; DCE8  15 7C 20      TCC_cond_flags .5 = 0
loc_DCEB:
	brclr <TCC_cond_flags,$80,loc_DCF5  ; DCEB  13 7C 80 06   if TCC_cond_flags .7 TCC release requested clear goto loc_DCF5
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$20            ; DCEF  14 7C 20      TCC_cond_flags .5 = 1
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$10            ; DCF2  15 7C 10      TCC_cond_flags .4 = 0
loc_DCF5:
	rts                                 ; DCF5  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; select_TCC_mode_request_DCF6
;   analysis [medium]: Priority decoder: turns the TCC condition bits in $7C (hi byte) and $7D (lo byte) into a
;        single one-hot requested-mode byte in $82 (1,2,4,8,$10,$20,$40,$80). calc_DS_TCCMODE then uses that byte
;        as the row index of its transition table.
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
select_TCC_mode_request_DCF6:
	ldd <TCC_cond_flags                 ; DCF6  DC 7C         D = TCC_cond_flags | priority decode of $7C/$7D condition bits into one-hot mode request $82
	bitb #$03                           ; DCF8  C5 03         test B mask 3
	beq loc_DD18                        ; DCFA  27 1C         if mask 3 all clear goto loc_DD18
	bitb #$02                           ; DCFC  C5 02         test B mask 2
	beq loc_DD10                        ; DCFE  27 10         if mask 2 all clear goto loc_DD10
	bitb #$01                           ; DD00  C5 01         test B mask 1
	beq loc_DD08                        ; DD02  27 04         if mask 1 all clear goto loc_DD08
	bitb #$03                           ; DD04  C5 03         test B mask 3
	bne loc_DD3E                        ; DD06  26 36         if any of mask 3 set goto loc_DD3E
loc_DD08:
	bitb #$10                           ; DD08  C5 10         test B mask $10(16)
	bne loc_DD3E                        ; DD0A  26 32         if any of mask $10(16) set goto loc_DD3E
	ldaa #$04                           ; DD0C  86 04         A = 4
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD0E  20 4C         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD10:
	bitb #$08                           ; DD10  C5 08         test B mask 8
	bne loc_DD4E                        ; DD12  26 3A         if any of mask 8 set goto loc_DD4E
	ldaa #$01                           ; DD14  86 01         A = 1
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD16  20 44         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD18:
	bitb #$60                           ; DD18  C5 60         test B mask $60(96)
	beq loc_DD26                        ; DD1A  27 0A         if mask $60(96) all clear goto loc_DD26
	bitb #$20                           ; DD1C  C5 20         test B mask $20(32)
	bne loc_DD3E                        ; DD1E  26 1E         if any of mask $20(32) set goto loc_DD3E
	bitb #$08                           ; DD20  C5 08         test B mask 8
	beq loc_DD5A                        ; DD22  27 36         if mask 8 all clear goto loc_DD5A
	bra loc_DD4E                        ; DD24  20 28         goto loc_DD4E
loc_DD26:
	bita #$01                           ; DD26  85 01         test A mask 1
	bne loc_DD3E                        ; DD28  26 14         if any of mask 1 set goto loc_DD3E
	bita #$30                           ; DD2A  85 30         test A mask $30(48)
	beq loc_DD42                        ; DD2C  27 14         if mask $30(48) all clear goto loc_DD42
	brset <TCC_cond_flags,$30,loc_DD3E  ; DD2E  12 7C 30 0C   if TCC_cond_flags .4,.5 set goto loc_DD3E
	bita #$10                           ; DD32  85 10         test A mask $10(16)
	bne loc_DD4A                        ; DD34  26 14         if any of mask $10(16) set goto loc_DD4A
	bitb #$10                           ; DD36  C5 10         test B mask $10(16)
	bne loc_DD42                        ; DD38  26 08         if any of mask $10(16) set goto loc_DD42
	ldaa #$20                           ; DD3A  86 20         A = $20(32)
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD3C  20 1E         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD3E:
	ldaa #$08                           ; DD3E  86 08         A = 8
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD40  20 1A         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD42:
	bitb #$08                           ; DD42  C5 08         test B mask 8
	bne loc_DD4E                        ; DD44  26 08         if any of mask 8 set goto loc_DD4E
	ldaa #$10                           ; DD46  86 10         A = $10(16)
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD48  20 12         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD4A:
	bitb #$08                           ; DD4A  C5 08         test B mask 8
	beq loc_DD5A                        ; DD4C  27 0C         if mask 8 all clear goto loc_DD5A
loc_DD4E:
	bitb #$80                           ; DD4E  C5 80         test B mask $80(128)
	beq loc_DD56                        ; DD50  27 04         if mask $80(128) all clear goto loc_DD56
	ldaa #$02                           ; DD52  86 02         A = 2
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD54  20 06         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD56:
	ldaa #$40                           ; DD56  86 40         A = $40(64)
	bra loc_DD5C                        ; DD58  20 02         goto loc_DD5C
loc_DD5A:
	ldaa #$80                           ; DD5A  86 80         A = $80(128)
loc_DD5C:
	staa <TCC_mode_request              ; DD5C  97 82         TCC_mode_request = A
	rts                                 ; DD5E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
;   analysis [medium]: Top-level TCC routine called from run_50ms_job. Steps: inhibit flags (E09D), slip-counter
;        bands (E396), FMEM flags (DC60), A/C/hot flags (DB99). When TCC is released/idle it calculates the apply
;        speed (DBC6); when applying/slipping or a release reason is active it runs the release logic (E20A),
;        slip-mode enable (DE32) and light-load flag (DF62). It then builds the request ($82) and steps the DS_TC
;   called from: run_50ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TCC_control_50ms_DD5F:
	jsr >calc_TCC_inhibit_flags_E09D    ; DD5F  BD E0 9D      call calc_TCC_inhibit_flags_E09D
	jsr >tcc_task_E396                  ; DD62  BD E3 96      call tcc_task_E396
	jsr >TCC_control_50ms_part_DC60     ; DD65  BD DC 60      call TCC_control_50ms_part_DC60
	jsr >tcc_ac_and_hot_flags_DB99      ; DD68  BD DB 99      call tcc_ac_and_hot_flags_DB99
	ldaa <TCC_release_reasons           ; DD6B  96 81         A = TCC_release_reasons | release reasons $81.1/.3 active -> skip apply-speed calc, run release/slip logic
	bita #$0A                           ; DD6D  85 0A         test TCC_release_reasons .1,.3
	bne loc_DD80                        ; DD6F  26 0F         if any of TCC_release_reasons .1,.3 set goto loc_DD80
	ldaa <DS_TCCMODE                    ; DD71  96 7A         A = DS_TCCMODE
	bita #$B4                           ; DD73  85 B4         test DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING,.5 TCC IS IN LOCKED-ADJUST MODE,.7 NEGATIVE SLIP RECENTLY PREVENTS APPLY
	bne loc_DD7C                        ; DD75  26 05         if any of DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING,.5 TCC IS IN LOCKED-ADJUST MODE,.7 NEGATIVE SLIP RECENTLY PREVENTS APPLY set goto loc_DD7C
	jsr >calc_TCC_apply_speed_DBC6      ; DD77  BD DB C6      call calc_TCC_apply_speed_DBC6
	bra loc_DD89                        ; DD7A  20 0D         goto loc_DD89
loc_DD7C:
	bita #$94                           ; DD7C  85 94         test A mask $94(148)
	beq loc_DD89                        ; DD7E  27 09         if mask $94(148) all clear goto loc_DD89
loc_DD80:
	jsr >calc_TCC_release_request_E20A  ; DD80  BD E2 0A      call calc_TCC_release_request_E20A
	jsr >calc_TCC_slip_target_DE32      ; DD83  BD DE 32      call calc_TCC_slip_target_DE32
	jsr >tcc_task_DF62                  ; DD86  BD DF 62      call tcc_task_DF62
loc_DD89:
	jsr >calc_TCC_apply_release_bits_DC9A; DD89  BD DC 9A      call calc_TCC_apply_release_bits_DC9A
	jsr >select_TCC_mode_request_DCF6   ; DD8C  BD DC F6      call select_TCC_mode_request_DCF6
	jsr >TCC_mode_state_machine_DD93    ; DD8F  BD DD 93      call TCC_mode_state_machine_DD93
	rts                                 ; DD92  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TCC_mode_state_machine_DD93
;   analysis [medium]: TCC mode state machine. Row = index of the one-hot request in $82 (0..7). Column = index of
;        the current DS_TCCMODE state with bit 6 masked off. The next DS_TCCMODE comes from the 8x7 table d_DDFA
;        (code-space, not calibratable). The previous mode is saved to $7B. If there is no request or DS_TCCMODE
;        is 0, it goes to state $01.
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TCC_mode_state_machine_DD93:
	ldx #d_DDFA                         ; DD93  CE DD FA      X = &d_DDFA | row index = position of the one-hot bit in $82 (1,2,4,8 -> 0..3; $10..$80 -> 4..7); 7 bytes per row
	ldab <TCC_mode_request              ; DD96  D6 82         B = TCC_mode_request
	beq loc_DDCA                        ; DD98  27 30         if B == 0 goto loc_DDCA
	bitb #$0F                           ; DD9A  C5 0F         test TCC_mode_request .0,.1,.2,.3
	beq loc_DDA6                        ; DD9C  27 08         if TCC_mode_request .0,.1,.2,.3 all clear goto loc_DDA6
	lsrb                                ; DD9E  54            B >>= 1
	cmpb #$03                           ; DD9F  C1 03         compare B with 3
	bcs loc_DDC0                        ; DDA1  25 1D         if TCC_mode_request < 3 goto loc_DDC0
	decb                                ; DDA3  5A            B--
	bra loc_DDC0                        ; DDA4  20 1A         goto loc_DDC0
loc_DDA6:
	bitb #$30                           ; DDA6  C5 30         test B mask $30(48)
	beq loc_DDB6                        ; DDA8  27 0C         if mask $30(48) all clear goto loc_DDB6
	bitb #$10                           ; DDAA  C5 10         test B mask $10(16)
	beq loc_DDB2                        ; DDAC  27 04         if mask $10(16) all clear goto loc_DDB2
	ldab #$04                           ; DDAE  C6 04         B = 4
	bra loc_DDC0                        ; DDB0  20 0E         goto loc_DDC0
loc_DDB2:
	ldab #$05                           ; DDB2  C6 05         B = 5
	bra loc_DDC0                        ; DDB4  20 0A         goto loc_DDC0
loc_DDB6:
	bitb #$40                           ; DDB6  C5 40         test B mask $40(64)
	beq loc_DDBE                        ; DDB8  27 04         if mask $40(64) all clear goto loc_DDBE
	ldab #$06                           ; DDBA  C6 06         B = 6
	bra loc_DDC0                        ; DDBC  20 02         goto loc_DDC0
loc_DDBE:
	ldab #$07                           ; DDBE  C6 07         B = 7
loc_DDC0:
	ldaa #$07                           ; DDC0  86 07         A = 7
	mul                                 ; DDC2  3D            D = A * B
	abx                                 ; DDC3  3A            X += B
	ldab <DS_TCCMODE                    ; DDC4  D6 7A         B = DS_TCCMODE | column index = current DS_TCCMODE state (bit6 ignored), same one-hot decode
	andb #$BF                           ; DDC6  C4 BF         B &= $BF(191) (keep bits)
	bne loc_DDCE                        ; DDC8  26 04         if B != 0 goto loc_DDCE
loc_DDCA:
	ldaa #$01                           ; DDCA  86 01         A = 1
	bra loc_DDEF                        ; DDCC  20 21         goto loc_DDEF
loc_DDCE:
	bitb #$0F                           ; DDCE  C5 0F         test B mask $0F(15)
	beq loc_DDDA                        ; DDD0  27 08         if mask $0F(15) all clear goto loc_DDDA
	lsrb                                ; DDD2  54            B >>= 1
	cmpb #$03                           ; DDD3  C1 03         compare B with 3
	bcs loc_DDEC                        ; DDD5  25 15         if B < 3 goto loc_DDEC
	decb                                ; DDD7  5A            B--
	bra loc_DDEC                        ; DDD8  20 12         goto loc_DDEC
loc_DDDA:
	bitb #$10                           ; DDDA  C5 10         test B mask $10(16)
	beq loc_DDE2                        ; DDDC  27 04         if mask $10(16) all clear goto loc_DDE2
	ldab #$04                           ; DDDE  C6 04         B = 4
	bra loc_DDEC                        ; DDE0  20 0A         goto loc_DDEC
loc_DDE2:
	bitb #$80                           ; DDE2  C5 80         test B mask $80(128)
	beq loc_DDEA                        ; DDE4  27 04         if mask $80(128) all clear goto loc_DDEA
	ldab #$06                           ; DDE6  C6 06         B = 6
	bra loc_DDEC                        ; DDE8  20 02         goto loc_DDEC
loc_DDEA:
	ldab #$05                           ; DDEA  C6 05         B = 5
loc_DDEC:
	abx                                 ; DDEC  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; DDED  A6 00         A = [X+0]
loc_DDEF:
	ldab <DS_TCCMODE                    ; DDEF  D6 7A         B = DS_TCCMODE | save previous TCC mode in $7B, store new mode
	stab <DS_TCCMODE_prev               ; DDF1  D7 7B         DS_TCCMODE_prev = B
	staa <DS_TCCMODE                    ; DDF3  97 7A         DS_TCCMODE = A
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$80,loc_DDF9      ; DDF5  13 7A 80 00   if DS_TCCMODE .7 NEGATIVE SLIP RECENTLY PREVENTS APPLY clear goto loc_DDF9
loc_DDF9:
	rts                                 ; DDF9  39            return

d_DDFA:
	fcb	$44,$44,$04,$44,$10,$44,$01,$01,$01,$01,$01,$C0,$01,$80,$01,$41 ; DDFA
	fcb	$48,$08,$48,$48,$48,$01,$01,$41,$41,$41,$41,$41,$02,$02,$01,$42 ; DE0A
	fcb	$01,$42,$01,$01,$02,$48,$08,$48,$48,$48,$42,$01,$50,$01,$10,$44 ; DE1A
	fcb	$50,$02,$44,$04,$44,$01,$44,$01                                 ; DE2A

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_slip_target_DE32
;   analysis [low]: Enable/abort logic for controlled-slip TCC operation. Timer $1B10 counts while $83.3 is clear;
;        $83.0 = time-in >= k_46FD. Slip target $1B11 = tblOfs3D_45BA[load, turbine speed]*8 (or the override
;        $1B05). $83.3 latches after k_46F8 counts once filtered slip $1B01 drops below target+kw_46F6. Slip below
;        target+kw_46F9 for k_46FB counts aborts ($83.0 clear, $84.4 set). Everything is reset when out of
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes TCC_slip_target; tables TRANS_line_pressure_base
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_slip_target_DE32:
	brset <tcc_v0083,$08,loc_DE41       ; DE32  12 83 08 0B   if tcc_v0083 .3 set goto loc_DE41 | $1B10 = time since slip mode was latched off; $83.0 = enough time elapsed (k_46FD)
	ldaa >tcc_v1B10                     ; DE36  B6 1B 10      A = tcc_v1B10
	inca                                ; DE39  4C            A++
	beq loc_DE44                        ; DE3A  27 08         if A == 0 goto loc_DE44
	staa >tcc_v1B10                     ; DE3C  B7 1B 10      tcc_v1B10 = A
	bra loc_DE44                        ; DE3F  20 03         goto loc_DE44
loc_DE41:
	clr >tcc_v1B10                      ; DE41  7F 1B 10      tcc_v1B10 = 0
loc_DE44:
	ldaa >tcc_v1B10                     ; DE44  B6 1B 10      A = tcc_v1B10
	cmpa >k_46FD                        ; DE47  B1 46 FD      compare A with k_46FD
	bcs loc_DE51                        ; DE4A  25 05         if tcc_v1B10 < k_46FD goto loc_DE51
	bset <tcc_v0083,$01                 ; DE4C  14 83 01      tcc_v0083 .0 = 1
	bra loc_DE54                        ; DE4F  20 03         goto loc_DE54
loc_DE51:
	bclr <tcc_v0083,$01                 ; DE51  15 83 01      tcc_v0083 .0 = 0
loc_DE54:
	ldaa >k_3868                        ; DE54  B6 38 68      A = k_3868
	bita #$01                           ; DE57  85 01         test k_3868 .0
	beq loc_DE61                        ; DE59  27 06         if k_3868 .0 all clear goto loc_DE61
	brclr <tcc_v006A,$06,loc_DE61       ; DE5B  13 6A 06 02   if tcc_v006A .1 trans temp hot,.2 coolant hot clear goto loc_DE61
	bra loc_DEC3                        ; DE5F  20 62         goto loc_DEC3
loc_DE61:
	brclr <DS_DIFLAGS,$02,loc_DE6C      ; DE61  13 66 02 07   if DS_DIFLAGS .1 A/C COMPRESSOR ENGAGED clear goto loc_DE6C
	ldaa >TCC_option_bits_43A4          ; DE65  B6 43 A4      A = TCC_option_bits_43A4
	bita #$10                           ; DE68  85 10         test TCC_option_bits_43A4 .4
	beq loc_DED9                        ; DE6A  27 6D         if TCC_option_bits_43A4 .4 all clear goto loc_DED9

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_PWM_slip_control_DFEA
;   analysis [medium]: Closed-loop TCC slip control (called from calc_line_pressure_max_D69C, which is really TCC
;        duty logic). Target slip $1B11 = 3D table 45BA[trans load, turbine speed]*8. Integrator step $1B14 comes
;        from sub_E351. Base duty $1B1B = tbl_4712[turbine speed], at least the min duty $1AF8. Integrator $1B0C
;        is +/- step depending on |slip| ($1AFD) vs target and is reset while applying. Output $1AF5 = base +
;   called from: calc_press_cmd_min_D69C
