; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_inhibit_flags_E09D
;   analysis [medium]: Builds the TCC inhibit-reason bytes $7E/$7F, enabled per reason by the tbl_43A4/k_43A5
;        option bits. Reasons: gear 1 ($7F.7), PRNDL/gear ($7E.0), trans temp window ($7E.1, X+8/X+9 hysteresis),
;        coolant temp window ($7E.2, $18DB), brake ($7E.3), $6B.0 ($7E.4), post-shift timer $1AE2 ($7E.5/$7F.0),
;        cold trans with tbl_457E hysteresis ($7F.2), FMEM gear ($7F.3). $7C.0 = any reason set. A force-motor ad
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_inhibit_flags_E09D:
	ldx #TCC_option_bits_43A4           ; E09D  CE 43 A4      X = &TCC_option_bits_43A4 | build TCC inhibit reasons $7E/$7F; each reason gated by an option bit in tbl_43A4/k_43A5
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$99       ; E0A0  15 7E 99      TCC_inhibit_reasons .0,.3,.4,.7 = 0
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$CE      ; E0A3  15 7F CE      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .1,.2,.3,.6,.7 = 0
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; E0A6  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT
	cmpa #$00                           ; E0A9  81 00         compare A with 0
	bne loc_E0B0                        ; E0AB  26 03         if trans_gear_AT != 0 goto loc_E0B0
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$80      ; E0AD  14 7F 80      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .7 = 1
loc_E0B0:
	brclr $01,x,$80,loc_E0C2            ; E0B0  1F 01 80 0E   if [X+1] .7 clear goto loc_E0C2
	brset <tcc_v006A,$02,loc_E0C2       ; E0B4  12 6A 02 0A   if tcc_v006A .1 trans temp hot set goto loc_E0C2
	ldaa >d_7F11                        ; E0B8  B6 7F 11      A = d_7F11
	bita #$01                           ; E0BB  85 01         test d_7F11 .0
	beq loc_E0C2                        ; E0BD  27 03         if d_7F11 .0 all clear goto loc_E0C2
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$40      ; E0BF  14 7F 40      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .6 = 1
loc_E0C2:
	brclr $00,x,$08,loc_E0CE            ; E0C2  1F 00 08 08   if [X+0] .3 clear goto loc_E0CE
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$03,loc_E0CE ; E0C6  13 5F 03 04   if Cal_bit_6_store .0 Low,.1 Drive 2 clear goto loc_E0CE
	brclr <tcc_v006A,$02,loc_E0E5       ; E0CA  13 6A 02 17   if tcc_v006A .1 trans temp hot clear goto loc_E0E5
loc_E0CE:
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; E0CE  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT
	cmpa #$02                           ; E0D1  81 02         compare A with 2
	bne loc_E0E8                        ; E0D3  26 13         if trans_gear_AT != 2 goto loc_E0E8
	brclr $01,x,$20,loc_E0DD            ; E0D5  1F 01 20 04   if [X+1] .5 clear goto loc_E0DD
	brset <Cal_bit_6_store,$04,loc_E0E5 ; E0D9  12 5F 04 08   if Cal_bit_6_store .2 Drive 3 set goto loc_E0E5
loc_E0DD:
	brclr $01,x,$40,loc_E0E8            ; E0DD  1F 01 40 07   if [X+1] .6 clear goto loc_E0E8
	brclr <Cal_bit_6_store,$08,loc_E0E8 ; E0E1  13 5F 08 03   if Cal_bit_6_store .3 Drive 4 clear goto loc_E0E8
loc_E0E5:
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$01       ; E0E5  14 7E 01      TCC_inhibit_reasons .0 = 1
loc_E0E8:
	brclr $00,x,$20,loc_E0FF            ; E0E8  1F 00 20 13   if [X+0] .5 clear goto loc_E0FF | trans temp window with hysteresis: inhibit below [X+9], release above [X+8]
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; E0EC  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered
	cmpa $09,x                          ; E0EF  A1 09         compare A with [X+9]
	bcs loc_E0FC                        ; E0F1  25 09         if trans_temp_filtered < [X+9] goto loc_E0FC
	cmpa $08,x                          ; E0F3  A1 08         compare A with [X+8]
	bls loc_E0FF                        ; E0F5  23 08         if trans_temp_filtered <= [X+8] goto loc_E0FF
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$02       ; E0F7  15 7E 02      TCC_inhibit_reasons .1 = 0
	bra loc_E0FF                        ; E0FA  20 03         goto loc_E0FF
loc_E0FC:
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$02       ; E0FC  14 7E 02      TCC_inhibit_reasons .1 = 1
loc_E0FF:
	brclr $00,x,$40,loc_E116            ; E0FF  1F 00 40 13   if [X+0] .6 clear goto loc_E116 | same for coolant temp ($18DB) with [X+11]/[X+10]
	ldaa >ECT_filtered_trans            ; E103  B6 18 DB      A = ECT_filtered_trans
	cmpa $0B,x                          ; E106  A1 0B         compare A with [X+11]
	bcs loc_E113                        ; E108  25 09         if ECT_filtered_trans < [X+11] goto loc_E113
	cmpa $0A,x                          ; E10A  A1 0A         compare A with [X+10]
	bls loc_E116                        ; E10C  23 08         if ECT_filtered_trans <= [X+10] goto loc_E116
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$04       ; E10E  15 7E 04      TCC_inhibit_reasons .2 = 0
	bra loc_E116                        ; E111  20 03         goto loc_E116
loc_E113:
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$04       ; E113  14 7E 04      TCC_inhibit_reasons .2 = 1
loc_E116:
	brclr <DS_DIFLAGS,$01,loc_E128      ; E116  13 66 01 0E   if DS_DIFLAGS .0 BRAKE ON clear goto loc_E128
	brclr <shift_v008A,$80,loc_E125     ; E11A  13 8A 80 07   if shift_v008A .7 clear goto loc_E125
	ldaa >tbl_4AC5                      ; E11E  B6 4A C5      A = tbl_4AC5
	bita #$10                           ; E121  85 10         test tbl_4AC5 .4
	bne loc_E128                        ; E123  26 03         if any of tbl_4AC5 .4 set goto loc_E128
loc_E125:
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$08       ; E125  14 7E 08      TCC_inhibit_reasons .3 = 1
loc_E128:
	brclr $00,x,$02,loc_E133            ; E128  1F 00 02 07   if [X+0] .1 clear goto loc_E133
	brclr <trans_v006B,$01,loc_E133     ; E12C  13 6B 01 03   if trans_v006B .0 tip-out (load falling fast) clear goto loc_E133
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$10       ; E130  14 7E 10      TCC_inhibit_reasons .4 = 1
loc_E133:
	ldaa >TCC_post_shift_timer          ; E133  B6 1A E2      A = TCC_post_shift_timer | post-shift inhibit timer $1AE2 (loaded in E1D5) counts down; clear reasons at 0
	beq loc_E13E                        ; E136  27 06         if A == 0 goto loc_E13E
	deca                                ; E138  4A            A--
	staa >TCC_post_shift_timer          ; E139  B7 1A E2      TCC_post_shift_timer = A
	bra loc_E144                        ; E13C  20 06         goto loc_E144
loc_E13E:
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$20       ; E13E  15 7E 20      TCC_inhibit_reasons .5 = 0
	bclr <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$01      ; E141  15 7F 01      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .0 = 0
loc_E144:
	ldx #TCC_option_bits_43A4           ; E144  CE 43 A4      X = &TCC_option_bits_43A4
	brclr $01,x,$01,loc_E152            ; E147  1F 01 01 07   if TCC_option_bits2_43A5 .0 clear goto loc_E152
	brclr <tcc_v006A,$20,loc_E152       ; E14B  13 6A 20 03   if tcc_v006A .5 TC slip negative (coast), hysteresis clear goto loc_E152
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$80       ; E14F  14 7E 80      TCC_inhibit_reasons .7 = 1
loc_E152:
	bclr <TCC_status_flags,$20          ; E152  15 80 20      TCC_status_flags .5 = 0
	brclr $01,x,$04,loc_E167            ; E155  1F 01 04 0E   if [X+1] .2 clear goto loc_E167
	brclr <tcc_v006A,$80,loc_E167       ; E159  13 6A 80 0A   if tcc_v006A .7 light load clear goto loc_E167
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$02      ; E15D  14 7F 02      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .1 = 1
	brclr <DS_TCCMODE,$14,loc_E167      ; E160  13 7A 14 03   if DS_TCCMODE .2 LOW THRESHOLD FOR COPETCC SELECTED,.4 TCC IS IN RELEASE MODE, SLIPPING clear goto loc_E167
	bset <TCC_status_flags,$20          ; E164  14 80 20      TCC_status_flags .5 = 1
loc_E167:
	jsr >set_fmem_bit6_from_dtc_mask_A4B9; E167  BD A4 B9      call set_fmem_bit6_from_dtc_mask_A4B9
	brclr <TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS,$40,loc_E188; E16A  13 88 40 1A   if TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS .6 clear goto loc_E188 | cold trans: temp <= tbl_457E threshold (hysteresis via $7C.2) -> inhibit $7F.2
	ldx #tbl_TCC_cold_trans_temp_hyst_457E; E16E  CE 45 7E      X = &tbl_TCC_cold_trans_temp_hyst_457E
	brset <TCC_cond_flags,$04,loc_E176  ; E171  12 7C 04 01   if TCC_cond_flags .2 set goto loc_E176
	inx                                 ; E175  08            X++
loc_E176:
	ldaa >trans_temp_filtered           ; E176  B6 18 E7      A = trans_temp_filtered
	cmpa $00,x                          ; E179  A1 00         compare A with [X+0]
	bhi loc_E185                        ; E17B  22 08         if trans_temp_filtered > [X+0] goto loc_E185
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$04            ; E17D  15 7C 04      TCC_cond_flags .2 = 0
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$04      ; E180  14 7F 04      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .2 = 1
	bra loc_E188                        ; E183  20 03         goto loc_E188
loc_E185:
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$04            ; E185  14 7C 04      TCC_cond_flags .2 = 1
loc_E188:
	brclr <TRANS_FMEM_ENA2_FLAGS,$04,loc_E19D; E188  13 89 04 11   if TRANS_FMEM_ENA2_FLAGS .2 P0723 failed this ignition clear goto loc_E19D
	ldaa >trans_gear_AT                 ; E18C  B6 1A C0      A = trans_gear_AT
	cmpa #$03                           ; E18F  81 03         compare A with 3
	beq loc_E19D                        ; E191  27 0A         if trans_gear_AT == 3 goto loc_E19D
	ldaa >tbl_4AC5                      ; E193  B6 4A C5      A = tbl_4AC5
	bita #$20                           ; E196  85 20         test tbl_4AC5 .5
	beq loc_E19D                        ; E198  27 03         if tbl_4AC5 .5 all clear goto loc_E19D
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$08      ; E19A  14 7F 08      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .3 = 1
loc_E19D:
	ldaa <TCC_inhibit_reasons           ; E19D  96 7E         A = TCC_inhibit_reasons | $7C.0 = any TCC inhibit reason active
	bne loc_E1A5                        ; E19F  26 04         if A != 0 goto loc_E1A5
	ldaa <TCC_inhibit_reasons2          ; E1A1  96 7F         A = TCC_inhibit_reasons2
	beq loc_E1AA                        ; E1A3  27 05         if A == 0 goto loc_E1AA
loc_E1A5:
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$01            ; E1A5  14 7C 01      TCC_cond_flags .0 any TCC inhibit reason = 1
	bra loc_E1AD                        ; E1A8  20 03         goto loc_E1AD
loc_E1AA:
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$01            ; E1AA  15 7C 01      TCC_cond_flags .0 any TCC inhibit reason = 0
loc_E1AD:
	ldaa >trans_fault_summary2          ; E1AD  B6 1B C3      A = trans_fault_summary2 | force-motor adapt request ($1BC3.6) holds TCC off for kw_4C8C ticks then clears request
	bita #$40                           ; E1B0  85 40         test trans_fault_summary2 .6
	beq loc_E1D4                        ; E1B2  27 20         if trans_fault_summary2 .6 all clear goto loc_E1D4
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$01            ; E1B4  14 7C 01      TCC_cond_flags .0 any TCC inhibit reason = 1
	ldd >tcc_v1C42                      ; E1B7  FC 1C 42      D = tcc_v1C42
	addd #$0001                         ; E1BA  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
	cpd >kw_4C8C                        ; E1BD  1A B3 4C 8C   compare D with kw_4C8C
	bcs loc_E1D1                        ; E1C1  25 0E         if D < kw_4C8C goto loc_E1D1
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$01            ; E1C3  15 7C 01      TCC_cond_flags .0 any TCC inhibit reason = 0
	ldaa >trans_fault_summary2          ; E1C6  B6 1B C3      A = trans_fault_summary2
	anda #$BF                           ; E1C9  84 BF         A &= $BF(191) (keep bits)
	staa >trans_fault_summary2          ; E1CB  B7 1B C3      trans_fault_summary2 = A
	ldd #$0000                          ; E1CE  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
loc_E1D1:
	std >tcc_v1C42                      ; E1D1  FD 1C 42      tcc_v1C42 = D
loc_E1D4:
	rts                                 ; E1D4  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; start_TCC_post_shift_delay_E1D5
;   analysis [medium]: On shift-event flags $77.3 (if tbl_43A4.0) or $77.0 (if k_43A5.4), loads the post-shift TCC
;        inhibit timer $1AE2 from tbl_43D6[gear] / tbl_43D8[gear] and sets $7E.5 / $7F.0. E09D counts it down and
;        clears the bits.
;   called from: run_50ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
start_TCC_post_shift_delay_E1D5:
	brclr <shift_event_flags,$08,loc_E1EF; E1D5  13 77 08 16   if shift_event_flags .3 downshift event clear goto loc_E1EF
	ldab >TCC_option_bits_43A4          ; E1D9  F6 43 A4      B = TCC_option_bits_43A4
	bitb #$01                           ; E1DC  C5 01         test TCC_option_bits_43A4 .0
	beq loc_E1EF                        ; E1DE  27 0F         if TCC_option_bits_43A4 .0 all clear goto loc_E1EF
	ldx #tbl_TCC_post_shift_delay_43D6  ; E1E0  CE 43 D6      X = &tbl_TCC_post_shift_delay_43D6
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E1E3  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	abx                                 ; E1E6  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; E1E7  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa >TCC_post_shift_timer          ; E1E9  B7 1A E2      TCC_post_shift_timer = A
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons,$20       ; E1EC  14 7E 20      TCC_inhibit_reasons .5 = 1
loc_E1EF:
	brclr <shift_event_flags,$01,loc_E209; E1EF  13 77 01 16   if shift_event_flags .0 upshift event (set one pass by calc_tran clear goto loc_E209
	ldab >TCC_option_bits2_43A5         ; E1F3  F6 43 A5      B = TCC_option_bits2_43A5
	bitb #$10                           ; E1F6  C5 10         test TCC_option_bits2_43A5 .4
	beq loc_E209                        ; E1F8  27 0F         if TCC_option_bits2_43A5 .4 all clear goto loc_E209
	ldx #tbl_TCC_post_shift_delay2_43D8 ; E1FA  CE 43 D8      X = &tbl_TCC_post_shift_delay2_43D8
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E1FD  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	abx                                 ; E200  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; E201  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa >TCC_post_shift_timer          ; E203  B7 1A E2      TCC_post_shift_timer = A
	bset <TCC_inhibit_reasons2,$01      ; E206  14 7F 01      TCC_inhibit_reasons2 .0 = 1
loc_E209:
	rts                                 ; E209  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_release_request_E20A
;   analysis [medium]: Calculates the TCC release vehicle speed the same way as DBC6 (pattern tables + altitude
;        blend) and builds release reasons in $81: .0 A/C below tbl_43CF[gear], .4 hot below k_43A7, .1 $6A.3
;        event (on falling edge forces release), .2 VSS below release speed, .5 negative slip at VSS < k_3895, .3
;        timed release from tbl_43D8 (counter $1AFC; at end sets $80.4). Any reason sets $7C.7 (release) and clear
;   called from: TCC_control_50ms_DD5F
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_release_request_E20A:
	brclr <DS_DIFLAGS,$10,loc_E235      ; E20A  13 66 10 27   if DS_DIFLAGS .4 KICKDOWN PATTERN ACTIVE clear goto loc_E235
	ldx #d_D56B                         ; E20E  CE D5 6B      X = &d_D56B
	ldaa <trans_v0075                   ; E211  96 75         A = trans_v0075
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E213  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; E216  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	bcs loc_E265                        ; E219  25 4A         if carry goto loc_E265
	ldaa $00,x                          ; E21B  A6 00         A = d_D56B
	psha                                ; E21D  36            push A
	ldx #d_D58D                         ; E21E  CE D5 8D      X = &d_D58D
	ldaa <shift_v0076                   ; E221  96 76         A = shift_v0076
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E223  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; E226  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	bcs loc_E269                        ; E229  25 3E         if carry goto loc_E269
	pula                                ; E22B  32            pop A
	ldab $00,x                          ; E22C  E6 00         B = d_D58D
	subb #$80                           ; E22E  C0 80         B -= $80(128)
	jsr >blend_by_altitude_EC22         ; E230  BD EC 22      call blend_by_altitude_EC22
	bra loc_E26A                        ; E233  20 35         goto loc_E26A
loc_E235:
	ldx #d_D547                         ; E235  CE D5 47      X = &d_D547
	ldaa <trans_v0073                   ; E238  96 73         A = trans_v0073
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E23A  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; E23D  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	bcs loc_E265                        ; E240  25 23         if carry goto loc_E265
	ldaa >trans_load_filtered           ; E242  B6 18 E4      A = trans_load_filtered
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; E245  BD 66 E5      call lookup_2D_17pt_noheader
	psha                                ; E248  36            push A
	ldx #d_D561                         ; E249  CE D5 61      X = &d_D561
	ldaa <shift_v0076                   ; E24C  96 76         A = shift_v0076
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E24E  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; E251  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	bcs loc_E269                        ; E254  25 13         if carry goto loc_E269
	ldaa >trans_load_filtered           ; E256  B6 18 E4      A = trans_load_filtered
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; E259  BD 66 E5      call lookup_2D_17pt_noheader
	tab                                 ; E25C  16            B = A
	pula                                ; E25D  32            pop A
	subb #$80                           ; E25E  C0 80         B -= $80(128)
	jsr >blend_by_altitude_EC22         ; E260  BD EC 22      call blend_by_altitude_EC22
	bra loc_E26A                        ; E263  20 05         goto loc_E26A
loc_E265:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; E265  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	bra loc_E26A                        ; E267  20 01         goto loc_E26A
loc_E269:
	pula                                ; E269  32            pop A
loc_E26A:
	brclr <TCC_status_flags,$40,loc_E283; E26A  13 80 40 15   if TCC_status_flags .6 A/C engaged TCC flag clear goto loc_E283 | A/C on below tbl_43CF[gear] -> release reason $81.0
	ldab >trans_gear_AT                 ; E26E  F6 1A C0      B = trans_gear_AT
	beq loc_E283                        ; E271  27 10         if B == 0 goto loc_E283
	ldx #tbl_TCC_release_VSS_AC_43CF    ; E273  CE 43 CF      X = &tbl_TCC_release_VSS_AC_43CF
	abx                                 ; E276  3A            X += B
	ldab $00,x                          ; E277  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	cmpb >VEHICLE_SPEED_0               ; E279  F1 18 BD      compare B with VEHICLE_SPEED_0
	bls loc_E283                        ; E27C  23 05         if [X+0] <= VEHICLE_SPEED_0 goto loc_E283
	bset <TCC_release_reasons,$01       ; E27E  14 81 01      TCC_release_reasons .0 = 1
	bra loc_E286                        ; E281  20 03         goto loc_E286
loc_E283:
	bclr <TCC_release_reasons,$01       ; E283  15 81 01      TCC_release_reasons .0 = 0
loc_E286:
	brclr <TCC_status_flags,$80,loc_E297; E286  13 80 80 0D   if TCC_status_flags .7 trans hot (hysteresis) clear goto loc_E297 | hot trans below k_43A7 -> release reason $81.4
	ldab >k_TCC_release_VSS_hot_43A7    ; E28A  F6 43 A7      B = k_TCC_release_VSS_hot_43A7
	cmpb >VEHICLE_SPEED_0               ; E28D  F1 18 BD      compare B with VEHICLE_SPEED_0
	bls loc_E297                        ; E290  23 05         if k_TCC_release_VSS_hot_43A7 <= VEHICLE_SPEED_0 goto loc_E297
	bset <TCC_release_reasons,$10       ; E292  14 81 10      TCC_release_reasons .4 = 1
	bra loc_E29A                        ; E295  20 03         goto loc_E29A
loc_E297:
	bclr <TCC_release_reasons,$10       ; E297  15 81 10      TCC_release_reasons .4 = 0
loc_E29A:
	brclr <tcc_v006A,$08,loc_E2A3       ; E29A  13 6A 08 05   if tcc_v006A .3 tip-in (load rising fast) clear goto loc_E2A3
	bset <TCC_release_reasons,$02       ; E29E  14 81 02      TCC_release_reasons .1 = 1
	bra loc_E2B0                        ; E2A1  20 0D         goto loc_E2B0
loc_E2A3:
	brclr <TCC_release_reasons,$02,loc_E2B0; E2A3  13 81 02 09   if TCC_release_reasons .1 clear goto loc_E2B0
	bclr <TCC_release_reasons,$02       ; E2A7  15 81 02      TCC_release_reasons .1 = 0
	bset <TCC_cond_flags,$80            ; E2AA  14 7C 80      TCC_cond_flags .7 TCC release requested = 1
	bclr <TCC_cond_flags,$40            ; E2AD  15 7C 40      TCC_cond_flags .6 TCC apply speed met = 0

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_TCC_slip_integ_step_E351
;   analysis [medium]: Slip error = (|slip| $1AFD - target $1B11)/4, stored in $1B21 and clamped to -80..+240. It
;        is mapped to 0..255 ((e+80)*4/5) and looked up in t17_46DE to give the integrator step (D = 0:step). A
;        non-zero $1AE0 overrides the step.
;   called from: trans_line_pressure_calc, calc_TCC_PWM_slip_control_DFEA
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_TCC_slip_integ_step_E351:
	ldd >TCC_slip_abs                   ; E351  FC 1A FD      D = TCC_slip_abs
	subd >TCC_slip_target               ; E354  B3 1B 11      D -= TCC_slip_target
	asra                                ; E357  47            A >>= 1 (signed)
	rorb                                ; E358  56            B rotate right thru C
	asra                                ; E359  47            A >>= 1 (signed)
	rorb                                ; E35A  56            B rotate right thru C
	std >TCC_slip_error_q4              ; E35B  FD 1B 21      TCC_slip_error_q4 = D
	cpd #$FFB0                          ; E35E  1A 83 FF B0   compare D with $FFB0(65456) | clamp slip error/4 to -80..+240, then map to 0..255 for the gain table
	bgt loc_E367                        ; E362  2E 03         if D > (signed) $FFB0(65456) goto loc_E367
	ldd #$FFB0                          ; E364  CC FF B0      D = $FFB0(65456)
loc_E367:
	cpd #$00F0                          ; E367  1A 83 00 F0   compare D with $00F0(240)
	blt loc_E370                        ; E36B  2D 03         if D < (signed) $00F0(240) goto loc_E370
	ldd #$00F0                          ; E36D  CC 00 F0      D = $00F0(240)
loc_E370:
	addd #$0050                         ; E370  C3 00 50      D += $0050(80)
	asld                                ; E373  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; E374  05            D <<= 1
	ldx #$0005                          ; E375  CE 00 05      X = $0005(5)
	idiv                                ; E378  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	pshx                                ; E379  3C            push X
	pula                                ; E37A  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; E37B  33            pop B
	tsta                                ; E37C  4D            test A
	beq loc_E381                        ; E37D  27 02         if A == 0 goto loc_E381
	ldab #$FF                           ; E37F  C6 FF         B = $FF(255)
loc_E381:
	tba                                 ; E381  17            A = B
	psha                                ; E382  36            push A
	pula                                ; E383  32            pop A
	ldx #t17_TCC_slip_integ_gain_46DE   ; E384  CE 46 DE      X = &t17_TCC_slip_integ_gain_46DE
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; E387  BD 66 E5      A = 17pt lookup t17_TCC_slip_integ_gain_46DE[A]
	psha                                ; E38A  36            push A
	pulb                                ; E38B  33            pop B
	ldaa >tcc_v1AE0                     ; E38C  B6 1A E0      A = tcc_v1AE0 | nonzero $1AE0 overrides the table step
	beq loc_E392                        ; E38F  27 01         if A == 0 goto loc_E392
	tab                                 ; E391  16            B = A
loc_E392:
	clra                                ; E392  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_E395                        ; E393  20 00         goto loc_E395
loc_E395:
	rts                                 ; E395  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; interp_4cell_by_temp_EAD6
;   analysis [medium]: Linear interpolation across a 4-cell array at X: A = input (trans temp), B = 3 segments.
;        A*3 high byte = cell index and low byte = fraction. Returns X[i] + (X[i+1]-X[i])*frac in A. Used to read
;        the adaptive shift-delay cells.
;   OBD1 LEFBE (match 0.93 p1-global)
;   called from: calc_upshift_RPM_projection_adapt_E8C2
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
interp_4cell_by_temp_EAD6:
	pshx                                ; EAD6  3C            push X
	pshb                                ; EAD7  37            push B
	mul                                 ; EAD8  3D            D = A * B | A*3: high byte = cell index 0..2, low byte = interpolation fraction
	pshb                                ; EAD9  37            push B
	tab                                 ; EADA  16            B = A
	abx                                 ; EADB  3A            X += B
	ldd $00,x                           ; EADC  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	sba                                 ; EADE  10            A -= B
	pulb                                ; EADF  33            pop B
	bcc loc_EAE8                        ; EAE0  24 06         if A >= 0 goto loc_EAE8
	nega                                ; EAE2  40            A = -A
	mul                                 ; EAE3  3D            D = A * B
	adca $00,x                          ; EAE4  A9 00         A += C + [X+0]
	bra loc_EAEE                        ; EAE6  20 06         goto loc_EAEE
loc_EAE8:
	mul                                 ; EAE8  3D            D = A * B
	adca #$00                           ; EAE9  89 00         A += C + 0
	nega                                ; EAEB  40            A = -A
	adda $00,x                          ; EAEC  AB 00         A += [X+0]
loc_EAEE:
	pulb                                ; EAEE  33            pop B
	pulx                                ; EAEF  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; EAF0  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_shift_speed_load_based_EAF1
;   analysis [medium]: Gets a load-based shift threshold for gear B from pointer struct Y. Base 17-pt table vs
;        trans_load_filtered is picked by pattern flags $74 ([Y+6]). An optional alternate table picked by $76
;        ([Y+10]) is blended in by baro/altitude weight (EC22). An optional per-gear offset vs load ([Y+8]) is
;        scaled by 18DD (EC5D). Returns the result in A/X; carry is set if no table applies.
;   called from: calc_shift_request_E4B2
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_shift_speed_load_based_EAF1:
	pshb                                ; EAF1  37            push B
	clra                                ; EAF2  4F            A = 0
	psha                                ; EAF3  36            push A
	ldx $08,y                           ; EAF4  CD EE 08      X = [Y+8] | optional per-gear load-based offset table [Y+8] (signed, $80 = 0)
	abx                                 ; EAF7  3A            X += B
	abx                                 ; EAF8  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; EAF9  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	beq loc_EB0A                        ; EAFB  27 0D         if X == 0 goto loc_EB0A
	ldaa >trans_load_filtered           ; EAFD  B6 18 E4      A = trans_load_filtered
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; EB00  BD 66 E5      call lookup_2D_17pt_noheader
	suba #$80                           ; EB03  80 80         A -= $80(128)
	tsx                                 ; EB05  30            X = SP + 1
	staa $00,x                          ; EB06  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	ldab $01,x                          ; EB08  E6 01         B = [X+1]
loc_EB0A:
	ldx $06,y                           ; EB0A  CD EE 06      X = [Y+6] | base shift table chosen by pattern flags $74, then altitude table by $76 blended via EC22
	ldaa <trans_v0074                   ; EB0D  96 74         A = trans_v0074
	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; EB0F  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	ldaa #$00                           ; EB12  86 00         A = 0
	bcc loc_EB19                        ; EB14  24 03         if A >= 0 goto loc_EB19
	pulb                                ; EB16  33            pop B
	bra loc_EB45                        ; EB17  20 2C         goto loc_EB45
loc_EB19:
	ldaa >trans_load_filtered           ; EB19  B6 18 E4      A = trans_load_filtered
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; EB1C  BD 66 E5      call lookup_2D_17pt_noheader
	psha                                ; EB1F  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; EB20  30            X = SP + 1
	ldab $02,x                          ; EB21  E6 02         B = [X+2]
	ldx $0A,y                           ; EB23  CD EE 0A      X = [Y+10]
	ldaa <shift_v0076                   ; EB26  96 76         A = shift_v0076

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;   analysis [medium]: Like EB47 but returns a 16-bit value in X: the engine-speed target for an RPM-based

	jsr >select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2  ; EBB2  BD EB F2      call select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
	bcc loc_EBBC                        ; EBB5  24 05         if no carry goto loc_EBBC
	pula                                ; EBB7  32            pop A
	clrb                                ; EBB8  5F            B = 0
	pulx                                ; EBB9  38            pop X
	bra loc_EBCC                        ; EBBA  20 10         goto loc_EBCC
loc_EBBC:
	pula                                ; EBBC  32            pop A
	ldab $00,x                          ; EBBD  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	subb #$80                           ; EBBF  C0 80         B -= $80(128)
	jsr >blend_by_altitude_EC22         ; EBC1  BD EC 22      call blend_by_altitude_EC22
	clrb                                ; EBC4  5F            B = 0
	xgdx                                ; EBC5  8F            swap D <-> X
	pula                                ; EBC6  32            pop A
	pulb                                ; EBC7  33            pop B
	jsr >add_weighted_offset_16_EC5D    ; EBC8  BD EC 5D      call add_weighted_offset_16_EC5D
	clc                                 ; EBCB  0C            C = 0
loc_EBCC:
	xgdx                                ; EBCC  8F            swap D <-> X
	pulb                                ; EBCD  33            pop B
	rts                                 ; EBCE  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; FETCH_VAL_USING_PRNDL
;   analysis [high]: If the PRNDL is in a manual range (L/2/3, Cal_bit_6_store b0-2) and the APP fault flag is
;        clear, it indexes the pointer table X by ((range>>1)*k_3890 + gear B)*2 and returns that byte in A with
;        C=0. Otherwise it returns A=0, C=1.
;   OBD1 FETCH_VAL_USING_PRNDL (match 0.96 p1-global)
;   called from: calc_shift_request_E4B2
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
FETCH_VAL_USING_PRNDL:
	pshb                                ; EBCF  37            push B
	brset <TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS,$04,loc_EBEE; EBD0  12 88 04 1A   if TRANS_FMEM_ENA_FLAGS .2 P1810 fault: force range = Drive 4 set goto loc_EBEE | OBD1: APP fault
	ldaa <Cal_bit_6_store               ; EBD4  96 5F         A = Cal_bit_6_store
	anda #$07                           ; EBD6  84 07         A &= 7 (keep bits) | OBD1: check for 3-2-1 position... if in one of those then we run this; if not, skip.
	beq loc_EBEE                        ; EBD8  27 14         if A == 0 goto loc_EBEE
	lsra                                ; EBDA  44            A >>= 1
	pshb                                ; EBDB  37            push B
	ldab >k_num_shift_adapt_tables_3890 ; EBDC  F6 38 90      B = k_num_shift_adapt_tables_3890
	mul                                 ; EBDF  3D            D = A * B
	pula                                ; EBE0  32            pop A
	aba                                 ; EBE1  1B            A += B
	asla                                ; EBE2  48            A <<= 1
	tab                                 ; EBE3  16            B = A
	abx                                 ; EBE4  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; EBE5  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	beq loc_EBEE                        ; EBE7  27 05         if X == 0 goto loc_EBEE
	ldaa $00,x                          ; EBE9  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	clc                                 ; EBEB  0C            C = 0
	bra loc_EBF0                        ; EBEC  20 02         goto loc_EBF0
loc_EBEE:
	clra                                ; EBEE  4F            A = 0 | OBD1: in OD position
	sec                                 ; EBEF  0D            C = 1
loc_EBF0:
	pulb                                ; EBF0  33            pop B
	rts                                 ; EBF1  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 LA444. Searches a calibration pointer list: X[0]/X[1] give the flag mask and record
;        stride, B = gear, A = pattern flag byte. It walks the bits to find the first matching entry and returns X
;        = the pointer, with C=1 if there is no valid pointer.
;   OBD1 LA444 (match 1.00 p1-exact): This routine jumps around in a pointer table
;   with inputs:
;   B - Gear
;   A - Flag Byte (Actual inputs are L0037, L0038, L0039, L003A)
;   called from: calc_TCC_apply_speed_DBC6, calc_TCC_release_request_E20A, calc_shift_speed_load_based_EAF1, calc_shift_speed_fixed_EB47, calc_shift_RPM_target_EB8E
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
select_ptr_by_gear_flags_EBF2:
	pshb                                ; EBF2  37            push B | OBD1: push gear
	psha                                ; EBF3  36            push A | OBD1: 0 = Ai, 1 = Bi push flag
	ldaa $00,x                          ; EBF4  A6 00         A = [X+0] | OBD1: A = Xi[0]  get bit mask from calibration tables (usually $04)
	psha                                ; EBF6  36            push A | OBD1: 0 = Xi[0], 1 = Ai, 2 = Bi
	ldaa $01,x                          ; EBF7  A6 01         A = [X+1] | OBD1: A = Xi[1] (usually $08)
	psha                                ; EBF9  36            push A | OBD1: 0 = Xi[1], 1 = Xi[0], 2 = Ai, 3 = Bi
	aslb                                ; EBFA  58            B <<= 1 | OBD1: double gear and offset it
	abx                                 ; EBFB  3A            X += B | OBD1: X = Xi + 2 * Bi
	ldaa #$01                           ; EBFC  86 01         A = 1 | OBD1: A = 1  start with first bit...
	inx                                 ; EBFE  08            X++
	inx                                 ; EBFF  08            X++ | OBD1: X = Xi + 2 * Bi + 2
	pulb                                ; EC00  33            pop B | OBD1: B = Xi[1], 0 = Xi[0], 1 = Ai, 2 = Bi  get second bit mask value, what is it for? - maybe length of structure... looks right.
loc_EC01:
	pshx                                ; EC01  3C            push X | OBD1: 0:1 = (Xi + 2 * Bi + 2), 2 = Xi[0], 3 = Ai, 4 = Bi
	tsx                                 ; EC02  30            X = SP + 1
	bita $03,x                          ; EC03  A5 03         test A mask [X+3] | OBD1: as soon as bit is found then skip out
	bne loc_EC12                        ; EC05  26 0B         if any of mask [X+3] set goto loc_EC12 | OBD1: BR IF Ai & 1
	bita $02,x                          ; EC07  A5 02         test A mask [X+2] | OBD1: Check compare with flag bit
	bne loc_EC19                        ; EC09  26 0E         if any of mask [X+2] set goto loc_EC19 | OBD1: bit set? then get out
	asla                                ; EC0B  48            A <<= 1 | OBD1: A <<= 1
	bcs loc_EC19                        ; EC0C  25 0B         if A < 0 goto loc_EC19 | OBD1: done bit list (8 bits?) then get out
	pulx                                ; EC0E  38            pop X
	abx                                 ; EC0F  3A            X += B
	bra loc_EC01                        ; EC10  20 EF         goto loc_EC01 | OBD1: go back.....
loc_EC12:
	pulx                                ; EC12  38            pop X | OBD1: X = Pointer to Pointer, 0 = Xi[0], 1 = Ai, 2 = Bi
	ldx $00,x                           ; EC13  EE 00         X = [X+0] | OBD1: fetch pointer and check if valid
	beq loc_EC1A                        ; EC15  27 03         if X == 0 goto loc_EC1A
	bra loc_EC1D                        ; EC17  20 04         goto loc_EC1D
loc_EC19:
	pulx                                ; EC19  38            pop X
loc_EC1A:
	sec                                 ; EC1A  0D            C = 1 | OBD1: error flag - no pointer list found, skip function
	bra loc_EC1E                        ; EC1B  20 01         goto loc_EC1E
loc_EC1D:
	clc                                 ; EC1D  0C            C = 0
loc_EC1E:
	ins                                 ; EC1E  31            SP++ | OBD1: 0 = Ai, 1 = Bi
	pula                                ; EC1F  32            pop A | OBD1: get flag back
	pulb                                ; EC20  33            pop B | OBD1: get gear back
	rts                                 ; EC21  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; blend_by_altitude_EC22
;   analysis [medium]: Not a DTC routine: '#DTC_P0602' is really the constant $51EB used as an fdiv divisor.
;        Weight = t17_389E[(18DE-$4000)/$51EB], where 18DE is a baro-derived value from B4BF. Returns A = A +
;        B*weight, with B a signed delta, clamped 0..255.
;   called from: calc_TCC_apply_speed_DBC6, calc_TCC_release_request_E20A, calc_shift_speed_load_based_EAF1, calc_shift_speed_fixed_EB47, calc_shift_RPM_target_EB8E
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
blend_by_altitude_EC22:
	psha                                ; EC22  36            push A
	pshb                                ; EC23  37            push B
	ldd >altitude_factor                ; EC24  FC 18 DE      D = altitude_factor | 18DE = baro-derived altitude value (B4BF); weight = t17_389E[(18DE-$4000)/$51EB]
	subd #$4000                         ; EC27  83 40 00      D -= $4000(16384)
	bcc loc_EC2F                        ; EC2A  24 03         if D >= 0 goto loc_EC2F
	ldd #$0000                          ; EC2C  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
loc_EC2F:
	cpd #$51EB                          ; EC2F  1A 83 51 EB   compare D with $51EB(20971)
	bls loc_EC38                        ; EC33  23 03         if D <= $51EB(20971) goto loc_EC38
	ldd #$51EB                          ; EC35  CC 51 EB      D = $51EB(20971)
loc_EC38:
	ldx #DTC_P0602                      ; EC38  CE 51 EB      X = &DTC_P0602 | $51EB here is just a divisor constant, not the P0602 DTC record
	fdiv                                ; EC3B  03            X = (D << 16) / X (fraction)
	xgdx                                ; EC3C  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldx #t17_altitude_weight_389E       ; EC3D  CE 38 9E      X = &t17_altitude_weight_389E
	jsr >lookup_2D_17pt_noheader        ; EC40  BD 66 E5      A = 17pt lookup t17_altitude_weight_389E[A]
	pulb                                ; EC43  33            pop B
	tstb                                ; EC44  5D            test B
	bmi loc_EC52                        ; EC45  2B 0B         if B < 0 (signed) goto loc_EC52
	mul                                 ; EC47  3D            D = A * B
	adca #$00                           ; EC48  89 00         A += C + 0
	pulb                                ; EC4A  33            pop B
	aba                                 ; EC4B  1B            A += B
	bcc loc_EC5C                        ; EC4C  24 0E         if A no overflow goto loc_EC5C
	ldaa #$FF                           ; EC4E  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	bra loc_EC5C                        ; EC50  20 0A         goto loc_EC5C
loc_EC52:
	negb                                ; EC52  50            B = -B
	mul                                 ; EC53  3D            D = A * B
	adca #$00                           ; EC54  89 00         A += C + 0
	tab                                 ; EC56  16            B = A
	pula                                ; EC57  32            pop A
	sba                                 ; EC58  10            A -= B
	bcc loc_EC5C                        ; EC59  24 01         if A >= 0 goto loc_EC5C
	clra                                ; EC5B  4F            A = 0
loc_EC5C:
	rts                                 ; EC5C  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; add_weighted_offset_16_EC5D
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 LA4C6. Takes the 16-bit base in X and the signed 16-bit offset in D. Scales the offset
;        by factor 18DD/256 (MUL8_16), adds it to the base and clamps 0..$FFFF. Result in D.
;   OBD1 LA4C6 (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: calc_shift_speed_load_based_EAF1, calc_shift_speed_fixed_EB47, calc_shift_RPM_target_EB8E
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_weighted_offset_16_EC5D:
	pshx                                ; EC5D  3C            push X
	psha                                ; EC5E  36            push A
	tsta                                ; EC5F  4D            test A
	bpl loc_EC66                        ; EC60  2A 04         if A >= 0 (signed) goto loc_EC66
	nega                                ; EC62  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; EC63  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; EC64  82 00         A -= C + 0
loc_EC66:
	pshb                                ; EC66  37            push B
	psha                                ; EC67  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; EC68  30            X = SP + 1
	ldaa >cold_ECT_weight               ; EC69  B6 18 DD      A = cold_ECT_weight | scale |offset| by 18DD/256 then reapply sign and add to base with 0..FFFF clamp
	jsr >MUL8_16                        ; EC6C  BD 67 74      call MUL8_16
	pulx                                ; EC6F  38            pop X
	tsx                                 ; EC70  30            X = SP + 1
	tst $00,x                           ; EC71  6D 00         test [X+0]
	bpl loc_EC79                        ; EC73  2A 04         if [X+0] >= 0 (signed) goto loc_EC79
	nega                                ; EC75  40            A = -A
	negb                                ; EC76  50            B = -B
	sbca #$00                           ; EC77  82 00         A -= C + 0
loc_EC79:
	ins                                 ; EC79  31            SP++
	psha                                ; EC7A  36            push A
	addd $01,x                          ; EC7B  E3 01         D += [X+1]
	bcs loc_EC89                        ; EC7D  25 0A         if D overflowed goto loc_EC89
	psha                                ; EC7F  36            push A
	anda $00,x                          ; EC80  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	pula                                ; EC82  32            pop A
	bpl loc_EC92                        ; EC83  2A 0D         if A >= 0 (signed) goto loc_EC92
	clra                                ; EC85  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; EC86  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_EC92                        ; EC87  20 09         goto loc_EC92
loc_EC89:
	psha                                ; EC89  36            push A
	oraa $00,x                          ; EC8A  AA 00         A |= [X+0]
	pula                                ; EC8C  32            pop A
	bmi loc_EC92                        ; EC8D  2B 03         if A < 0 (signed) goto loc_EC92
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; EC8F  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_EC92:
	ins                                 ; EC92  31            SP++
	pulx                                ; EC93  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; EC94  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
;   analysis [medium]: 100 ms engine housekeeping, called from bank-1 far_b1_part_8089. Decides running vs stopped
;        (RPM > k_2259), counts ENGINE_RUN_TIME and resets fueling/antistall state when stopped. Captures startup
;        ECT once. Calls glow-plug, sensor linearization, baro, APP zero, engine-stop solenoid, boost control,
;        shift-pattern select, fuel/timing modifiers and backup timing. Also decays the cold-start timing adde
;   called from: TOC3_scheduler_ISR_8000
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95:
	bset <TASKFLAGS1,$20                ; EC95  14 55 20      TASKFLAGS1 .5 100 ms job in progress = 1
	ldaa >security_lockout_timer        ; EC98  B6 1F 70      A = security_lockout_timer | 1AAE counts 0..9 at 100 ms -> bulb-test timer service every 500 ms
	beq loc_ECA0                        ; EC9B  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_ECA0
	dec >security_lockout_timer         ; EC9D  7A 1F 70      security_lockout_timer--
loc_ECA0:
	inc >sched_100ms_count              ; ECA0  7C 1A AE      sched_100ms_count++
	ldaa >sched_100ms_count             ; ECA3  B6 1A AE      A = sched_100ms_count
	cmpa #$05                           ; ECA6  81 05         compare A with 5
	beq loc_ECB1                        ; ECA8  27 07         if sched_100ms_count == 5 goto loc_ECB1
	cmpa #$0A                           ; ECAA  81 0A         compare A with $0A(10)
	bne loc_ECB4                        ; ECAC  26 06         if sched_100ms_count != $0A(10) goto loc_ECB4
	clr >sched_100ms_count              ; ECAE  7F 1A AE      sched_100ms_count = 0
loc_ECB1:
	jsr >far_calc_sensor_pullup_range_7E03; ECB1  BD 7E 03      call bank 1 via far_calc_sensor_pullup_range_7E03
loc_ECB4:
	brclr <$04,$80,loc_ECBC             ; ECB4  13 04 80 04   if [$04] .7 clear goto loc_ECBC
	brset <$07,$02,loc_ECC4             ; ECB8  12 07 02 08   if [$07] .1 set goto loc_ECC4
loc_ECBC:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; ECBC  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM | engine considered running when RPM > k_2259 (2 = 37.5 rpm)
	cmpa >CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM           ; ECBF  B1 22 59      compare A with CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM
	bhi loc_ED29                        ; ECC2  22 65         if engine_RPM > CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM goto loc_ED29
loc_ECC4:
	bclr <shift_v0069,$40               ; ECC4  15 69 40      shift_v0069 .6 engine running stable (RPM > 475 for kw_ = 0 | engine stopped: clear running flag, disable OC1 interrupt, reset antistall/pump backup/run time
	ldaa >TMSK1                         ; ECC7  B6 10 22      A = TMSK1
	anda #$7F                           ; ECCA  84 7F         A &= $7F(127) (keep bits)
	staa >TMSK1                         ; ECCC  B7 10 22      TMSK1 = A
	bclr <cylbal_diag_flags,$80         ; ECCF  15 4B 80      cylbal_diag_flags .7 pedal tip-out idle dashpot active = 0
	bclr <cylbal_diag_flags,$40         ; ECD2  15 4B 40      cylbal_diag_flags .6 stall saver (anti-stall dashpot) active = 0
	clra                                ; ECD5  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; ECD6  5F            B = 0
	staa >ANTISTALL_DASHPOT_TMR         ; ECD7  B7 1A A7      ANTISTALL_DASHPOT_TMR = A
	staa >ANTISTALL_DASHPOT             ; ECDA  B7 1A A9      ANTISTALL_DASHPOT = A
	std >$1462                          ; ECDD  FD 14 62      [$1462] = D
	std >$1462                          ; ECE0  FD 14 62      [$1462] = D
	std >$158E                          ; ECE3  FD 15 8E      [$158E] = D
	std >$158E                          ; ECE6  FD 15 8E      [$158E] = D
	staa <PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS              ; ECE9  97 46         PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS = A
	staa >missed_I4_ref_count           ; ECEB  B7 1A 35      missed_I4_ref_count = A
	staa >P0251_mismatch_ctr            ; ECEE  B7 1A 41      P0251_mismatch_ctr = A
	std >ENGINE_RUN_TIME                ; ECF1  FD 1A 21      ENGINE_RUN_TIME = D
	std >ram_v18EB                      ; ECF4  FD 18 EB      ram_v18EB = D
	ldaa >P0335_mismatch_ctr            ; ECF7  B6 1A 42      A = P0335_mismatch_ctr
	cmpa >k_36C5                        ; ECFA  B1 36 C5      compare A with k_36C5

	stab >rpm_v1A3C                     ; ECFF  F7 1A 3C      rpm_v1A3C = B
loc_ED02:

	cmpa >rpm_v1A3D                     ; ED05  B1 1A 3D      compare A with rpm_v1A3D

	ldaa >rpm_v1A3E                     ; ED0A  B6 1A 3E      A = rpm_v1A3E
	inca                                ; ED0D  4C            A++
	staa >rpm_v1A3E                     ; ED0E  B7 1A 3E      rpm_v1A3E = A
	cmpa >k_323D                        ; ED11  B1 32 3D      compare A with k_323D
	bcs loc_ED3C                        ; ED14  25 26         if rpm_v1A3E < k_323D goto loc_ED3C
	clr >rpm_v1A3C                      ; ED16  7F 1A 3C      rpm_v1A3C = 0
	clr >rpm_v1A3E                      ; ED19  7F 1A 3E      rpm_v1A3E = 0
	bra loc_ED3C                        ; ED1C  20 1E         goto loc_ED3C
loc_ED1E:
	ldaa >rpm_v1A3C                     ; ED1E  B6 1A 3C      A = rpm_v1A3C
	staa >rpm_v1A3D                     ; ED21  B7 1A 3D      rpm_v1A3D = A
	clr >rpm_v1A3E                      ; ED24  7F 1A 3E      rpm_v1A3E = 0
	bra loc_ED3C                        ; ED27  20 13         goto loc_ED3C
loc_ED29:
	bset <shift_v0069,$40               ; ED29  14 69 40      shift_v0069 .6 engine running stable (RPM > 475 for kw_ = 1 | engine running: count ENGINE_RUN_TIME (0.1 s) unless ENGMODEFLAG.7
	clr >rpm_v1A3E                      ; ED2C  7F 1A 3E      rpm_v1A3E = 0
	brset <ENGMODEFLAG,$80,loc_ED3C     ; ED2F  12 4C 80 09   if ENGMODEFLAG .7 cranking (STARTUP_CTR <= CAL_MIN_CRANK_C set goto loc_ED3C
	ldx >ENGINE_RUN_TIME                ; ED33  FE 1A 21      X = ENGINE_RUN_TIME
	inx                                 ; ED36  08            X++
	beq loc_ED3C                        ; ED37  27 03         if X == 0 goto loc_ED3C
	stx >ENGINE_RUN_TIME                ; ED39  FF 1A 21      ENGINE_RUN_TIME = X
loc_ED3C:
	ldaa >engine_RPM_sample             ; ED3C  B6 1A 32      A = engine_RPM_sample | 1A33/1A32 = previous / current RPM sample for RPM-change checks
	staa >engine_RPM_sample_prev        ; ED3F  B7 1A 33      engine_RPM_sample_prev = A

	staa >engine_RPM_sample             ; ED45  B7 1A 32      engine_RPM_sample = A

loc_ED59:
	jsr >far_diag_P0102_P0103_P0107_etc_7CB9; ED59  BD 7C B9      call bank 1 via far_diag_P0102_P0103_P0107_etc_7CB9

	bita #$08                           ; ED6E  85 08         test SERIAL_TEST_MODE .3

	ldaa >glow_v181F                    ; ED72  B6 18 1F      A = glow_v181F | after k_307F ticks from power-up capture startup ECT once (1A2B, 02E1); FLAGS2.1 = warm start
	cmpa >k_307F                        ; ED75  B1 30 7F      compare A with k_307F
	bcc loc_ED8A                        ; ED78  24 10         if glow_v181F >= k_307F goto loc_ED8A

loc_ED8A:
	brset <FLAGS2,$04,loc_EDAE          ; ED8A  12 4A 04 20   if FLAGS2 .2 startup ECT captured set goto loc_EDAE
	bset <FLAGS2,$04                    ; ED8E  14 4A 04      FLAGS2 .2 startup ECT captured = 1

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; baro_from_MAP
;   analysis [medium]: Baro estimate from MAP (Turbo_ram_address*2). On NA engines (200C.6) or with the engine
;        stopped it uses MAP directly. On a running turbo engine it keeps min(baro, MAP) and fully re-learns from
;        MAP only after $5D.6 (low load) has held for k_baro_learn_loops (60) passes.
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
baro_from_MAP:
	ldaa >NA_ram_address                ; EE7D  B6 19 2F      A = NA_ram_address
	ldab >engine_RPM                    ; EE80  F6 19 86      B = engine_RPM
	beq loc_EEAF                        ; EE83  27 2A         if B == 0 goto loc_EEAF
	ldx #Configuration_set_2_200C       ; EE85  CE 20 0C      X = &Configuration_set_2_200C
	brset $00,x,$40,loc_EEAF            ; EE88  1E 00 40 23   if Configuration_set_2_200C .6 NA: baro = MAP set goto loc_EEAF | 200C.6 or engine stopped: baro = MAP*2, else min(baro,MAP) after 5D.6 held 31F5 loops
	ldab >Turbo_ram_address             ; EE8C  F6 19 23      B = Turbo_ram_address
	aslb                                ; EE8F  58            B <<= 1
	bcs loc_EEB7                        ; EE90  25 25         if B < 0 goto loc_EEB7
	cba                                 ; EE92  11            compare A with B
	blt loc_EE96                        ; EE93  2D 01         if A < (signed) B goto loc_EE96
	tba                                 ; EE95  17            A = B
loc_EE96:
	ldab <idle_v005D                    ; EE96  D6 5D         B = idle_v005D
	bitb #$40                           ; EE98  C5 40         test idle_v005D .6 idle governor fuel floor in control
	beq loc_EEAA                        ; EE9A  27 0E         if idle_v005D .6 idle governor fuel floor in control all clear goto loc_EEAA
	ldab >baro_learn_counter            ; EE9C  F6 1C 61      B = baro_learn_counter
	incb                                ; EE9F  5C            B++
	stab >baro_learn_counter            ; EEA0  F7 1C 61      baro_learn_counter = B
	cmpb >k_baro_learn_loops            ; EEA3  F1 31 F5      compare B with k_baro_learn_loops
	bcs loc_EEB7                        ; EEA6  25 0F         if baro_learn_counter < k_baro_learn_loops goto loc_EEB7
	bra loc_EEAF                        ; EEA8  20 05         goto loc_EEAF
loc_EEAA:
	clr >baro_learn_counter             ; EEAA  7F 1C 61      baro_learn_counter = 0
	bra loc_EEB7                        ; EEAD  20 08         goto loc_EEB7
loc_EEAF:
	ldaa >Turbo_ram_address             ; EEAF  B6 19 23      A = Turbo_ram_address
	asla                                ; EEB2  48            A <<= 1
	bcc loc_EEB7                        ; EEB3  24 02         if A >= 0 goto loc_EEB7
	ldaa #$FF                           ; EEB5  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_EEB7:
	rts                                 ; EEB7  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; scale_baro_sensor_EEB8
;   analysis [medium]: Baro sensor voltage (192E) to NA_ram_address units: ((A*94 + $0A95)*2)>>8, clamped 30..210
;        (0.5 kPa per count, i.e. 15..105 kPa).
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scale_baro_sensor_EEB8:
	ldab #$5E                           ; EEB8  C6 5E         B = $5E(94)
	mul                                 ; EEBA  3D            D = A * B
	addd #$0A95                         ; EEBB  C3 0A 95      D += $0A95(2709)
	asld                                ; EEBE  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_EEC5                        ; EEBF  25 04         if D overflowed goto loc_EEC5
	cmpa #$D2                           ; EEC1  81 D2         compare A with $D2(210)
	bls loc_EEC9                        ; EEC3  23 04         if A <= $D2(210) goto loc_EEC9
loc_EEC5:
	ldaa #$D2                           ; EEC5  86 D2         A = $D2(210)
	bra loc_EECF                        ; EEC7  20 06         goto loc_EECF
loc_EEC9:
	cmpa #$1E                           ; EEC9  81 1E         compare A with $1E(30)
	bcc loc_EECF                        ; EECB  24 02         if A >= $1E(30) goto loc_EECF
	ldaa #$1E                           ; EECD  86 1E         A = $1E(30)
loc_EECF:
	rts                                 ; EECF  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; scale_MAP_2bar_EED0
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 SCALE_2BAR_MAP: kPa = (A*200 + $0878)>>8, clamped to 210 kPa.
;   called from: read_sensors_linearize_EEDD
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scale_MAP_2bar_EED0:
	ldab #$C8                           ; EED0  C6 C8         B = $C8(200)
	mul                                 ; EED2  3D            D = A * B
	addd #$0878                         ; EED3  C3 08 78      D += $0878(2168)

	bls loc_EEDC                        ; EED8  23 02         if A <= $D2(210) goto loc_EEDC
	ldaa #$D2                           ; EEDA  86 D2         A = $D2(210)
loc_EEDC:
	rts                                 ; EEDC  39            return

	brset <$07,$04,loc_EFC8             ; EFBE  12 07 04 06   if [$07] .2 set goto loc_EFC8
	brset <$09,$08,loc_EFC8             ; EFC2  12 09 08 02   if [$09] .3 set goto loc_EFC8
	bra loc_EFDA                        ; EFC6  20 12         goto loc_EFDA
loc_EFC8:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; EFC8  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	cmpa >CAL_SOL_RSP_RPM_SPLIT         ; EFCB  B1 22 8A      compare A with CAL_SOL_RSP_RPM_SPLIT
	bcs loc_EFD5                        ; EFCE  25 05         if engine_RPM < CAL_SOL_RSP_RPM_SPLIT goto loc_EFD5
	ldd >CAL_SOL_RSP_DFLT_RUN           ; EFD0  FC 22 90      D = CAL_SOL_RSP_DFLT_RUN
	bra loc_EFE4                        ; EFD3  20 0F         goto loc_EFE4
loc_EFD5:
	ldd >CAL_SOL_RSP_DFLT_CRANK         ; EFD5  FC 22 92      D = CAL_SOL_RSP_DFLT_CRANK
	bra loc_EFE4                        ; EFD8  20 0A         goto loc_EFE4
loc_EFDA:
	ldd >kw_3733                        ; EFDA  FC 37 33      D = kw_3733
	brset <FLAGS2,$10,loc_EFE4          ; EFDD  12 4A 10 03   if FLAGS2 .4 measured injector response too high set goto loc_EFE4
	ldd >rpm_v011E                      ; EFE1  FC 01 1E      D = rpm_v011E
loc_EFE4:
	std >INJ_RESPONSE_230556            ; EFE4  FD 01 1C      INJ_RESPONSE_230556 = D
	rts                                 ; EFE7  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; convert_trans_temp_EFE8
;   analysis [high]: Converts trans_temp_raw to trans_temp with one of two tables (38AF / 38C1) picked by the
;        trans-temp pull-up range flag $50.1, with hysteresis k_38D3/k_38D4. Also latches BARO_VOLTAGE into 02E6.
;   called from: calc_SHIFTPAT_SELECT_90AC
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
convert_trans_temp_EFE8:
	ldab >BARO_VOLTAGE                  ; EFE8  F6 19 2D      B = BARO_VOLTAGE
	stab >trans_v02E6                   ; EFEB  F7 02 E6      trans_v02E6 = B
	ldx #tbl_38AF                       ; EFEE  CE 38 AF      X = &tbl_38AF
	brclr <sensor_pullup_range,$02,loc_EFF8; EFF1  13 50 02 03   if sensor_pullup_range .1 clear goto loc_EFF8
	ldx #tbl2D_trans_temp_conv_38C1     ; EFF5  CE 38 C1      X = &tbl2D_trans_temp_conv_38C1
loc_EFF8:
	ldaa >trans_temp_raw                ; EFF8  B6 19 2B      A = trans_temp_raw
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; EFFB  BD 6D 06      call lookup_2D_table
	staa >trans_temp                    ; EFFE  B7 18 E6      trans_temp = A
	cmpa >k_38D4                        ; F001  B1 38 D4      compare A with k_38D4
	bhi loc_F010                        ; F004  22 0A         if trans_temp_raw > k_38D4 goto loc_F010
	cmpa >k_38D3                        ; F006  B1 38 D3      compare A with k_38D3
	bhi loc_F013                        ; F009  22 08         if trans_temp_raw > k_38D3 goto loc_F013
	bset <sensor_pullup_range,$02       ; F00B  14 50 02      sensor_pullup_range .1 = 1
	bra loc_F013                        ; F00E  20 03         goto loc_F013
loc_F010:
	bclr <sensor_pullup_range,$02       ; F010  15 50 02      sensor_pullup_range .1 = 0
loc_F013:
	rts                                 ; F013  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; filter_ADC_inputs_F014
;   analysis [medium]: Averages (new+old)/2 several ADC/AMUX raw values into their filtered copies relative to
;        ADC_AN0_APP1 (1903). Some channels are updated only when battery voltage > k_36AB. Then filters
;        MEAS_INJ_RSP raw into 193F with FILT_16A (coefficient k_3231). Contains an inner entry label sub_F019.
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
filter_ADC_inputs_F014:
	ldx #ADC_AN0_APP1                   ; F014  CE 19 03      X = &ADC_AN0_APP1
	ldaa $04,x                          ; F017  A6 04         A = ADC_AN4_battery_volts
	; ---- calc_inj_response_filtered_F019: continues the routine above (nothing calls this point)
	;      inferred [B, pass A]: writes inj_response_filtered
calc_inj_response_filtered_F019:
	cmpa >k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB      ; F019  B1 36 AB      compare A with k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB | only update these channels when battery voltage > k_36AB
	bls loc_F047                        ; F01C  23 29         if A <= k_ODM_diag_min_batt_36AB goto loc_F047
	ldaa $05,x                          ; F01E  A6 05         A = ADC_AN5_boost_pressure
	adda $1F,x                          ; F020  AB 1F         A += MAP_raw_AN5_copy
	rora                                ; F022  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F023  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $1F,x                          ; F025  A7 1F         MAP_raw_AN5_copy = A
	ldaa $41,x                          ; F027  A6 41         A = MUX3_ECT_voltage
	ldab $24,x                          ; F029  E6 24         B = ram_v1927
	std $24,x                           ; F02B  ED 24         ram_v1927 = D
	ldaa $40,x                          ; F02D  A6 40         A = MUX2_diag_switch
	adda $2D,x                          ; F02F  AB 2D         A += ram_v1930
	rora                                ; F031  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F032  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $2D,x                          ; F034  A7 2D         ram_v1930 = A
	ldaa $3F,x                          ; F036  A6 3F         A = MUX1_fuel_temp
	adda $2F,x                          ; F038  AB 2F         A += fuel_temp_raw
	rora                                ; F03A  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F03B  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $2F,x                          ; F03D  A7 2F         fuel_temp_raw = A
	ldaa $4B,x                          ; F03F  A6 4B         A = MUX13_trans_temp
	staa $28,x                          ; F041  A7 28         trans_temp_raw = A
	ldaa $48,x                          ; F043  A6 48         A = MUX10_IAT
	staa $35,x                          ; F045  A7 35         IAT_raw = A
loc_F047:
	ldaa $04,x                          ; F047  A6 04         A = [X+4]
	adda $1E,x                          ; F049  AB 1E         A += [X+30]
	rora                                ; F04B  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F04C  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $1E,x                          ; F04E  A7 1E         [X+30] = A
	ldaa $3E,x                          ; F050  A6 3E         A = [X+62]
	adda $33,x                          ; F052  AB 33         A += [X+51]
	rora                                ; F054  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F055  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $33,x                          ; F057  A7 33         [X+51] = A
	ldaa $43,x                          ; F059  A6 43         A = [X+67]
	adda $32,x                          ; F05B  AB 32         A += [X+50]
	rora                                ; F05D  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F05E  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $32,x                          ; F060  A7 32         [X+50] = A
	ldaa $45,x                          ; F062  A6 45         A = [X+69]
	adda $34,x                          ; F064  AB 34         A += [X+52]
	rora                                ; F066  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F067  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $34,x                          ; F069  A7 34         [X+52] = A
	ldaa $2A,x                          ; F06B  A6 2A         A = [X+42]
	adda $2B,x                          ; F06D  AB 2B         A += [X+43]
	rora                                ; F06F  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F070  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $2B,x                          ; F072  A7 2B         [X+43] = A
	ldaa $49,x                          ; F074  A6 49         A = [X+73]
	adda $38,x                          ; F076  AB 38         A += [X+56]
	rora                                ; F078  46            A rotate right thru C
	adca #$00                           ; F079  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa $38,x                          ; F07B  A7 38         [X+56] = A
	ldx <MEAS_INJ_RSP_196740_RAW        ; F07D  DE 3A         X = MEAS_INJ_RSP_196740_RAW | 16-bit filter of measured injector response into 193F, coefficient k_3231
	ldaa >k_3231                        ; F07F  B6 32 31      A = k_3231
	psha                                ; F082  36            push A
	ldd >inj_response_filtered          ; F083  FC 19 3F      D = inj_response_filtered
	pshx                                ; F086  3C            push X
	jsr >FILT_16A                       ; F087  BD 69 70      call FILT_16A
	std >inj_response_filtered          ; F08A  FD 19 3F      inj_response_filtered = D
	ins                                 ; F08D  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; F08E  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; F08F  31            SP++
	rts                                 ; F090  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_MANUAL_GLOWPLUG_CTL
;   analysis [high]: Tester-commanded glow-plug override (OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG+1 flags) at 100 ms. Turns the glow
;        relay on for CAL_MIN_GLO_OVERRIDE ticks, then off until CAL_MAX_GLO_OVERRIDE, then ends the override;
;        SERIAL_TEST_MODE.3 marks it active.
;   OBD1 DO_MANUAL_GLOWPLUG_CTL (match 0.85 p1-global): 100ms - 10hz
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO_MANUAL_GLOWPLUG_CTL:
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F091  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	bita #$02                           ; F094  85 02         test glow_v1CD1 .1
	bne loc_F0A9                        ; F096  26 11         if any of glow_v1CD1 .1 set goto loc_F0A9 | OBD1: BR IF L14CE.b1 SET
	bita #$01                           ; F098  85 01         test glow_v1CD1 .0
	bne loc_F0FA                        ; F09A  26 5E         if any of glow_v1CD1 .0 set goto loc_F0FA | OBD1: BR IF L14CE.b0 SET
	sei                                 ; F09C  0F            disable interrupts
	ldaa >SERIAL_TEST_MODE              ; F09D  B6 1C C0      A = SERIAL_TEST_MODE
	anda #$F7                           ; F0A0  84 F7         A &= $F7(247) (keep bits) | OBD1: CLR SERIAL_TEST_MODE.b3
	staa >SERIAL_TEST_MODE              ; F0A2  B7 1C C0      SERIAL_TEST_MODE = A
	cli                                 ; F0A5  0E            enable interrupts
	jmp >loc_F137                       ; F0A6  7E F1 37      goto loc_F137
loc_F0A9:
	bita #$04                           ; F0A9  85 04         test A mask 4
	bne loc_F0B6                        ; F0AB  26 09         if any of mask 4 set goto loc_F0B6
	ldaa >glow_v1CC6                    ; F0AD  B6 1C C6      A = glow_v1CC6
	bita #$01                           ; F0B0  85 01         test glow_v1CC6 .0
	beq loc_F0FA                        ; F0B2  27 46         if glow_v1CC6 .0 all clear goto loc_F0FA
	bra loc_F0D9                        ; F0B4  20 23         goto loc_F0D9
loc_F0B6:
	bita #$01                           ; F0B6  85 01         test A mask 1
	beq loc_F0C2                        ; F0B8  27 08         if mask 1 all clear goto loc_F0C2
	ldd #$3C01                          ; F0BA  CC 3C 01      D = $3C01(15361)
	std >TDC_learn_test_result          ; F0BD  FD 1F 7E      TDC_learn_test_result = D
	bra loc_F0D1                        ; F0C0  20 0F         goto loc_F0D1
loc_F0C2:
	oraa #$01                           ; F0C2  8A 01         A |= 1 | OBD1: SET 14CE.b0
	staa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F0C4  B7 1C D1      glow_v1CD1 = A
	sei                                 ; F0C7  0F            disable interrupts
	ldaa >SERIAL_TEST_MODE              ; F0C8  B6 1C C0      A = SERIAL_TEST_MODE
	oraa #$08                           ; F0CB  8A 08         A |= 8 | OBD1: SET SERIAL_TEST_MODE.b3
	staa >SERIAL_TEST_MODE              ; F0CD  B7 1C C0      SERIAL_TEST_MODE = A
	cli                                 ; F0D0  0E            enable interrupts
loc_F0D1:
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F0D1  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	anda #$FB                           ; F0D4  84 FB         A &= $FB(251) (keep bits)
	staa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F0D6  B7 1C D1      glow_v1CD1 = A
loc_F0D9:
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F0D9  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	bita #$08                           ; F0DC  85 08         test glow_v1CD1 .3
	bne loc_F110                        ; F0DE  26 30         if any of glow_v1CD1 .3 set goto loc_F110 | OBD1: BR IF NOT 14CE.b3
	ldab >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG             ; F0E0  F6 1C D0      B = OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG
	cmpb >CAL_MIN_GLO_OVERRIDE          ; F0E3  F1 20 21      compare B with CAL_MIN_GLO_OVERRIDE
	bcc loc_F101                        ; F0E6  24 19         if OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG >= CAL_MIN_GLO_OVERRIDE goto loc_F101 | OBD1: BR IF OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG >= CAL_MIN_GLO_OVERRIDE
	incb                                ; F0E8  5C            B++
	stab >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG             ; F0E9  F7 1C D0      OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG = B
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; F0EC  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800 | override ON phase also drives IOR_1800.6 together with the glow relay
	bset $00,x,$01                      ; F0EF  1C 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 1
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; F0F2  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bset $00,x,$40                      ; F0F5  1C 00 40      IOR_1800 .6 glow wait-lamp (4L60E TCC on/off on OBD1) = 1 | 1800.6 switches with the glow relay: on this OS it is the glow wait-lamp output, not a TCC solenoid | OBD1: turn on glow plug
	bra loc_F137                        ; F0F8  20 3D         goto loc_F137
loc_F0FA:
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F0FA  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	bita #$08                           ; F0FD  85 08         test glow_v1CD1 .3
	bne loc_F110                        ; F0FF  26 0F         if any of glow_v1CD1 .3 set goto loc_F110
loc_F101:
	sei                                 ; F101  0F            disable interrupts
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F102  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	oraa #$08                           ; F105  8A 08         A |= 8 | OBD1: SET 14CE.b3
	staa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F107  B7 1C D1      glow_v1CD1 = A
	cli                                 ; F10A  0E            enable interrupts
	clr >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG              ; F10B  7F 1C D0      OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG = 0
	bra loc_F11C                        ; F10E  20 0C         goto loc_F11C
loc_F110:
	ldab >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG             ; F110  F6 1C D0      B = OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG
	cmpb >CAL_MAX_GLO_OVERRIDE          ; F113  F1 20 22      compare B with CAL_MAX_GLO_OVERRIDE
	bcc loc_F12A                        ; F116  24 12         if OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG >= CAL_MAX_GLO_OVERRIDE goto loc_F12A | OBD1: BR IF OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG >= CAL_MAX_GLO_OVERRIDE
	incb                                ; F118  5C            B++
	stab >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG             ; F119  F7 1C D0      OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG = B
loc_F11C:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; F11C  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; F11F  1D 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 0 | OBD1: turn off glow plugs
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; F122  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bclr $00,x,$40                      ; F125  1D 00 40      IOR_1800 .6 glow wait-lamp (4L60E TCC on/off on OBD1) = 0
	bra loc_F137                        ; F128  20 0D         goto loc_F137
loc_F12A:
	sei                                 ; F12A  0F            disable interrupts
	ldaa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F12B  B6 1C D1      A = glow_v1CD1
	anda #$F4                           ; F12E  84 F4         A &= $F4(244) (keep bits) | OBD1: CLR 14CE.b3, 14CE.b1, 14CE.b0
	staa >glow_v1CD1                    ; F130  B7 1C D1      glow_v1CD1 = A
	cli                                 ; F133  0E            enable interrupts
	clr >OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG              ; F134  7F 1C D0      OVERRIDE_GLOWPLUG = 0
loc_F137:
	rts                                 ; F137  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_fuel_timing_modifiers
;   analysis [high]: 100 ms. Computes the fuel-temp fuel adjust, fuel-temp timing (Table_all_0 -> 19D0), hot-ECT
;        fuel reduction, boost/baro fuel reduction (with a neutral/stationary limit k_22DC), ECT and IAT timing
;        adders, the baro axis and min timing (2899). Runs the warm-idle timing adder ramp 19D3 and selects
;        governor_RPM_start/cutoff (cold, warm, or VSS/ECT interpolated).
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_fuel_timing_modifiers:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; F138  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	ldab >fuel_temp                     ; F13B  F6 19 33      B = fuel_temp
	ldx #tbl3D_fuel_temp_comp_RPM_x_FuelTemp_9x17_2DA1; F13E  CE 2D A1      X = &tbl3D_fuel_temp_comp_RPM_x_FuelTemp_9x17_2DA1
	jsr >lookup_3D_table                ; F141  BD 6D 20      A = 3D lookup tbl3D_fuel_temp_comp_RPM_x_FuelTemp_9x17_2DA1[col A, row B]
	staa >FTS_FUEL_PW_ADJ               ; F144  B7 19 A8      FTS_FUEL_PW_ADJ = A
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; F147  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	ldab >fuel_temp                     ; F14A  F6 19 33      B = fuel_temp
	ldx #Table_all_0                    ; F14D  CE 29 6B      X = &Table_all_0
	jsr >lookup_3D_table                ; F150  BD 6D 20      A = 3D lookup Table_all_0[col A, row B]
	staa >fuel_temp_timing_adder        ; F153  B7 19 D0      fuel_temp_timing_adder = A
	ldaa >coolant_temp                  ; F156  B6 19 29      A = coolant_temp | hot-ECT axis: (ECT-198) scaled ~x9.8, clamp at ECT 224
	cmpa #$E0                           ; F159  81 E0         compare A with $E0(224)
	bls loc_F15F                        ; F15B  23 02         if coolant_temp <= $E0(224) goto loc_F15F
	ldaa #$E0                           ; F15D  86 E0         A = $E0(224)
loc_F15F:
	suba #$C6                           ; F15F  80 C6         A -= $C6(198)
	bcc loc_F166                        ; F161  24 03         if A >= 0 goto loc_F166
	clra                                ; F163  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_F19A                        ; F164  20 34         goto loc_F19A
loc_F166:
	psha                                ; F166  36            push A
	ldab #$CF                           ; F167  C6 CF         B = $CF(207)
	mul                                 ; F169  3D            D = A * B
	adca #$00                           ; F16A  89 00         A += C + 0
	pulb                                ; F16C  33            pop B
	aba                                 ; F16D  1B            A += B
	aslb                                ; F16E  58            B <<= 1
	aslb                                ; F16F  58            B <<= 1
	aslb                                ; F170  58            B <<= 1
	aba                                 ; F171  1B            A += B
	cmpa #$80                           ; F172  81 80         compare A with $80(128)
	bls loc_F17E                        ; F174  23 08         if A <= $80(128) goto loc_F17E
	ldab >vehicle_speed                 ; F176  F6 19 F1      B = vehicle_speed | $4B.3: low-speed light-load latch halves (via ~(~A<<1)) the hot-ECT axis
	cmpb >k_277A                        ; F179  F1 27 7A      compare B with k_277A
	bcs loc_F183                        ; F17C  25 05         if vehicle_speed < k_277A goto loc_F183
loc_F17E:
	bclr <cylbal_diag_flags,$08         ; F17E  15 4B 08      cylbal_diag_flags .3 = 0
	bra loc_F19A                        ; F181  20 17         goto loc_F19A
loc_F183:
	brset <cylbal_diag_flags,$08,loc_F197; F183  12 4B 08 10   if cylbal_diag_flags .3 set goto loc_F197
	cmpb >k_277B                        ; F187  F1 27 7B      compare B with k_277B
	bcc loc_F19A                        ; F18A  24 0E         if B >= k_277B goto loc_F19A
	ldab >pedal_position_filtered       ; F18C  F6 19 16      B = pedal_position_filtered
	cmpb >k_277C                        ; F18F  F1 27 7C      compare B with k_277C
	bls loc_F19A                        ; F192  23 06         if pedal_position_filtered <= k_277C goto loc_F19A
	bset <cylbal_diag_flags,$08         ; F194  14 4B 08      cylbal_diag_flags .3 = 1
loc_F197:
	coma                                ; F197  43            A = ~A
	asla                                ; F198  48            A <<= 1
	coma                                ; F199  43            A = ~A
loc_F19A:
	ldab >engine_RPM                    ; F19A  F6 19 86      B = engine_RPM
	ldx #tbl3D_fuel_limit_hotECT_x_RPM_9x9_2789; F19D  CE 27 89      X = &tbl3D_fuel_limit_hotECT_x_RPM_9x9_2789
	jsr >lookup_3D_table                ; F1A0  BD 6D 20      A = 3D lookup tbl3D_fuel_limit_hotECT_x_RPM_9x9_2789[col A, row B]
	staa >fuel_reduction_hotECT         ; F1A3  B7 19 A9      fuel_reduction_hotECT = A
	ldx #Configuration_set              ; F1A6  CE 20 0B      X = &Configuration_set
	brset $00,x,$02,loc_F1C5            ; F1A9  1E 00 02 18   if Configuration_set .1 turbo enable set goto loc_F1C5 | Configuration_set.1 (0x02) turbo: 19AA pressure input set=MAP 1923, clr=BARO 192F
	ldab >NA_ram_address                ; F1AD  F6 19 2F      B = NA_ram_address | NA: boost axis from baro (124..220) scaled; turbo: from MAP (60..180)
	cmpb #$DC                           ; F1B0  C1 DC         compare B with $DC(220)
	bls loc_F1B6                        ; F1B2  23 02         if NA_ram_address <= $DC(220) goto loc_F1B6
	ldab #$DC                           ; F1B4  C6 DC         B = $DC(220)
loc_F1B6:
	subb #$7C                           ; F1B6  C0 7C         B -= $7C(124)
	bcc loc_F1BD                        ; F1B8  24 03         if B >= 0 goto loc_F1BD
	clrb                                ; F1BA  5F            B = 0
	bra loc_F1DB                        ; F1BB  20 1E         goto loc_F1DB
loc_F1BD:
	ldaa #$AA                           ; F1BD  86 AA         A = $AA(170)
	mul                                 ; F1BF  3D            D = A * B
	asld                                ; F1C0  05            D <<= 1
	asld                                ; F1C1  05            D <<= 1
	tab                                 ; F1C2  16            B = A
	bra loc_F1DB                        ; F1C3  20 16         goto loc_F1DB
loc_F1C5:
