; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ignition_off_powerdown_F615
;   analysis [medium]: Handles ignition off. With battery/IGN >= 4.9 V it just clears 0091.3 and the 1DA9 counter
;        (if non-zero). With IGN < 4.9 V it sets FLAGS0.2, resets backup-fuel and timer state, sets limp flags and
;        clears DTCs P0251/P0335/P0370 unless they failed this trip. It also clears the missed-reference counters
;        and counts 1DA9 up to k_329E (100). When the glow state is 7 (or 0009.0 is set, and the anti-theft
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_GLOWPLUG_CTL
;   analysis [medium]: 10 Hz glow-plug state machine. GLOW_PLUG_STATE low nibble is the state, dispatched through
;        d_FD0C. States: 0 = compute preglow (inline at F9B3), 1 = preglow (relay on), 2 = afterglow off-phase, 3
;        = afterglow on-phase, 4 = done, 5 = stalled/waiting for crank, 6 = low battery, 7 = battery
;        dead/powerdown. Battery >= k_307A (16 V) forces state 4. States > 7 turn the relay off. The state-0 code
;        (F9B3-F
;   OBD1 DO_GLOWPLUG_CTL (match 1.00 p1-exact): Crazy complicated glow plug logic (with tons of code duplication)
;   100ms - 10hz
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO_GLOWPLUG_CTL:
	ldaa >GLOW_TIMER_2                  ; F974  B6 18 1E      A = GLOW_TIMER_2
	beq loc_F97D                        ; F977  27 04         if A == 0 goto loc_F97D | OBD1: BR IF GLOW_TIMER_2 == 0
	deca                                ; F979  4A            A-- | OBD1: Else dec and Save
	staa >GLOW_TIMER_2                  ; F97A  B7 18 1E      GLOW_TIMER_2 = A
loc_F97D:
	ldaa >battery_voltage               ; F97D  B6 19 21      A = battery_voltage
	cmpa >k_glow_overvolt_cutoff_307A   ; F980  B1 30 7A      compare A with k_glow_overvolt_cutoff_307A | OBD1: 16 volts
	bcs loc_F998                        ; F983  25 13         if battery_voltage < k_glow_overvolt_cutoff_307A goto loc_F998 | OBD1: BR IF BAT_VOLTS <= 16
	ldaa >GLOW_PLUG_STATE               ; F985  B6 18 12      A = GLOW_PLUG_STATE
	tab                                 ; F988  16            B = A
	anda #$0F                           ; F989  84 0F         A &= $0F(15) (keep bits)
	cmpa #$07                           ; F98B  81 07         compare A with 7
	beq loc_F998                        ; F98D  27 09         if A == 7 goto loc_F998 | OBD1: BR IF state == 7
	tba                                 ; F98F  17            A = B
	ldab #$04                           ; F990  C6 04         B = 4
	anda #$F0                           ; F992  84 F0         A &= $F0(240) (keep bits)
	aba                                 ; F994  1B            A += B | OBD1: Set State == 4
	staa >GLOW_PLUG_STATE               ; F995  B7 18 12      GLOW_PLUG_STATE = A
loc_F998:
	ldab >GLOW_PLUG_STATE               ; F998  F6 18 12      B = GLOW_PLUG_STATE
	andb #$0F                           ; F99B  C4 0F         B &= $0F(15) (keep bits)
	cmpb #$07                           ; F99D  C1 07         compare B with 7
	bls loc_F9AA                        ; F99F  23 09         if B <= 7 goto loc_F9AA
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; F9A1  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800 | state > 7 is invalid: relay off
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; F9A4  1D 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 0 | OBD1: turn off plugs
	jmp >loc_FD0B                       ; F9A7  7E FD 0B      goto loc_FD0B | OBD1: and out of here
loc_F9AA:
	aslb                                ; F9AA  58            B <<= 1 | dispatch on glow state via d_FD0C (0:F9B3 1:FA6F 2:FBC7 3:FC19 4:FC8A 5:FCA6 6:FCCE 7:FCF5)
	ldx #glow_state_handlers_FD0C       ; F9AB  CE FD 0C      X = &glow_state_handlers_FD0C
	abx                                 ; F9AE  3A            X += B
	ldx $00,x                           ; F9AF  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	jmp $00,x                           ; F9B1  6E 00         goto [X]

	suba >afterglow_on_time             ; FC71  B0 18 1B      A -= afterglow_on_time
	bcc loc_FC77                        ; FC74  24 01         if A >= 0 goto loc_FC77

	bra loc_FC84                        ; FC80  20 02         goto loc_FC84
loc_FC82:

loc_FC84:
	jmp >loc_FD02                       ; FC84  7E FD 02      goto loc_FD02
loc_FC87:
	jmp >loc_FD0B                       ; FC87  7E FD 0B      goto loc_FD0B

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; glow_state4_done_FC8A
;   analysis [medium]: Glow state 4 (finished). Relay off. GLOW_TIMER_1 (time since glow ended, saturates at 255)
;        counts up; it is used at the next state 0 to subtract residual plug heat. Battery <= 4.9 V -> state 6.
;   OBD1 LBCE2 (match 0.83 p1-global)
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
glow_state4_done_FC8A:
	ldaa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FC8A  B6 01 34      A = GLOW_TIMER_1
	inca                                ; FC8D  4C            A++
	beq loc_FC93                        ; FC8E  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_FC93
	staa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FC90  B7 01 34      GLOW_TIMER_1 = A
loc_FC93:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; FC93  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800 | OBD1: turn off plugs ??
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; FC96  1D 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 0 | OBD1: CLR 1400.b0
	ldaa >battery_voltage               ; FC99  B6 19 21      A = battery_voltage
	cmpa #$31                           ; FC9C  81 31         compare A with $31(49)
	bhi loc_FCA4                        ; FC9E  22 04         if battery_voltage > $31(49) goto loc_FCA4 | OBD1: BR IF Bat Volts > 4.9
	ldab #$06                           ; FCA0  C6 06         B = 6 | OBD1: if battery is low then go to state 6
	bra loc_FD02                        ; FCA2  20 5E         goto loc_FD02
loc_FCA4:
	bra loc_FD0B                        ; FCA4  20 65         goto loc_FD0B | OBD1: Set GLOW_PLUG_STATE low nibble & rts

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; glow_state5_wait_crank_FCA6
;   analysis [medium]: Glow state 5 (engine stopped during afterglow). Relay off, GLOW_TIMER_1++. Low battery ->
;        state 6. RPM >= k_3079 -> state 0 (recompute the glow cycle).
;   OBD1 LBCC6 (match 0.57 p2-dataref)
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
glow_state5_wait_crank_FCA6:
	ldaa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FCA6  B6 01 34      A = GLOW_TIMER_1
	inca                                ; FCA9  4C            A++
	beq loc_FCAF                        ; FCAA  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_FCAF
	staa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FCAC  B7 01 34      GLOW_TIMER_1 = A
loc_FCAF:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; FCAF  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; FCB2  1D 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 0
	ldaa >battery_voltage               ; FCB5  B6 19 21      A = battery_voltage
	cmpa #$31                           ; FCB8  81 31         compare A with $31(49)

	bra loc_FD02                        ; FCCA  20 36         goto loc_FD02
loc_FCCC:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; glow_state6_low_batt_FCCE
;   analysis [medium]: Glow state 6 (low battery). Relay off, GLOW_TIMER_1++. Battery back above 4.9 V -> state 0.
;        After GLOW_TIMER_1 reaches 255 while low -> state 7.
;   OBD1 LBD0A (match 0.81 p1-global): 6 - gets here at least on low battery
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
glow_state6_low_batt_FCCE:
	ldaa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FCCE  B6 01 34      A = GLOW_TIMER_1
	inca                                ; FCD1  4C            A++
	beq loc_FCD7                        ; FCD2  27 03         if A == 0 goto loc_FCD7
	staa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FCD4  B7 01 34      GLOW_TIMER_1 = A
loc_FCD7:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; FCD7  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bclr $00,x,$01                      ; FCDA  1D 00 01      IOR_1800 .0 glow plug relay = 0 | OBD1: turn off plugs
	ldaa >battery_voltage               ; FCDD  B6 19 21      A = battery_voltage
	cmpa #$31                           ; FCE0  81 31         compare A with $31(49) | OBD1: 4.9 volts
	bhi loc_FCEF                        ; FCE2  22 0B         if battery_voltage > $31(49) goto loc_FCEF | OBD1: BR IF Bat Volts > 4.9
	ldaa >GLOW_TIMER_1                  ; FCE4  B6 01 34      A = GLOW_TIMER_1
	cmpa #$FF                           ; FCE7  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)
	bcs loc_FCF3                        ; FCE9  25 08         if GLOW_TIMER_1 < $FF(255) goto loc_FCF3 | OBD1: BR IF GLOW_TIMER_1 < 0xFF
	ldab #$07                           ; FCEB  C6 07         B = 7 | OBD1: New Low Byte of GLOW_PLUG_STATE
	bra loc_FCF1                        ; FCED  20 02         goto loc_FCF1
loc_FCEF:
	ldab #$00                           ; FCEF  C6 00         B = 0
loc_FCF1:
	bra loc_FD02                        ; FCF1  20 0F         goto loc_FD02
loc_FCF3:
	bra loc_FD0B                        ; FCF3  20 16         goto loc_FD0B

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; glow_state7_dead_batt_FCF5
;   analysis [medium]: Glow state 7 (battery off/powerdown, used by ignition_off_powerdown). Battery >= 4.9 V ->
;        state 0. Contains the common exit FD02 (write new state into the low nibble) and FD0B (rts).
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
glow_state7_dead_batt_FCF5:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; lookup_GLOW_temp_FD24
;   analysis [low]: Below RPM byte $7B, drives IOR_1800 bit6 as a glow/wait-to-start lamp (also switched together
;        with the relay in glow device control at F0F5). States 0/1: lamp on while elapsed preglow +
;        tbl2D_GLOW_temp_4E75(temp) < target. Also on in state 3; off in other states.
;   inferred [B, pass A]: tables GLOW_temp
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
lookup_GLOW_temp_FD24:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; FD24  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM | only below RPM $7B: IOR_1800.6 used here as glow / wait-to-start lamp, not TCC
	cmpa #$7B                           ; FD27  81 7B         compare A with $7B(123)
	bhi loc_FD5B                        ; FD29  22 30         if engine_RPM > $7B(123) goto loc_FD5B
	ldaa >GLOW_PLUG_STATE               ; FD2B  B6 18 12      A = GLOW_PLUG_STATE
	anda #$0F                           ; FD2E  84 0F         A &= $0F(15) (keep bits)
	cmpa #$03                           ; FD30  81 03         compare A with 3
	beq loc_FD4D                        ; FD32  27 19         if A == 3 goto loc_FD4D
	cmpa #$01                           ; FD34  81 01         compare A with 1
	bhi loc_FD55                        ; FD36  22 1D         if A > 1 goto loc_FD55
	ldaa >glow_ctrl_temp                ; FD38  B6 18 13      A = glow_ctrl_temp
	ldx #tbl2D_GLOW_temp_4E75           ; FD3B  CE 4E 75      X = &tbl2D_GLOW_temp_4E75
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; FD3E  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_GLOW_temp_4E75[A]
	adda >GLOW_TIMER_3                  ; FD41  BB 18 17      A += GLOW_TIMER_3
	bcc loc_FD48                        ; FD44  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_FD48
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FD46  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FD48:
	cmpa >GLOW_TIMER_3_LIM              ; FD48  B1 18 16      compare A with GLOW_TIMER_3_LIM
	bcc loc_FD55                        ; FD4B  24 08         if A >= GLOW_TIMER_3_LIM goto loc_FD55
loc_FD4D:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; FD4D  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bset $00,x,$40                      ; FD50  1C 00 40      IOR_1800 .6 glow wait-lamp (4L60E TCC on/off on OBD1) = 1
	bra loc_FD5B                        ; FD53  20 06         goto loc_FD5B
loc_FD55:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; FD55  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	bclr $00,x,$40                      ; FD58  1D 00 40      IOR_1800 .6 glow wait-lamp (4L60E TCC on/off on OBD1) = 0
loc_FD5B:
	rts                                 ; FD5B  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_ext_latch_0C04_shadow_FD5C
;   analysis [low]: Controls output latch bit 00BE.1, copied to $0C04. On during glow states 0-3 or when RPM >
;        k_2259 (2). Off after glow is done with the engine stopped. Fits a fuel lift-pump/prime relay
;        (unconfirmed). Serial device-control override via 1CC5/1CC6 .5.
;   inferred [B, pass A]: writes ext_latch_0C04_shadow, ext_output_latch_AMUX
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_ext_latch_0C04_shadow_FD5C:
	ldaa >serial_v1DF1                  ; FD5C  B6 1D F1      A = serial_v1DF1
	bita #$10                           ; FD5F  85 10         test serial_v1DF1 .4
	beq loc_FD70                        ; FD61  27 0D         if serial_v1DF1 .4 all clear goto loc_FD70
	ldx #serial_v1CC5                   ; FD63  CE 1C C5      X = &serial_v1CC5
	brclr $00,x,$20,loc_FD70            ; FD66  1F 00 20 06   if serial_v1CC5 .5 clear goto loc_FD70
	brclr $01,x,$20,loc_FD81            ; FD6A  1F 01 20 13   if glow_v1CC6 .5 clear goto loc_FD81
	bra loc_FD86                        ; FD6E  20 16         goto loc_FD86
loc_FD70:
	ldaa >GLOW_PLUG_STATE               ; FD70  B6 18 12      A = GLOW_PLUG_STATE
	anda #$0F                           ; FD73  84 0F         A &= $0F(15) (keep bits)
	cmpa #$04                           ; FD75  81 04         compare A with 4
	bcs loc_FD86                        ; FD77  25 0D         if A < 4 goto loc_FD86
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; FD79  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	cmpa >CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM           ; FD7C  B1 22 59      compare A with CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM
	bhi loc_FD86                        ; FD7F  22 05         if engine_RPM > CAL_ENG_STOPPED_RPM goto loc_FD86
loc_FD81:
	bclr <ext_latch_0C04_shadow,$02     ; FD81  15 BE 02      ext_latch_0C04_shadow .1 = 0
	bra loc_FD89                        ; FD84  20 03         goto loc_FD89
loc_FD86:
	bset <ext_latch_0C04_shadow,$02     ; FD86  14 BE 02      ext_latch_0C04_shadow .1 = 1
loc_FD89:
	tpa                                 ; FD89  07            A = CCR | 00BE is the shadow of output latch $0C04 (hi nibble AMUX select, lo nibble discrete outputs)
	sei                                 ; FD8A  0F            disable interrupts
	ldab <ext_latch_0C04_shadow         ; FD8B  D6 BE         B = ext_latch_0C04_shadow
	stab >ext_output_latch_AMUX         ; FD8D  F7 0C 04      ext_output_latch_AMUX = B
	tap                                 ; FD90  06            CCR = A
	rts                                 ; FD91  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; AC_clutch_relay_ctl_FD92
;   analysis [medium]: Sets output latch bit 00BE.0 (written to $0C04) on A/C request (MUX9 >= $56). It is cut out
;        when coolant > $DB (k_323E, cal name misleading) with a 1-count hysteresis flag 004B.2. Device control
;        (1CC5/1CC6 .6) is allowed only with the engine stopped or A/C requested, otherwise reply code $0A02.
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AC_clutch_relay_ctl_FD92:
	ldaa >serial_v1DF1                  ; FD92  B6 1D F1      A = serial_v1DF1
	bita #$10                           ; FD95  85 10         test serial_v1DF1 .4
	beq loc_FDB8                        ; FD97  27 1F         if serial_v1DF1 .4 all clear goto loc_FDB8
	ldx #serial_v1CC5                   ; FD99  CE 1C C5      X = &serial_v1CC5
	brclr $00,x,$40,loc_FDB8            ; FD9C  1F 00 40 18   if serial_v1CC5 .6 clear goto loc_FDB8
	brclr $01,x,$40,loc_FDD6            ; FDA0  1F 01 40 32   if glow_v1CC6 .6 clear goto loc_FDD6
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; FDA4  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	beq loc_FDDB                        ; FDA7  27 32         if A == 0 goto loc_FDDB
	ldaa >MUX9_AC_request               ; FDA9  B6 19 4A      A = MUX9_AC_request
	cmpa #$56                           ; FDAC  81 56         compare A with $56(86)
	bcc loc_FDDB                        ; FDAE  24 2B         if MUX9_AC_request >= $56(86) goto loc_FDDB
	ldd #$0A02                          ; FDB0  CC 0A 02      D = $0A02(2562)
	std >TDC_learn_test_result          ; FDB3  FD 1F 7E      TDC_learn_test_result = D
	bra loc_FDD6                        ; FDB6  20 1E         goto loc_FDD6
loc_FDB8:
	ldaa >coolant_temp                  ; FDB8  B6 19 29      A = coolant_temp | A/C cutout when coolant > $DB, hysteresis flag 004B.2
	suba >k_EGR_openloop_load_hi        ; FDBB  B0 32 3E      A -= k_EGR_openloop_load_hi
	bhi loc_FDD3                        ; FDBE  22 13         if A > 0 goto loc_FDD3
	brclr <cylbal_diag_flags,$04,loc_FDCA; FDC0  13 4B 04 06   if cylbal_diag_flags .2 A/C cut-out for high coolant temp clear goto loc_FDCA
	inca                                ; FDC4  4C            A++
	bcc loc_FDD6                        ; FDC5  24 0F         if A >= 0 goto loc_FDD6
	bclr <cylbal_diag_flags,$04         ; FDC7  15 4B 04      cylbal_diag_flags .2 A/C cut-out for high coolant temp = 0
loc_FDCA:
	ldaa >MUX9_AC_request               ; FDCA  B6 19 4A      A = MUX9_AC_request
	cmpa #$56                           ; FDCD  81 56         compare A with $56(86)
	bcc loc_FDDB                        ; FDCF  24 0A         if MUX9_AC_request >= $56(86) goto loc_FDDB
	bra loc_FDD6                        ; FDD1  20 03         goto loc_FDD6
loc_FDD3:
	bset <cylbal_diag_flags,$04         ; FDD3  14 4B 04      cylbal_diag_flags .2 A/C cut-out for high coolant temp = 1
loc_FDD6:
	bclr <ext_latch_0C04_shadow,$01     ; FDD6  15 BE 01      ext_latch_0C04_shadow .0 A/C clutch relay output (latch $0C04) = 0
	bra loc_FDDE                        ; FDD9  20 03         goto loc_FDDE
loc_FDDB:
	bset <ext_latch_0C04_shadow,$01     ; FDDB  14 BE 01      ext_latch_0C04_shadow .0 A/C clutch relay output (latch $0C04) = 1
loc_FDDE:
	tpa                                 ; FDDE  07            A = CCR
	sei                                 ; FDDF  0F            disable interrupts
	ldab <ext_latch_0C04_shadow         ; FDE0  D6 BE         B = ext_latch_0C04_shadow
	stab >ext_output_latch_AMUX         ; FDE2  F7 0C 04      ext_output_latch_AMUX = B
	tap                                 ; FDE5  06            CCR = A
	rts                                 ; FDE6  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; GET_BACKUP_MEAS_INJ_TMG
;   analysis [medium]: Backup (cam-sensor) injection-timing measurement. It limits PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP against
;        reference period + latency (kw_2051). It converts the time to an angle through sub_6A3F with engine_RPM,
;        then sub_6A3F with ANTISTALL_DASHPOT_TMR, then averages it 50/50 into BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING.
;   OBD1 GET_BACKUP_MEAS_INJ_TMG (match 0.99 p1-global): Calculate backup mode CKP signal
;   Trigger = CMP interrupt
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GET_BACKUP_MEAS_INJ_TMG:
	brset <$04,$80,loc_FE30             ; FDE7  12 04 80 45   if [$04] .7 set goto loc_FE30
	brclr <PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS,$08,loc_FE30; FDEB  13 46 08 41   if PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS .3 clear goto loc_FE30
	brclr <PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS,$40,loc_FE30; FDEF  13 46 40 3D   if PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS .6 clear goto loc_FE30
	ldd >BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY         ; FDF3  FC 19 63      D = BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY
	addd >kw_2051                       ; FDF6  F3 20 51      D += kw_2051
	bcc loc_FDFE                        ; FDF9  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_FDFE
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; FDFB  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_FDFE:
	pshb                                ; FDFE  37            push B
	psha                                ; FDFF  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; FE00  30            X = SP + 1
	ldd >TIC_CAP_RPM                    ; FE01  FC 19 8D      D = TIC_CAP_RPM
	subd >ref_edge_time                 ; FE04  B3 19 6B      D -= ref_edge_time
	cpd $00,x                           ; FE07  1A A3 00      compare D with [X+0]
	pulx                                ; FE0A  38            pop X
	bcs loc_FE0E                        ; FE0B  25 01         if D < [X+0] goto loc_FE0E
	xgdx                                ; FE0D  8F            swap D <-> X
loc_FE0E:
	ldd >ref_period_filtered            ; FE0E  FC 19 54      D = ref_period_filtered
	asld                                ; FE11  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_FE2D                        ; FE12  25 19         if D < 0 goto loc_FE2D
	asld                                ; FE14  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_FE2D                        ; FE15  25 16         if D < 0 goto loc_FE2D
	asld                                ; FE17  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_FE2D                        ; FE18  25 13         if D < 0 goto loc_FE2D
	pshb                                ; FE1A  37            push B
	psha                                ; FE1B  36            push A
	tsy                                 ; FE1C  18 30         Y = SP + 1
	cpx $00,y                           ; FE1E  CD AC 00      compare X with [Y+0]
	bls loc_FE2B                        ; FE21  23 08         if X <= [Y+0] goto loc_FE2B
	pulx                                ; FE23  38            pop X
	clra                                ; FE24  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; FE25  5F            B = 0
	std >BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY         ; FE26  FD 19 63      BACKUP_MAX_INT_LATENCY = D
	bra loc_FE2D                        ; FE29  20 02         goto loc_FE2D
loc_FE2B:
	ins                                 ; FE2B  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; FE2C  31            SP++
loc_FE2D:
	stx >PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP          ; FE2D  FF 01 16      PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP = X
loc_FE30:
	bset <PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS,$08          ; FE30  14 46 08      PUMP_BACKUPFLAGS .3 = 1
	ldd >PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP          ; FE33  FC 01 16      D = PUMP_TO_TDC_TIME_BKUP | convert pump-to-TDC time to angle and average 50/50 into BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING
	ldx >engine_RPM                     ; FE36  FE 19 86      X = engine_RPM
	jsr >MUL32                          ; FE39  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	ldx #ANTISTALL_DASHPOT_TMR          ; FE3C  CE 1A A7      X = &ANTISTALL_DASHPOT_TMR
	jsr >MUL32                          ; FE3F  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	addd >BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING          ; FE42  F3 01 10      D += BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING
	rora                                ; FE45  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; FE46  56            B rotate right thru C
	std >BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING           ; FE47  FD 01 10      BKUP_MEAS_INJ_TIMING = D
	rts                                 ; FE4A  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; empty_task_stub_FE4B

empty_task_stub_FE4B:

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_APP_ZERO
;   analysis [high]: Learns the APP1/2/3 closed-pedal zero downward only. When filtered sensor + offset
;        (k_340C/D/E) is below the stored zero, APPn_ZERO_A is lag-filtered toward it (coefs k_3416/17/18 = $50).
;        Skipped for faulted sensors.
;   OBD1 DO_APP_ZERO (match 1.00 p1-exact): 100ms - 10hz
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO_APP_ZERO:
	brset <$02,$04,loc_FE6B             ; FE4C  12 02 04 1B   if [$02] .2 set goto loc_FE6B | OBD1: flag learn APP1 zero
	ldaa >APP1_FILT                     ; FE50  B6 19 0C      A = APP1_FILT
	adda >k_340C                        ; FE53  BB 34 0C      A += k_340C | OBD1: set to 0
	bcc loc_FE5A                        ; FE56  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_FE5A
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FE58  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FE5A:
	cmpa >APP1_ZERO_A                   ; FE5A  B1 1C 8A      compare A with APP1_ZERO_A
	bcc loc_FE6B                        ; FE5D  24 0C         if A >= APP1_ZERO_A goto loc_FE6B | OBD1: run this filter if APP value is below pedal voltage value
	ldab >k_3416                        ; FE5F  F6 34 16      B = k_3416 | OBD1: this is set to $50
	ldx >APP1_ZERO_A                    ; FE62  FE 1C 8A      X = APP1_ZERO_A
	jsr >lag_filter_8bit_coef           ; FE65  BD 69 49      call lag_filter_8bit_coef
	std >APP1_ZERO_A                    ; FE68  FD 1C 8A      APP1_ZERO_A = D
loc_FE6B:
	brset <$03,$20,loc_FE8A             ; FE6B  12 03 20 1B   if [$03] .5 set goto loc_FE8A
	ldaa >APP2_FILT                     ; FE6F  B6 19 0F      A = APP2_FILT
	adda >k_340D                        ; FE72  BB 34 0D      A += k_340D
	bcc loc_FE79                        ; FE75  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_FE79
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FE77  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FE79:
	cmpa >APP2_ZERO_A                   ; FE79  B1 1C 8C      compare A with APP2_ZERO_A
	bcc loc_FE8A                        ; FE7C  24 0C         if A >= APP2_ZERO_A goto loc_FE8A
	ldab >k_3417                        ; FE7E  F6 34 17      B = k_3417
	ldx >APP2_ZERO_A                    ; FE81  FE 1C 8C      X = APP2_ZERO_A
	jsr >lag_filter_8bit_coef           ; FE84  BD 69 49      call lag_filter_8bit_coef
	std >APP2_ZERO_A                    ; FE87  FD 1C 8C      APP2_ZERO_A = D
loc_FE8A:
	brset <$04,$02,loc_FEA9             ; FE8A  12 04 02 1B   if [$04] .1 set goto loc_FEA9
	ldaa >APP3_FILT                     ; FE8E  B6 19 13      A = APP3_FILT
	adda >k_340E                        ; FE91  BB 34 0E      A += k_340E
	bcc loc_FE98                        ; FE94  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_FE98
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FE96  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FE98:
	cmpa >APP3_ZERO_A                   ; FE98  B1 1C 8E      compare A with APP3_ZERO_A
	bcc loc_FEA9                        ; FE9B  24 0C         if A >= APP3_ZERO_A goto loc_FEA9
	ldab >k_3418                        ; FE9D  F6 34 18      B = k_3418

	jsr >lag_filter_8bit_coef           ; FEA3  BD 69 49      call lag_filter_8bit_coef
	std >APP3_ZERO_A                    ; FEA6  FD 1C 8E      APP3_ZERO_A = D
loc_FEA9:
	rts                                 ; FEA9  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; boost_control
;   analysis [medium]: Wastegate PWM. Below RPM k_342D the duty is 0. Above it: boost target =
;        tbl3D_BOOST_target_RPM_x_Fuel_9x17_3450 + IAT adder ((IAT - k_34EB)/2, capped at k_34EA), stored in 1AB1.
;        Error vs Turbo_ram_address goes through P (DO_BOOST_PGAIN) and I (DO_BOOST_IGAIN) terms. Duty = high byte
;        of I +/- P, rounded. Boost sensor faults (0004 .4-.6) force k_3716 (0). Device-control override via 1CCC
;        (1CCA.5). O
;   called from: run_100ms_engine_tasks_EC95
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
boost_control:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; FEAA  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM
	cmpa >k_boost_ctrl_min_RPM_342D     ; FEAD  B1 34 2D      compare A with k_boost_ctrl_min_RPM_342D
	bhi loc_FEB5                        ; FEB0  22 03         if engine_RPM > k_boost_ctrl_min_RPM_342D goto loc_FEB5
	clra                                ; FEB2  4F            A = 0
	bra loc_FF17                        ; FEB3  20 62         goto loc_FF17
loc_FEB5:
	clr >BOOST_ERROR_SIGN               ; FEB5  7F 1A B3      BOOST_ERROR_SIGN = 0
	ldx #tbl3D_BOOST_target_RPM_x_Fuel_9x17_3450; FEB8  CE 34 50      X = &tbl3D_BOOST_target_RPM_x_Fuel_9x17_3450
	ldab >fuel_quantity                 ; FEBB  F6 19 A4      B = fuel_quantity
	jsr >lookup_3D_table                ; FEBE  BD 6D 20      A = 3D lookup tbl3D_BOOST_target_RPM_x_Fuel_9x17_3450[col A, row B]
	ldab >IAT_temp                      ; FEC1  F6 19 39      B = IAT_temp | IAT adder to boost target: (IAT - k_34EB)/2 capped at k_34EA (k_34EB=$DF so practically off)
	subb >k_34EB                        ; FEC4  F0 34 EB      B -= k_34EB
	bmi loc_FED3                        ; FEC7  2B 0A         if B < 0 (signed) goto loc_FED3
	lsrb                                ; FEC9  54            B >>= 1
	cmpb >k_34EA                        ; FECA  F1 34 EA      compare B with k_34EA
	bls loc_FED2                        ; FECD  23 03         if B <= k_34EA goto loc_FED2
	ldab >k_34EA                        ; FECF  F6 34 EA      B = k_34EA
loc_FED2:
	aba                                 ; FED2  1B            A += B
loc_FED3:
	staa >boost_target                  ; FED3  B7 1A B1      boost_target = A
	suba >Turbo_ram_address             ; FED6  B0 19 23      A -= Turbo_ram_address
	bcc loc_FEDF                        ; FED9  24 04         if A >= 0 goto loc_FEDF
	inc >BOOST_ERROR_SIGN               ; FEDB  7C 1A B3      BOOST_ERROR_SIGN++
	nega                                ; FEDE  40            A = -A
loc_FEDF:
	staa >BOOST_ERROR                   ; FEDF  B7 1A B2      BOOST_ERROR = A
	jsr >DO_BOOST_PGAIN                 ; FEE2  BD FF A0      call DO_BOOST_PGAIN | duty = I term +/- P term (direction from BOOST_ERROR_SIGN), round, take high byte
	pshb                                ; FEE5  37            push B
	psha                                ; FEE6  36            push A
	jsr >DO_BOOST_IGAIN                 ; FEE7  BD FF 45      call DO_BOOST_IGAIN
	tsx                                 ; FEEA  30            X = SP + 1
	tst >BOOST_ERROR_SIGN               ; FEEB  7D 1A B3      test BOOST_ERROR_SIGN
	beq loc_FEF9                        ; FEEE  27 09         if BOOST_ERROR_SIGN == 0 goto loc_FEF9
	subd $00,x                          ; FEF0  A3 00         D -= [X+0]
	bcc loc_FF00                        ; FEF2  24 0C         if D >= 0 goto loc_FF00
	ldd #$0000                          ; FEF4  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	bra loc_FF00                        ; FEF7  20 07         goto loc_FF00
loc_FEF9:
	addd $00,x                          ; FEF9  E3 00         D += [X+0]
	bcc loc_FF00                        ; FEFB  24 03         if D no overflow goto loc_FF00
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; FEFD  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_FF00:
	pulx                                ; FF00  38            pop X
	addd #$0080                         ; FF01  C3 00 80      D += $0080(128)
	bcc loc_FF08                        ; FF04  24 02         if D no overflow goto loc_FF08
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FF06  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FF08:
	brset <$04,$10,loc_FF14             ; FF08  12 04 10 08   if [$04] .4 set goto loc_FF14
	brset <$04,$40,loc_FF14             ; FF0C  12 04 40 04   if [$04] .6 set goto loc_FF14
	brclr <$04,$20,loc_FF17             ; FF10  13 04 20 03   if [$04] .5 clear goto loc_FF17
loc_FF14:
	ldaa >CAL_DIAG_WGT_SAFE1            ; FF14  B6 37 16      A = CAL_DIAG_WGT_SAFE1
loc_FF17:
	ldab >serial_v1DF1                  ; FF17  F6 1D F1      B = serial_v1DF1 | device control of wastegate: duty from 1CCC, only if RPM == 0 or <= k_2039, else reply code $1201
	bitb #$10                           ; FF1A  C5 10         test serial_v1DF1 .4
	beq loc_FF41                        ; FF1C  27 23         if serial_v1DF1 .4 all clear goto loc_FF41
	ldab >serial_v1CCA                  ; FF1E  F6 1C CA      B = serial_v1CCA
	bitb #$20                           ; FF21  C5 20         test serial_v1CCA .5
	beq loc_FF41                        ; FF23  27 1C         if serial_v1CCA .5 all clear goto loc_FF41
	ldab >engine_RPM                    ; FF25  F6 19 86      B = engine_RPM
	beq loc_FF3E                        ; FF28  27 14         if B == 0 goto loc_FF3E
	cmpb >k_2039                        ; FF2A  F1 20 39      compare B with k_2039
	bls loc_FF39                        ; FF2D  23 0A         if engine_RPM <= k_2039 goto loc_FF39
	psha                                ; FF2F  36            push A
	ldd #$1201                          ; FF30  CC 12 01      D = $1201(4609)
	std >TDC_learn_test_result          ; FF33  FD 1F 7E      TDC_learn_test_result = D
	pula                                ; FF36  32            pop A
	bra loc_FF41                        ; FF37  20 08         goto loc_FF41
loc_FF39:
	cmpa >boost_v1CCC                   ; FF39  B1 1C CC      compare A with boost_v1CCC
	bls loc_FF41                        ; FF3C  23 03         if A <= boost_v1CCC goto loc_FF41
loc_FF3E:
	ldaa >boost_v1CCC                   ; FF3E  B6 1C CC      A = boost_v1CCC
loc_FF41:
	staa >$180B                         ; FF41  B7 18 0B      PWM_boost_modulator+1 = A
	rts                                 ; FF44  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_BOOST_IGAIN
;   analysis [medium]: Boost integrator. Upper limit = baro table 3432, plus (RPM - k_3430) when fuel > k_3431.
;        Integrator BOOST_INTEG moves by baro-table gain (343C) x BOOST_ERROR, direction from BOOST_ERROR_SIGN,
;        clamped to [CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT, BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT].
;   OBD1 DO_BOOST_IGAIN (match 0.82 p1-global)
;   called from: boost_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO_BOOST_IGAIN:
	ldaa >baro_scaled_axis              ; FF45  B6 1A B8      A = baro_scaled_axis
	ldx #tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3432     ; FF48  CE 34 32      X = &tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3432
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; FF4B  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3432[A]
	ldab >fuel_quantity                 ; FF4E  F6 19 A4      B = fuel_quantity
	cmpb >k_3431                        ; FF51  F1 34 31      compare B with k_3431
	bls loc_FF63                        ; FF54  23 0D         if fuel_quantity <= k_3431 goto loc_FF63
	ldab >engine_RPM                    ; FF56  F6 19 86      B = engine_RPM
	subb >k_3430                        ; FF59  F0 34 30      B -= k_3430
	bcs loc_FF63                        ; FF5C  25 05         if B < 0 goto loc_FF63
	aba                                 ; FF5E  1B            A += B
	bcc loc_FF63                        ; FF5F  24 02         if A no overflow goto loc_FF63
	ldaa #$FF                           ; FF61  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
loc_FF63:
	clrb                                ; FF63  5F            B = 0
	std >BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT              ; FF64  FD 1A B6      BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT = D
	ldaa >baro_scaled_axis              ; FF67  B6 1A B8      A = baro_scaled_axis
	ldx #tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_343C     ; FF6A  CE 34 3C      X = &tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_343C
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; FF6D  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_343C[A]
	ldab >BOOST_ERROR                   ; FF70  F6 1A B2      B = BOOST_ERROR
	mul                                 ; FF73  3D            D = A * B
	tst >BOOST_ERROR_SIGN               ; FF74  7D 1A B3      test BOOST_ERROR_SIGN
	beq loc_FF8E                        ; FF77  27 15         if BOOST_ERROR_SIGN == 0 goto loc_FF8E
	subd >BOOST_INTEG                   ; FF79  B3 1A B4      D -= BOOST_INTEG
	bcc loc_FF89                        ; FF7C  24 0B         if D >= 0 goto loc_FF89
	coma                                ; FF7E  43            A = ~A
	comb                                ; FF7F  53            B = ~B
	addd #$0001                         ; FF80  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
	cpd >CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT              ; FF83  1A B3 34 2E   compare D with CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT
	bcc loc_FF9C                        ; FF87  24 13         if D >= CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT goto loc_FF9C
loc_FF89:
	ldd >CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT              ; FF89  FC 34 2E      D = CAL_BOOST_MIN_INT
	bra loc_FF9C                        ; FF8C  20 0E         goto loc_FF9C
loc_FF8E:
	addd >BOOST_INTEG                   ; FF8E  F3 1A B4      D += BOOST_INTEG
	bcs loc_FF99                        ; FF91  25 06         if D overflowed goto loc_FF99
	cpd >BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT              ; FF93  1A B3 1A B6   compare D with BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT
	bls loc_FF9C                        ; FF97  23 03         if D <= BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT goto loc_FF9C
loc_FF99:
	ldd >BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT              ; FF99  FC 1A B6      D = BOOST_INTEG_LIMIT
loc_FF9C:
	std >BOOST_INTEG                    ; FF9C  FD 1A B4      BOOST_INTEG = D
	rts                                 ; FF9F  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_BOOST_PGAIN
;   analysis [high]: Boost proportional term: D = baro-table gain (3446) x BOOST_ERROR x 4, saturating at $FFFF.
;        The bytes after it (FFB7-FFBE) are zero padding, FFBF is the default RTI used by unused vectors, then the
;        vector table FFC0-FFFF.
;   OBD1 DO_BOOST_PGAIN (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: boost_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DO_BOOST_PGAIN:
	ldaa >baro_scaled_axis              ; FFA0  B6 1A B8      A = baro_scaled_axis
	ldx #tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3446     ; FFA3  CE 34 46      X = &tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3446
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; FFA6  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_boost_ctrl_BARO_3446[A]
	ldab >BOOST_ERROR                   ; FFA9  F6 1A B2      B = BOOST_ERROR
	mul                                 ; FFAC  3D            D = A * B
	asld                                ; FFAD  05            D <<= 1
	bcs loc_FFB3                        ; FFAE  25 03         if B < 0 goto loc_FFB3
	asld                                ; FFB0  05            D <<= 1
	bcc loc_FFB6                        ; FFB1  24 03         if B >= 0 goto loc_FFB6
loc_FFB3:
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; FFB3  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
loc_FFB6:
	rts                                 ; FFB6  39            return
	fcb	$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00                                 ; FFB7
	rti                                 ; FFBF  3B            return from interrupt | default handler (rti) for all unused interrupt vectors
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFC0 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFC2 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFC4 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFC6 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFC8 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFCA vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFCC vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFCE vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFD0 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFD2 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFD4 vector reserved
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFD6 vector SCI
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFD8 vector SPI
	fdb	PAISVC_4KPPMI                       ; FFDA vector PAI_edge
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFDC vector PA_overflow
	fdb	TOVFL_SERVICE                       ; FFDE vector TOF
	fdb	$7E5D                               ; FFE0 vector TIC4_TOC5
	fdb	$7E7B                               ; FFE2 vector TOC4
	fdb	$7E99                               ; FFE4 vector TOC3
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFE6 vector TOC2
	fdb	$7EB7                               ; FFE8 vector TOC1
	fdb	$7ED5                               ; FFEA vector TIC3
	fdb	ISR_IC2_trans_input_shaft           ; FFEC vector TIC2
	fdb	ISR_IC1_VSS                         ; FFEE vector TIC1
	fdb	ISR_RTI_EEPROM_write_6614           ; FFF0 vector RTI
	fdb	$7EF3                               ; FFF2 vector IRQ
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFF4 vector XIRQ
	fdb	$FFBF                               ; FFF6 vector SWI
	fdb	loc_6117                            ; FFF8 vector illegal_op
	fdb	COP_clock_fail_entry_6119           ; FFFA vector COP_fail
	fdb	COP_clock_fail_entry_6119           ; FFFC vector clock_fail
	fdb	RESET_entry                         ; FFFE vector RESET

; ============================================================================
; 16216588 OS  bank 1  ($8000-$FFFF)        assembler: MGTEK asm11 (MiniIDE)
; Keep the < and > prefixes: they force direct / extended addressing exactly as in the original.
; ============================================================================

	org	$8000

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_engine_speed_902A
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 calculate_engine_speed. Takes an atomic snapshot of the captured reference time and
;        overflow count (TIC_CAP_RPM / TOVFL_CAP_RPM) and forms the 24-bit period since the last poll. It

;        FDIV, then shifts back. FLAGS1.7 is a re-entry lock; FLAGS0.4 skips one sample after resync.
;   OBD1 calculate_engine_speed (match 0.60 p2-dataref)

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_RPM_and_engine_mode_9098
;   analysis [high]: OBD1 CRANK_RUN_MODE_SELECT, run on each reference from calc_TOVFL_CAP_RPM_8A40. engine_RPM is
;        the average of RPM_RAW and the previous value; RPM_5 is lag-filtered with k_22C7, and RPM_6 adds a
;        clamped 4x(raw-filtered) lead term. It sets ENGMODEFLAG: b7 crank below k_226E (300 rpm), b6 idle, b4
;        cyl-balance enable, b5 overrev above CAL_SAFETY_OVERREV_RPM with hysteresis. It also sets $5A.0 from the
;   OBD1 CRANK_RUN_MODE_SELECT (match 0.61 p2-dataref): STARTING MODE ETC. DETERMINATION
;   Trigger = CMP sensor
;   called from: diag_P0251_P0335_890E
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_RPM_and_engine_mode_9098:
	ldd >RPM_RAW                        ; 9098  FC 19 82      D = RPM_RAW
	addd >RPM_1                         ; 909B  F3 19 84      D += RPM_1
	rora                                ; 909E  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; 909F  56            B rotate right thru C
	adcb #$00                           ; 90A0  C9 00         B += C + 0
	adca #$00                           ; 90A2  89 00         A += C + 0
	std >RPM_1                          ; 90A4  FD 19 84      RPM_1 = D
	std >engine_RPM                     ; 90A7  FD 19 86      engine_RPM = D

	ldaa #$FF                           ; 90AD  86 FF         A = $FF(255)

	bpl b1_loc_90D7                     ; 90CF  2A 06         if D >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_90D7
	cpd #$F555                          ; 90D1  1A 83 F5 55   compare D with $F555(62805)

b1_loc_90D7:
	ldd #$F555                          ; 90D7  CC F5 55      D = $F555(62805)

b1_loc_90DC:
	asld                                ; 90DC  05            D <<= 1

	cmpa >k_crank_mode_RPM_226E         ; 90F4  B1 22 6E      compare A with k_crank_mode_RPM_226E

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_fuel_quantity
;   analysis [medium]: OBD1 RUN_FUEL_QTY_CONTROL, runs per reference. Final fuel request = pedal/governor fuel
;        (FETCH_BASIC_APP_FUEL) -> delta-fuel limiter -> max with cruise -> torque-reduction scale -> idle-
;        governor floor -> limp clamps, stored in fuel_quantity (mm3*0.3125). READ_PUMP_MAPS turns it into a pump
;        pulse/angle, and then come the cylinder-balance trim and the test-mode cylinder cut. It ends at
;        COMMAND_FUEL_
;   OBD1 RUN_FUEL_QTY_CONTROL (match 0.68 p2-dataref): Fuel quantity control.
;   Trigger: CMP interrupt
;   called from: diag_P0251_P0335_890E
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; FETCH_BASIC_APP_FUEL
;   analysis [high]: Pedal fuel from FETCH_DES_PEDAL_PWR. In crank it adds the constant crank fuel and caps the
;        pedal adder at CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER. In run it returns min(pedal fuel, governor/limiter max fuel), and
;        a governed value below CAL_MIN_GOVERNED_FUEL becomes 0.
;   OBD1 FETCH_BASIC_APP_FUEL (match 1.00 p1-exact): called in crank job
;   called from: calc_fuel_quantity
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
FETCH_BASIC_APP_FUEL:
	jsr >FETCH_DES_PEDAL_PWR            ; 941E  BD 94 48      call FETCH_DES_PEDAL_PWR | OBD1: RPM,APP_COND -> A -> P
	psha                                ; 9421  36            push A
	brclr <ENGMODEFLAG,$80,b1_loc_9439  ; 9422  13 4C 80 13   if ENGMODEFLAG .7 cranking (STARTUP_CTR <= CAL_MIN_CRANK_C clear goto b1_loc_9439
	jsr >get_crank_base_fuel_945E       ; 9426  BD 94 5E      call get_crank_base_fuel_945E
	pulb                                ; 9429  33            pop B
	cmpb >CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER       ; 942A  F1 22 8F      compare B with CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER
	bls b1_loc_9432                     ; 942D  23 03         if B <= CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER goto b1_loc_9432
	ldab >CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER       ; 942F  F6 22 8F      B = CAL_CRANK_APP_MAX_ADDER | OBD1: for cranking

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;        the

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; RUN_EGR_DELTAFUEL_LIM
;   analysis [high]: Rate limit on increasing fuel when EGR is active (Configuration_set_2.2). Applies only with
;        pedal <= $DE, VSS >= 19 mph, and EGR vac+baro <= CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_MAP. The rise from APP_FUEL_REQ is
;        limited to FAST_SLEW (big step) or SLOW_SLEW per reference. With this cal's values (EGR_MAP=0, STEP=0) it
;        is effectively off.
;   OBD1 RUN_EGR_DELTAFUEL_LIM (match 0.88 p1-global)
;   called from: calc_fuel_quantity
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN_EGR_DELTAFUEL_LIM:
	ldab >pedal_position_filtered       ; 95B5  F6 19 16      B = pedal_position_filtered
	cmpb #$DE                           ; 95B8  C1 DE         compare B with $DE(222)
	nop                                 ; 95BA  01          
	bhi b1_loc_95EF                     ; 95BB  22 32         if pedal_position_filtered > $DE(222) goto b1_loc_95EF
	ldab >vehicle_speed                 ; 95BD  F6 19 F1      B = vehicle_speed
	cmpb #$26                           ; 95C0  C1 26         compare B with $26(38)
	bcs b1_loc_95EF                     ; 95C2  25 2B         if vehicle_speed < $26(38) goto b1_loc_95EF | OBD1: vehicle less than 19 mph? then no limit on power
	ldab >MEASURED_EGR_VAC              ; 95C4  F6 19 26      B = MEASURED_EGR_VAC
	addb >EGR_BARO_CORR                 ; 95C7  FB 19 7D      B += EGR_BARO_CORR
	cmpb >CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_MAP          ; 95CA  F1 22 D0      compare B with CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_MAP | OBD1: is set to b4
	bhi b1_loc_95EF                     ; 95CD  22 20         if B > CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_MAP goto b1_loc_95EF | OBD1: if egr vac is higher than calibrated value then don't change
	ldab >APP_FUEL_REQ                  ; 95CF  F6 19 AB      B = APP_FUEL_REQ
	cba                                 ; 95D2  11            compare A with B
	bls b1_loc_95EF                     ; 95D3  23 1A         if A <= B goto b1_loc_95EF | OBD1: if power is dropping then no limit
	addb >CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_STEP         ; 95D5  FB 22 D1      B += CAL_FUEL_LIM_EGR_STEP | OBD1: is 40 = limit of max fuel delta request
	bcc b1_loc_95DC                     ; 95D8  24 02         if B no overflow goto b1_loc_95DC

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DO_CYLBAL
;   analysis [high]: Cylinder balance accumulator, run each idle-governor pass: first pass clears sums; afterwards
;        adds RPM_RAW into the per-cylinder sum slot (CYLBAL_STOR_CYL) and, after CAL_CYLBAL_PACETMR cycles, runs
;        CYLBAL_ADJUST_AND_DIAG and restarts.

;   called from: IDLE_MODE_GOVERNOR
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;   analysis [medium]: IDLEDT90 = fraction kw_31F3 / max(engine_RPM, kw_31F3) (<=1.0): normalises the per-event
;        loop time so I and D gains are per unit time rather than per crank event.

;   called from: IDLE_MODE_GOVERNOR
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_idle_period_ratio_9DD4:

	bhi b1_loc_9DDF                     ; 9DDA  22 03         if X > kw_31F3 goto b1_loc_9DDF

	stx >IDLEDT90                       ; 9DE3  FF 1C 6F      IDLEDT90 = X
	rts                                 ; 9DE6  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; b1_sub_9DE7
;   analysis [low]: Generic 2-coefficient digital filter (OBD1 LE6AA): input D clamped to +-$1AAE, X = 3-byte
;        coefficient table (tbl_31D6), 24-bit state passed on the stack. Updates state via sub_69B8 (coef0) and
;        returns (coef1*state - coef2*input)>>4. Used for the filtered idle error ($1C6B); updated state returned
;        on stack goes to $1C65..67.
;   OBD1 LE6AA (match 1.00 p1-call)
;   called from: IDLE_MODE_GOVERNOR
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	pshb                                ; 9DE8  37            push B
	psha                                ; 9DE9  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; 9DEA  30            X = SP + 1
	tsta                                ; 9DEB  4D            test A

	comb                                ; 9DEF  53            B = ~B
	addd #$0001                         ; 9DF0  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)

	ldd #$F257                          ; 9E00  CC F2 57      D = $F257(62039) | OBD1: this is actually some constant.... not a pointer!!! This should really be e552!!!

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; cruise_check_enable_conds_A0AB
;   analysis [high]: Cruise enable checks; returns A=1 (after reset_cruise(1)) if any fail: run time < kw_206E,
;        brake, TCC brake switch open, set+resume both pressed, gear (Cal_bit_6_store & $F1), accel outside
;        kw_2079..kw_2077, VSS > MAXVSS or below MINSETPT/MINVSSENA, in hold >15 mph (k_208C) under desired, RPM
;        outside MIN/MAXRPM, 4WD low active, or resume pressed while state<=1.
;   OBD1 L7BBD (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: cruise_control_main_9F80
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	bcs b1_loc_A121                     ; A0B2  25 6D         if ENGINE_RUN_TIME < kw_206E goto b1_loc_A121 | OBD1: reset_cruise & rts
	brset <RAM_status_resistor,$02,b1_loc_A121; A0B4  12 4E 02 69   if RAM_status_resistor .1 brake sw set goto b1_loc_A121 | OBD1: brake switch

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; RAM_set_subroutine
;   analysis [medium]: Cruise hard-inhibit check: cruise on/off switch off, brake not yet cycled (FLAGS2.3), any
;        of several current-DTC bits (RAM 0004-000C) or derate flags (DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .3/.7) ->
;        reset_cruise(0) (also clears stored speed) and return A=1; else A=0. Several bit tests are duplicated
;        (harmless).
;   called from: cruise_control_main_9F80
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RAM_set_subroutine:
	brclr <IN_1802_debounced,$01,b1_loc_A170; A129  13 4F 01 43   if IN_1802_debounced .0 cruise on/off sw clear goto b1_loc_A170 | hard inhibits (switch, brake latch, DTCs, derate) -> full reset incl. stored speed
	brclr <FLAGS2,$08,b1_loc_A170       ; A12D  13 4A 08 3F   if FLAGS2 .3 brake cycled since power-up (cruise perm clear goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$04,b1_loc_A170          ; A131  12 08 04 3B   if [$08] .2 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$07,$04,b1_loc_A170          ; A135  12 07 04 37   if [$07] .2 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$04,$80,b1_loc_A170          ; A139  12 04 80 33   if [$04] .7 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$07,$02,b1_loc_A170          ; A13D  12 07 02 2F   if [$07] .1 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$0C,$01,b1_loc_A170          ; A141  12 0C 01 2B   if [$0C] .0 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$0C,$02,b1_loc_A170          ; A145  12 0C 02 27   if [$0C] .1 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$40,b1_loc_A170          ; A149  12 08 40 23   if [$08] .6 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$08,b1_loc_A170          ; A14D  12 08 08 1F   if [$08] .3 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$08,b1_loc_A170          ; A151  12 08 08 1B   if [$08] .3 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$20,b1_loc_A170          ; A155  12 08 20 17   if [$08] .5 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$20,b1_loc_A170          ; A159  12 08 20 13   if [$08] .5 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$10,b1_loc_A170          ; A15D  12 08 10 0F   if [$08] .4 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <$08,$10,b1_loc_A170          ; A161  12 08 10 0B   if [$08] .4 set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2,$08,b1_loc_A170; A165  12 53 08 07   if DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .3 only one valid pedal sensor (P1125) set goto b1_loc_A170
	brset <DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2,$80,b1_loc_A170; A169  12 53 80 03   if DERATE_LIMP_ENA_FLAGS2 .7 no valid pedal sensor (limp, P1125) set goto b1_loc_A170
	clra                                ; A16D  4F            A = 0
	bra b1_loc_A176                     ; A16E  20 06         goto b1_loc_A176
b1_loc_A170:
	clra                                ; A170  4F            A = 0
	jsr >reset_cruise                   ; A171  BD A5 A1      call reset_cruise
	ldaa #$01                           ; A174  86 01         A = 1
b1_loc_A176:
	rts                                 ; A176  39            return

;   analysis [low]: Filter state update helper (OBD1 L7E8E) for Scaling_and_clamping_fixed: delta = input - 24-bit
;        state(Y), scaled by coefficient via sub_6AEB, magnitude x8 with saturation, sign restored and added back
;        to the state. Bank-1 copy of sub_69B8.
;   OBD1 L7E8E (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: Scaling_and_clamping_fixed
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
b1_sub_A381:
	pshx                                ; A381  3C            push X
	pshb                                ; A382  37            push B
	pshb                                ; A383  37            push B
	psha                                ; A384  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; A385  30            X = SP + 1
	clr $02,x                           ; A386  6F 02         [X+2] = 0
	ldy $03,x                           ; A388  1A EE 03      Y = [X+3]
	ldd $01,x                           ; A38B  EC 01         D = [X+1]
	subd $01,y                          ; A38D  18 A3 01      D -= [Y+1]
	std $01,x                           ; A390  ED 01         [X+1] = D
	ldaa $00,x                          ; A392  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	sbca $00,y                          ; A394  18 A2 00      A -= C + [Y+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; A397  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	ldaa $07,x                          ; A399  A6 07         A = [X+7]
	jsr >muls24_by_frac8_6AEB           ; A39B  BD 6A EB      call muls24_by_frac8_6AEB
	clra                                ; A39E  4F            A = 0
	tst $00,x                           ; A39F  6D 00         test [X+0]
	bpl b1_loc_A3B1                     ; A3A1  2A 0E         if [X+0] >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_A3B1
	clrb                                ; A3A3  5F            B = 0
	subd $01,x                          ; A3A4  A3 01         D -= [X+1]
	std $01,x                           ; A3A6  ED 01         [X+1] = D
	tpa                                 ; A3A8  07            A = CCR
	clrb                                ; A3A9  5F            B = 0
	tap                                 ; A3AA  06            CCR = A
	sbcb $00,x                          ; A3AB  E2 00         B -= C + [X+0]
	stab $00,x                          ; A3AD  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	ldaa #$11                           ; A3AF  86 11         A = $11(17)
b1_loc_A3B1:
	psha                                ; A3B1  36            push A
	ldab $00,x                          ; A3B2  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	ldx $01,x                           ; A3B4  EE 01         X = [X+1]
	pshx                                ; A3B6  3C            push X
	tba                                 ; A3B7  17            A = B
	pulb                                ; A3B8  33            pop B
	tsx                                 ; A3B9  30            X = SP + 1
	asl $00,x                           ; A3BA  68 00         [X+0] <<= 1
	rolb                                ; A3BC  59            B rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; A3BD  49            A rotate left thru C
	bcs b1_loc_A3CC                     ; A3BE  25 0C         if X < 0 goto b1_loc_A3CC
	asl $00,x                           ; A3C0  68 00         [X+0] <<= 1
	rolb                                ; A3C2  59            B rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; A3C3  49            A rotate left thru C
	bcs b1_loc_A3CC                     ; A3C4  25 06         if X < 0 goto b1_loc_A3CC
	asl $00,x                           ; A3C6  68 00         [X+0] <<= 1
	rolb                                ; A3C8  59            B rotate left thru C
	rola                                ; A3C9  49            A rotate left thru C
	bcc b1_loc_A3D5                     ; A3CA  24 09         if X >= 0 goto b1_loc_A3D5
b1_loc_A3CC:
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; A3CC  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
	std $02,x                           ; A3CF  ED 02         [X+2] = D
	stab $04,x                          ; A3D1  E7 04         [X+4] = B
	bra b1_loc_A3DB                     ; A3D3  20 06         goto b1_loc_A3DB
b1_loc_A3D5:
	std $02,x                           ; A3D5  ED 02         [X+2] = D
	ldaa $00,x                          ; A3D7  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa $04,x                          ; A3D9  A7 04         [X+4] = A
b1_loc_A3DB:
	ins                                 ; A3DB  31            SP++
	pula                                ; A3DC  32            pop A
	tsx                                 ; A3DD  30            X = SP + 1
	tsta                                ; A3DE  4D            test A
	beq b1_loc_A3EE                     ; A3DF  27 0D         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_A3EE
	clra                                ; A3E1  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; A3E2  5F            B = 0
	subd $01,x                          ; A3E3  A3 01         D -= [X+1]
	std $01,x                           ; A3E5  ED 01         [X+1] = D
	tpa                                 ; A3E7  07            A = CCR
	clrb                                ; A3E8  5F            B = 0
	tap                                 ; A3E9  06            CCR = A
	sbcb $00,x                          ; A3EA  E2 00         B -= C + [X+0]
	stab $00,x                          ; A3EC  E7 00         [X+0] = B
b1_loc_A3EE:
	ldd $01,y                           ; A3EE  18 EC 01      D = [Y+1]
	addd $01,x                          ; A3F1  E3 01         D += [X+1]
	std $01,y                           ; A3F3  18 ED 01      [Y+1] = D
	ldaa $00,y                          ; A3F6  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	adca $00,x                          ; A3F9  A9 00         A += C + [X+0]
	staa $00,y                          ; A3FB  18 A7 00      [Y+0] = A
	pulx                                ; A3FE  38            pop X
	ins                                 ; A3FF  31            SP++
	pulx                                ; A400  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; A401  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Scaling_and_clamping_fixed
;   analysis [medium]: Same 2-coefficient filter as b1_sub_9DE7 but input clamped to +-$3000 and state update via
;        b1_sub_A381; used for the filtered cruise speed error (coefs tbl_2059). Label b1_sub_A431 inside is the
;        output stage.
;   OBD1 L7F0F (match 1.00 p1-call)
;   called from: cruise_fuel_PID_A224
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Scaling_and_clamping_fixed:
	pshx                                ; A402  3C            push X
	pshb                                ; A403  37            push B
	psha                                ; A404  36            push A
	tsx                                 ; A405  30            X = SP + 1
	tsta                                ; A406  4D            test A
	bpl b1_loc_A40E                     ; A407  2A 05         if A >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_A40E
	coma                                ; A409  43            A = ~A
	comb                                ; A40A  53            B = ~B
	addd #$0001                         ; A40B  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
b1_loc_A40E:
	cpd #$3000                          ; A40E  1A 83 30 00   compare D with $3000(12288) | clamp filter input to +-$3000 | OBD1: cap to +/- 0x3000
	bls b1_loc_A420                     ; A412  23 0C         if D <= $3000(12288) goto b1_loc_A420
	ldd #$3000                          ; A414  CC 30 00      D = $3000(12288)
	tst $00,x                           ; A417  6D 00         test [X+0]
	bpl b1_loc_A41E                     ; A419  2A 03         if [X+0] >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_A41E
	ldd #$D000                          ; A41B  CC D0 00      D = $D000(53248)
b1_loc_A41E:
	std $00,x                           ; A41E  ED 00         [X+0] = D
b1_loc_A420:
	ldx $02,x                           ; A420  EE 02         X = [X+2]
	ldaa $00,x                          ; A422  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	tsx                                 ; A424  30            X = SP + 1
	psha                                ; A425  36            push A
	ldd $00,x                           ; A426  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	pshb                                ; A428  37            push B
	ldab #$06                           ; A429  C6 06         B = 6
	abx                                 ; A42B  3A            X += B
	pulb                                ; A42C  33            pop B
	jsr >b1_sub_A381                    ; A42D  BD A3 81      call b1_sub_A381
	ins                                 ; A430  31            SP++
	tsx                                 ; A431  30            X = SP + 1
	ldx $02,x                           ; A432  EE 02         X = [X+2]
	ldaa $01,x                          ; A434  A6 01         A = [X+1]
	tsx                                 ; A436  30            X = SP + 1
	ldx $06,x                           ; A437  EE 06         X = [X+6]
	jsr >MUL16S                         ; A439  BD 6A A2      call MUL16S
	pshb                                ; A43C  37            push B
	pshx                                ; A43D  3C            push X
	tsx                                 ; A43E  30            X = SP + 1
	ldx $05,x                           ; A43F  EE 05         X = [X+5]
	ldaa $02,x                          ; A441  A6 02         A = [X+2]
	tsx                                 ; A443  30            X = SP + 1
	ldx $03,x                           ; A444  EE 03         X = [X+3]
	jsr >MUL16S                         ; A446  BD 6A A2      call MUL16S
	pshb                                ; A449  37            push B
	pshx                                ; A44A  3C            push X
	tsx                                 ; A44B  30            X = SP + 1
	ldd $01,x                           ; A44C  EC 01         D = [X+1]
	subd $04,x                          ; A44E  A3 04         D -= [X+4]
	std $04,x                           ; A450  ED 04         [X+4] = D
	pula                                ; A452  32            pop A
	sbca $03,x                          ; A453  A2 03         A -= C + [X+3]
	pulx                                ; A455  38            pop X
	pulb                                ; A456  33            pop B
	pulx                                ; A457  38            pop X
	psha                                ; A458  36            push A
	xgdx                                ; A459  8F            swap D <-> X
	tsx                                 ; A45A  30            X = SP + 1
	asr $00,x                           ; A45B  67 00         [X+0] >>= 1 (signed)
	rora                                ; A45D  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; A45E  56            B rotate right thru C
	asr $00,x                           ; A45F  67 00         [X+0] >>= 1 (signed)
	rora                                ; A461  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; A462  56            B rotate right thru C
	asr $00,x                           ; A463  67 00         [X+0] >>= 1 (signed)
	rora                                ; A465  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; A466  56            B rotate right thru C
	asr $00,x                           ; A467  67 00         [X+0] >>= 1 (signed)
	rora                                ; A469  46            A rotate right thru C
	rorb                                ; A46A  56            B rotate right thru C
	ins                                 ; A46B  31            SP++
	pulx                                ; A46C  38            pop X
	pulx                                ; A46D  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; A46E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_cruise_gain_term_A46F
;   analysis [medium]: Picks a 16-bit gain from tbl_2066 (A!=0) or tbl_206A (A=0), word 0 if CRUISE_STATE>4 else
;        word 1, signed-multiplies (MULS32) the cruise error word at 1A03 by it, saturates the result to a signed
;        24-bit value and stores it at 1A0F..1A11. Called from the cruise fuel controller A224 (OBD1 comment:
;        p-term).
;   OBD1 L7F7C (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: cruise_fuel_PID_A224
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_cruise_gain_term_A46F:
	ldx #tbl_2066                       ; A46F  CE 20 66      X = &tbl_2066
	tsta                                ; A472  4D            test A
	bne b1_loc_A478                     ; A473  26 03         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_A478
	ldx #tbl_206A                       ; A475  CE 20 6A      X = &tbl_206A
b1_loc_A478:
	ldab >CRUISE_STATE                  ; A478  F6 19 F0      B = CRUISE_STATE
	cmpb #$04                           ; A47B  C1 04         compare B with 4 | CRUISE_STATE>4 uses first gain word of the pair, otherwise second
	bhi b1_loc_A481                     ; A47D  22 02         if CRUISE_STATE > 4 goto b1_loc_A481
	inx                                 ; A47F  08            X++
	inx                                 ; A480  08            X++
b1_loc_A481:
	ldx $00,x                           ; A481  EE 00         X = [X+0]
	ldd >cruise_error_filtered          ; A483  FC 1A 03      D = cruise_error_filtered
	jsr >MULS32                         ; A486  BD 6A 6C      call MULS32 | signed 16x16 multiply; result saturated to +/-$7FFFFF and kept as 24-bit term in 1A0F-1A11
	tsta                                ; A489  4D            test A
	bpl b1_loc_A49A                     ; A48A  2A 0E         if A >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_A49A
	cpd #$FF80                          ; A48C  1A 83 FF 80   compare D with $FF80(65408)
	bcc b1_loc_A4A6                     ; A490  24 14         if cruise_error_filtered >= $FF80(65408) goto b1_loc_A4A6
	ldd #$FF80                          ; A492  CC FF 80      D = $FF80(65408)
	ldx #ram_v0000                      ; A495  CE 00 00      X = &ram_v0000
	bra b1_loc_A4A6                     ; A498  20 0C         goto b1_loc_A4A6
b1_loc_A49A:
	cpd #$007F                          ; A49A  1A 83 00 7F   compare D with $007F(127)
	bls b1_loc_A4A6                     ; A49E  23 06         if D <= $007F(127) goto b1_loc_A4A6
	ldd #$007F                          ; A4A0  CC 00 7F      D = $007F(127)
	ldx #$FFFF                          ; A4A3  CE FF FF      X = $FFFF(65535)
b1_loc_A4A6:
	stab >cruise_gain_term              ; A4A6  F7 1A 0F      cruise_gain_term = B
	stx >cruise_v1A10                   ; A4A9  FF 1A 10      cruise_v1A10 = X
	rts                                 ; A4AC  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; count_resume_accel_switch_A4AD
;   analysis [high]: Resume/accel switch hold timer: while CRUISE_FLAGS_1 b1+b2 and the resume/accel input are
;        set, 19FB counts up (saturating at FF) and 19FC is cleared; otherwise 19FC counts released time and 19FB
;        is cleared. Callers save the old 19FB in B to detect a press-and-release.
;   OBD1 L7FBA (match 1.00 p1-exact): Seems like more switch debounce logic
;   Modifies 142E, 142F
;   called from: cruise_state3_accel_A00B, cruise_state6_hold_A1E2, cruise_state2_A524
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
count_resume_accel_switch_A4AD:
	brclr <CRUISE_FLAGS_1,$02,b1_loc_A4C7; A4AD  13 47 02 16   if CRUISE_FLAGS_1 .1 cruise on/off switch debounced on clear goto b1_loc_A4C7
	brclr <CRUISE_FLAGS_1,$04,b1_loc_A4C7; A4B1  13 47 04 12   if CRUISE_FLAGS_1 .2 resume delay expired (resume/accel press clear goto b1_loc_A4C7
	brclr <RAM_status_resistor,$80,b1_loc_A4C7; A4B5  13 4E 80 0E   if RAM_status_resistor .7 resume/accel sw clear goto b1_loc_A4C7 | OBD1: resume/accel switch
	ldaa >cruise_resacc_held_ctr        ; A4B9  B6 19 FB      A = cruise_resacc_held_ctr
	inca                                ; A4BC  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_A4C2                     ; A4BD  27 03         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_A4C2
	staa >cruise_resacc_held_ctr        ; A4BF  B7 19 FB      cruise_resacc_held_ctr = A
b1_loc_A4C2:
	clr >cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr  ; A4C2  7F 19 FC      cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr = 0
	bra b1_loc_A4D3                     ; A4C5  20 0C         goto b1_loc_A4D3
b1_loc_A4C7:
	ldaa >cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr ; A4C7  B6 19 FC      A = cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr
	inca                                ; A4CA  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_A4D0                     ; A4CB  27 03         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_A4D0
	staa >cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr ; A4CD  B7 19 FC      cruise_resume_sw_released_ctr = A
b1_loc_A4D0:
	clr >cruise_resacc_held_ctr         ; A4D0  7F 19 FB      cruise_resacc_held_ctr = 0
b1_loc_A4D3:
	rts                                 ; A4D3  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; cruise_state2_A524
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cruise_state2_A524:

	jsr >count_set_coast_switch_A505    ; A527  BD A5 05      call count_set_coast_switch_A505
	; ---- cruise_standby_switch_handler_A52A: continues the routine above (nothing calls this point)
	;      analysis [medium]: Cruise state handler. The real entry is b1:A524 (ldab 19F9 / jsr
	;      count_set_coast_switch), so B = the previous set-switch count. Releasing SET after >=k_2083 ticks calls
	;      A076 (setpoint = current speed, state 6). RESUME held >=k_208F engages accel mode (state 3). RESUME tapped
	;      resumes to the stored speed 19F5 (state 4, CRUISE_SETPOINT=current VSS). If VSS is already >=10 mph
	;      OBD1 L8031 (match 0.80 p1-global)

	jsr >cruise_engage_at_current_speed_A076; A534  BD A0 76      call cruise_engage_at_current_speed_A076
	bra b1_loc_A5A0                     ; A537  20 67         goto b1_loc_A5A0

	ldd >cruise_desired_speed           ; A53E  FC 19 F5      D = cruise_desired_speed
	beq b1_loc_A5A0                     ; A541  27 5D         if D == 0 goto b1_loc_A5A0

	ldab >cruise_resacc_held_ctr        ; A543  F6 19 FB      B = cruise_resacc_held_ctr
	jsr >count_resume_accel_switch_A4AD ; A546  BD A4 AD      call count_resume_accel_switch_A4AD
	ldaa >cruise_resacc_held_ctr        ; A549  B6 19 FB      A = cruise_resacc_held_ctr

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ramp_cruise_setpoint_to_target_A5ED
;   analysis [medium]: Moves CRUISE_SETPOINT toward the target/resume speed 19F5 by a rate step (rate byte * 256).
;        Rate: state 4 (resume) uses tbl2D_CRUISE_RAMP_RATE_UP indexed by 2*(target-setpoint), and does nothing
;        until VSS is within k_207D (10 mph) of the setpoint. State 3 (accel) uses tbl2D_CRUISE_RAMP_RATE_DN
;        indexed by VSS; other states use k_2082. Snaps to the target when within kw_207B.
;   OBD1 L8127 (match 1.00 p1-exact)

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; TDCCAL2
;   analysis [high]: TDC learn state 2: while the timer runs, filters the TIO cam-to-crank angle (146C) into
;        TDC_LEARN_VALUE with FILT_16A (coefficient CAL_TDCLEARN_FILT), then advances.

	cli                                 ; AA79  0E            enable interrupts
	ldd >$146C                          ; AA7A  FC 14 6C      D = [$146C] | OBD1: TDC offset from TPU section
	pshb                                ; AA7D  37            push B

	bra b1_loc_AB03                     ; AA93  20 6E         goto b1_loc_AB03

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; run_egr_press_filter
;   OBD1 _run_egr_press_filter (match 0.93 p1-global)
;   called from: run_6ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_egr_press_filter:

	addb >egr_v1978                     ; ABBE  FB 19 78      B += egr_v1978

	bra b1_loc_ABE5                     ; ABDE  20 05         goto b1_loc_ABE5

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; EGR_control
;   analysis [high]: EGR vacuum servo; runs every 5th pass of the fast I/O task. A scan-tool override (1DF1/1CCA
;        b4) writes the duty directly. Configuration_set_3 b7 selects simple open-loop on/off EGR by
;        engine_load_est_filtered with hysteresis k_323F/k_EGR_openloop_load_lo and a delay timer (k_3241).
;        Otherwise it runs a PI loop on desired (EGR_map_lookup) minus MEASURED_EGR_VAC. EGR is forced off below
;        CAL_EGR_MIN_R
;   OBD1 _run_egr_servo (match 0.60 p2-dataref): EGR Control
;   trigger = 6ms loop
;   called from: run_6ms_job
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; EGR_map_lookup
;   analysis [high]: Desired EGR: 3D table tbl3D_EGR_MAIN (RPM x min(CMD_PWR_FROM_APP, fuel_quantity)), minus a
;        baro correction, plus EGR_ECTS_ADJ, limited by CAL_EGR_MAX_PRESS. A minimum is applied per gear state
;        (P/N vs driving above CAL_EGR_MIN_DRIVING_VSPD). EGR is shut (MAX_PRESS) after CAL_EGR_MAX_VSPD_DLY above
;        CAL_EGR_MAX_VSPEED or when fuel exceeds a baro-dependent threshold (tblOfs2D_EGR_fuel_thresh_BARO_224
;   OBD1 get_desired_egr (match 0.87 p1-global)
;   called from: EGR_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
EGR_map_lookup:
	ldaa >engine_RPM                    ; ACDE  B6 19 86      A = engine_RPM | RPM axis: (rpm-25)*0.625 -> 0..255 across 17 points; fuel axis same scaling
	suba #$19                           ; ACE1  80 19         A -= $19(25)
	bcc b1_loc_ACE6                     ; ACE3  24 01         if A >= 0 goto b1_loc_ACE6
	clra                                ; ACE5  4F            A = 0
b1_loc_ACE6:
	cmpa #$66                           ; ACE6  81 66         compare A with $66(102)
	bls b1_loc_ACEE                     ; ACE8  23 04         if A <= $66(102) goto b1_loc_ACEE
	ldaa #$FF                           ; ACEA  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	bra b1_loc_ACF3                     ; ACEC  20 05         goto b1_loc_ACF3

	asld                                ; ACF2  05            D <<= 1

	cba                                 ; ACFA  11            compare A with B

	cmpb >k_20DA                        ; AD04  F1 20 DA      compare B with k_20DA | fuel above k_20DA (0 here) -> skip table, use 255 directly (EGR off)

	asld                                ; AD13  05            D <<= 1
	std >egr_scratch_debug              ; AD14  FD 1F 8F      egr_scratch_debug = D

	jsr >lookup_2D_offset_table         ; AD29  BD 66 C8      A = ofs2D lookup tblOfs2D_EGR_BARO_corr_20DB[A]

	psha                                ; AD44  36            push A | minimum EGR level depends on P/N vs drive and on vehicle speed
	ldab <Cal_bit_6_store               ; AD45  D6 5F         B = Cal_bit_6_store | OBD1: check for NEUTRAL flag
	andb #$50                           ; AD47  C4 50         B &= $50(80) (keep bits) | OBD1: Mask b4, b6 (Neutral, Park)
	beq b1_loc_AD50                     ; AD49  27 05         if B == 0 goto b1_loc_AD50
	ldab >CAL_EGR_MIN_PRESS_FAULT       ; AD4B  F6 20 CE      B = CAL_EGR_MIN_PRESS_FAULT | OBD1: is set to b4, EGR level
	bra b1_loc_AD5E                     ; AD4E  20 0E         goto b1_loc_AD5E

	cmpa >CAL_EGR_MIN_DRIVING_VSPD      ; AD56  B1 20 D7      compare A with CAL_EGR_MIN_DRIVING_VSPD | OBD1: 19 mph???
	bcs b1_loc_AD5E                     ; AD59  25 03         if vehicle_speed < CAL_EGR_MIN_DRIVING_VSPD goto b1_loc_AD5E | OBD1: branch if below 19 mph....
	ldab >CAL_EGR_MIN_PRESS_DRIVING     ; AD5B  F6 20 D0      B = CAL_EGR_MIN_PRESS_DRIVING | OBD1: is set at 5c...
b1_loc_AD5E:
	pula                                ; AD5E  32            pop A
	subb >EGR_BARO_CORR                 ; AD5F  F0 19 7D      B -= EGR_BARO_CORR | OBD1: limit - baro correction
	bcc b1_loc_AD65                     ; AD62  24 01         if B >= 0 goto b1_loc_AD65
	clrb                                ; AD64  5F            B = 0
b1_loc_AD65:

	tba                                 ; AD68  17            A = B
b1_loc_AD69:

	bra b1_loc_AD88                     ; AD74  20 12         goto b1_loc_AD88
b1_loc_AD76:

	cmpb >CAL_EGR_MAX_VSPD_DLY          ; AD79  F1 20 D8      compare B with CAL_EGR_MAX_VSPD_DLY | OBD1: is set to ff
	bcc b1_loc_AD83                     ; AD7C  24 05         if VSS_FAST_EGR_STOP_TIMER >= CAL_EGR_MAX_VSPD_DLY goto b1_loc_AD83 | OBD1: after 255 seconds at 60 mph, turn off egr?
	inc >VSS_FAST_EGR_STOP_TIMER        ; AD7E  7C 19 7A      VSS_FAST_EGR_STOP_TIMER++
	bra b1_loc_AD88                     ; AD81  20 05         goto b1_loc_AD88

	bra b1_loc_ADA4                     ; AD86  20 1C         goto b1_loc_ADA4
b1_loc_AD88:
