; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; do_egr_igain
;   analysis [high]: EGR integrator: gain from tbl2D_EGR_INTEGRAL_GAIN (axis = baro margin computed in
;        EGR_control) * |error|, scaled, added to or subtracted from EGR_INTEG (clamped 0..7FFF). The integrator
;        is frozen when EGR is forced (FLAGS2.7) or the duty is saturated in the same direction (anti-windup).
;   OBD1 do_egr_igain (match 0.95 p1-global)
;   called from: EGR_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
do_egr_igain:
	ldx #tbl2D_EGR_INTEGRAL_GAIN_20EA   ; ADA5  CE 20 EA      X = &tbl2D_EGR_INTEGRAL_GAIN_20EA | OBD1: flat table, 0e...0e
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; ADA8  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_EGR_INTEGRAL_GAIN_20EA[A]
	ldab >EGR_ERROR                     ; ADAB  F6 19 70      B = EGR_ERROR
	mul                                 ; ADAE  3D            D = A * B
	ldx #$8100                          ; ADAF  CE 81 00      X = $8100(33024)
	jsr >MUL32                          ; ADB2  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	tst >EGR_ERROR_SIGN                 ; ADB5  7D 19 71      test EGR_ERROR_SIGN
	bpl b1_loc_ADC6                     ; ADB8  2A 0C         if EGR_ERROR_SIGN >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_ADC6
	subd >EGR_INTEG                     ; ADBA  B3 19 72      D -= EGR_INTEG
	coma                                ; ADBD  43            A = ~A
	comb                                ; ADBE  53            B = ~B
	addd #$0001                         ; ADBF  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
	bmi b1_loc_ADD2                     ; ADC2  2B 0E         if result < 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_ADD2
	bra b1_loc_ADD5                     ; ADC4  20 0F         goto b1_loc_ADD5
b1_loc_ADC6:
	addd >EGR_INTEG                     ; ADC6  F3 19 72      D += EGR_INTEG
	bvc b1_loc_ADD0                     ; ADC9  28 05         if no overflow goto b1_loc_ADD0
	bpl b1_loc_ADD2                     ; ADCB  2A 05         if result >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_ADD2
	ldd #$7FFF                          ; ADCD  CC 7F FF      D = $7FFF(32767)
b1_loc_ADD0:
	bpl b1_loc_ADD5                     ; ADD0  2A 03         if result >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_ADD5
b1_loc_ADD2:
	ldd #$0000                          ; ADD2  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
b1_loc_ADD5:
	xgdx                                ; ADD5  8F            swap D <-> X
	brset <FLAGS2,$80,b1_loc_ADE8       ; ADD6  12 4A 80 0E   if FLAGS2 .7 EGR forced/open-loop (integrator frozen) set goto b1_loc_ADE8 | anti-windup: keep old integrator when forced or duty saturated in error direction
	ldaa >EGR_PWM_duty                  ; ADDA  B6 18 0F      A = EGR_PWM_duty
	beq b1_loc_ADE3                     ; ADDD  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_ADE3
	inca                                ; ADDF  4C            A++
	bne b1_loc_ADEB                     ; ADE0  26 09         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_ADEB
	deca                                ; ADE2  4A            A--
b1_loc_ADE3:
	cmpa >EGR_ERROR_SIGN                ; ADE3  B1 19 71      compare A with EGR_ERROR_SIGN
	beq b1_loc_ADEB                     ; ADE6  27 03         if A == EGR_ERROR_SIGN goto b1_loc_ADEB
b1_loc_ADE8:
	ldx >EGR_INTEG                      ; ADE8  FE 19 72      X = EGR_INTEG
b1_loc_ADEB:
	stx >EGR_INTEG                      ; ADEB  FF 19 72      EGR_INTEG = X
	rts                                 ; ADEE  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; do_egr_pgain
;   analysis [high]: EGR proportional term: gain from tbl2D_EGR_duty_20FC * |error|, scaled via sub_6A3F, negated
;        when EGR_ERROR_SIGN is negative; returned in D.
;   OBD1 do_egr_pgain (match 1.00 p1-exact)
;   called from: EGR_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
do_egr_pgain:
	ldx #tbl2D_EGR_duty_20FC            ; ADEF  CE 20 FC      X = &tbl2D_EGR_duty_20FC | OBD1: a0..ff..c8  wavy 1 line table
	jsr >lookup_2D_table                ; ADF2  BD 6D 06      A = 2D lookup tbl2D_EGR_duty_20FC[A]
	ldab >EGR_ERROR                     ; ADF5  F6 19 70      B = EGR_ERROR
	mul                                 ; ADF8  3D            D = A * B
	ldx #$8100                          ; ADF9  CE 81 00      X = $8100(33024)
	jsr >MUL32                          ; ADFC  BD 6A 3F      call MUL32
	tst >EGR_ERROR_SIGN                 ; ADFF  7D 19 71      test EGR_ERROR_SIGN
	bpl b1_loc_AE09                     ; AE02  2A 05         if EGR_ERROR_SIGN >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_AE09
	coma                                ; AE04  43            A = ~A
	comb                                ; AE05  53            B = ~B
	addd #$0001                         ; AE06  C3 00 01      D += $0001(1)
b1_loc_AE09:
	rts                                 ; AE09  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; EGR_vent_and_baro_sample_AE0A
;   analysis [medium]: Controls the EGR vent solenoid (IOR_1800 b3) and baro sampling. It clears b3 (vent) when
;        EGR is disabled/faulted (FLAGS2.7, DTC bits 0028 b0/b1) or when the over-vacuum error >
;        CAL_EGR_VENT_PRESS (FLAGS2.6). After CAL_EGR_BARO_DELAY ticks vented it copies the AN7 sensor into
;        BARO_VOLTAGE and sets $C7.2. Otherwise it sets b3 and clears the timer. Scan-tool override via 1CC5/1CC6
;        b1.
;   OBD1 write_egr_duty_cycle (match 0.56 p2-dataref)
;   called from: EGR_control
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
EGR_vent_and_baro_sample_AE0A:
	ldx #IOR_1800                       ; AE0A  CE 18 00      X = &IOR_1800
	ldaa >serial_v1DF1                  ; AE0D  B6 1D F1      A = serial_v1DF1
	bita #$10                           ; AE10  85 10         test serial_v1DF1 .4
	beq b1_loc_AE24                     ; AE12  27 10         if serial_v1DF1 .4 all clear goto b1_loc_AE24
	ldaa >serial_v1CC5                  ; AE14  B6 1C C5      A = serial_v1CC5
	bita #$02                           ; AE17  85 02         test serial_v1CC5 .1
	beq b1_loc_AE24                     ; AE19  27 09         if serial_v1CC5 .1 all clear goto b1_loc_AE24
	ldaa >glow_v1CC6                    ; AE1B  B6 1C C6      A = glow_v1CC6
	bita #$02                           ; AE1E  85 02         test glow_v1CC6 .1
	beq b1_loc_AE44                     ; AE20  27 22         if glow_v1CC6 .1 all clear goto b1_loc_AE44
	bra b1_loc_AE68                     ; AE22  20 44         goto b1_loc_AE68
b1_loc_AE24:
	brset <$28,$01,b1_loc_AE44          ; AE24  12 28 01 1C   if [$28] .0 set goto b1_loc_AE44 | vent conditions: EGR DTC, forced off, or over-vacuum beyond CAL_EGR_VENT_PRESS
	brset <$28,$02,b1_loc_AE44          ; AE28  12 28 02 18   if [$28] .1 set goto b1_loc_AE44
	brset <FLAGS2,$80,b1_loc_AE44       ; AE2C  12 4A 80 14   if FLAGS2 .7 EGR forced/open-loop (integrator frozen) set goto b1_loc_AE44
	brset <diag_misc_flags,$02,b1_loc_AE68; AE30  12 C7 02 34   if diag_misc_flags .1 set goto b1_loc_AE68
	ldaa >EGR_ERROR_SIGN                ; AE34  B6 19 71      A = EGR_ERROR_SIGN
	bmi b1_loc_AE68                     ; AE37  2B 2F         if A < 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_AE68
	ldaa >EGR_ERROR                     ; AE39  B6 19 70      A = EGR_ERROR
	cmpa >CAL_EGR_VENT_PRESS            ; AE3C  B1 20 D5      compare A with CAL_EGR_VENT_PRESS
	bls b1_loc_AE4C                     ; AE3F  23 0B         if EGR_ERROR <= CAL_EGR_VENT_PRESS goto b1_loc_AE4C
	bset <FLAGS2,$40                    ; AE41  14 4A 40      FLAGS2 .6 = 1
b1_loc_AE44:
	bclr $00,x,$08                      ; AE44  1D 00 08      [X+0] .3 = 0
	bset <FLAGS2,$20                    ; AE47  14 4A 20      FLAGS2 .5 = 1
	bra b1_loc_AE50                     ; AE4A  20 04         goto b1_loc_AE50
b1_loc_AE4C:
	brclr <FLAGS2,$40,b1_loc_AE68       ; AE4C  13 4A 40 18   if FLAGS2 .6 clear goto b1_loc_AE68
b1_loc_AE50:
	ldaa >EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER         ; AE50  B6 19 7B      A = EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER | sensor vented: after CAL_EGR_BARO_DELAY ticks it reads baro -> BARO_VOLTAGE
	cmpa >CAL_EGR_BARO_DELAY            ; AE53  B1 20 D9      compare A with CAL_EGR_BARO_DELAY
	bcc b1_loc_AE5D                     ; AE56  24 05         if EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER >= CAL_EGR_BARO_DELAY goto b1_loc_AE5D
	inc >EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER          ; AE58  7C 19 7B      EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER++
	bra b1_loc_AE74                     ; AE5B  20 17         goto b1_loc_AE74
b1_loc_AE5D:
	ldaa >ADC_AN7_EGR_baro_pressure     ; AE5D  B6 19 0A      A = ADC_AN7_EGR_baro_pressure
	staa >BARO_VOLTAGE                  ; AE60  B7 19 2D      BARO_VOLTAGE = A
	bset <diag_misc_flags,$04           ; AE63  14 C7 04      diag_misc_flags .2 = 1
	bra b1_loc_AE74                     ; AE66  20 0C         goto b1_loc_AE74
b1_loc_AE68:
	bset $00,x,$08                      ; AE68  1C 00 08      [X+0] .3 = 1
	bclr <FLAGS2,$20                    ; AE6B  15 4A 20      FLAGS2 .5 = 0
	bclr <FLAGS2,$40                    ; AE6E  15 4A 40      FLAGS2 .6 = 0
	clr >EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER          ; AE71  7F 19 7B      EGR_BARO_SAMPLE_TIMER = 0
b1_loc_AE74:
	rts                                 ; AE74  39            return
	fcb	$39                                                             ; AE75  no traced path reaches these bytes; as code: rts

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; EGR_baro_flow_test_AE76
;   analysis [low]: Misaligned banner (AF2A is mid-instruction): the real entry is b1:AE76, called from bank-0
;        ED59 via far_b1_AE76_7CB9. It first checks the AN7 EGR/baro sensor for out of range high/low with fail
;        counters 1A88/1A89 (limit k_368C) and sets P0405/P0406. It then runs an intrusive EGR flow test: it
;        forces EGR off/on ($C7 b0/b1), compares sensor readings and baro (temperature-corrected via
;        k_375A/k_375B)
;   inferred [A, pass A]: sets/clears DTC record(s) P0102, P0103, P0107, P0108, P0112, P0113, P0117, P0118, P0182,
;        P0183, P0215, P0216, P0219, P0231, P0236, P0237, P0238, P0380, P0501, P0567, P0568, P0571, P1627, P1635,
;        P1641, P1643, P1653, P1654, P1656
;   inferred [A, pass A]: sets/clears DTC record(s) P0102, P0103, P0107, P0108, P0112, P0113, P0117, P0118, P0182,
;        P0183, P0215, P0216, P0219, P0231, P0236, P0237, P0238, P0380, P0405, P0406, P0501, P0567, P0568, P0571,
;        P1627, P1635, P1641, P1643, P1653, P1654, P1656

b1_loc_AEA6:

b1_loc_AEA9:

;   called from: calc_engine_torque_est_from_NA_fuel_derate_BARO_C586

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; calc_AC_load_torque_C687
;   analysis [medium]: A/C compressor load term. If MUX9_AC_request < $56 (A/C off), the result $1CBA = 0, the
;        ramp $1CB8 is cleared and the hold timer $1CB9 is reloaded with k_4D17. Otherwise, while $1CB9 runs down,
;        the kick $1CB8 rises toward k_4D18 (engagement spike); afterwards it decays. $1CBA =

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; add_A_to_download_checksum_CBA1
;   analysis [high]: Adds byte A into the 16-bit running checksum $1F76:$1F77, carrying into the high byte. Used
;        by the mode $36 download handler.
;   called from: J1850_mode36_download_execute_CA64
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_A_to_download_checksum_CBA1:
	adda >ram_v1F77                     ; CBA1  BB 1F 77      A += ram_v1F77
	staa >ram_v1F77                     ; CBA4  B7 1F 77      ram_v1F77 = A
	ldaa >download_checksum             ; CBA7  B6 1F 76      A = download_checksum
	adca #$00                           ; CBAA  89 00         A += C + 0
	staa >download_checksum             ; CBAC  B7 1F 76      download_checksum = A
	rts                                 ; CBAF  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; J1850_mode36_download_execute_part_CBB0
;   analysis [low]: Kicks the watchdogs, then polls the external J1850 controller word at $0C02 (up to 983 tries)
;        until status bits 7-5 are non-zero. Returns the data byte (2nd byte) in A. C=1 means status >= $A0 with
;        no error bits, C=0 means status < $A0. On timeout, or if the data byte has bit 6 or 7 set, it loops
;        forever so the watchdog resets the ECM. Called from b1_sub_CA64.
;   inferred [C, pass B]: only called from J1850_mode36_download_execute_CA64
;   called from: J1850_mode36_download_execute_CA64
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
J1850_mode36_download_execute_part_CBB0:
	pshb                                ; CBB0  37            push B
	pshy                                ; CBB1  18 3C         push Y
	ldy #$03D7                          ; CBB3  18 CE 03 D7   Y = $03D7(983)
	jsr >service_COP_watchdogs_CBEC     ; CBB7  BD CB EC      call service_COP_watchdogs_CBEC
b1_loc_CBBA:
	dey                                 ; CBBA  18 09         Y--
	bne b1_loc_CBC1                     ; CBBC  26 03         if Y != 0 goto b1_loc_CBC1
	jmp >b1_loc_CBE6                    ; CBBE  7E CB E6      goto b1_loc_CBE6
b1_loc_CBC1:
	ldaa >J1850_DLC_cmd                 ; CBC1  B6 0C 02      A = J1850_DLC_cmd | poll external J1850 controller status ($0C02) until any of bits 7-5 set; Y=983 tries
	bita #$E0                           ; CBC4  85 E0         test J1850_DLC_cmd .5,.6,.7
	beq b1_loc_CBBA                     ; CBC6  27 F2         if J1850_DLC_cmd .5,.6,.7 all clear goto b1_loc_CBBA
	staa >serial_v1F7C                  ; CBC8  B7 1F 7C      serial_v1F7C = A
	ldd >J1850_DLC_cmd                  ; CBCB  FC 0C 02      D = J1850_DLC_cmd
	cmpa >serial_v1F7C                  ; CBCE  B1 1F 7C      compare A with serial_v1F7C
	bls b1_loc_CBD6                     ; CBD1  23 03         if J1850_DLC_cmd <= serial_v1F7C goto b1_loc_CBD6
	ldaa >serial_v1F7C                  ; CBD3  B6 1F 7C      A = serial_v1F7C
b1_loc_CBD6:
	puly                                ; CBD6  18 38         pop Y
	cmpa #$A0                           ; CBD8  81 A0         compare A with $A0(160)
	bcc b1_loc_CBDF                     ; CBDA  24 03         if A >= $A0(160) goto b1_loc_CBDF
	clc                                 ; CBDC  0C            C = 0
	bra b1_loc_CBE9                     ; CBDD  20 0A         goto b1_loc_CBE9
b1_loc_CBDF:
	bitb #$40                           ; CBDF  C5 40         test B mask $40(64)
	bne b1_loc_CBE6                     ; CBE1  26 03         if any of mask $40(64) set goto b1_loc_CBE6
	tstb                                ; CBE3  5D            test B
	bpl b1_loc_CBE8                     ; CBE4  2A 02         if B >= 0 (signed) goto b1_loc_CBE8
b1_loc_CBE6:
	bra b1_loc_CBE6                     ; CBE6  20 FE         goto b1_loc_CBE6 | deliberate endless loop: timeout or error bit -> let the COP/IOR watchdog reset the ECM
b1_loc_CBE8:
	sec                                 ; CBE8  0D            C = 1
b1_loc_CBE9:
	tba                                 ; CBE9  17            A = B
	pulb                                ; CBEA  33            pop B
	rts                                 ; CBEB  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; service_COP_watchdogs_CBEC
;   analysis [high]: Writes the $55/$AA arming sequence to both the HC11 COPRST register and the external watchdog
;        on the IOR chip (IOR_COP $1806).
;   OBD1 LF0A6 (match 0.84 p2-dataref)
;   called from: J1850_mode36_download_execute_part_CBB0
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
service_COP_watchdogs_CBEC:
	ldab #$55                           ; CBEC  C6 55         B = $55(85)
	stab >COPRST                        ; CBEE  F7 10 3A      COPRST = B
	stab >IOR_COP                       ; CBF1  F7 18 06      IOR_COP = B
	ldab #$AA                           ; CBF4  C6 AA         B = $AA(170)
	stab >COPRST                        ; CBF6  F7 10 3A      COPRST = B
	stab >IOR_COP                       ; CBF9  F7 18 06      IOR_COP = B
	rts                                 ; CBFC  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; J1850_rx_message_process_CBFD
;   analysis [medium]: Called from the background loop at 5F24 with bank 1 selected (bank-0 bytes at CBFD are not
;        code). Stage 1 drains the J1850 receive ring (five 16-byte slots, $1CE2-$1D31, read ptr $1D34,
;        byte+15=$AA means full). Frames addressed to OBD2 functional $6A, broadcast $FE or this ECM's own address
;        (k_329C) are copied into the diag request queue ($1D45-$1D74, write ptr $1D75). On queue overflow it sets
;        $1
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
J1850_rx_message_process_CBFD:
	ldy >J1850_rx_ring_rd_ptr           ; CBFD  18 FE 1D 34   Y = J1850_rx_ring_rd_ptr | J1850 rx ring: 5 slots x 16 bytes $1CE2-$1D31, byte+15=$AA marks slot full
	ldaa $0F,y                          ; CC01  18 A6 0F      A = [Y+15]

b1_loc_CC0B:
	ldab $00,y                          ; CC0B  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0] | header byte: (b3 inverted, b4) must be 0, else drop frame; b2 = physical vs functional addressing
	eorb #$08                           ; CC0E  C8 08         B ^= 8

	cmpa #$6A                           ; CC1E  81 6A         compare A with $6A(106)
	beq b1_loc_CC37                     ; CC20  27 15         if [Y+1] == $6A(106) goto b1_loc_CC37
	jsr >serial_task_CDCC               ; CC22  BD CD CC      call serial_task_CDCC
	jmp >b1_loc_CC92                    ; CC25  7E CC 92      goto b1_loc_CC92

	cmpa #$FE                           ; CC2B  81 FE         compare A with $FE(254)
	beq b1_loc_CC37                     ; CC2D  27 08         if [Y+1] == $FE(254) goto b1_loc_CC37
	cmpa >k_J1850_ECM_node_addr_329C    ; CC2F  B1 32 9C      compare A with k_J1850_ECM_node_addr_329C

	jmp >b1_loc_CC92                    ; CC34  7E CC 92      goto b1_loc_CC92
b1_loc_CC37:
	ldx >diag_req_queue_wr_ptr          ; CC37  FE 1D 75      X = diag_req_queue_wr_ptr | copy frame into diag queue (3 x 16 bytes $1D45-$1D74); queue full -> set overflow flag $1D92.3
	ldaa $0F,x                          ; CC3A  A6 0F         A = [X+15]
	cmpa #$AA                           ; CC3C  81 AA         compare A with $AA(170)
	bne b1_loc_CC4A                     ; CC3E  26 0A         if [X+15] != $AA(170) goto b1_loc_CC4A
	ldaa >serial_v1D92                  ; CC40  B6 1D 92      A = serial_v1D92
	oraa #$08                           ; CC43  8A 08         A |= 8
	staa >serial_v1D92                  ; CC45  B7 1D 92      serial_v1D92 = A

b1_loc_CC4A:

	std $00,x                           ; CC4D  ED 00         [X+0] = D
	ldd $02,y                           ; CC4F  18 EC 02      D = [Y+2]
	std $02,x                           ; CC52  ED 02         [X+2] = D
	ldd $04,y                           ; CC54  18 EC 04      D = [Y+4]
	std $04,x                           ; CC57  ED 04         [X+4] = D
	ldd $06,y                           ; CC59  18 EC 06      D = [Y+6]
	std $06,x                           ; CC5C  ED 06         [X+6] = D
	ldd $08,y                           ; CC5E  18 EC 08      D = [Y+8]
	std $08,x                           ; CC61  ED 08         [X+8] = D
	ldd $0A,y                           ; CC63  18 EC 0A      D = [Y+10]
	std $0A,x                           ; CC66  ED 0A         [X+10] = D
	ldd $0C,y                           ; CC68  18 EC 0C      D = [Y+12]
	std $0C,x                           ; CC6B  ED 0C         [X+12] = D
	ldd $0E,y                           ; CC6D  18 EC 0E      D = [Y+14]
	std $0E,x                           ; CC70  ED 0E         [X+14] = D
	ldd $0C,y                           ; CC72  18 EC 0C      D = [Y+12] | rebase the slot's end pointer (byte 12) to the new buffer; bytes CC7D-CC7F are really 'stx $0C,y'
	subd >J1850_rx_ring_rd_ptr          ; CC75  B3 1D 34      D -= J1850_rx_ring_rd_ptr

	addd #$0010                         ; CC83  C3 00 10      D += $0010(16)

	bcs b1_loc_CC8F                     ; CC8A  25 03         if D < $1D75(7541) goto b1_loc_CC8F

	ldaa $0F,y                          ; CCBC  18 A6 0F      A = [Y+15]
	cmpa #$AA                           ; CCBF  81 AA         compare A with $AA(170)
	beq b1_loc_CCC5                     ; CCC1  27 02         if [Y+15] == $AA(170) goto b1_loc_CCC5
	bra b1_loc_CD33                     ; CCC3  20 6E         goto b1_loc_CD33
b1_loc_CCC5:
	ldx #diag_tx_buffer                 ; CCC5  CE 1D 79      X = &diag_tx_buffer
	ldab $00,y                          ; CCC8  18 E6 00      B = [Y+0]
	bitb #$04                           ; CCCB  C5 04         test [Y+0] .2
	bne b1_loc_CCE4                     ; CCCD  26 15         if any of [Y+0] .2 set goto b1_loc_CCE4
	bset <serial_v008D,$10              ; CCCF  14 8D 10      serial_v008D .4 diag response header built = 1 | functional reply header: priority byte, target $6B (OBD2 response), source = own address k_329C
	ldaa $00,y                          ; CCD2  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	anda #$DF                           ; CCD5  84 DF         A &= $DF(223) (keep bits)
	staa $00,x                          ; CCD7  A7 00         diag_tx_buffer = A
	ldaa #$6B                           ; CCD9  86 6B         A = $6B(107)
	staa $01,x                          ; CCDB  A7 01         diag_tx_buffer+1 = A
	ldaa >k_J1850_ECM_node_addr_329C    ; CCDD  B6 32 9C      A = k_J1850_ECM_node_addr_329C
	staa $02,x                          ; CCE0  A7 02         diag_tx_buffer+2 = A

b1_loc_CCE4:
	bset <serial_v008D,$10              ; CCE4  14 8D 10      serial_v008D .4 diag response header built = 1 | physical reply: target = requester (req byte 2), source = own addr (k_329C if request was to $FE)
	ldaa $00,y                          ; CCE7  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; CCEA  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	ldaa $02,y                          ; CCEC  18 A6 02      A = [Y+2]
	staa $01,x                          ; CCEF  A7 01         [X+1] = A
	ldaa $01,y                          ; CCF1  18 A6 01      A = [Y+1]

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; diag_read_mem_byte_checked_DCF5
;   analysis [high]: Reads the byte at X for diagnostic memory access (DPID-by-address, mode $2C). Returns C=0 and
;        A=byte if X is allowed: internal RAM <$0400 (except $0037/$0038), TIO $1400-$17FF (16-bit regs read as a
;        word, correct half returned), ext RAM $1810-$1FFF. Returns C=1, A=0 for everything else (regs, IOR
;        $1800-$180F, calibration/flash >= $2000).
;   called from: J1850_mode23_read_memory_DCA5, J1850_mode2C_define_DPID_E06C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	cpx #k_2000                         ; DCF5  8C 20 00      compare X with &k_2000 | address >= $2000 (cal/flash), IOR $1800-$180F and regs $0400-$13FF are not readable -> C=1
	bcc b1_loc_DD36                     ; DCF8  24 3C         if X >= &k_2000 goto b1_loc_DD36

	bcc b1_loc_DD27                     ; DCFD  24 28         if X >= &RAM_valid_signature goto b1_loc_DD27
	cpx #IOR_1800                       ; DCFF  8C 18 00      compare X with &IOR_1800

	bcs b1_loc_DD22                     ; DD07  25 19         if X < $1400(5120) goto b1_loc_DD22
	xgdx                                ; DD09  8F            swap D <-> X | TIO chip $1400-$17FF: 16-bit registers, read the whole word, return the wanted half
	rorb                                ; DD0A  56            B rotate right thru C
	bcc b1_loc_DD19                     ; DD0B  24 0C         if X >= $1400(5120) goto b1_loc_DD19
	rolb                                ; DD0D  59            B rotate left thru C
	xgdx                                ; DD0E  8F            swap D <-> X
	dex                                 ; DD0F  09            X--
	ldaa $00,x                          ; DD10  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	nop                                 ; DD12  01          
	ldd $00,x                           ; DD13  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	tba                                 ; DD15  17            A = B
	inx                                 ; DD16  08            X++
	bra b1_loc_DD33                     ; DD17  20 1A         goto b1_loc_DD33

	beq b1_loc_DD36                     ; DD2F  27 05         if X == $0038(56) goto b1_loc_DD36

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; J1850_tx_frame_from_desc_EA4B
;   analysis [medium]: Writes one J1850 frame to the DLC chip (cmd $0C02 / data $0C03): header=[X+0]|[[X+10]+6],
;        target=[X+1], source=k_329C ($10 = ECM node), mode byte [X+2] (+$80/$40 from $8F.2/.1), then [X+3]-1

;   called from: calc_J1850_DLC_cmd_E8B5

	stab >J1850_DLC_cmd                 ; EA55  F7 0C 02      J1850_DLC_cmd = B

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	psha                                ; EB71  36            push A
	stab >DTC_select_byte_idx           ; EB72  F7 1D F2      DTC_select_byte_idx = B
	clrb                                ; EB75  5F            B = 0
	bra b1_loc_EB34                     ; EB76  20 BC         goto b1_loc_EB34
b1_loc_EB78:
	ins                                 ; EB78  31            SP++
	rts                                 ; EB79  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_status_src_ptrs_EB7A  (data EB7A-EB89)
;   DTC flag arrays used for the status byte (RAM) + cal 380C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_status_src_ptrs_EB7A:
	; DATA: 8 flag-array pointers $02A5,$0021,$0011,$0278,$0287,$0296,$0001,$380C (not code)
	fdb	DTC_MIL_request,DTC_first_set_flags,DTC_passed_this_trip,DTC_confirmed_flags,DTC_history_flags,DTC_test_incomplete,DTC_current_flags,DTC_diag_enable_mask; EB7A

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_select_bitmap_count_EB8A
;   analysis [medium]: Real code after the EB7A pointer table, no label/banner. Counts set bits in $1E07-$1E15 and
;        returns the number of selected DTCs in A ($FF on overflow).
;   called from: J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_DB44
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_select_bitmap_count_EB8A:
	ldx #DTC_select_bitmap              ; EB8A  CE 1E 07      X = &DTC_select_bitmap | entry: count selected DTCs in $1E07-$1E15
	clra                                ; EB8D  4F            A = 0
b1_loc_EB8E:
	ldab $00,x                          ; EB8E  E6 00         B = [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EB9F                     ; EB90  27 0D         if B == 0 goto b1_loc_EB9F
b1_loc_EB92:
	aslb                                ; EB92  58            B <<= 1
	beq b1_loc_EB9C                     ; EB93  27 07         if B == 0 goto b1_loc_EB9C
	bcc b1_loc_EB92                     ; EB95  24 FB         if B >= 0 goto b1_loc_EB92
	inca                                ; EB97  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_EBA7                     ; EB98  27 0D         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EBA7
	bra b1_loc_EB92                     ; EB9A  20 F6         goto b1_loc_EB92
b1_loc_EB9C:
	inca                                ; EB9C  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_EBA7                     ; EB9D  27 08         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EBA7
b1_loc_EB9F:
	inx                                 ; EB9F  08            X++
	cpx #DTC_status_req_mask            ; EBA0  8C 1E 16      compare X with &DTC_status_req_mask
	bne b1_loc_EB8E                     ; EBA3  26 E9         if X != &DTC_status_req_mask goto b1_loc_EB8E
	bra b1_loc_EBA9                     ; EBA5  20 02         goto b1_loc_EBA9
b1_loc_EBA7:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; EBA7  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
b1_loc_EBA9:
	rts                                 ; EBA9  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_select_next_EBAA
;   analysis [medium]: No banner. Scans the selection bitmap from byte index $1DF2 for the next set bit; returns
;        its mask in $1DF4 (byte index in $1DF2) and clears it from the bitmap. When none remain sets
;        $1DF2=$1DF4=$FF.
;   called from: J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_DB44, J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_cont_DBB1
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_select_next_EBAA:
	ldab >DTC_select_byte_idx           ; EBAA  F6 1D F2      B = DTC_select_byte_idx
b1_loc_EBAD:
	ldx #DTC_select_bitmap              ; EBAD  CE 1E 07      X = &DTC_select_bitmap
	abx                                 ; EBB0  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; EBB1  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_EBBF                     ; EBB3  26 0A         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_EBBF
	incb                                ; EBB5  5C            B++
	cmpb #$0F                           ; EBB6  C1 0F         compare B with $0F(15)
	beq b1_loc_EBD3                     ; EBB8  27 19         if B == $0F(15) goto b1_loc_EBD3
	stab >DTC_select_byte_idx           ; EBBA  F7 1D F2      DTC_select_byte_idx = B
	bra b1_loc_EBAD                     ; EBBD  20 EE         goto b1_loc_EBAD
b1_loc_EBBF:
	ldab #$01                           ; EBBF  C6 01         B = 1
b1_loc_EBC1:
	tba                                 ; EBC1  17            A = B
	anda $00,x                          ; EBC2  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_EBC9                     ; EBC4  26 03         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_EBC9
	aslb                                ; EBC6  58            B <<= 1
	bra b1_loc_EBC1                     ; EBC7  20 F8         goto b1_loc_EBC1
b1_loc_EBC9:
	stab >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EBC9  F7 1D F4      DTC_select_bit_mask = B
	comb                                ; EBCC  53            B = ~B
	andb $00,x                          ; EBCD  E4 00         B &= [X+0]
	stab $00,x                          ; EBCF  E7 00         [X+0] = B
	bra b1_loc_EBDB                     ; EBD1  20 08         goto b1_loc_EBDB
b1_loc_EBD3:
	ldaa #$FF                           ; EBD3  86 FF         A = $FF(255)
	staa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EBD5  B7 1D F4      DTC_select_bit_mask = A
	staa >DTC_select_byte_idx           ; EBD8  B7 1D F2      DTC_select_byte_idx = A
b1_loc_EBDB:
	rts                                 ; EBDB  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_bit_to_code_EBDC
;   analysis [medium]: Converts a DTC flag position (A = bit mask, B = byte index) into the DTC record at $50EB +
;        (B*8+bit)*4 and returns X = word at record+2 (the P-code number). A=0 returns X=0.
;   called from: J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_DB44, J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_cont_DBB1
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_bit_to_code_EBDC:
	pshb                                ; EBDC  37            push B
	tsta                                ; EBDD  4D            test A
	bne b1_loc_EBE6                     ; EBDE  26 06         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_EBE6
	pulb                                ; EBE0  33            pop B
	ldx #ram_v0000                      ; EBE1  CE 00 00      X = &ram_v0000
	bra b1_loc_EBFA                     ; EBE4  20 14         goto b1_loc_EBFA
b1_loc_EBE6:
	ldab #$FF                           ; EBE6  C6 FF         B = $FF(255) | convert bit mask to bit number; record index = byte*8+bit, 4-byte DTC records at $50EB
b1_loc_EBE8:
	lsra                                ; EBE8  44            A >>= 1
	incb                                ; EBE9  5C            B++
	bcc b1_loc_EBE8                     ; EBEA  24 FC         if B >= 0 goto b1_loc_EBE8
	pula                                ; EBEC  32            pop A
	asla                                ; EBED  48            A <<= 1
	asla                                ; EBEE  48            A <<= 1
	asla                                ; EBEF  48            A <<= 1
	aba                                 ; EBF0  1B            A += B
	ldab #$04                           ; EBF1  C6 04         B = 4
	mul                                 ; EBF3  3D            D = A * B
	addd #$50EB                         ; EBF4  C3 50 EB      D += $50EB(20715)
	xgdx                                ; EBF7  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldx $02,x                           ; EBF8  EE 02         X = [X+2]
b1_loc_EBFA:
	rts                                 ; EBFA  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_build_status_byte_EBFB
;   analysis [medium]: Builds the J1850 DTC status byte for DTC (mask A, byte B): b0 always 1, b1 current $0001,
;        b2 $0296, b3 history $0287, b4 $0278, b5 set when $0011 bit is CLEAR, b6 first-set $0021, b7 $02A5.
;        Returned in A. (b1_sub_EC00/EC3D/EC58 labels inside are false fdb-derived labels.)
;   called from: J1850_mode17_read_DTC_by_number_DABA, J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_DB44, J1850_mode19_read_DTCs_by_status_cont_DBB1
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_build_status_byte_EBFB:
	staa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EBFB  B7 1D F4      DTC_select_bit_mask = A
	ldaa #$01                           ; EBFE  86 01         A = 1
	psha                                ; EC00  36            push A
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC01  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_MIL_request                ; EC04  CE 02 A5      X = &DTC_MIL_request
	abx                                 ; EC07  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC08  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC10                     ; EC0A  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC10
	pula                                ; EC0C  32            pop A
	oraa #$80                           ; EC0D  8A 80         A |= $80(128)
	psha                                ; EC0F  36            push A
b1_loc_EC10:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC10  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_first_set_flags            ; EC13  CE 00 21      X = &DTC_first_set_flags
	abx                                 ; EC16  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC17  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC1F                     ; EC19  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC1F
	pula                                ; EC1B  32            pop A
	oraa #$40                           ; EC1C  8A 40         A |= $40(64)
	psha                                ; EC1E  36            push A
b1_loc_EC1F:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC1F  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_passed_this_trip           ; EC22  CE 00 11      X = &DTC_passed_this_trip
	abx                                 ; EC25  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC26  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_EC2E                     ; EC28  26 04         if A != 0 goto b1_loc_EC2E
	pula                                ; EC2A  32            pop A
	oraa #$20                           ; EC2B  8A 20         A |= $20(32)
	psha                                ; EC2D  36            push A
b1_loc_EC2E:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC2E  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_confirmed_flags            ; EC31  CE 02 78      X = &DTC_confirmed_flags
	abx                                 ; EC34  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC35  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC3D                     ; EC37  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC3D
	pula                                ; EC39  32            pop A
	oraa #$10                           ; EC3A  8A 10         A |= $10(16)
	psha                                ; EC3C  36            push A
b1_loc_EC3D:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC3D  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_history_flags              ; EC40  CE 02 87      X = &DTC_history_flags
	abx                                 ; EC43  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC44  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC4C                     ; EC46  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC4C
	pula                                ; EC48  32            pop A
	oraa #$08                           ; EC49  8A 08         A |= 8
	psha                                ; EC4B  36            push A
b1_loc_EC4C:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC4C  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_test_incomplete            ; EC4F  CE 02 96      X = &DTC_test_incomplete
	abx                                 ; EC52  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC53  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC5B                     ; EC55  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC5B
	pula                                ; EC57  32            pop A
	oraa #$04                           ; EC58  8A 04         A |= 4
	psha                                ; EC5A  36            push A
b1_loc_EC5B:
	ldaa >DTC_select_bit_mask           ; EC5B  B6 1D F4      A = DTC_select_bit_mask
	ldx #DTC_current_flags              ; EC5E  CE 00 01      X = &DTC_current_flags
	abx                                 ; EC61  3A            X += B
	anda $00,x                          ; EC62  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_EC6A                     ; EC64  27 04         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_EC6A
	pula                                ; EC66  32            pop A

b1_loc_EC6A:

	rts                                 ; EC6B  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; binary_search_records_EC6C
;   analysis [medium]: Binary search of a sorted table of fixed-size records for the 16-bit key in $1DFD. In: X =
;        table start, Y = table end, A = key offset in record, B = record size. Out: D = record index and X =
;        record address ($1DFF), or D=$FFFF if not found. Used to find PID definition records for mode $22/$2C
;        requests.
;   called from: J1850_OBD_mode01_current_data_D63B, J1850_mode17_read_DTC_by_number_DABA, J1850_mode22_read_by_PID_DC3B, J1850_mode2C_define_DPID_E06C
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
binary_search_records_EC6C:
	pshb                                ; EC6C  37            push B | binary search: count = (end-start)/recsize, compare word at rec+keyofs with $1DFD
	psha                                ; EC6D  36            push A
	pshx                                ; EC6E  3C            push X
	xgdy                                ; EC6F  18 8F         swap D <-> Y
	tsy                                 ; EC71  18 30         Y = SP + 1
	subd $00,y                          ; EC73  18 A3 00      D -= [Y+0]
	ldx $02,y                           ; EC76  CD EE 02      X = [Y+2]
	xgdx                                ; EC79  8F            swap D <-> X
	clra                                ; EC7A  4F            A = 0
	xgdx                                ; EC7B  8F            swap D <-> X
	idiv                                ; EC7C  02            X = D / X, D = remainder
	cpx #$FFFF                          ; EC7D  8C FF FF      compare X with $FFFF(65535) | idiv by 0 (record size 0) -> not found
	bne b1_loc_EC85                     ; EC80  26 03         if X != $FFFF(65535) goto b1_loc_EC85
	jmp >b1_loc_ED16                    ; EC82  7E ED 16      goto b1_loc_ED16
b1_loc_EC85:
	stx >search_hi                      ; EC85  FF 1E 03      search_hi = X
	ldd #$0000                          ; EC88  CC 00 00      D = $0000(0)
	std >search_lo                      ; EC8B  FD 1E 01      search_lo = D
b1_loc_EC8E:
	ldd >search_hi                      ; EC8E  FC 1E 03      D = search_hi
	subd >search_lo                     ; EC91  B3 1E 01      D -= search_lo
	cpd #$0001                          ; EC94  1A 83 00 01   compare D with $0001(1)
	beq b1_loc_ECD2                     ; EC98  27 38         if D == $0001(1) goto b1_loc_ECD2
	lsrd                                ; EC9A  04            D >>= 1
	addd >search_lo                     ; EC9B  F3 1E 01      D += search_lo
	std >search_mid                     ; EC9E  FD 1E 05      search_mid = D
	ldaa $03,y                          ; ECA1  18 A6 03      A = [Y+3]
	mul                                 ; ECA4  3D            D = A * B
	tst >search_mid                     ; ECA5  7D 1E 05      test search_mid
	beq b1_loc_ECAD                     ; ECA8  27 03         if search_mid == 0 goto b1_loc_ECAD
	adda $03,y                          ; ECAA  18 AB 03      A += [Y+3]
b1_loc_ECAD:
	addd $00,y                          ; ECAD  18 E3 00      D += [Y+0]
	std >search_result_ptr              ; ECB0  FD 1D FF      search_result_ptr = D
	xgdx                                ; ECB3  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldab $02,y                          ; ECB4  18 E6 02      B = [Y+2]
	abx                                 ; ECB7  3A            X += B
	ldd $00,x                           ; ECB8  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	cpd >search_key_PID                 ; ECBA  1A B3 1D FD   compare D with search_key_PID
	beq b1_loc_ED1B                     ; ECBE  27 5B         if [X+0] == search_key_PID goto b1_loc_ED1B
	bcs b1_loc_ECCA                     ; ECC0  25 08         if [X+0] < search_key_PID goto b1_loc_ECCA
	ldd >search_mid                     ; ECC2  FC 1E 05      D = search_mid
	std >search_hi                      ; ECC5  FD 1E 03      search_hi = D
	bra b1_loc_EC8E                     ; ECC8  20 C4         goto b1_loc_EC8E
b1_loc_ECCA:
	ldd >search_mid                     ; ECCA  FC 1E 05      D = search_mid
	std >search_lo                      ; ECCD  FD 1E 01      search_lo = D
	bra b1_loc_EC8E                     ; ECD0  20 BC         goto b1_loc_EC8E
b1_loc_ECD2:
	ldd >search_lo                      ; ECD2  FC 1E 01      D = search_lo
	ldaa $03,y                          ; ECD5  18 A6 03      A = [Y+3]
	mul                                 ; ECD8  3D            D = A * B
	tst >search_mid                     ; ECD9  7D 1E 05      test search_mid
	beq b1_loc_ECE1                     ; ECDC  27 03         if search_mid == 0 goto b1_loc_ECE1
	adda $03,y                          ; ECDE  18 AB 03      A += [Y+3]
b1_loc_ECE1:
	addd $00,y                          ; ECE1  18 E3 00      D += [Y+0]
	std >search_result_ptr              ; ECE4  FD 1D FF      search_result_ptr = D
	xgdx                                ; ECE7  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldab $02,y                          ; ECE8  18 E6 02      B = [Y+2]
	abx                                 ; ECEB  3A            X += B
	ldd $00,x                           ; ECEC  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	cpd >search_key_PID                 ; ECEE  1A B3 1D FD   compare D with search_key_PID
	beq b1_loc_ED1B                     ; ECF2  27 27         if [X+0] == search_key_PID goto b1_loc_ED1B
	ldd >search_hi                      ; ECF4  FC 1E 03      D = search_hi
	ldaa $03,y                          ; ECF7  18 A6 03      A = [Y+3]
	mul                                 ; ECFA  3D            D = A * B
	tst >search_mid                     ; ECFB  7D 1E 05      test search_mid
	beq b1_loc_ED03                     ; ECFE  27 03         if search_mid == 0 goto b1_loc_ED03
	adda $03,y                          ; ED00  18 AB 03      A += [Y+3]
b1_loc_ED03:
	addd $00,y                          ; ED03  18 E3 00      D += [Y+0]
	std >search_result_ptr              ; ED06  FD 1D FF      search_result_ptr = D
	xgdx                                ; ED09  8F            swap D <-> X
	ldab $02,y                          ; ED0A  18 E6 02      B = [Y+2]
	abx                                 ; ED0D  3A            X += B
	ldd $00,x                           ; ED0E  EC 00         D = [X+0]
	cpd >search_key_PID                 ; ED10  1A B3 1D FD   compare D with search_key_PID
	beq b1_loc_ED1B                     ; ED14  27 05         if [X+0] == search_key_PID goto b1_loc_ED1B
b1_loc_ED16:
	ldd #$FFFF                          ; ED16  CC FF FF      D = $FFFF(65535)
	bra b1_loc_ED21                     ; ED19  20 06         goto b1_loc_ED21
b1_loc_ED1B:
	ldd >search_mid                     ; ED1B  FC 1E 05      D = search_mid
	ldx >search_result_ptr              ; ED1E  FE 1D FF      X = search_result_ptr
b1_loc_ED21:
	ins                                 ; ED21  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; ED22  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; ED23  31            SP++
	ins                                 ; ED24  31            SP++
	rts                                 ; ED25  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DPID_record_ptr_ED26
;   analysis [medium]: For a dynamic PID number A=$F0-$FE returns X = $1E20 + (A-$F0)*19 (19-byte DPID definition
;        records, $1E20-$1F29); otherwise X=$FFFF. A preserved.
;   called from: J1850_mode2A_request_DPID_DED0, b1_sub_F5CE
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DPID_record_ptr_ED26:
	psha                                ; ED26  36            push A
	cmpa #$FF                           ; ED27  81 FF         compare A with $FF(255)
	beq b1_loc_ED3A                     ; ED29  27 0F         if A == $FF(255) goto b1_loc_ED3A
	cmpa #$F0                           ; ED2B  81 F0         compare A with $F0(240)
	bcs b1_loc_ED3A                     ; ED2D  25 0B         if A < $F0(240) goto b1_loc_ED3A
	ldab #$13                           ; ED2F  C6 13         B = $13(19)
	suba #$F0                           ; ED31  80 F0         A -= $F0(240)
	mul                                 ; ED33  3D            D = A * B
	addd #$1E20                         ; ED34  C3 1E 20      D += $1E20(7712)
	xgdx                                ; ED37  8F            swap D <-> X
	bra b1_loc_ED3D                     ; ED38  20 03         goto b1_loc_ED3D
b1_loc_ED3A:
	ldx #$FFFF                          ; ED3A  CE FF FF      X = $FFFF(65535)
b1_loc_ED3D:
	pula                                ; ED3D  32            pop A
	rts                                 ; ED3E  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DPID_build_response_ED3F
;   analysis [medium]: Builds a $6A (mode $2A data-by-DPID) response in $1D79: [$1D7D]=DPID number, 6 data bytes
;        at $1D7E. Walks the DPID's 3-byte entries: b3 set = direct memory read (only $1400-$17FF TIO range, read
;        as words), else PID entry -> PID record, calls its handler if address > tbl_5099, copies up to 6 bytes
;        total with IRQs off. Sets [$1D84]=8.
;   called from: J1850_mode2A_request_DPID_DED0, b1_sub_F5CE
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DPID_build_response_ED3F:
	pshy                                ; ED3F  18 3C         push Y
	inx                                 ; ED41  08            X++
	stx >DPID_entry_ptr                 ; ED42  FF 1F 61      DPID_entry_ptr = X
	ldab #$00                           ; ED45  C6 00         B = 0
	stab >DPID_bytes_filled             ; ED47  F7 1F 65      DPID_bytes_filled = B
	stab >ram_v1F60                     ; ED4A  F7 1F 60      ram_v1F60 = B
	ldy #diag_tx_buffer                 ; ED4D  18 CE 1D 79   Y = &diag_tx_buffer
	staa $04,y                          ; ED51  18 A7 04      serial_v1D7D = A
	clra                                ; ED54  4F            A = 0
	std $05,y                           ; ED55  18 ED 05      serial_v1D7D+1 = D
	std $07,y                           ; ED58  18 ED 07      serial_v1D7D+3 = D
	std $09,y                           ; ED5B  18 ED 09      serial_v1D7D+5 = D
	ldaa #$6A                           ; ED5E  86 6A         A = $6A(106) | $6A = positive response to mode $2A (read data by DPID)
	staa $03,y                          ; ED60  18 A7 03      diag_tx_buffer+3 = A
	ldy #$1D7E                          ; ED63  18 CE 1D 7E   Y = $1D7E(7550)
b1_loc_ED67:
	ldab #$01                           ; ED67  C6 01         B = 1
	brclr $00,x,$80,b1_loc_ED89         ; ED69  1F 00 80 1C   if [X+0] .7 clear goto b1_loc_ED89
	brset $00,x,$08,b1_loc_ED8C         ; ED6D  1E 00 08 1B   if [X+0] .3 set goto b1_loc_ED8C | entry flag b7 clear = unused slot, b3 set = memory address entry, else PID entry

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; PID_00_supported_pids_EFDB
;   analysis [medium]: Mode $01/$02 PID $00 handler (called via Y from D645). A=1 (mode $01): $98,$1A/$1B,$00,$10
;        = PIDs 01,04,05,0C,0D,0F,1C (+10 MAF if k_382B!=0); otherwise (freeze frame) $58.. = PIDs 02,04,05,...
;        Result at $1D88-$1D8B, X=$1D88.

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

	abx                                 ; FB8C  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,y                          ; FB8D  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	bita $00,x                          ; FB90  A5 00         test [Y+0] mask [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_FB97                     ; FB92  26 03         if any of [Y+0] mask [X+0] set goto b1_loc_FB97
	pulx                                ; FB94  38            pop X
	bra b1_loc_FBAA                     ; FB95  20 13         goto b1_loc_FBAA
b1_loc_FB97:
	ldx #DTC_confirmed_flags            ; FB97  CE 02 78      X = &DTC_confirmed_flags
	abx                                 ; FB9A  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FB9B  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	pulx                                ; FB9D  38            pop X
	beq b1_loc_FBAA                     ; FB9E  27 0A         if mask [X+0] all clear goto b1_loc_FBAA
	brset <$10,$40,b1_loc_FBAA          ; FBA0  12 10 40 06   if [$10] .6 mode-2 freeze frame latched set goto b1_loc_FBAA
	bset <$10,$40                       ; FBA4  14 10 40      [$10] .6 mode-2 freeze frame latched = 1
	jsr >copy_freeze_frame_to_mode2_FBAE; FBA7  BD FB AE      call copy_freeze_frame_to_mode2_FBAE
b1_loc_FBAA:
	jsr >poll_trans_speed_captures_65FB ; FBAA  BD 65 FB      call poll_trans_speed_captures_65FB
	rts                                 ; FBAD  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; copy_freeze_frame_to_mode2_FBAE
;   analysis [high]: Copies the 62-byte freeze-frame slot at X into 0231-026E (frame reported for OBD mode $02).
;   called from: freeze_frame_capture_F9F7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
copy_freeze_frame_to_mode2_FBAE:
	pshx                                ; FBAE  3C            push X
	pshy                                ; FBAF  18 3C         push Y
	ldy #mode2_freeze_frame             ; FBB1  18 CE 02 31   Y = &mode2_freeze_frame
b1_loc_FBB5:
	ldaa $00,x                          ; FBB5  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	staa $00,y                          ; FBB7  18 A7 00      [Y+0] = A
	inx                                 ; FBBA  08            X++
	iny                                 ; FBBB  18 08         Y++
	cpy #warmups_no_MIL_fault           ; FBBD  18 8C 02 6F   compare Y with &warmups_no_MIL_fault
	bcs b1_loc_FBB5                     ; FBC1  25 F2         if Y < &warmups_no_MIL_fault goto b1_loc_FBB5
	puly                                ; FBC3  18 38         pop Y
	pulx                                ; FBC5  38            pop X
	rts                                 ; FBC6  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
;   analysis [medium]: Unbannered (bytes shown as ptrtab FBC9): called at power-down via far_b1_FBC7_7DC7. jsr
;        FBDD, FC0E, FC29, FCAB, FCF3, FE10 then clears $10.3 so next key-on re-runs DTC_powerup_init.
;   OBD1 LC400 (match 0.88 p1-global): 100ms - 10hz
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7:
	jsr >update_failed_last_trip_FBDD   ; FBC7  BD FB DD      call update_failed_last_trip_FBDD
	jsr >check_warmup_cycle_FC0E        ; FBCA  BD FC 0E      call check_warmup_cycle_FC0E
	jsr >diag_P0101_FC29                ; FBCD  BD FC 29      call diag_P0101_FC29
	jsr >ff_slot_trip_counters_FCAB     ; FBD0  BD FC AB      call ff_slot_trip_counters_FCAB
	jsr >MIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FCF3   ; FBD3  BD FC F3      call MIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FCF3
	jsr >nonMIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FE10; FBD6  BD FE 10      call nonMIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FE10
	bclr <$10,$08                       ; FBD9  15 10 08      [$10] .3 DTC power-up init done this key cycle = 0
	rts                                 ; FBDC  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; update_failed_last_trip_FBDD
;   analysis [medium]: For 15 flag bytes: 02B4 = (02B4
;   failed_this_trip) & ~(passed_this_trip & ~failed_this_trip) - pending 'failed last trip' flags.
;   called from: DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
update_failed_last_trip_FBDD:
	ldab #$0F                           ; FBDD  C6 0F         B = $0F(15)
b1_loc_FBDF:
	ldx #$0020                          ; FBDF  CE 00 20      X = $0020(32)
	abx                                 ; FBE2  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,x                          ; FBE3  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	ldx #$02B3                          ; FBE5  CE 02 B3      X = $02B3(691)
	abx                                 ; FBE8  3A            X += B
	pshb                                ; FBE9  37            push B
	tab                                 ; FBEA  16            B = A
	orab $00,x                          ; FBEB  EA 00         B |= [X+0]
	xgdy                                ; FBED  18 8F         swap D <-> Y
	pulb                                ; FBEF  33            pop B
	pshb                                ; FBF0  37            push B
	ldx #$0010                          ; FBF1  CE 00 10      X = $0010(16)
	abx                                 ; FBF4  3A            X += B
	xgdy                                ; FBF5  18 8F         swap D <-> Y
	pshb                                ; FBF7  37            push B
	tsy                                 ; FBF8  18 30         Y = SP + 1
	eora $00,x                          ; FBFA  A8 00         A ^= [X+0]
	anda $00,x                          ; FBFC  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	coma                                ; FBFE  43            A = ~A
	anda $00,y                          ; FBFF  18 A4 00      A &= [Y+0]
	ldx #$02B3                          ; FC02  CE 02 B3      X = $02B3(691)
	pulb                                ; FC05  33            pop B
	pulb                                ; FC06  33            pop B
	abx                                 ; FC07  3A            X += B
	staa $00,x                          ; FC08  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	decb                                ; FC0A  5A            B--
	bne b1_loc_FBDF                     ; FC0B  26 D2         if B != 0 goto b1_loc_FBDF
	rts                                 ; FC0D  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; check_warmup_cycle_FC0E
;   analysis [medium]: $20.1 = warm-up cycle completed: [$18DA] > 0x94 and rose more than 0x1D above start value
;        02E1 (OBD2 warm-up definition).
;   called from: DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_warmup_cycle_FC0E:
	ldaa >trans_v18DA                   ; FC0E  B6 18 DA      A = trans_v18DA | warm-up: temperature above 0x94 and risen >0x1D counts since start (02E1)
	cmpa #$94                           ; FC11  81 94         compare A with $94(148)
	bls b1_loc_FC20                     ; FC13  23 0B         if trans_v18DA <= $94(148) goto b1_loc_FC20
	suba >startup_coolant_temp          ; FC15  B0 02 E1      A -= startup_coolant_temp
	bcs b1_loc_FC20                     ; FC18  25 06         if A < 0 goto b1_loc_FC20
	cmpa #$1D                           ; FC1A  81 1D         compare A with $1D(29)
	bls b1_loc_FC20                     ; FC1C  23 02         if A <= $1D(29) goto b1_loc_FC20
	bra b1_loc_FC25                     ; FC1E  20 05         goto b1_loc_FC25
b1_loc_FC20:
	bclr <$20,$02                       ; FC20  15 20 02      [$20] .1 warm-up cycle completed this trip = 0
	bra b1_loc_FC28                     ; FC23  20 03         goto b1_loc_FC28
b1_loc_FC25:
	bset <$20,$02                       ; FC25  14 20 02      [$20] .1 warm-up cycle completed this trip = 1
b1_loc_FC28:
	rts                                 ; FC28  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; diag_P0101_FC29
;   analysis [low]: Walks every DTC record 50EB..52B3: for MIL-class codes with MIL requested that passed and did
;        not fail this trip (and $10.5), counts good trips in 02D2 then 02C3; next good trip clears all MIL
;        request bytes 02A5. A failing trip resets both counters.
;   inferred [A, pass A]: sets/clears DTC record(s) P0101
;   called from: DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
diag_P0101_FC29:
	ldy #DTC_P0101                      ; FC29  18 CE 50 EB   Y = &DTC_P0101
b1_loc_FC2D:
	ldx #DTC_cal_mask_37D0              ; FC2D  CE 37 D0      X = &DTC_cal_mask_37D0
	ldd $00,y                           ; FC30  18 EC 00      D = [Y+0]
	abx                                 ; FC33  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FC34  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_FC63                     ; FC36  27 2B         if mask [X+0] all clear goto b1_loc_FC63
	ldx #DTC_MIL_request                ; FC38  CE 02 A5      X = &DTC_MIL_request
	abx                                 ; FC3B  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FC3C  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_FC85                     ; FC3E  27 45         if mask [X+0] all clear goto b1_loc_FC85
	ldx #DTC_first_set_flags            ; FC40  CE 00 21      X = &DTC_first_set_flags
	abx                                 ; FC43  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FC44  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_FC85                     ; FC46  26 3D         if any of mask [X+0] set goto b1_loc_FC85
	ldx #DTC_passed_this_trip           ; FC48  CE 00 11      X = &DTC_passed_this_trip
	abx                                 ; FC4B  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FC4C  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	beq b1_loc_FC9D                     ; FC4E  27 4D         if mask [X+0] all clear goto b1_loc_FC9D
	brclr <$10,$20,b1_loc_FC9D          ; FC50  13 10 20 49   if [$10] .5 trip qualifier for MIL good-trip countin clear goto b1_loc_FC9D | count good trips: 02D2 = 1st, 02C3 = 2nd, 3rd clears MIL requests
	ldd $00,y                           ; FC54  18 EC 00      D = [Y+0]
	ldx #$02D2                          ; FC57  CE 02 D2      X = $02D2(722)
	abx                                 ; FC5A  3A            X += B
	bita $00,x                          ; FC5B  A5 00         test A mask [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_FC65                     ; FC5D  26 06         if any of mask [X+0] set goto b1_loc_FC65
	oraa $00,x                          ; FC5F  AA 00         A |= [X+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; FC61  A7 00         [X+0] = A
b1_loc_FC63:
	bra b1_loc_FC9D                     ; FC63  20 38         goto b1_loc_FC9D
b1_loc_FC65:
	ldx #$02C3                          ; FC65  CE 02 C3      X = $02C3(707)
	abx                                 ; FC68  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,y                          ; FC69  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	bita $00,x                          ; FC6C  A5 00         test [Y+0] mask [X+0]
	bne b1_loc_FC76                     ; FC6E  26 06         if any of [Y+0] mask [X+0] set goto b1_loc_FC76
	oraa $00,x                          ; FC70  AA 00         A |= [X+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; FC72  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	bra b1_loc_FC9D                     ; FC74  20 27         goto b1_loc_FC9D
b1_loc_FC76:
	pshb                                ; FC76  37            push B | note: clears ALL 15 MIL-request bytes, not just this code
	clra                                ; FC77  4F            A = 0
	clrb                                ; FC78  5F            B = 0
	ldx #DTC_MIL_request                ; FC79  CE 02 A5      X = &DTC_MIL_request
b1_loc_FC7C:
	staa $00,x                          ; FC7C  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	inx                                 ; FC7E  08            X++
	incb                                ; FC7F  5C            B++
	cmpb #$0E                           ; FC80  C1 0E         compare B with $0E(14)
	bls b1_loc_FC7C                     ; FC82  23 F8         if B <= $0E(14) goto b1_loc_FC7C
	pulb                                ; FC84  33            pop B
b1_loc_FC85:
	ldx #$02C3                          ; FC85  CE 02 C3      X = $02C3(707)
	abx                                 ; FC88  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,y                          ; FC89  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	coma                                ; FC8C  43            A = ~A
	anda $00,x                          ; FC8D  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; FC8F  A7 00         [X+0] = A
	ldx #$02D2                          ; FC91  CE 02 D2      X = $02D2(722)
	abx                                 ; FC94  3A            X += B
	ldaa $00,y                          ; FC95  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	coma                                ; FC98  43            A = ~A
	anda $00,x                          ; FC99  A4 00         A &= [X+0]
	staa $00,x                          ; FC9B  A7 00         [X+0] = A
b1_loc_FC9D:
	ldab #$04                           ; FC9D  C6 04         B = 4
	aby                                 ; FC9F  18 3A         Y += B
	cpy #tbl_52B3                       ; FCA1  18 8C 52 B3   compare Y with &tbl_52B3
	bcc b1_loc_FCAA                     ; FCA5  24 03         if Y >= &tbl_52B3 goto b1_loc_FCAA
	jmp >b1_loc_FC2D                    ; FCA7  7E FC 2D      goto b1_loc_FC2D
b1_loc_FCAA:
	rts                                 ; FCAA  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; ff_slot_trip_counters_FCAB
;   analysis [medium]: For each of 4 freeze-frame slots, using the DTC record saved at +3C: saturating counts of
;        trips failed (+39), passed (+3A) and not run (+3B).
;   called from: DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ff_slot_trip_counters_FCAB:
	ldaa #$01                           ; FCAB  86 01         A = 1
	psha                                ; FCAD  36            push A
	ldx #freeze_frame_slots             ; FCAE  CE 01 35      X = &freeze_frame_slots
b1_loc_FCB1:
	ldy #DTC_first_set_flags            ; FCB1  18 CE 00 21   Y = &DTC_first_set_flags
	ldd $3C,x                           ; FCB5  EC 3C         D = [X+60] | +3C/+3D of slot = DTC mask/index; count failed/passed/not-run trips
	psha                                ; FCB7  36            push A
	aby                                 ; FCB8  18 3A         Y += B
	anda $00,y                          ; FCBA  18 A4 00      A &= [Y+0]
	beq b1_loc_FCC8                     ; FCBD  27 09         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FCC8
	ldaa $39,x                          ; FCBF  A6 39         A = [X+57]
	inca                                ; FCC1  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_FCE5                     ; FCC2  27 21         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FCE5
	staa $39,x                          ; FCC4  A7 39         [X+57] = A
	bra b1_loc_FCE5                     ; FCC6  20 1D         goto b1_loc_FCE5
b1_loc_FCC8:
	pula                                ; FCC8  32            pop A
	psha                                ; FCC9  36            push A
	ldy #DTC_passed_this_trip           ; FCCA  18 CE 00 11   Y = &DTC_passed_this_trip
	aby                                 ; FCCE  18 3A         Y += B
	anda $00,y                          ; FCD0  18 A4 00      A &= [Y+0]
	beq b1_loc_FCDE                     ; FCD3  27 09         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FCDE
	ldaa $3A,x                          ; FCD5  A6 3A         A = [X+58]
	inca                                ; FCD7  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_FCE5                     ; FCD8  27 0B         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FCE5
	staa $3A,x                          ; FCDA  A7 3A         [X+58] = A
	bra b1_loc_FCE5                     ; FCDC  20 07         goto b1_loc_FCE5
b1_loc_FCDE:
	ldaa $3B,x                          ; FCDE  A6 3B         A = [X+59]
	inca                                ; FCE0  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_FCE5                     ; FCE1  27 02         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FCE5
	staa $3B,x                          ; FCE3  A7 3B         [X+59] = A
b1_loc_FCE5:
	pula                                ; FCE5  32            pop A
	pula                                ; FCE6  32            pop A
	cmpa #$04                           ; FCE7  81 04         compare A with 4
	bcc b1_loc_FCF2                     ; FCE9  24 07         if A >= 4 goto b1_loc_FCF2
	inca                                ; FCEB  4C            A++
	psha                                ; FCEC  36            push A
	ldab #$3E                           ; FCED  C6 3E         B = $3E(62)
	abx                                 ; FCEF  3A            X += B
	bra b1_loc_FCB1                     ; FCF0  20 BF         goto b1_loc_FCB1
b1_loc_FCF2:
	rts                                 ; FCF2  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
; MIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FCF3
;   analysis [medium]: If no MIL-class code failed this or last trip and a warm-up cycle occurred, increments
;        026F; at 40 warm-ups calls FD3E to erase MIL-class codes. Any failure resets the count.
;   called from: DTC_end_of_trip_update_FBC7
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FCF3:
	ldab #$0F                           ; FCF3  C6 0F         B = $0F(15)
	ldx #$002F                          ; FCF5  CE 00 2F      X = $002F(47)
	ldy #tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE    ; FCF8  18 CE 37 DE   Y = &tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE
b1_loc_FCFC:
	ldaa $00,x                          ; FCFC  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	anda $00,y                          ; FCFE  18 A4 00      A &= [Y+0]
	beq b1_loc_FD08                     ; FD01  27 05         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FD08
	clr >warmups_no_MIL_fault           ; FD03  7F 02 6F      warmups_no_MIL_fault = 0
	bra b1_loc_FD3D                     ; FD06  20 35         goto b1_loc_FD3D
b1_loc_FD08:
	dey                                 ; FD08  18 09         Y--
	dex                                 ; FD0A  09            X--
	decb                                ; FD0B  5A            B--
	bne b1_loc_FCFC                     ; FD0C  26 EE         if B != 0 goto b1_loc_FCFC
	ldab #$0F                           ; FD0E  C6 0F         B = $0F(15)
	ldx #$02B3                          ; FD10  CE 02 B3      X = $02B3(691)
	ldy #tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE    ; FD13  18 CE 37 DE   Y = &tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE
b1_loc_FD17:
	ldaa $00,x                          ; FD17  A6 00         A = [X+0]
	anda $00,y                          ; FD19  18 A4 00      A &= [Y+0]
	beq b1_loc_FD23                     ; FD1C  27 05         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FD23
	clr >warmups_no_MIL_fault           ; FD1E  7F 02 6F      warmups_no_MIL_fault = 0
	bra b1_loc_FD3D                     ; FD21  20 1A         goto b1_loc_FD3D
b1_loc_FD23:
	dey                                 ; FD23  18 09         Y--
	dex                                 ; FD25  09            X--
	decb                                ; FD26  5A            B--
	bne b1_loc_FD17                     ; FD27  26 EE         if B != 0 goto b1_loc_FD17
	brclr <$20,$02,b1_loc_FD3D          ; FD29  13 20 02 10   if [$20] .1 warm-up cycle completed this trip clear goto b1_loc_FD3D | count clean warm-up cycles; 40 -> erase MIL-class codes
	ldaa >warmups_no_MIL_fault          ; FD2D  B6 02 6F      A = warmups_no_MIL_fault
	inca                                ; FD30  4C            A++
	beq b1_loc_FD3D                     ; FD31  27 0A         if A == 0 goto b1_loc_FD3D
	staa >warmups_no_MIL_fault          ; FD33  B7 02 6F      warmups_no_MIL_fault = A
	cmpa #$28                           ; FD36  81 28         compare A with $28(40)
	bcs b1_loc_FD3D                     ; FD38  25 03         if warmups_no_MIL_fault < $28(40) goto b1_loc_FD3D
	jsr >erase_MIL_class_DTCs_FD3E      ; FD3A  BD FD 3E      call erase_MIL_class_DTCs_FD3E
b1_loc_FD3D:
	rts                                 ; FD3D  39            return

; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

;   analysis [medium]: Clears MIL-class (37D0 mask) bits in confirmed, history, MIL-request, pending, current and
;        good-trip arrays; frees freeze-frame slots of type 1 and unlatches the mode-2 frame.
;   called from: MIL_DTC_40_warmup_erase_FCF3

erase_MIL_class_DTCs_FD3E:

	ldy #tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE    ; FD40  18 CE 37 DE   Y = &tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE
	ldx #$0286                          ; FD44  CE 02 86      X = $0286(646)
b1_loc_FD47:

	coma                                ; FD4A  43            A = ~A

	ldab #$0F                           ; FD55  C6 0F         B = $0F(15)

	ldab #$0F                           ; FD6C  C6 0F         B = $0F(15)
	ldy #tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE    ; FD6E  18 CE 37 DE   Y = &tbl_DTC_MIL_count_mask_37DE
	ldx #$02B3                          ; FD72  CE 02 B3      X = $02B3(691)
b1_loc_FD75:
	ldaa $00,y                          ; FD75  18 A6 00      A = [Y+0]
	coma                                ; FD78  43            A = ~A
